rows.foe: Free Company, with a Mercenary Commander
Mercenary Commander, with his Free Company
Duke of Bretonnia, with Knights Errant
Black Knight, with a militia horde
Death Knight, with skeletons if refused
Hobgoblin Patrol, led by a Gray Ogre
Savage Orc Scouts, led by an Orc Leader
Savage Orc Captain, with Orc Sentinels
Ice Witches, with their bound dead

tables.name: Lesser Demons of the Outer Dark
Demons and Gods of the Outer Dark

putrefied penitent.name: Putrefied Penitents
putrefied penitent.desc: Heretics reanimated by the Inquisition's own necromancers, working off their sins until the bodies come apart.
putrefied penitent.stat: AC 9, HP 9, ATK 1 slam +1 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D -2, C +2, I -2, W -2, Ch -3, AL L, LV 2
traits: **Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.
**Penance.** Reduced to 0 HP by a non-magical source, DC 12 CON to drop to 1 HP instead.
**Trial.** Before combat, roll 1d6: on a 1 they offer food and drink; on 2–5 they demand
the party submit to an Inquisition trial; on a 6 they attack at once.

mist rat.name: Mist Rat
mist rat.desc: Pale flying rats that want nothing to do with you and everything to do with your baggage.
mist rat.stat: AC 12, HP 4, ATK 1 gnaw +1 (1), MV near (fly), S -2, D +3, C +0, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Thieving Gnaw.** Instead of attacking, one mist rat destroys a single carried item each
round, in this order: a cheese, a day's rations, a scroll, a leather item, then anything
else that is not metal.
**Lanternshy.** Mist rats never approach a character holding a lit lantern.

cursed peasant.name: Cursed Peasant
cursed peasant.desc: Villagers under a blight they cannot name, and pass on by touch.
cursed peasant.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 tool +1 (1d4 + curse), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I -1, W +0, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Curse.** A creature damaged by a cursed peasant makes a DC 12 INT check or is cursed: the first attack or check they make in each fight is at disadvantage, until a remove curse or a cleric's blessing lifts it.

smidge wing.name: Smidge Wing
smidge wing.desc: A cloud of biting wing-things that settles on a traveller and does not leave.
smidge wing.stat: AC 13, HP 5, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4), MV near (fly), S -2, D +3, C +0, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Elusive.** Ranged and bludgeoning attacks against a smidge wing are at disadvantage.
**Kindling.** Fire damage against a smidge wing is rolled with advantage.
**Swarm Upon One.** If two or more strike the same target in a round, that target also
takes 1d4 and is blinded until the end of its next turn.

red hawk.name: Red Hawk
red hawk.desc: Red-feathered raptors that hunt the roadside in flocks and stoop all together.
red hawk.stat: AC 13, HP 5, ATK 1 talons +2 (1d4), MV near (fly), S +0, D +3, C +0, I -3, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Strafing Flock.** Roll 1d6 for the flock at the start of each round. On 1–4 they stay
airborne: each hero they stoop on makes a DC 12 DEX check or takes 1d4, and while the
flock is airborne only ranged attacks and spells can reach it. On 5–6 the flock lands and
fights in melee, and having landed it does not strafe again.

brigand.name: Brigand
brigand.desc: Roadsmen who shoot first and decide afterwards whether it is worth drawing steel.
brigand.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 5, ATK 1 shortbow (far) +1 (1d4) or 1 club +1 (1d4), MV near, S +1, D +1, C +0, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 1
traits: **Ambush.** Deals an extra die of damage when undetected.
**Volley or Vanish.** On the first round, if the brigands outnumber the party they all
shoot and then close to melee. If they do not, they loose one volley and withdraw into
the trees, and the encounter ends.

armed militia.name: Armed Militia
armed militia.desc: Townsfolk with billhooks, standing in a block because nobody told them they could run.
armed militia.stat: AC 13, HP 32, ATK 2 billhook (close/near) +2 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL L, LV 4
traits: **Horde.** Each of its two attacks must target a different creature within close.
**Stubborn.** Unlike other hordes, the militia keeps both attacks below half HP. It
checks morale each round once reduced to a quarter of its HP.

pistolier.name: Pistolier
pistolier.desc: Young gentlemen of the Empire, riding past at speed with a brace of wheel-locks.
pistolier.stat: AC 15 (leather + shield), HP 12, ATK 1 pistol (near) +3 (1d8) or 1 sabre +2 (1d6), MV double near, S +1, D +2, C +0, I +0, W +0, Ch +1, AL L, LV 3
traits: **First Volley.** On the first round every pistolier fires; attacks made that round are
rolled with advantage. Each pistol then bursts or fouls on a d6 roll of 1–3 and cannot be
fired again this encounter.
**Ride By.** After attacking, a pistolier may move up to near without provoking.
**Loot.** 1d6 gp each, and 1d3−1 intact pistols worth 50 gp apiece.

parliamentaire.name: Parliamentaire
parliamentaire.desc: Rides out ahead of the troop under a white glove, and is insulted when it is ignored.
parliamentaire.stat: AC 17 (chainmail + shield), HP 26, ATK 2 sabre +5 (1d8), MV double near, S +2, D +2, C +1, I +1, W +0, Ch +2, AL L, LV 5
traits: **Parley First.** Accompanies any group of five or more pistoliers. Before combat he
offers terms: a toll of 1d8 gp per hero, a wager, or a duel with the party's champion.
**Honour.** If his terms are accepted he keeps them exactly and the troop withdraws.

state troop.name: State Troop
state troop.desc: Drilled Reikland infantry in slashed sleeves, fighting in a hedge of pole arms.
state troop.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 11, ATK 1 halberd (close/near) +3 (1d10), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL L, LV 2
traits: **Reach.** Shields give no AC bonus against a state troop's pole arm.
**Formation.** While two or more state troops are adjacent, a creature that misses one of
them with a melee attack is struck by a second for 1d6. This stops the moment the troops
no longer outnumber their attackers.

flagellant.name: Flagellant
flagellant.desc: Penitents who have already decided how this ends, and get up once more to prove it.
flagellant.stat: AC 10, HP 10, ATK 1 flail +2 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +1, I -2, W -1, Ch -2, AL L, LV 2
traits: **Rise Once.** The first time a flagellant drops to 0 HP, it stands at the start of the
mob's next turn with 3 HP as a bound cadaver. It does not rise a second time, and does
not rise at all if the killing blow was fire or a critical hit.
**Zealots.** Immune to fear. They check morale only once, when half the mob is down.

cursed soldier.name: Cursed Soldier
cursed soldier.desc: What is left of a regiment that camped in the wrong wood, still in uniform.
cursed soldier.stat: AC 13, HP 10, ATK 1 sword +2 (1d8 + curse), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +2, I -1, W -1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Unhallowed.** Only magical weapons and spells harm a cursed soldier. Nonmagical weapons
pass through it.

free company.name: Free Company
free company.desc: A paid-for block of billhooks and bad teeth that fights shoulder to shoulder.
free company.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 28, ATK 2 billhook (close/near) +3 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Horde.** Each of its two attacks must target a different creature within close.
**Broken.** At half HP or less it loses one attack and checks morale each round. Above
half HP it does not check morale at all.

mercenary commander.name: Mercenary Commander
mercenary commander.desc: *Hinsgrim of the Dark Company.* Sells his block by the week and spends it carefully.
mercenary commander.stat: AC 16 (chainmail + shield), HP 19, ATK 2 longsword +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +1, I +1, W +1, Ch +2, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Hold the Line.** While the commander lives, the Free Company does not check morale.
**Paid in Full.** Will accept a bribe of 100 gp to march away, and keeps the bargain.

green slime.name: Green Slime
green slime.desc: It does no harm worth speaking of. What it leaves behind is the problem.
green slime.stat: AC 8, HP 16, ATK 2 touch +3, MV close, S +0, D -2, C +3, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Rot.** A green slime's attacks deal no damage. Instead the target makes a DC 12 CON
check or is infected. An infected creature loses 1 extra HP whenever it takes any damage,
and cannot heal, until a remove curse, a cure, or a cleric's blessing ends it.
**Becoming.** A creature that dies while infected rises as a green slime in 1d4 rounds
and attacks the party.
**Impervious.** Only fire and cold damage a green slime.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale checks and to fear.

gray slime.name: Gray Slime
gray slime.desc: A sheet of grey matter set to guard a door, which eats the gear before it eats the hand.
gray slime.stat: AC 10, HP 14, ATK 2 touch +3 (1d6 + corrode), MV close, S +1, D -2, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Corrode.** On a hit, the target gives up a shield, a weapon, a lantern or a suit of
armour — their choice — or takes 2d6 damage instead.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale checks and to fear.
**Ambusher.** 1-in-6 chance of surprising a party.
**Salt.** A sack of salt deals 2d6 damage and ends its Corrode for the encounter.
**Set to Guard.** Gray slimes are posted at secret doors. A room one was holding may be
searched as though it were empty once the slime is dead.

black ooze.name: Black Ooze
black ooze.desc: A spreading pool that grows a limb for every living thing it can reach.
black ooze.stat: AC 11, HP 22, ATK 3 pseudopod +3 (1d6), MV near (climb), S +2, D +0, C +2, I -4, W -3, Ch -4, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Many Limbs.** Each attack must target a different creature within close.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale checks and to fear.
**Slow.** A creature may withdraw from the ooze without a check; it takes one parting
attack as they go.
**Salt.** A sack of salt (6 gp in any town) thrown onto the ooze destroys it outright.

cavern sludge.name: Cavern Sludge
cavern sludge.desc: It is the floor, until it is not.
cavern sludge.stat: AC 12, HP 26, ATK 2 engulf +4 (1d8), MV near (climb), S +3, D -1, C +3, I -4, W -2, Ch -4, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Many Limbs.** Each attack must target a different creature within close.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.
**The Floor.** 4-in-6 chance of surprising a party that crosses it.

hedge witch.name: Hedge Witch
hedge witch.desc: Keeps to the treeline with a following she did not have to pay for.
hedge witch.stat: AC 12, HP 18, ATK 1 evil eye (near) +4 (1d6) or 1 knife +2 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +1, I +2, W +3, Ch +1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Behind the Hedge.** A hedge witch cannot be harmed by a melee attack while any of her
minions still stands. Spells and ranged attacks reach her normally.
**Evil Eye.** A witch not in melee uses her eye instead of a weapon, always against the
creature with the most current HP.
**Bribe.** 20 gp of jewellery apiece will send her and her following away.
**Her Following (d6).** 1–2 1d6 goblins, 3–4 1d6 orcs (both as the core book), 5–6 1d6 Fungus Leeches (Skaven table).

the headsman.name: The Headsman
the headsman.desc: The town pays him by the neck, and he is used to working where he is not seen.
the headsman.stat: AC 14, HP 29, ATK 2 greatsword +6 (1d12), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Executioner.** On a critical hit, the greatsword deals its damage twice over.
**Unseen.** 2-in-6 chance of surprising a party.
**Paid by the Town.** He will not pursue beyond the walls, and breaks off willingly at
the gate.

witch hunter captain.name: Witch Hunter Captain
witch hunter captain.desc: *Helmut van Hal.* Black hat, two pistols and a list of names.
witch hunter captain.stat: AC 16 (leather + shield), HP 30, ATK 2 pistol (near) +5 (1d8) or 2 rapier +5 (1d8), MV near, S +1, D +3, C +1, I +2, W +3, Ch +2, AL L, LV 6
traits: **Witch Hunter.** Attacks undead, chaos creatures and spellcasters with advantage, and
never checks morale against them.
**He Is Watching.** While the captain lives and can see them, every spellcaster within
far has disadvantage on spellcasting checks.
**Zealot.** Immune to fear and to charm.

winged capricorn.name: Winged Capricorn
winged capricorn.desc: Goat-fish of the clean water, which bless the pool they live in.
winged capricorn.stat: AC 13, HP 14, ATK 2 gore +3 (1d6), MV near (fly), S +2, D +2, C +1, I -1, W +2, Ch +0, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Charge.** On the first round of combat the males attack with advantage and deal +1d6.
**The Herd.** Behind each male come 2d6 females and young (LV 1, HP 4, ATK 1 gore +0
(1d4)), which always flee rather than fight.
**Blessed Water.** They are met only at a pond or river. Every creature regains 1d6 HP
the first time it drinks there.

dread wolf.name: Dread Wolf
dread wolf.desc: They bite and they do not let go.
dread wolf.stat: AC 13, HP 16, ATK 1 bite +4 (1d6 + grip), MV double near, S +3, D +2, C +1, I -1, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Grip.** On a hit, DC 12 STR or the wolf keeps its jaws in: the victim takes 1d6
automatically at the start of each of the wolf's turns and attacks at disadvantage until
the wolf is killed or a DC 12 STR check breaks free.
**Ambush.** Deals an extra die of damage when undetected.

redcap.name: Redcap
redcap.desc: Malign little things that dye their hats in the blood of whoever they catch.
redcap.stat: AC 13, HP 10, ATK 1 blade +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Dancing.** If a redcap kills a creature, every redcap that has not yet acted this round
loses its attack — they are too busy dancing.
**Bribe.** 20 gp buys off every three redcaps.

jabbering jackalope.name: Jabbering Jackalope
jabbering jackalope.desc: Horned hares that will not stand still and will not stop talking.
jabbering jackalope.stat: AC 13, HP 5, ATK 1 gore +2 (1d4), MV double near, S +0, D +3, C +0, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Too Quick.** Melee attacks against a jackalope are at disadvantage.
**All at the Front.** Every jackalope attacks the same target — whoever stands first in
the marching order — until that target drops.

corrupted pixie.name: Corrupted Pixie
corrupted pixie.desc: Small, bright and spiteful, and very interested in what you have written down.
corrupted pixie.stat: AC 14, HP 8, ATK 1 blade +2 (1d4), MV near (fly), S -2, D +4, C +0, I +1, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Scribbler.** At the end of the encounter, each scroll the party carries has a 1-in-6
chance of being scribbled over. Casting from a scribbled scroll fails on a 1–2 on 1d6,
rolled as it is cast. A scroll used to learn a spell is unaffected.
**Invisible.** Can turn invisible for 1d4 rounds; attacking ends it.

treewalker.name: Treewalker
treewalker.desc: The forest remembers what the elves did, and has got up to discuss it.
treewalker.stat: AC 13, HP 17, ATK 2 branch +4 (1d8), MV near, S +4, D -1, C +3, I +0, W +2, Ch -1, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Bark.** Bludgeoning weapons deal half damage. Fire deals double.
**Old Grudge.** Elves defend against a treewalker at disadvantage.
**Bribe.** 50 gp a tree, and they stand aside.

knight errant.name: Knight Errant
knight errant.desc: Young, mounted, and sure that one charge will settle the whole business.
knight errant.stat: AC 16 (chainmail + shield), HP 16, ATK 1 lance (close/near) +4 (1d10) or 1 longsword +3 (1d8), MV double near, S +2, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch +1, AL L, LV 3
traits: **The Lance.** The first attack a knight errant makes in an encounter is rolled with
advantage and deals an extra 1d10. Afterwards they are only men on horses.
**Bribe.** 50 gp each, or a boast worth repeating, buys passage.

manatarm.name: Man-At-Arms
manatarm.desc: Levied off the fields, much reduced in wealth and in stature.
manatarm.stat: AC 13 (leather + shield), HP 10, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +2 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL L, LV 2
traits: **Levy.** Checks morale with disadvantage once any knight present has fallen.

questing knight.name: Questing Knight
questing knight.desc: Sworn to the Grail and to a courtesy that is worse than cruelty.
questing knight.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 26, ATK 2 greatsword +5 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +2, I +0, W +2, Ch +2, AL L, LV 5
traits: **The Vow.** Never checks morale, and never strikes a fleeing foe.
**Again, Then.** A party that flees a questing knight meets the same knight at its next
encounter, at LV 6 and with 32 HP.

the forest drake.name: The Forest Drake
the forest drake.desc: It never lands. It does not need to.
the forest drake.stat: AC 16, HP 30, ATK 1 acid breath (far), MV double near (fly), S +3, D +3, C +3, I +1, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 6
traits: **On the Wing.** The drake cannot be reached by melee attacks at all. Only ranged weapons
and spells touch it.
**Acid Breath.** Its only attack. Each round, every creature within far makes a DC 15 DEX
check or takes 2d6 acid damage, half on a success.
**Terms.** It does not fight for its own sake: it wants something fetched, and will say so
if anyone asks before attacking.

the green knight.name: The Green Knight
the green knight.desc: A malevolent shape-changer who comes as a knight, a black dog, a goat, or a horse.
the green knight.stat: AC 14, HP 25, ATK 2 greatsword +5 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I +2, W +3, Ch +2, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Shape-Changer.** Takes the form of a knight, a black dog, a goat or a horse at will. In
animal form its AC is 14 and it attacks once for 1d8, but it moves double near.
**The Headless Stroke.** A creature that rolls a natural 1 on an attack or a check
against the Green Knight takes 2d10 damage at once.
**Riddling.** Before combat, roll 1d6: 1 he withdraws; 2–3 he poses a riddle and departs
if it is answered; 4–5 he attacks; 6 he lays a curse (disadvantage on checks until
lifted) and departs.

duke of bretonnia.name: Duke Of Bretonnia
duke of bretonnia.desc: *The Grail Vow.* The dukedom in one man, and the charge that goes with him.
duke of bretonnia.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 35, ATK 2 lance (close/near) +7 (1d12) or 2 longsword +7 (1d8+2), MV double near, S +4, D +1, C +3, I +1, W +2, Ch +3, AL L, LV 7
traits: **The Charge.** His first attack of the fight is rolled with advantage and deals an extra
**Grail Vow.** Immune to fear. Never checks morale.
**His Knights.** He rides with 1d6 Knights Errant, and while he lives they do not check
morale either.

swarm of chao wasp.name: Swarm Of Chaos Wasps
swarm of chao wasp.desc: One mind, ten thousand bodies, and a sting that does not care what you are wearing.
swarm of chao wasp.stat: AC 14, HP 15, ATK 2 sting +4 (1d6), MV double near (fly), S -2, D +4, C +1, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Swarm.** Each attack must target a different creature within close. Armour and shields
give no AC bonus against the swarm, magical ones included.
**Dispersing.** Every 6 damage it takes, the swarm loses one attack and 1 to its attack
bonus. It disperses entirely at 0 HP.
**Impervious.** Immune to sleep, charm and morale. A fireball or equivalent area fire
spell destroys the whole swarm outright.

chao gremlin.name: Chaos Gremlin
chao gremlin.desc: They feed on luck, and there is always enough to go round.
chao gremlin.stat: AC 13, HP 11, ATK 1 claw +2 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Ill Fortune.** At the end of each gremlin turn, every character within near must roll
their next check of the round twice and keep the worse result. A cleric's blessing, or
spending a Luck Token, ends this for one character.

forest spite.name: Forest Spite
forest spite.desc: The bray-shamans' rattish familiars. They steal rather than bite.
forest spite.stat: AC 13, HP 9, ATK 1 claw +2 (1d4), MV near (climb), S -1, D +3, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Pilfer.** Instead of attacking, a spite picks a target within close: DC 12 DEX or that
creature loses, in this order, one Luck Token, one unspent spell, one potion, or 1d4 HP.
**No Quarrel.** Forest spites never attack mutated or undead-touched creatures, and
always attack a paladin or cleric of Law first if one is present.

chao acolyte.name: Chaos Acolyte
chao acolyte.desc: The men who followed the drums into the forest and never came back out.
chao acolyte.stat: AC 12 (leather), HP 6, ATK 1 knife +1 (1d4) or 1 sling (near) +1 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +1, I +0, W -1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 1
traits: **Devoted.** Checks morale with advantage while a bray-shaman or beastlord is in sight.

mutant rat.name: Mutant Rat
mutant rat.desc: Their shriek makes the inside of your head the wrong shape for spellcasting.
mutant rat.stat: AC 12, HP 10, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +2, C +1, I -2, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Shriek.** While any mutant rat lives, spellcasting checks within near are at
disadvantage, and scrolls cannot be read at all.
**Gnaw.** If any mutant rat is still alive at the end of the first round, each scroll and
each magic item of cloth, leather or hide carried by the party has a 1-in-6 chance of
being ruined. Roll once for the encounter.

ungor raider.name: Ungor Raider
ungor raider.desc: The small, horned and resentful, who charge first because they are sent first.
ungor raider.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 9, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +1, C +1, I -1, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Fanatic Charge.** On the first round of combat, ungor raiders attack with advantage and
deal +1d6 damage, whether they charge or are charged.

bestigor.name: Bestigor
bestigor.desc: The herd's armoured core, under the standard and behind the great axes.
bestigor.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 24, ATK 2 greataxe +5 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Brutal.** +1 damage with melee weapons (included).
**Under the Standard.** Checks morale with advantage while another bestigor stands.

chao hound.name: Chaos Hound
chao hound.desc: They burn from the inside, and so does everything they breathe on.
chao hound.stat: AC 13, HP 18, ATK 2 bite +4 (1d6 + fire), MV double near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I -2, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Firegut.** At the end of every second round, each creature within near makes a DC 12
DEX check or takes 1d6 fire damage. On a natural 1, a scroll or book they carry burns up.

harpy.name: Harpy
harpy.desc: Filthy wings, a woman's face, and a song you cannot put down.
harpy.stat: AC 13, HP 14, ATK 2 claw +3 (1d6) or 1 song, MV near (fly), S +1, D +3, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch +1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Song.** Enemies who can hear within double near make a DC 12 CHA check or are dazed and drawn to the harpy for 1d4 rounds. Immune for 1 day after passing the check.

chao beast.name: Chaos Beast
chao beast.desc: Mutant animals grown through with bone quills, driven ahead of the herd.
chao beast.stat: AC 13, HP 14, ATK 2 gore +3 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Quills.** 1-in-6 chance the pack has ranged quills; if so, each beast fires one bone
dart (near, +3, 1d6) before melee is joined.
**Driven.** 1-in-6 chance of surprise. 1-in-6 chance a Twisted beastman leads the pack.

gor.name: Gor
gor.desc: The herd proper: tall, horned, and already moving when you see them.
gor.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 20, ATK 2 axe +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Charge.** On the first round of combat, gors attack with advantage.
**Fearless.** Never checks morale.
**Bellow.** At the start of each gor turn, 1-in-8 chance another gor comes out of the
trees and joins the fight.

centigor.name: Centigor
centigor.desc: Horse below, beastman above, drunk on herdstone brew throughout.
centigor.stat: AC 14, HP 22, ATK 2 axe +4 (1d8), MV double near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I -1, W -1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Fanatic Charge.** On the first round, attacks with advantage and deals +1d8.
**Fast.** Centigors act before the party each round unless the party surprised them.
**Drunk.** At the start of each centigor's turn, 1-in-6 chance it tramples another
centigor instead of attacking, dealing 1d8 to it.

minotaur.name: Minotaur
minotaur.desc: It knows the forest the way you know a corridor, and it is already between you and the way out.
minotaur.stat: AC 14 (chainmail), HP 34, ATK 2 greataxe +6 (1d10) and 1 horns +6 (1d12), MV near, S +4, D +1, C +3, I +1, W +2, Ch +1, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Charge.** In place of attacks, move up to double near in a straight line and make 1 horns attack. On a hit, double damage.
**Unerring.** Cannot become lost, and always knows the shortest way out of any enclosed
space.

giant.name: Giant
giant.desc: Big enough that one swing is two problems.
giant.stat: AC 14, HP 30, ATK 2 club +6 (1d12), MV double near, S +5, D -1, C +3, I -2, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Sweeping Blow.** Each attack strikes two creatures within close of one another. Roll
once to hit against each.
**Hurl.** In place of its attacks, throws a boulder at a target within far: +6, 2d8.

jabberslythe.name: Jabberslythe
jabberslythe.desc: Toad, dragon and insect in one body. It grows fat on whatever has already broken you.
jabberslythe.stat: AC 14, HP 26, ATK 3 lash +4 (1d6), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Fed on Fear.** The jabberslythe gains 3 HP for each character in the party currently
suffering a curse, a fear effect, or a lasting madness.
**Grown Stronger.** Roll 1d3 before combat for its power, and it gains another each time
it kills: **1** it heals as much HP as it deals; **2** nobody may be healed until the
fight ends; **3** metal weapons and mind-affecting spells cannot harm it. If a power is
rolled that it already has, its attack bonus and damage rise by 1 instead.

cygor.name: Cygor
cygor.desc: A one-eyed bull-giant that hears magic and throws rocks at it.
cygor.stat: AC 14, HP 26, ATK 2 club +5 (1d10), MV near, S +4, D -1, C +3, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Hurled Rock.** If the cygor surprises the party, its first act is to throw a rock at a
random character: +5, 2d6 damage, range far.
**Sung to Sleep.** If no one has yet struck it, a character may attempt a DC 15 CHA check
to sing the cygor down. On a success it sleeps where it stands and its hoard may be taken.
A bard makes this check with advantage.

chao spawn.name: Chaos Spawn
chao spawn.desc: It was a champion once. It is a bag of mouths now, and it does not stay one thing.
chao spawn.stat: AC 13, HP 24, ATK 3 flail +4 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +3, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Mindless.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.
**Comes Apart.** When the spawn is killed, and also whenever it kills a character, it
splits into 1d4 Lesser Spawn: AC 12, HP 8, ATK 1 flail +2 (1d6), MV near, AL C, LV 2.
Lesser Spawn do not split again.

minosaur.name: Minosaur
minosaur.desc: The cavern strain. Larger, stupider, and harder to put down.
minosaur.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 30, ATK 3 greataxe +6 (1d10), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +3, I -2, W -1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Charge.** The first attack it makes in an encounter is rolled with advantage.
**Thick-Skulled.** Immune to charm, fear and illusion.

brayshaman.name: Bray-Shaman
brayshaman.desc: *Malagor the Dark Omen.* He reads the entrails and the herd does what he says.
brayshaman.stat: AC 13, HP 30, ATK 2 staff +4 (1d6) or 1 spell +6, MV near, S +1, D +1, C +2, I +2, W +3, Ch +1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Entrails.** The herd never checks morale while the bray-shaman lives.
**Viletide (WIS Spell).** DC 12. All creatures within near take 2d6 and make a DC 12 CON
check or are poisoned (disadvantage on attacks) for 1d4 rounds.
**Call the Herd (WIS Spell).** DC 12. 1d4 Gors arrive from the trees within 1d3 rounds.
**Dark Omen (WIS Spell).** DC 12. One creature within far has disadvantage on all rolls
for 1d4 rounds.

minotaur lord.name: Minotaur Lord
minotaur lord.desc: *Gorthor the Beastlord.* Two clubs and a head he intends to use.
minotaur lord.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 30, ATK 2 club +6 (1d10+1) and 1 gore +6 (1d10), MV near, S +4, D +1, C +3, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Charge.** Its first attack of the fight is rolled with advantage.
**Beastlord.** All beastmen within far check morale with advantage while it lives.

ghorgon.name: Ghorgon
ghorgon.desc: *The Great Devourer.* A bull-headed brute that swallows men whole. Spells only feed it.
ghorgon.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 36, ATK 3 great axe +7 (1d12), MV near, S +5, D +0, C +4, I -2, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Devours Magic.** Every spell cast within near of the ghorgon — including from scrolls
and items, by anyone — heals it 1d6 HP, to a maximum of 60.
**Swallow.** On a critical hit, the target is swallowed: 2d6 damage at the start of each
ghorgon turn, and a DC 15 STR check to climb out.

doombull.name: Doombull
doombull.desc: *Taurox the Brass Bull.* It builds. Kill it early or not at all.
doombull.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 40, ATK 1 brass axe +7 (1d12+2), MV near, S +5, D +1, C +4, I -1, W +0, Ch +0, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Builds.** The doombull gains one additional attack at the start of each of its turns
after the first, to a maximum of four attacks.
**Brass Hide.** Immune to fear, charm and sleep. Fire deals half damage.

whip nettle.name: Whip Nettle
whip nettle.desc: A patch of green that leans towards you as you pass it.
whip nettle.stat: AC 12, HP 10, ATK 2 lash +3 (1d4 + poison), MV none, S +1, D +0, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6 and have disadvantage on attacks for 1d4 rounds.
**Ambush.** They are a patch of undergrowth until they move: 3-in-6 chance of surprise.
**Impervious.** Bludgeoning weapons deal half damage. Fire deals double.

creeping centipede.name: Creeping Centipede
creeping centipede.desc: A long, fast, many-legged thing that goes for the hands.
creeping centipede.stat: AC 13, HP 8, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d4 + venom), MV near (climb), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or one arm swells shut for 2 rounds: everything held in it
is dropped, and it cannot be used.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it goes into the leaf litter · 4–5 it rears and holds its ground, striking only what reaches past it · 6 it goes for the nearest hand.

jungle spider.name: Jungle Spider
jungle spider.desc: Small, numerous, and worth harvesting afterwards.
jungle spider.stat: AC 13, HP 4, ATK 1 bite +2 (1 + poison), MV near (climb), S -1, D +3, C +0, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they stay in the canopy · 4–5 they drop on whoever disturbs the web · 6 they drop together.
**Harvest.** Every two jungle spiders killed yield one dose of venom: coat a weapon, and
the next creature it hits makes the same check.

jungle ant.name: Jungle Ant
jungle ant.desc: The mound is bigger than it looks and it is not finished sending them out.
jungle ant.stat: AC 13, HP 4, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4), MV near (climb), S +0, D +2, C +1, I -4, W -2, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **The Mound.** At the end of each party turn, another 1d4 jungle ants emerge, up to a
total of 3d6 for the encounter.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear. Always fights to the death.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 the column is carrying something and goes round the party · 3–4 they swarm anything that touches the mound · 5–6 the mound is already emptying, and they come.

massive mosquito.name: Massive Mosquito
massive mosquito.desc: They take the blood, and the wound does not close behind them.
massive mosquito.stat: AC 13, HP 7, ATK 1 beak +3 (1d4 + bleed), MV near (fly), S -1, D +3, C +0, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Bleed.** A creature wounded by a massive mosquito makes a DC 12 CON check or loses 1 HP
at the start of each of its turns. A cleric's blessing, a healing spell, or a round spent
binding the wound stops it. All bleeding stops when the encounter ends.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they settle on the pack animals and leave the party alone · 4–5 they take the two sweatiest characters · 6 the whole cloud comes.

rainforest jackal.name: Rainforest Jackal
rainforest jackal.desc: They have already worked out which two of you are the weakest.
rainforest jackal.stat: AC 12, HP 11, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6), MV double near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Cull the Weak.** The pack attacks only the two characters with the fewest current HP,
and keeps doing so until one of those two damages the pack with fire or lightning, which
turns the whole pack onto someone else.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they shadow the party from the thicket without closing · 4–5 they close only if the party is strung out · 6 the pack commits at once.

skink skirmisher.name: Skink Skirmisher
skink skirmisher.desc: Blowpipes and javelins, loosed before anyone has decided whether this is a fight.
skink skirmisher.stat: AC 14 (leather), HP 10, ATK 1 blowpipe (far) +3 (1d4 + poison) or 1 javelin (near) +3 (1d6), MV near (swim), S +0, D +3, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL N, LV 2
traits: **First Volley.** Skink skirmishers always act immediately after the party's ranged
attacks on the first round, before anything else resolves.

skink.name: Skink
skink.desc: Small, quick, ravenous, and entirely expendable — and they know it.
skink.stat: AC 13, HP 5, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +2 (1d6), MV near (swim), S +0, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Scatter.** Checks morale with disadvantage, and a fleeing skink moves double near.

sauru warrior.name: Saurus Warrior
sauru warrior.desc: Grown for this and nothing else, and incapable of being talked out of it.
sauru warrior.stat: AC 15 (natural + shield), HP 16, ATK 1 club +4 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +3, I -2, W +0, Ch -2, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Cold-Blooded.** Checks morale with advantage. Immune to fear.

temple guard.name: Temple Guard
temple guard.desc: The Slann's own, in feathered crests, who do not move unless it is threatened.
temple guard.stat: AC 17 (natural + shield), HP 26, ATK 2 halberd (close/near) +5 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +3, I +0, W +2, Ch -1, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Sacred Charge.** While the Slann lives, temple guard never check morale. On the round
it dies, they check at disadvantage.
**Cold-Blooded.** Immune to fear and charm.

carnosaur.name: Carnosaur
carnosaur.desc: Chaotic flesh on a frame that was already large enough.
carnosaur.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 36, ATK 1 bite +7 (2d8) and 2 stomp +7 (1d6), MV double near, S +5, D +1, C +4, I -3, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Chaotic Flesh.** At the start of each of its turns roll 1d6: on a 1 it takes 1d6 damage
as the flesh turns on itself; on a 5–6 its attack bonus and damage rise by 1 until the
fight ends.
**Unstoppable.** Never checks morale. Always fights to the death.

salamander.name: Salamander
salamander.desc: Fire-coloured lizardfolk with flame for a frill, kept by the temple-cities for what burns.
salamander.atk: 2 flaming spear (close/near) +4 (1d6, ignites flammables) or 1 iron longbow (far) +2 (1d8)
salamander.stat: AC 13, HP 24, ATK 2 flaming spear (close/near) +4 (1d6, ignites flammables) or 1 iron longbow (far) +2 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I -1, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Impervious.** Fire immune.
**Heat Aura.** Creatures within close make a DC 12 CON check on their turn or take 1d8 damage.

large intelligent arachnid.name: Large Intelligent Arachnid
large intelligent arachnid.desc: It would genuinely rather make an arrangement than eat you, but it will do either.
large intelligent arachnid.stat: AC 13, HP 25, ATK 2 bite +5 (1d8 + poison), MV near (climb), S +2, D +3, C +2, I +2, W +2, Ch +1, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Web.** A creature that rolls a natural 1 on an attack roll is webbed: it may take no
action, and attacks against it hit automatically. A DC 15 STR check, or 5 fire damage to
the web, frees it.
**Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6.
**The Arrangement.** It always wants the same thing: a living minion brought to it to eat.
It pays 50 gp and a worthwhile trinket, and keeps the bargain.

striped velociraptor.name: Striped Velociraptor
striped velociraptor.desc: It was behind you a moment ago and it is not there now.
striped velociraptor.stat: AC 14, HP 22, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d8), MV double near, S +2, D +4, C +2, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Pack Ambush.** 3-in-6 chance of surprise.
**Open Up.** On a critical hit, the target takes an extra 2d6 and bleeds 1 HP per round
until healed or bound.

maneating plant.name: Man-Eating Plant
maneating plant.desc: The flower is the lure. The stem is the problem.
maneating plant.stat: AC 13, HP 26, ATK 2 vine (near) +5 (1d8), MV none, S +4, D -2, C +3, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Swallow.** On a critical hit the target is swallowed whole. It may do nothing but
attempt a DC 12 STR check each round to climb free, losing 1d6 each round until it does.
The plant can hold only one creature at a time.
**Impervious.** Immune to sleep, charm and morale. Fire deals double damage.

stone temple guardian.name: Stone Temple Guardian
stone temple guardian.desc: It has stood in that doorway for nine hundred years and has no opinion about you.
stone temple guardian.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 31, ATK 1 slam +6 (2d8), MV near, S +4, D -2, C +4, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Elemental Core.** Roll 1d6 on first meeting: 1–2 earth, 3 air, 4–5 fire, 6 water. The
guardian is immune to damage and spells of its own element.
**Construct.** Immune to morale, fear, charm, sleep and poison.
**Set to Guard.** It attacks only those who pass it or strike it. Roll 1d6 on approach:
on 1–2 it ignores the party entirely.

slann magepriest.name: Slann Mage-Priest
slann magepriest.desc: It floats, it does not look at you, and everything it does, it does to your mind.
slann magepriest.stat: AC 13, HP 38, ATK 1 spell +8, MV near (fly), S -2, D +0, C +2, I +5, W +5, Ch +3, AL N, LV 8
traits: **Out of Reach.** The Slann makes no physical attack and cannot make one. It floats above
the palanquin: melee attacks against it are at disadvantage.
**Mind Hammer (INT Spell).** DC 15. One creature within far takes 3d6 and is stunned for
one round — no action, attacks against it have advantage.
**Unmake Thought (INT Spell).** DC 15. One creature within far makes a DC 15 WIS check or
forgets its prepared spells and cannot cast for 1d4 rounds.
**Hold (INT Spell).** DC 15. Up to two creatures within near make a DC 15 WIS check or
are paralysed for 1d4 rounds.
**Second Sight.** Cannot be surprised, and knows when it is lied to.

sauru oldblood.name: Saurus Oldblood
sauru oldblood.desc: Older than the city above him, and entirely without doubt.
sauru oldblood.stat: AC 16 (natural + shield), HP 36, ATK 3 great club +7 (1d10+1), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +4, I +0, W +2, Ch +0, AL N, LV 7
traits: **Cold-Blooded.** Never checks morale, never flees, cannot be bribed, and is immune to
fear and charm.
**Spawn-Lord.** While any Temple Guard still stands, the Oldblood's attacks are rolled
with advantage.

temple guardian beast.name: Temple Guardian Beast
temple guardian beast.desc: A vast horned saurian the Slann woke and never dismissed. Steel mostly glances off.
temple guardian beast.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 46, ATK 2 bite +8 (2d10) and 1 tail +8 (2d6), MV double near, S +6, D +1, C +5, I -2, W +2, Ch -1, AL N, LV 9
traits: **Ancient Hide.** Nonmagical weapons deal half damage.
**Tail Sweep.** In place of its other attacks, every creature within near makes a DC 15
DEX check or takes 2d8 and is knocked prone.
**Do Not Meet This Early.** Never checks morale.

grave hound.name: Grave Hound
grave hound.desc: What was buried with the master, dug back out and still hungry.
grave hound.stat: AC 13, HP 15, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6 + grave rot), MV double near, S +2, D +2, C +1, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Grave Rot.** A creature wounded by a grave hound makes a DC 12 CON check at the start
of each of its turns or loses 1d4 HP. It must succeed on three such checks, not
necessarily consecutive, before the rot ends.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

rat swarm undead.name: Rat Swarm, Undead
rat swarm undead.desc: A swarm that does not disperse, because there is nothing left in it that wants to live.
rat swarm undead.stat: AC 12, HP 16, ATK 2 bite +3 (1d6), MV near (climb), S +0, D +2, C +2, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Swarm.** Each attack must target a different creature within close.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

fell bat.name: Fell Bat
fell bat.desc: Larger, and no longer interested in insects.
fell bat.stat: AC 13, HP 5, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4), MV double near (fly), S +0, D +3, C +0, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 1
traits: **Dive.** On the first round of combat, a fell bat's attack is rolled with advantage.

vampire bat.name: Vampire Bat
vampire bat.desc: Animals, whatever the name says, and loud enough to ruin a spell.
vampire bat.stat: AC 13, HP 4, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4), MV near (fly), S -2, D +3, C +0, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Shrieking.** While vampire bats are in the air, spellcasting checks within near are at
disadvantage.

animated skeleton hand.name: Animated Skeleton Hand
animated skeleton hand.desc: They come up out of the floor of the crypt, and they have been waiting.
animated skeleton hand.stat: AC 13, HP 4, ATK 1 claw +2 (1d4), MV near (climb), S +0, D +2, C +0, I -4, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 1
traits: **Always First.** Animated skeleton hands always surprise a party on first meeting.
**Brittle.** Bludgeoning weapons attack them with advantage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

runner ghoul.name: Runner Ghoul
runner ghoul.desc: Lean, fast, and already in the room by the time anyone has drawn.
runner ghoul.stat: AC 13, HP 11, ATK 1 claw +3 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +3, C +1, I -2, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Always Six.** Runner ghouls are met in packs of exactly six.
**Caught Short.** The party always acts first against runner ghouls — they overrun rather
than ambush.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

crypt ghoul.name: Crypt Ghoul
crypt ghoul.desc: Older, bigger, and used to being fed.
crypt ghoul.stat: AC 14, HP 25, ATK 2 claw +5 (1d8 + paralysis), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Paralysis.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or be paralysed for 1d4 rounds. Attacks against a
paralysed creature hit automatically. Elves are immune; a cleric's blessing frees one
victim.
**Ghoul King.** 1-in-6 chance the pack is led by a ghoul king: AC 15, HP 36, ATK 3 claw
+7 (1d8 + paralysis, DC 15), LV 7.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

grave guard.name: Grave Guard
grave guard.desc: Buried in their armour, and still wearing it.
grave guard.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 16, ATK 1 longsword +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I -2, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Still Armoured.** Bludgeoning weapons gain no advantage against grave guard, and
arrows, bolts and bullets attack them at disadvantage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

shambling corpse.name: Shambling Corpse
shambling corpse.desc: Cut it down and there are two of it.
shambling corpse.stat: AC 10, HP 10, ATK 1 slam +2 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D -2, C +2, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Breaks in Half.** When a shambling corpse is reduced to 0 HP, roll 1d6: on a 1–2 it
splits into two halves, each AC 10, HP 5, ATK 1 slam +1 (1d4), LV 1, and each able to
split once more in the same way. A cleric's blessing, or any fire or holy damage on the
killing blow, prevents the split entirely.
**Soft.** Slashing weapons attack at disadvantage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

zombie.name: Zombie
zombie.desc: Slow, patient, and difficult to discourage.
zombie.stat: AC 8, HP 11, ATK 1 slam +2 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D -2, C +2, I -2, W -2, Ch -3, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Relentless.** Reduced to 0 HP by a non-magical source, DC 15 CON to drop to 1 HP
instead.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.desc: The paralysis is the point. The eating comes afterwards.
ghoul.stat: AC 11, HP 11, ATK 1 claw +2 (1d6 + paralyze), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I -3, W -1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Paralyze.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or paralyzed 1d4 rounds.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

dire wolf.name: Dire Wolf
dire wolf.desc: They close before the infantry does, every time.
dire wolf.stat: AC 12, HP 19, ATK 2 bite +4 (1d8), MV double near, S +3, D +2, C +1, I -1, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Pack Hunter.** Attacks with advantage while an ally is within close of its target.
**Ahead of the Line.** Dire wolves always act on the first round before any other foe in
the encounter.

banshee.name: Banshee
banshee.desc: She has decided something about you and you will hear about it.
banshee.stat: AC 13, HP 27, ATK 1 wail, MV near (fly), S +0, D +3, C +0, I +1, W +3, Ch +2, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Wail.** Its only attack. Every creature within far that can hear makes a DC 15 CON
check or takes 2d6 and is held for one round — no action, attacks against it have
advantage.
**Incorporeal.** Only magical, silvered or blessed weapons and spells harm her.

**Reactions (d6).** 1 she asks for something and departs if promised; 2 she blesses one character (advantage on its first attack each round in the next fight); 3–4 she curses one (disadvantage on checks until lifted); 5–6 she wails at once.

barghest.name: Barghest
barghest.desc: The black dog that waits in the graveyard for someone to be alone.
barghest.stat: AC 14, HP 26, ATK 2 bite +5 (1d8), MV double near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +2, Ch -1, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Knocked Down.** The first blow a barghest lands in an encounter knocks its target
prone: that character forfeits its next action.
**Always Fights.** Never checks morale.

barrow wight.name: Barrow Wight
barrow wight.desc: It was put in the mound with its sword and it has kept hold of it.
barrow wight.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 25, ATK 2 ancient blade +5 (1d8 + drain), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Drain.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or lose a level.
**Grave-Bound.** Only magical or blessed weapons harm it. Within its own barrow it
regains 1d6 HP at the start of each of its turns.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

spectre.name: Spectre
spectre.desc: A shape that is cold where it passes, and remembers being angry.
spectre.stat: AC 13, HP 23, ATK 2 chilling touch +5 (1d8 + drain), MV near (fly), S +0, D +3, C +0, I +1, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Incorporeal.** Only magical, silvered or blessed weapons and spells harm it. It passes
through walls.
**Drain.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or lose a level (see above).
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison. Sunlight destroys it.

wurdalak.name: Wurdalak
wurdalak.desc: A shapeshifter that is usually already a wolf when you meet it.
wurdalak.stat: AC 14, HP 25, ATK 2 bite +5 (1d8), MV double near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Already Running.** 3-in-6 chance it is met in wolf shape. In wolf shape its bite deals
+1d8, and checks to flee or escape it are at disadvantage.
**Held by Faith.** A brandished holy symbol holds the wurdalak at bay: it cannot approach
within close while a character succeeds on a DC 12 WIS check each round.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

varghulf.name: Varghulf
varghulf.desc: A vampire that stopped being careful about what it looked like.
varghulf.stat: AC 14, HP 30, ATK 2 claw +6 (1d10), MV double near, S +4, D +2, C +3, I -1, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Bull Rush.** A creature struck by the varghulf attacks at disadvantage on its next turn.
**Regeneration.** Regains 1d6 HP at the start of its turn unless it took fire or holy
damage since its last turn.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

vampire lord.name: Vampire Lord
vampire lord.desc: *Mannfred von Carstein.* And he does not stay dead unless it is done properly.
vampire lord.stat: AC 16, HP 45, ATK 3 claw +8 (1d10+1 + drain), MV double near (climb, fly), S +5, D +4, C +4, I +3, W +3, Ch +4, AL C, LV 9
traits: **Drain.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or lose a level. He regains 2d6 HP each time.
**Hard to Kill.** Harmed only by magical weapons, spells, holy water, or a critical hit.
**Does Not Stay Dead.** Reduced to 0 HP, the lord collapses. Unless the body is burned or
staked through the heart before the end of the next day, he rises the following night at
full HP and comes looking.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

vampire thrall.name: Vampire Thrall
vampire thrall.desc: *Konrad von Carstein.* All of the hunger and none of the patience.
vampire thrall.stat: AC 14, HP 36, ATK 2 claw +6 (1d8 + drain), MV double near, S +3, D +3, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +2, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Drain.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or lose a level.
**Hard to Kill.** Harmed only by magical weapons, spells, holy water (1d6 a vial), or a
critical hit from any weapon.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

black knight.name: Black Knight
black knight.desc: *The Drachenfels Guard.* He rides at the head of whatever the town could raise.
black knight.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 29, ATK 2 lance (close/near) +6 (1d10), MV double near, S +3, D +1, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Cold Iron Only.** Harmed only by magical weapons, masterwork weapons, or spells.
**At the Head.** Rides with an Armed Militia horde, which does not check morale while he
lives.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.desc: *Heinrich Kemmler · the Witch Lord of Barak Tor · Fanrax the Malicious.* Robed, and raising your dead faster than you can put them down.
necromancer.stat: AC 13, HP 29, ATK 2 staff +5 (1d6) or 1 spell +7, MV near, S +0, D +1, C +2, I +4, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Warded.** Spells cast at the necromancer fail entirely on a d6 roll of 4–6.
**Grave Chill.** A creature he wounds has disadvantage on its next attack against him.
**Oblivious.** He does not watch his own back. A rogue or assassin who is undetected may
make one attack against him that hits automatically and deals triple damage.
**Raise Dead (INT Spell).** DC 15. 1d4 zombies rise from any corpses within near.
**Deathbolt (INT Spell).** DC 15. One creature within far takes 3d6.

death knight.name: Death Knight
death knight.desc: *Walach Harkon.* He would rather this were done properly, one against one.
death knight.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 35, ATK 2 black blade +7 (1d10+2), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +3, I +1, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 7
traits: **The Trial.** He offers a quest, or single combat against the party's champion. If the
offer is refused he calls up 1d6+2 armoured skeletons (AC 15, HP 11, ATK 1 sword +3
(1d8), LV 2; slashing weapons at disadvantage) and fights to the death.
**Broken Word.** A party that accepts his quest and returns without it is struck first,
and his attacks that fight are rolled with advantage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

wraith.name: Wraith
wraith.desc: It puts the lights out first.
wraith.stat: AC 14, HP 36, ATK 3 death touch +6 (1d10 + life drain), MV near (fly), S -4, D +4, C +0, I +0, W +0, Ch +3, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Greater Undead.** Immune to morale. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.
**Incorporeal.** In place of attacks, becomes corporeal or incorporeal.
**Life Drain.** On a hit, 1d4 CON damage. Death at 0 CON.
**Darkness.** 2-in-6 chance that every light source in the room goes out for the fight
and cannot be relit.

vampire count.name: Vampire Count
vampire count.desc: *Vlad and Isabella von Carstein.* They have been here a very long time.
vampire count.stat: AC 15, HP 39, ATK 3 claw +7 (1d10 + drain), MV double near (climb), S +4, D +3, C +3, I +2, W +2, Ch +4, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Drain.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or lose a level. The count regains 2d6 HP each time a
level is drained.
**Nothing Else Works.** Sunlight, holy water and fire damage the count normally. Every
other source of damage deals a maximum of 1 HP per round, however it is rolled.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

zombie dragon.name: Zombie Dragon
zombie dragon.desc: It does not breathe fire any more. It breathes what is left in its lungs.
zombie dragon.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 40, ATK 2 bite +7 (2d8) and 1 grave breath, MV double near (fly), S +5, D +0, C +4, I -2, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Grave Breath.** In place of its bites, all creatures within near make a DC 15 CON check
or take 3d6 and are poisoned (disadvantage on attacks) for 1d4 rounds.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep, poison and disease.

goblin wolf rider.name: Goblin Wolf Rider
goblin wolf rider.desc: Rider and wolf are one encounter and two problems.
goblin wolf rider.stat: AC 15 (leather + shield), HP 10, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +2 (1d6), MV double near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Charge.** On the first round of combat, each rider's attack is rolled with advantage.
**The Wolf.** Each rider is astride a wolf: AC 12, HP 9, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d6), MV double
near, LV 2.
**Both Must Fall.** Kill the rider and the wolf fights on, checking morale at
disadvantage. Kill the wolf and the rider fights on at disadvantage. The pair counts as
slain only when both are down.

goblin archer.name: Goblin Archer
goblin archer.desc: One volley, and then they remember they have knives.
goblin archer.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 5, ATK 1 shortbow (far) +2 (1d6) or 1 knife +1 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 1
traits: **One Volley.** Every goblin archer looses a single arrow before contact is made. From
the following round they fight with knives and do not shoot again.

goblin spearman.name: Goblin Spearman
goblin spearman.desc: A hedge of points held by people who would rather be behind it.
goblin spearman.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 5, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +1 (1d6), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 1
traits: **Ranks.** While three or more goblin spearmen are adjacent, each attacks with advantage.

goblin mob.name: Goblin Mob
goblin mob.desc: More of them than anyone has bothered to count, including them.
goblin mob.stat: AC 12, HP 5, ATK 1 club +1 (1d6), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +1, I -1, W -1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 1
traits: **Mob.** Attacks with advantage in melee while adjacent to another goblin.
**Big Boss.** 1-in-6 chance the mob is led by a Goblin Big Boss (see *Goblin Bosses*).

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.desc: The common sort, in numbers, with a grudge against dwarves.
goblin.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 club +0 (1d4) or 1 shortbow (far) +1 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +1, I -1, W -1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 1
traits: **Keen Senses.** Cannot be surprised.
**Grudge.** Attacks dwarves with advantage.
**Wary.** 1-in-6 chance of surprise. Goblins met as wandering monsters still get a
reaction roll — they are as likely to bargain as to fight.

night goblin.name: Night Goblin
night goblin.stat: AC 12, HP 10, ATK 1 crude club +2 (1d6), MV near, S +0, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Out of the Dark.** 2-in-6 chance of surprise. Night goblins see in the dark.
**Crude Clubs.** They attack anyone wearing chainmail or plate with disadvantage.
**Light-Shy.** Checks morale with disadvantage in bright light.

goblin knife fighter.name: Goblin Knife Fighter
goblin knife fighter.desc: Fast, low, and in under your guard.
goblin knife fighter.stat: AC 14 (leather), HP 10, ATK 1 knife +3 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +3, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Gutter Work.** Deals an extra 1d4 against a target that has already been struck this
round by another goblin.

goblin hunter.name: Goblin Hunter
goblin hunter.desc: The wild kind, met a long way from any camp and not pleased about it.
goblin hunter.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 10, ATK 1 shortbow (far) +2 (1d6) or 1 knife +2 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Stalkers.** 2-in-6 chance of surprise.
**Skittish.** Checks morale with disadvantage.

goblin sentinel.name: Goblin Sentinel
goblin sentinel.desc: Posted at the warren mouth, and far more interested in shrieking than in fighting.
goblin sentinel.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 10, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +2 (1d6), MV near, S +0, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Raise the Alarm.** A sentinel's first action is always to raise the alarm rather than
to fight. 1d4 rounds later, the Warriors arrive; 1d4 rounds after that, the Brutes.

goblin warrior.name: Goblin Warrior
goblin warrior.desc: The camp's standing troops, which is to say everyone who could be found.
goblin warrior.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 8, ATK 1 shortsword +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **At Home.** In their own camp, goblin warriors check morale with advantage.

goblin brute.name: Goblin Brute
goblin brute.desc: The biggest in the warren, which is not saying much, with the heaviest club, which is.
goblin brute.stat: AC 14, HP 20, ATK 1 great club +4 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Crushing Blow.** On a critical hit, the target is knocked prone and forfeits its next
action.

goblin fanatic.name: Goblin Fanatic
goblin fanatic.desc: *Whirling Death.* He is not steering and he cannot stop.
goblin fanatic.stat: AC 11, HP 26, ATK 2 ball and chain +5 (1d10), MV double near, S +3, D +1, C +2, I -3, W -2, Ch -3, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Whirling.** On a critical hit the target takes the damage twice. A character may give
up a shield — it is torn away and destroyed — to reduce this to normal damage.
**Cannot Stop.** Never checks morale, and must move at least near every round in a
straight line. Always fights.

goblin berserker.name: Goblin Berserker
goblin berserker.desc: *Da Mad One.* Something was done to him and nobody will say what.
goblin berserker.stat: AC 12, HP 20, ATK 2 axe +4 (1d8+1), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I -2, W -2, Ch -3, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Fearless.** Never checks morale. Immune to fear. Always fights to the death.
**Frenzy.** From the third round on, he attacks with advantage.

goblin nightblade.name: Goblin Nightblade
goblin nightblade.desc: *Backstabba.* He prefers the dark and he can see in it.
goblin nightblade.stat: AC 15 (leather), HP 22, ATK 2 blade +4 (1d6+1), MV near, S +1, D +4, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **In the Dark.** In darkness or dim light his attacks deal +1d6, and creatures cannot
hide from him — his darkvision negates stealth.

goblin skulker.name: Goblin Skulker
goblin skulker.desc: *Mistcloak.* You will not see him until he has already decided.
goblin skulker.stat: AC 15 (leather), HP 19, ATK 2 knife +4 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +4, C +1, I +1, W +2, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Unseen.** 4-in-6 chance of surprising a party.
**Slip Away.** May withdraw from melee without provoking, and hides as a free action
whenever there is cover.

night goblin shaman.name: Night Goblin Shaman
night goblin shaman.desc: *Skarsnik's Whisperer.* Fungus, spite and one very bad idea.
night goblin shaman.stat: AC 13, HP 20, ATK 1 staff +3 (1d6) or 1 spell +5, MV near, S +0, D +1, C +1, I +2, W +3, Ch +0, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Hex (WIS Spell).** DC 12, cast on his first turn against a random character: the first attack or check they make in each fight is at disadvantage, until a cleric's blessing or *remove curse* lifts it.
**Fungus-Addled.** Advantage on checks to resist sleep, charm and illusion.
**Bad Moon (WIS Spell).** DC 12. All creatures within near take 2d6, and goblins within
near attack with advantage next round.

goblin big boss.name: Goblin Big Boss
goblin big boss.desc: *Grishnak · Skarsnik.* The one the warren actually listens to.
goblin big boss.stat: AC 16 (chainmail + shield), HP 25, ATK 3 choppa +5 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Hates Elves.** Attacks elves with advantage.
**Bodyguard.** 2-in-6 chance he is attended by 1d3 Goblin Brutes.
**Boss.** All goblins within far check morale with advantage while he lives, and at
disadvantage on the round he falls.

orc boy.name: Orc Boy
orc boy.desc: Green, loud, and genuinely frightened of magic.
orc boy.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 14, ATK 1 choppa +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Hates Elves.** Attacks elves with advantage.
**Superstitious.** Checks morale whenever one or more orcs is killed by a spell, and at
disadvantage once the group is below half strength.
**No Magic.** Orc boys never carry magic items. Treat any magic result as 2d6 × 10 gp.

black orc.name: Black Orc
black orc.desc: Bigger, better armoured, and disciplined enough to be frightening.
black orc.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 22, ATK 2 greataxe +4 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +3, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **No Animosity.** Black orcs never bicker, and other greenskins within near do not
either.
**Bribe.** 50 gp each will send them elsewhere, and they take it seriously.

orc arrer boy.name: Orc Arrer Boy
orc arrer boy.desc: One arrow each, because orcs do not shoot into a scrum.
orc arrer boy.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 16, ATK 1 bow (far) +4 (1d6) or 1 choppa +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **One Shot.** Each arrer boy looses a single arrow before contact. From the next round
they fight hand to hand and do not shoot again.

orc looter.name: Orc Looter
orc looter.desc: Here for what is portable, and willing to fight about it.
orc looter.stat: AC 13 (leather + shield), HP 9, ATK 1 choppa +3 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Animosity.** At the start of each of their turns, 1-in-6 chance that the group falls
to bickering and does nothing that round.
**Laden.** Carries 2d6 gp of other people's property.

mountain orc.name: Mountain Orc
mountain orc.desc: Hardier, higher up, and used to the cold.
mountain orc.stat: AC 14, HP 17, ATK 1 axe +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +3, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Sure-Footed.** No penalty for fighting on steep or broken ground, and advantage on
checks to climb.

orc boar boy.name: Orc Boar Boy
orc boar boy.desc: Mounted on something as bad-tempered as the rider.
orc boar boy.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 18, ATK 1 choppa +4 (1d8) and 1 boar tusk +4 (1d6), MV double near, S +3, D +1, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Charge.** 2-in-6 chance of surprise, and every character on foot attacks at
disadvantage for the first round.
**Superstitious.** As Orc Boy.
**No Magic.** Treat any magic result as 2d6 × 20 gp.

orc warboss.name: Orc Warboss
orc warboss.desc: *Gorgut · Grimgor Ironhide · Ulag.* The warren follows him, and stops when he does.
orc warboss.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 36, ATK 2 great choppa +7 (1d12+2), MV near, S +5, D +0, C +4, I +0, W +1, Ch +2, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Hates Elves.** Attacks elves with advantage.
**Warboss.** Every greenskin within far checks morale with advantage while he lives, and
the whole warband breaks the round he falls.
**No Magic.** Treat any magic result as 3d6 × 20 gp.

orc big un.name: Orc Big 'Un
orc big un.desc: *Grimcrag · Azhag the Slaughterer · Ograk.* Four swings and a masterwork choppa.
orc big un.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 30, ATK 4 choppa +6 (1d8+1), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +3, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Hates Elves.** Attacks elves with advantage.
**Big Target.** Spells target him with advantage, and once he has been wounded by a spell
he loses the masters' advantage on morale.
**Masterwork Choppa.** In his hands it deals +1 damage (included). Sells for 120 gp.

orc shaman.name: Orc Shaman
orc shaman.desc: *Skabnoze · Grawshak of the Northern Tribes.* The Waaagh! has to go somewhere.
orc shaman.stat: AC 14, HP 25, ATK 2 staff +5 (1d6) or 1 spell +6, MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I +1, W +3, Ch +0, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Waaagh! Energy.** At the start of each of his turns, 2-in-6 chance that 1d3 Orc Boyz
arrive from somewhere nearby.
**Green Fist (WIS Spell).** DC 12. One creature within far takes 2d6 and makes a DC 12
INT check or attacks at disadvantage until the shaman falls.

squig herder.name: Squig Herder
squig herder.desc: *Nibbla.* He is not in charge of it so much as attached to it.
squig herder.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 20, ATK 1 prodder (close/near) +4 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Bound Pair.** If the herder or his squig dies, the survivor checks morale immediately.

cave squig.name: Cave Squig
cave squig.desc: A mouth with legs, and the legs are optional.
cave squig.stat: AC 14, HP 30, ATK 3 bite +6 (1d8), MV double near, S +4, D +2, C +3, I -4, W -1, Ch -4, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Bounding.** Moves double near and may not be opportunity-attacked.
**Mindless.** Immune to fear and charm. Checks morale only through its herder.

orc bodyguard.name: Orc Bodyguard
orc bodyguard.desc: *Grak, Da Boss's Best.* Armour thick enough to make the point.
orc bodyguard.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 26, ATK 2 choppa +5 (1d8+1), MV near, S +3, D -1, C +3, I -1, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Deflecting Plate.** 2-in-6 chance that any non-magical attack that would hit him is
turned aside entirely.
**Interpose.** May take a hit aimed at the boss he guards.

orc siege veteran.name: Orc Siege Veteran
orc siege veteran.desc: *Skarrag.* He has done this to walls and does not see much difference.
orc siege veteran.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 30, ATK 3 flail +6 (1d10), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +3, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Flail.** Shields give no AC bonus against his attacks.
**Veteran.** Checks morale with advantage, and is immune to fear.

goblin troop.name: Goblin Troop
goblin troop.desc: Fed on moss-troll dung, and grabby with it.
goblin troop.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 11, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +1, C +2, I +0, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Grab.** While the goblins outnumber the party, a character struck by one must make a DC
12 STR check or have their shield wrenched away, losing its bonus until the goblins no
longer outnumber the party.

orc infantry.name: Orc Infantry
orc infantry.desc: They close ranks as they fall, and it works.
orc infantry.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 15, ATK 1 choppa +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Close Ranks.** Once half the infantry are down, the survivors attack with advantage.

goblin henchman.name: Goblin Henchman
goblin henchman.desc: Shoved to the front, and very good at not being there.
goblin henchman.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 10, ATK 1 knife +2 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Ducks.** 2-in-6 chance that any attack which would hit a goblin henchman misses
entirely.

orc bandit.name: Orc Bandit
orc bandit.desc: They take the front and they take the loot.
orc bandit.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 14, ATK 1 choppa +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Always Fight.** Orc bandits never check morale while any goblin henchman still stands.

goblin lackey.name: Goblin Lackey
goblin lackey.desc: Roped to the slavers' service and no happier for it.
goblin lackey.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 10, ATK 1 club +2 (1d6), MV near, S +0, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2

gray halforc slaver.name: Gray Half-Orc Slaver
gray halforc slaver.desc: They would rather take you alive, which is worse.
gray halforc slaver.stat: AC 15 (leather + shield), HP 18, ATK 1 lasso (near) +4 or 1 blade +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Lasso.** Instead of a weapon attack: DC 12 DEX or the target is roped. A roped
character may take no action and is hit automatically, taking 1d6 each round from the
drag, until it succeeds on a DC 12 STR check. Ogres and other large creatures make this
check with advantage.

hobgoblin cutthroat.name: Hobgoblin Cutthroat
hobgoblin cutthroat.desc: Taller, meaner, and organised, which is the problem.
hobgoblin cutthroat.stat: AC 15 (chainmail), HP 20, ATK 1 sword +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Outnumbering.** While the cutthroats outnumber the party, they attack with advantage.

orc runner.name: Orc Runner
orc runner.desc: Sent ahead to find out what is there, and worth catching before they report.
orc runner.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 20, ATK 1 choppa +4 (1d8), MV double near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Always Fight.** Never checks morale.
**Worth Catching.** A party that kills every orc runner before one escapes learns the
layout of the warren ahead.

troll.name: Troll
troll.desc: Tall, stupid, hungry, and it knits back together while you watch.
troll.stat: AC 12, HP 24, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d6) and 1 bite +4 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Regenerate.** Regains 2d6 HP on its turn unless its wounds are cauterized with fire or acid.

hobgoblin blademaster.name: Hobgoblin Blademaster
hobgoblin blademaster.desc: The ones who got good at it, and who know it.
hobgoblin blademaster.stat: AC 16 (chainmail), HP 22, ATK 2 sword +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +3, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Blademaster.** Rolls initiative with advantage, and deals +1d8 on a critical hit.

hobgoblin.name: Hobgoblin
hobgoblin.desc: Disciplined where orcs are not, which makes them worse.
hobgoblin.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 10, ATK 1 longsword +3 (1d8) or 1 longbow (far) +0 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +1, I +2, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Phalanx.** Attacks with advantage while within close of an allied hobgoblin.
**Drilled.** Checks morale with advantage while a leader lives.

gray ogre.name: Gray Ogre
gray ogre.desc: Three times the size of what it leads, and twice as quick to take offence.
gray ogre.stat: AC 14, HP 30, ATK 2 club +6 (1d10+1), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +3, I -2, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Retaliate.** When the ogre is wounded, 2-in-6 chance it strikes back immediately,
out of turn, against whoever hurt it.
**Menacing.** Hobgoblins it leads check morale with advantage.

deep troll.name: Deep Troll
deep troll.desc: Smaller than a proper troll, and no easier to keep down.
deep troll.stat: AC 13, HP 17, ATK 1 claw +3 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +3, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Regeneration.** At the end of any deep troll turn, one slain deep troll stands back up
with 1d6 HP and fights from the following round. A character may spend one action hacking
a corpse apart to prevent that corpse rising, and fire damage on the killing blow
prevents it entirely.
**Bribe.** Gems, at least one per troll, and they let the party by.

enslaved troll.name: Enslaved Troll
enslaved troll.desc: Collared, driven, and still the hardest thing in the room.
enslaved troll.stat: AC 14, HP 21, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +3, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Gets Back Up.** Each round after an enslaved troll is killed, roll 1d6: on a 5–6 it
stands with half its HP and fights again, and it keeps rolling every round until someone
spends an action chopping the corpse to pieces. A troll killed by a spell does not rise.

baalgarg.name: Baalgarg
baalgarg.desc: The hobgoblin that a chaos-touched warren turned into something else.
baalgarg.atk: 2 claw +7 (1d8) and 1 tail slap +7 (1d8) and 1 bite +7 (1d12)
baalgarg.stat: AC 16, HP 40, ATK 2 claw +7 (1d8) and 1 tail slap +7 (1d8) and 1 bite +7 (1d12), MV near, S +4, D +2, C +4, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Demon-Touched.** Immune to fear and charm. Non-magical weapons deal half damage.
**Where He Is Found.** Roll Baalgarg only where a warren has been chaos-touched.

ogre chieftain.name: Ogre Chieftain
ogre chieftain.desc: The bellow comes before the club and does more damage.
ogre chieftain.stat: AC 14, HP 35, ATK 2 great club +7 (1d12+1), MV near, S +5, D +0, C +3, I -1, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Battle Cry.** Once per encounter, as its first action: every character within far makes
a DC 12 WIS check or cannot score critical hits for the rest of the encounter. Paladins
are immune.

hobgoblin champion.name: Hobgoblin Champion
hobgoblin champion.desc: *Oglok the Mighty.* The rattleblade is a signal as much as a sword.
hobgoblin champion.stat: AC 17 (chainmail + shield), HP 29, ATK 2 rattleblade +6 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Rattleblade.** Each time he attacks, 3-in-6 chance that 1d4 Hobgoblin Blademasters
arrive. This happens once per encounter only.

dark ogre.name: Dark Ogre
dark ogre.desc: Something in it eats magic before the magic arrives.
dark ogre.stat: AC 15, HP 30, ATK 2 club +6 (1d10+2), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +3, I -1, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Sweep.** On a critical hit, one additional character of the ogre's choice within close
takes 1d10.
**Magic Resistance.** Every spell or prayer cast within near of the dark ogre — scrolls
and magic items included — requires its caster to succeed on a DC 15 check of the
relevant stat, or the casting is wasted.

ogre.name: Ogre
ogre.desc: *Golgfag Maneater.* Paid in meat, and not fussy about the source.
ogre.stat: AC 9, HP 30, ATK 2 greatclub +6 (2d6), MV near, S +4, D -1, C +3, I -2, W -2, Ch -2, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Maneater.** Will take a contract from anyone, and keeps it as long as the food lasts.

stone troll.name: Stone Troll
stone troll.desc: Arrows bounce. Clubs skid. Give it time and it knits itself back together.
stone troll.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 36, ATK 2 stone club +6 (1d12), MV near, S +4, D -1, C +4, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Stone Skin.** Bludgeoning weapons attack at disadvantage. Arrows, bolts and sling
stones deal no damage at all.
**Slow Regeneration.** Regains 1d6 HP at the end of every second round.
**Its Club.** Cannot be sold, but a character of great size or strength may wield it as a
two-handed non-metallic weapon dealing 1d12.

chao troll.name: Chaos Troll
chao troll.desc: *Throgg.* Whatever chaos did to it, it has not finished.
chao troll.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 36, ATK 2 claw +7 (1d10+1), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +4, I -2, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Mutated Hide.** Bludgeoning weapons attack at disadvantage.
**Regeneration.** Regains 2d6 HP at the start of its turn unless it took fire or acid
damage since its last turn.

dark ogre champion.name: Dark Ogre Champion
dark ogre champion.desc: Bigger, and the wild swings are worse than the aimed ones.
dark ogre champion.stat: AC 16, HP 40, ATK 4 club +7 (1d10+2), MV near, S +5, D +0, C +4, I -1, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Wild Swing.** On a critical hit it immediately makes one extra attack against a random
character within close — possibly the same one.
**Magic Resistance.** As Dark Ogre, at DC 15.

bugbear archer.name: Bugbear Archer
bugbear archer.desc: The first the party knows of them is the arrows.
bugbear archer.stat: AC 14 (leather), HP 18, ATK 1 longbow (far) +4 (1d8) or 1 club +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +3, C +2, I +0, W +2, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Unheard.** 5-in-6 chance of surprise.

goblin assassin.name: Goblin Assassin
goblin assassin.desc: The smoke comes first, and it is still there next time.
goblin assassin.stat: AC 14 (leather), HP 15, ATK 1 poisoned blade +4 (1d6 + poison), MV near, S +0, D +3, C +1, I +1, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Smoke Bombs.** As a free action before melee: every character within near makes a DC 12
CON check or can make no ranged attack for this encounter and the next. Spellcasting is
unaffected.
**Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6.
**Ambush.** 3-in-6 chance of surprise.

goblin cutthroat.name: Goblin Cutthroat
goblin cutthroat.desc: Filthy little things roasting a dog over a fire, and glad of an interruption.
goblin cutthroat.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 15, ATK 1 knife +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Swarm Tactics.** While the cutthroats outnumber the party, they attack with advantage.
**Ambush.** 3-in-6 chance of surprise.

goblin scoundrel.name: Goblin Scoundrel
goblin scoundrel.desc: Four dozen of them, squabbling over what they have already taken.
goblin scoundrel.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 8, ATK 1 club +2 (1d6), MV near, S +0, D +2, C +1, I +0, W -1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Squabbling.** At the start of each round, 2-in-6 chance that 1d4 scoundrels spend the
round fighting each other over loot instead of the party.
**Faint-Hearted.** Checks morale with disadvantage.

hobgoblin reaver.name: Hobgoblin Reaver
hobgoblin reaver.desc: Out of the bushes, shoulder first.
hobgoblin reaver.stat: AC 15 (leather + shield), HP 14, ATK 1 axe +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Out of the Bushes.** 3-in-6 chance of surprise.
**Bowl Over.** On a critical hit, DC 12 STR or the target is knocked flat and forfeits
its next action.

bugbear.name: Bugbear
bugbear.desc: The big hairy ones, and they wait in the trees.
bugbear.stat: AC 13 (leather + shield), HP 14, ATK 2 spiked mace +3 (1d6), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +1, I -1, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Stealthy.** Advantage on checks to sneak and hide.
**In the Trees.** 4-in-6 chance of surprise, or 2-in-6 if anyone in the party is a hunter
or ranger.

the spider totem.name: The Spider Totem
the spider totem.desc: The thing the tribe paints on its shields, kept alive in the canopy and fed.
the spider totem.stat: AC 16, HP 35, ATK 2 bite +7 (1d10 + web), MV near (climb), S +4, D +3, C +3, I -2, W +2, Ch -3, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Web.** On a hit, DC 15 DEX or the target is webbed and forfeits its next action.
**Never Checks Morale.** Always fights to the death.

toll troll.name: Toll Troll
toll troll.desc: He holds the trail and he wants paying for it.
toll troll.stat: AC 15, HP 30, ATK 2 club +6 (1d10), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +3, I -2, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Thick Hide.** Bludgeoning weapons attack at disadvantage.
**Slow Regeneration.** At the end of each of its turns, roll 1d6: on a 1–2 it regains
1d6 HP.
**The Toll.** He names a price — usually everything shiny the party carries — and keeps
the bargain if it is paid.

goblinogre.name: Goblinogre
goblinogre.desc: He looks harmless. That is the entire point of him.
goblinogre.stat: AC 14, HP 28, ATK 2 cleaver +5 (1d10+1), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +3, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Looks Harmless.** 3-in-6 chance of surprise.
**The First Blow.** If his first attack of the encounter hits, it deals triple damage.
Every character who sees it then makes a DC 12 WIS check or spends its next turn
fleeing from him.

goblin elite swordsman.name: Goblin Elite Swordsman
goblin elite swordsman.desc: *Kelak.* The scimitar is better than he is, and it is thin.
goblin elite swordsman.stat: AC 16 (leather + shield), HP 22, ATK 2 masterwork scimitar +5 (1d8), MV near, S +1, D +3, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Masterwork Scimitar.** In a character's hands it
scores a critical hit on a natural 19 or 20 — but on a natural 1 the blade snaps and is
destroyed. It sells for 100 gp intact.

goblin king.name: Goblin King
goblin king.desc: Enormously fat, enormously pleased, and not easy to put to sleep.
goblin king.stat: AC 14 (natural), HP 27, ATK 2 golden sceptre +5 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D -1, C +4, I +1, W +1, Ch +2, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Too Much of Him.** Immune to poison. Advantage on checks to resist sleep and charm.
