**Golden Sceptre.** A bludgeoning weapon dealing 1d8. Sells for 80 gp.

large moss troll.name: Large Moss Troll
large moss troll.desc: Weapons go into the moss and stay there.
large moss troll.stat: AC 15, HP 34, ATK 2 limb +6 (1d10), MV near, S +4, D -1, C +4, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 7
traits: **Moss.** On a natural 1 on an attack roll, the weapon is buried in the moss: that
character must spend their next turn pulling it free.
**Regeneration.** Regains 1d6 HP at the end of each of its turns, unless the damage it
last took came from a spell, fire, acid, or a magic weapon.

savage orc nooseman.name: Savage Orc Nooseman
savage orc nooseman.desc: The rope comes out before the axe does.
savage orc nooseman.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 18, ATK 1 noose (near) +5 or 1 stone axe +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Opening Noose.** Their first action is always against the last character in the
marching order: that character takes 1d6 and makes a DC 12 DEX check or is bound, unable
to act; DC 12 STR on its turn, or an ally's action, cuts it free. A party that flees leaves
a bound character behind to die; a bribe frees them.
**Noosed.** Thereafter, on a critical hit, the target is noosed and forfeits its next
turn.

savage orc boy.name: Savage Orc Boy
savage orc boy.desc: Warpaint, stone, and no warning at all.
savage orc boy.stat: AC 14, HP 22, ATK 1 great stone axe +4 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +3, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Always Surprise.** Savage orc boyz always surprise a party on first meeting.

savage orc scout.name: Savage Orc Scout
savage orc scout.desc: Talking among themselves, and not always looking.
savage orc scout.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 15, ATK 1 stone axe +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Not Looking.** 3-in-6 chance the scouts have not spotted the party. If they have not,
the party may take another trail and avoid the encounter entirely.

orc leader.name: Orc Leader
orc leader.desc: Four scars and an opinion about how this should go.
orc leader.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 26, ATK 2 stone axe +5 (1d8+1), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +3, I +0, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Trial of Champions.** Will often propose single combat instead of a general fight, and
honours the result.

savage orc arrer boy.name: Savage Orc Arrer Boy
savage orc arrer boy.desc: Up in the branches, and they open the conversation.
savage orc arrer boy.stat: AC 13, HP 14, ATK 1 bone bow (far) +4 (1d6) or 1 stone axe +4 (1d8), MV near (climb), S +2, D +2, C +2, I -1, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **From the Branches.** They always act first on the first round. While they remain in the
canopy only spells and ranged attacks reach them at all; they come down on the third
round, or when half of them are dead.
**Always Fight.** Never checks morale.

savage orc raider.name: Savage Orc Raider
savage orc raider.desc: For every three of them there is one captive roped along behind.
savage orc raider.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 16, ATK 1 stone axe +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Captives.** One roped captive per three raiders. A bribe buys the party's passage but
never the captives.

savage orc boar boy.name: Savage Orc Boar Boy
savage orc boar boy.desc: Kill the rider and the boar is still there.
savage orc boar boy.stat: AC 12 (leather), HP 15, ATK 1 stone axe +4 (1d8), MV double near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **The Boar.** Each rider is astride a war boar: AC 13, HP 14, ATK 1 tusk +4 (1d8), MV
double near, LV 3. The boar fights on alone when the rider dies.
**Charge.** On the first round, attacks with advantage.

king of the jungle.name: King Of The Jungle
king of the jungle.desc: A half-clothed, club-swinging gorilla the orcs raised as one of their own.
king of the jungle.stat: AC 15, HP 35, ATK 3 club +7 (1d10), MV double near (climb), S +5, D +2, C +3, I +0, W +2, Ch +1, AL N, LV 7
traits: **Stampede.** At the end of any round in which he was wounded, roll 1d6: on a 1 he calls
the jungle down. Every character makes a DC 12 DEX check or takes 2d6 from trampling
beasts.
**Unique.** Once killed, he is killed. A second roll of this result is some other weird
monster of the GM's choosing.

savage orc big boss.name: Savage Orc Big Boss
savage orc big boss.desc: There is a point in the fight where he stops defending himself.
savage orc big boss.stat: AC 15, HP 32, ATK 2 great stone axe +6 (1d10+1), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +3, I -1, W +0, Ch +0, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Berserk.** The first time he is reduced below half HP he goes berserk: for the rest of
the fight he makes three attacks per round instead of two, and attacks against him are
made with advantage.

savage orc battleboss.name: Savage Orc Battle-Boss
savage orc battleboss.desc: Wound him and he is already turning round.
savage orc battleboss.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 28, ATK 2 stone axe +5 (1d8+1), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +3, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Strikes Back.** Each time he is wounded, 2-in-6 chance he immediately attacks whoever
hurt him, out of turn.
**Fearless.** Checks morale with advantage.

savage orc shaman.name: Savage Orc Shaman
savage orc shaman.desc: Hurt him and he has something to say about it.
savage orc shaman.stat: AC 13, HP 20, ATK 1 bone staff +4 (1d6) or 1 spell +5, MV near, S +1, D +1, C +2, I +1, W +3, Ch +0, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Curse of the Shaman.** Any character who deals him damage makes a DC 12 INT check or is cursed: the first attack or check they make in each fight is at disadvantage, until a blessing or *remove curse* lifts it.
**Gem-Hungry.** A bribe of one gem buys him off — but if the party carries a ruby, it
must be the ruby.

the warbosss boar.name: The Warboss'S Boar
the warbosss boar.desc: It is not his mount. It is his colleague.
the warbosss boar.stat: AC 14, HP 30, ATK 2 gore +6 (1d10 + rip), MV double near, S +4, D +1, C +3, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Rip.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6 as the tusk comes out.
**The Sows.** Accompanied by 1d6 sows: AC 13, HP 20, ATK 1 gore +4 (1d8), LV 4. Sows
never check morale and fight to the death whether the boar does or not.

savage orc captain.name: Savage Orc Captain
savage orc captain.desc: A long-haired chief carrying a massive stone club, and his sentinels behind him.
savage orc captain.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 36, ATK 2 great stone club +7 (1d12), MV near, S +4, D +1, C +3, I +0, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 7
traits: **His Sentinels.** Accompanied by 1d6+1 Orc Sentinels: AC 14, HP 20, ATK 1 stone axe +5
(1d8), LV 4, which check morale with advantage while the captain stands.
**Trial of Champions.** Often proposes single combat, and honours the result.

earth elemental.name: Earth Elemental
earth elemental.desc: Stone that has been told to object to you.
earth elemental.stat: AC 17, HP 31, ATK 3 slam +7 (2d8) or 1 avalanche, MV near (burrow), S +5, D +0, C +4, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Impervious.** Only damaged by magical sources.
**Avalanche.** In place of attacks, all within close make a DC 15 STR check or are entombed for 1d4 rounds under mounds of earth.
**Gemstones.** Each destroyed elemental yields 1d6 × 5 gp in gems.

giant starnosed mole.name: Giant Star-Nosed Mole
giant starnosed mole.desc: It comes up through the floor of the gallery.
giant starnosed mole.stat: AC 13, HP 16, ATK 1 claw +3 (1d6 + rot), MV near (burrow), S +2, D +0, C +2, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 3
traits: **From Below.** 3-in-6 chance of surprise.
**Weremole.** A character that loses 4 or more HP to a single mole makes a DC 12 CON
check or contracts weremole lycanthropy.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it surfaces, smells iron, and goes back down · 4–5 it takes the rearmost pack and burrows off with it · 6 it comes up underneath someone.

ichor wisp.name: Ichor Wisp
ichor wisp.desc: Fist-sized flying bladders of resin. The spit blinds before anything bites.
ichor wisp.stat: AC 13, HP 10, ATK 1 resin spit (near) +2 or 1 bite +2 (1d4), MV near (fly), S -1, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Resin.** Each wisp opens with a spit. DC 12 DEX or the target is blinded — disadvantage on attacks, and attacks against it have advantage — until it spends a full round washing the resin off. After the
first round they fight normally.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they drift away on the air · 3–4 they follow the brightest lantern and spit at whoever carries it · 5–6 they spit at everyone.

echo bat.name: Echo Bat
echo bat.desc: In a hall that echoes they are a great deal worse.
echo bat.stat: AC 13, HP 10, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4), MV near (fly), S -1, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Echo.** In an enclosed hall or gallery that echoes, echo bats attack with advantage and
deal +1d4.
**Blood Offering.** A fresh kill thrown aside will often buy passage.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 the roost settles again if nobody speaks above a whisper · 4–5 they circle, and the next spell cast in the hall fails · 6 they come down.

red cave spider.name: Red Cave Spider
red cave spider.desc: The bite is not the problem. What stops working afterwards is.
red cave spider.stat: AC 13, HP 9, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d4 + numb), MV near (climb), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Numb.** A character that loses 3 or more HP to one bite makes a DC 12 CON check or a
limb goes dead — roll 1d6: 1–3 an arm, 4–6 a leg. A dead arm cannot hold a shield or use
a ranged or two-handed weapon, though it can carry a lantern; a dead leg means that
character cannot flee. Any healing restores it.
**Immune to Poison.**
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it retreats into its crack · 4–5 it holds the passage and bites only what tries to pass · 6 it drops on the first character through.

bound bone.name: Bound Bones
bound bone.desc: Dwarf skeletons held together by the spell that holds your cleric off them.
bound bone.stat: AC 13, HP 16, ATK 1 claw +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +1, C +2, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Bindings.** On first meeting, each cleric makes a DC 12 WIS check. On a failure, that
cleric's turn undead and holy damage have no effect on bound bones for the encounter.
**Brittle.** Bludgeoning weapons attack with advantage; arrows and bolts at
disadvantage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

bull centaur.name: Bull Centaur
bull centaur.desc: Too heavy to run from underground.
bull centaur.stat: AC 14 (chainmail), HP 26, ATK 2 great axe +5 (1d10), MV double near, S +4, D +1, C +3, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Charge.** They attack with advantage on the first round of melee.
**Cannot Be Outrun.** A party may not withdraw from bull centaurs underground. Above
ground they may.

dwarf ghast headhunter.name: Dwarf Ghast Headhunter
dwarf ghast headhunter.desc: The more trophies they take, the worse they get.
dwarf ghast headhunter.stat: AC 14 (chainmail), HP 24, ATK 2 axe +5 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +3, I -1, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Trophies.** Once they have taken a head, the surviving headhunters attack with advantage for the rest of the encounter.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

possessed dwarf.name: Possessed Dwarf
possessed dwarf.desc: Something else is wearing it, and not carefully.
possessed dwarf.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 21, ATK 2 axe +4 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +3, I -2, W -2, Ch -3, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Ridden.** Immune to fear, charm and sleep. A *dispel magic* or exorcism rite forces a
DC 15 CHA check; on a failure the thing leaves and the dwarf drops unconscious.

skeletal dwarf.name: Skeletal Dwarf
skeletal dwarf.desc: Buried with their tools and dug out with them still in hand.
skeletal dwarf.stat: AC 14, HP 16, ATK 1 weapon +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Armed As Found.** Roll 1d6 once for the group: **1** scythes — two attacks each at +3,
and +1 AC; **2–3** maces — on a critical hit a non-magical shield is destroyed; **4**
javelins — 4-in-6 chance they attack before anything else; **5** axes — shields give no
AC bonus; **6** ram-riders — MV double near, and they attack with advantage on the first
round.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

hobgoblin hyaenodon rider.name: Hobgoblin Hyaenodon Riders
hobgoblin hyaenodon rider.desc: A running mass of dogs and riders that does not resolve into individuals.
hobgoblin hyaenodon rider.stat: AC 14, HP 36, ATK 2 lance (close/near) +4 (1d8), MV double near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Horde.** Each of its two attacks must target a different creature within close.
**Broken.** At half HP or less it loses one attack and checks morale each round.
**Charge.** 2-in-6 chance of surprise, and they attack characters on foot with advantage.
**Warlord.** If the horde is at full HP when met, a mounted warlord rides at its head and
fights separately (see below).

hobgoblin warlord.name: Hobgoblin Warlord
hobgoblin warlord.desc: He picks one opponent and conducts the rest of the battle around them.
hobgoblin warlord.stat: AC 17 (chainmail + shield), HP 32, ATK 3 sword +6 (1d8+1), MV double near, S +3, D +2, C +3, I +1, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Single Combat.** Fights one character of the party's choosing, apart from the horde.
**Disarm.** On a critical hit, the target's weapon is struck from its hand to near
distance.
**Warlord.** The horde checks morale with advantage while he lives, and at disadvantage
once he falls. Killed in single combat, the horde checks morale at once or scatters.

chao dwarf.name: Chaos Dwarf
chao dwarf.desc: Beards in ringlets, tall hats, and crossbows they are happy to use indoors.
chao dwarf.stat: AC 15 (plate mail), HP 26, ATK 1 axe +5 (1d8+1) or 1 crossbow (far) +5 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +3, I +1, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Crossbows.** 1-in-6 chance the group carries them. If so they act first automatically
on the first round and shoot before the party acts.
**Corridor Drill.** In a corridor the front two fight with axes while the rest shoot
overhead without penalty.

kdaai.name: K'Daai
kdaai.desc: Something out of the forge got into it, and it was not iron.
kdaai.stat: AC 15, HP 28, ATK 2 burning fist +6 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +3, I -2, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Forge-Element.** Roll 1d6 once: **1** earth — slashing at disadvantage; **2** air — it
flies, bludgeoning at disadvantage; **3** fire — immune to fire; **4** water — ranged
attacks at disadvantage; **5** lightning — it flies, immune to lightning, ungilded metal
weapons at disadvantage; **6** energy — on a hit, DC 12 CON or lose a level.
**Gilded.** Gold or gilded weapons attack it with advantage.
**Impervious.** Immune to sleep and morale. Always fights.

daemon blade.name: Daemon Blade
daemon blade.desc: A demon-forged sword that has eaten enough souls to walk about on its own.
daemon blade.stat: AC 14, HP 24, ATK 3 blade +5 (1d8), MV near (fly), S +0, D +4, C +0, I +1, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Reach of the Blade.** Characters outside the front rank attack the daemon blade with disadvantage.
**Soul-Eater.** No character it kills can be raised or resurrected.
**Impervious.** Immune to sleep, charm, fear and morale. Always fights.

lammasu.name: Lammasu
lammasu.desc: Winged, bull-bodied, and it wears a sorcerer's face.
lammasu.stat: AC 14, HP 30, ATK 2 claw +6 (1d10), MV double near (fly), S +4, D +2, C +3, I +3, W +3, Ch +2, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Sorcerous Presence.** Every spell or prayer cast within far while the lammasu lives is
made at disadvantage.
**Swallow the Word.** Once per round, when a spell is cast within far, roll 1d6: on a
1–2 the lammasu swallows it. The caster loses the spell and nothing happens.

great tauru.name: Great Taurus
great tauru.desc: It opens with fire and finishes with hooves and horns.
great tauru.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 40, ATK 2 gore +7 (1d12), MV double near (fly), S +5, D +1, C +4, I -1, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Fire Blast.** On the first round only: every character within near makes a DC 15 DEX
check or takes 3d6 fire damage, half on a success.
**Brass Hide.** Immune to fire.

daemonsmith golem.name: Daemonsmith'S Golem
daemonsmith golem.desc: It is damaged, it is old, and it has been told to stand there.
daemonsmith golem.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 36, ATK 2 iron fist +7 (1d12), MV near, S +5, D -2, C +4, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 7
traits: **Spell Immunity.** Immune to every spell. Not resistant — immune.
**Construct.** Immune to morale, fear, charm, sleep and poison.
**Told to Stand There.** It will not pursue beyond the room it guards.

hellsmith.name: Hellsmith
hellsmith.desc: He never walks alone, and he keeps standing them back up.
hellsmith.stat: AC 15 (plate mail), HP 34, ATK 2 forge hammer +6 (1d10+1), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +3, I +2, W +2, Ch +1, AL C, LV 7
traits: **His Gunners.** Accompanied by 1d3+1 hellfire gunners: AC 14, HP 20, ATK 1 hellfire
harquebus (far) +5 (1d10 + fire), LV 4. They always shoot first. On a hit, DC 12 CON or
take an extra 1d6 fire.
**Raise the Fallen.** At the end of each of his turns the hellsmith raises one slain
gunner with half its HP. He keeps doing this until he is dead.

sorcererprophet.name: Sorcerer-Prophet
sorcererprophet.desc: *Hezak the Twisted.* He is turning to stone as he casts, and he knows it.
sorcererprophet.stat: AC 14, HP 36, ATK 2 staff +5 (1d6) or 1 spell +7, MV near, S +1, D +0, C +3, I +4, W +3, Ch +1, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Turning to Stone.** At the end of each of his turns, roll 1d6: on a 1 he loses one
attack or spell permanently. When he has none left he is a statue, and the fight is over
however much HP remains.
**Warded.** Every spell cast at him is made at disadvantage.
**Fires of Hashut (INT Spell).** DC 15. All creatures within near take 3d6 fire damage,
half on a DC 15 DEX check.
**Petrify (INT Spell).** DC 15. One creature within far makes a DC 15 CON check or is
paralysed for 1d4 rounds.

infernal castellan.name: Infernal Castellan
infernal castellan.desc: A chaos dwarf in sealed black plate, at the head of the headhunters. Magic does nothing.
infernal castellan.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 40, ATK 3 halberd (close/near) +7 (1d10+2), MV near, S +4, D +1, C +4, I +1, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Spell Immunity.** No spell, scroll or magical effect of any kind affects him.
**At Their Head.** He stands at the head of the Dwarf Ghast Headhunters and does not
leave them. Never checks morale, always fights to the death.

armoured skeleton.name: Armoured Skeleton
armoured skeleton.desc: Buried in their harness, and it still fits.
armoured skeleton.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 16, ATK 1 sword +3 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Still Armoured.** Bludgeoning weapons gain no advantage; arrows and bolts attack at
disadvantage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

tomb scorpion.name: Tomb Scorpion
tomb scorpion.desc: Two stings, and the second one is the one that matters.
tomb scorpion.stat: AC 14 (natural), HP 10, ATK 1 sting +3 (1d6 + venom), MV near (burrow), S +1, D +2, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** A wounded character makes two successive DC 12 CON checks. Failing one, the
wound festers: 1d4 damage per day until cured. Failing both, the limb is lost.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

bejeweled beetle.name: Bejeweled Beetle
bejeweled beetle.desc: Their shells throw the lamplight straight back at you.
bejeweled beetle.stat: AC 14 (natural), HP 9, ATK 1 mandible +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +1, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Dazzle.** A character without a shield to look past attacks them at disadvantage. A
character with a shield attacks normally.
**Encrusted.** Each beetle's shell is worth 1d6 gp in loose stones.

skeletal rat.name: Skeletal Rat
skeletal rat.desc: Arrows pass between the ribs and keep going.
skeletal rat.stat: AC 12, HP 4, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4), MV near (climb), S -1, D +2, C +1, I -4, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 1
traits: **Between the Ribs.** Arrows, bolts and sling stones deal no damage. Bludgeoning weapons
attack with advantage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

skeletal beast.name: Skeletal Beast
skeletal beast.desc: They do not give up, and they know the way you went.
skeletal beast.stat: AC 13, HP 11, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I -4, W -1, Ch -4, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Between the Ribs.** Bows and slings deal no damage. Bludgeoning weapons attack with
advantage.
**Will Not Stop.** A party that flees is caught again in each room it enters on a 1–2
on 1d6.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

tomb guardian.name: Tomb Guardian
tomb guardian.desc: Set at the door of the tomb and never relieved.
tomb guardian.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 16, ATK 1 khopesh +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +3, I -3, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Still Armoured.** As Armoured Skeleton.
**Set to Guard.** Tomb guardians do not pursue beyond the chamber they were set to hold.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

barrow skeleton.name: Barrow Skeleton
barrow skeleton.desc: Older, heavier, and they do not stop.
barrow skeleton.stat: AC 13, HP 26, ATK 2 ancient blade +5 (1d8+1), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +3, I -2, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Brittle but Dense.** Bludgeoning weapons attack with advantage; arrows attack at
disadvantage and deal half damage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

tomb herald.name: Tomb Herald
tomb herald.desc: The axes are made to go round shields.
tomb herald.stat: AC 14 (chainmail), HP 21, ATK 1 axe +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +3, I -2, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Round the Shield.** Shields give no AC bonus against a tomb herald's axe.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

skeleton archer.name: Skeleton Archer
skeleton archer.desc: They were loosing before anyone had decided this was a fight.
skeleton archer.stat: AC 13, HP 16, ATK 1 bow (far) +4 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +2, I -3, W -1, Ch -4, AL C, LV 3
traits: **First Volley.** 4-in-6 chance the archers shoot before anything else happens in the
encounter, the party included.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

skeleton warrior.name: Skeleton Warrior
skeleton warrior.desc: Rank and file, and the rank is the point.
skeleton warrior.stat: AC 14, HP 14, ATK 1 sword +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 3
traits: **In Ranks.** While three or more skeleton warriors are adjacent, each attacks with advantage.
**Holy Water.** A flask destroys one outright.
**Brittle.** Bludgeoning weapons attack with advantage; arrows at disadvantage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

grave skeleton.name: Grave Skeleton
grave skeleton.desc: Up out of the grave mud, with the mud still on them.
grave skeleton.stat: AC 13, HP 15, ATK 1 blade +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Out of the Mud.** 1-in-6 chance of surprise.
**Holy Water.** A flask destroys two of them outright.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

mummified legion.name: Mummified Legion
mummified legion.desc: Anyone they kill joins them, and joins them quickly.
mummified legion.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 24, ATK 2 bandaged fist +5 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D -1, C +3, I -2, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 5
traits: **They Join.** A character killed by the mummified legion rises as one of them at the end
of the following round and must be fought.
**Dry.** Fire damage is rolled with advantage against them.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

mummy.name: Mummy
mummy.desc: *Settra the Imperishable.* Anyone he kills gets up as one of him.
mummy.stat: AC 13, HP 47, ATK 3 rot touch +8 (1d10 + necrosis), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +2, I +3, W +2, Ch +3, AL C, LV 10
traits: **Supreme Undead.** Immune to morale. Only damaged by magical sources.
**Desiccated.** Can be damaged by fire, and takes double damage from it.
**Necrosis.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or drop to 0 HP. Healing spells are DC 15 to cast on a target at 0 HP from this effect.
**They Join.** A character slain by the mummy rises as a mummy at the end of the
following round and attacks the party.

krell tomb herald.name: Krell, Tomb Herald
krell tomb herald.desc: The first of them to be buried, and the first to get up.
krell tomb herald.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 26, ATK 2 black axe +5 (1d8 + drain), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +3, I +0, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Drain.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or lose a level: 1d6 maximum HP until lifted.
**As a Demon.** Holy water affects Krell as it does a demon: 2d6 damage a flask.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

ushabti.name: Ushabti
ushabti.desc: Until it moves, it is only a statue.
ushabti.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 36, ATK 2 great blade +7 (1d12), MV near, S +5, D -1, C +4, I -2, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 7
traits: **Spell Immunity.** Immune to every spell, and to poison.
**Stone.** Slashing weapons and arrows attack at disadvantage.
**Shield-Breaker.** On a critical hit, the target's shield is destroyed.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it does not stir unless the tomb is robbed or it is struck · 4–6 it steps down from its plinth as the party enters the chamber.

liche priest.name: Liche Priest
liche priest.desc: *High Queen Khalida.* The wound she gives does not close cleanly.
liche priest.stat: AC 13, HP 29, ATK 2 staff +5 (1d6) or 1 spell +7, MV near, S +0, D +1, C +2, I +3, W +4, Ch +1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Ill-Healing.** A character she wounds cannot regain HP by any means until the encounter
ends.
**Smite the Living (WIS Spell).** DC 15. One creature within far takes 3d6.
**Call the Legion (WIS Spell).** DC 15. 1d4 Skeleton Warriors rise within near.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

tomb prince.name: Tomb Prince
tomb prince.desc: Buried with his chariot, his bow and his opinion of you.
tomb prince.stat: AC 16 (chainmail + shield), HP 30, ATK 2 khopesh +6 (1d8+2), MV near, S +4, D +1, C +3, I +1, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Royal.** Every undead within far attacks with advantage while he stands.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

liche high priest.name: Liche High Priest
liche high priest.desc: *Arkhan the Black.* Every prayer in the room has to get past him first.
liche high priest.stat: AC 14, HP 40, ATK 2 staff +6 (1d8) or 1 spell +8, MV near, S +1, D +1, C +3, I +4, W +4, Ch +2, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Null Field.** Every spell or prayer cast within far — by anyone, from any source —
requires a DC 15 check of the caster's spellcasting stat or it fizzles entirely.
**Hand of Dust (INT Spell).** DC 15. One creature within near takes 4d6; on a failed DC
15 CON check it also loses 1d6 maximum HP.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

necrosphinx.name: Necrosphinx
necrosphinx.desc: Built, bound, and entirely beyond argument.
necrosphinx.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 40, ATK 2 blade-limb +7 (1d12) and 1 sting +7 (1d10), MV double near (fly), S +5, D +2, C +4, I -1, W +2, Ch -2, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Spell Immunity.** Immune to every spell, and to poison.
**Stone.** Slashing weapons and arrows attack at disadvantage.
**Shield-Breaker.** On a critical hit, the target's shield is destroyed.
**Construct.** Never checks morale.

bone giant.name: Bone Giant
bone giant.desc: Arrows go between the ribs and out the other side.
bone giant.stat: AC 16, HP 45, ATK 2 great blade +8 (1d12+2), MV near, S +6, D -1, C +4, I -3, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 9
traits: **Between the Ribs.** Arrows, bolts and sling stones deal no damage at all. Bludgeoning
weapons attack with advantage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

chao warrior.name: Chaos Warrior
chao warrior.desc: Plate, a chaos mark, and no hurry whatsoever.
chao warrior.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 26, ATK 2 great axe +5 (1d10+1), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +3, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Marked.** Immune to fear. Checks morale with advantage.
**Brutal.** +1 damage with melee weapons (included).

chao marauder.name: Chaos Marauder
chao marauder.desc: Human raiders out of the northern wastes, who came a long way for this.
chao marauder.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 21, ATK 1 great axe +4 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +3, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Hardened.** Immune to the effects of natural cold.

chao cultist.name: Chaos Cultist
chao cultist.desc: They came north for a reason and have stopped explaining it.
chao cultist.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 11, ATK 1 longsword +3 (1d8) or 1 spell +3, MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Devoted.** Checks morale with advantage.
**Leader.** 2-in-6 chance the group is led by a cult leader: AC 15, HP 22, ATK 2
longsword +5 (1d8), LV 4.

chao thug.name: Chaos Thug
chao thug.desc: Unarmoured human fanatics who stop being frightened at the worst moment.
chao thug.stat: AC 11, HP 16, ATK 1 axe +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I -1, W -1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Until the Champion Falls.** Chaos thugs check morale at disadvantage while their
champion lives. Once the champion falls they never check morale again.

fimir.name: Fimir
fimir.desc: One eye, a tail, and a bog they would rather be standing in.
fimir.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 20, ATK 2 club +4 (1d8), MV near (swim), S +3, D +0, C +3, I +0, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Tail Sweep.** A character attempting to flee within close makes a DC 12 DEX check or
falls and must spend its next turn standing. Flying creatures are unaffected.
**Cold-Blooded.** Cold damage is rolled with advantage against them.
**Chaos Creature.** Counts as a chaos creature for anything that targets chaos. Always
fights.

chao knight.name: Chaos Knight
chao knight.desc: Plate from throat to heel, and mounted.
chao knight.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 32, ATK 2 lance (close/near) +6 (1d12), MV double near, S +4, D +0, C +3, I +0, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Full Plate.** Light weapons — daggers, clubs, staves and the like — attack at
disadvantage.
**Charge.** On the first round of combat, attacks with advantage.
**Bribe.** One magic item buys them off, and they take it as their due.

chao sorcerer.name: Chaos Sorcerer
chao sorcerer.desc: *Morcar · Zargon · Zanwrath, High Mage of Sarako · Boroush the Storm Master.* Armoured, and he heals himself by mutating further.
chao sorcerer.stat: AC 17 (chaos armour), HP 38, ATK 2 mace +5 (1d6) or 1 spell +8, MV near, S +1, D +0, C +3, I +4, W +2, Ch +1, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Dark Gift.** Roll as Chaos Lord, at DC 15.
**Void Blast (INT Spell).** DC 15. One creature within far takes 3d6.
**Finger of Fate (INT Spell).** DC 15. Melee attacks against him are at disadvantage for
1d4 rounds.
**Cloud of Flies (INT Spell).** DC 15. All enemies within near take 1d6 and must pass a
DC 15 CON check before their next attack or retreat out of near instead.
**Eye of the Gods (INT Spell).** DC 15. Heals 2d6 HP and gains one mutation.

chao lord.name: Chaos Lord
chao lord.desc: *Archaon · Festral, who took an ogre clan.* His slaves are behind him, and chained.
chao lord.stat: AC 19 (chaos armour + shield), HP 36, ATK 3 great sword +7 (1d10+2), MV near, S +4, D +1, C +4, I +1, W +1, Ch +3, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Chaos Mark.** As Chaos Champion.
**Dark Gift.** Roll 1d6: 1–3 none; 4 **evil eye** — on his first turn, every character
within far makes a DC 15 WIS check or he attacks them with advantage until he falls; 5 **energy drain** — on
a hit, DC 15 CON or lose a level; 6 **hellfire blast** — once per encounter, all within
near take 3d6 fire, half on a DC 15 DEX check.
**His Slaves.** They do not fight. Defeating him frees them: useful information, and the
noise draws a wandering monster.

fimir lord.name: Fimir Lord
fimir lord.desc: *The Meargh's Consort.* Four ways to be hit, and one of them is a look.
fimir lord.atk: 2 claw +6 (1d8) and 1 bite +6 (1d10) and 1 eye blast (far) +6 (1d12)
fimir lord.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 31, ATK 2 claw +6 (1d8) and 1 bite +6 (1d10) and 1 eye blast (far) +6 (1d12), MV near (swim), S +4, D +1, C +4, I +1, W +2, Ch -1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Eye Blast.** A ranged attack that ignores shields and cover.
**Tail Sweep.** As Fimir.
**Cold-Blooded.** Cold damage is rolled with advantage.

chao spawn verag.name: Chaos Spawn, Verag
chao spawn verag.desc: *Verag the Gargoyle.* It was a champion once, and the reward was this.
chao spawn verag.stat: AC 14, HP 36, ATK 3 flail +6 (1d10), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +4, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Breathes Fire.** At the start of each of its turns, 2-in-6 chance it breathes instead of
attacking: all characters within near make a DC 12 DEX check or take 2d6 fire.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale, fear, charm, sleep and poison.

chao champion.name: Chaos Champion
chao champion.desc: *Egrimm van Horstmann · Skulmar · Sir Ragnar, after his fall.* Chaos armour, a great axe, and three mutations he did not choose.
chao champion.stat: AC 19 (chaos armour + shield), HP 35, ATK 3 great axe +7 (1d8+2), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +3, I +0, W +0, Ch +2, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Bloodlust.** +2 damage to all melee attacks (included).
**Chaos Mark.** Choose one: **Undivided** +1 AC and one Luck Token; **Krom** +1 attack; **Nergal** +10 HP; **Slavinath** a creature within close that attacks him makes a DC 12
CON check or attacks at disadvantage that round; **Zentar** Coruscating Fire (CHA Spell)
DC 12, one target within far, 2d6 damage.
**Mutations.** Roll up to three times on any mutation table.

chao ogre executioner.name: Chaos Ogre Executioner
chao ogre executioner.desc: Twice the meat of any other champion, and a sword to match.
chao ogre executioner.stat: AC 17 (chaos armour), HP 41, ATK 3 great sword +7 (1d12+2), MV near, S +5, D +0, C +5, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Executioner.** On a critical hit the sword deals its damage twice over.
**Vast.** Immune to fear. Never checks morale.

lord of change.name: Lord Of Change
lord of change.desc: *Kairos Fateweaver.* It does not strike at your body.
lord of change.stat: AC 16, HP 48, ATK 3 mind bolt (far) +9 (2d8), MV double near (fly), S +2, D +4, C +3, I +5, W +5, Ch +4, AL C, LV 10
traits: **Mind Bolts.** Ignore armour and shields entirely — AC against them is 10 + DEX
modifier only. A character struck makes a DC 15 WIS check or takes a lasting madness.
**Twice-Headed.** 3-in-6 chance of surprise. Cannot be surprised itself.
**Daemon.** Immune to fear, charm, sleep and poison. Instability.

daemon prince.name: Daemon Prince
daemon prince.desc: *Be'lakor.* Reaching it is the problem. It has very little left to take.
daemon prince.stat: AC 20, HP 24, ATK 3 claw +9 (1d10+2), MV double near (fly), S +5, D +5, C +3, I +4, W +4, Ch +5, AL C, LV 10
traits: **Almost Untouchable.** Slashing weapons attack it at disadvantage.
**Ascending.** At the end of each round, its attack bonus and damage rise by 1,
cumulative, for the rest of the fight.
**Daemon.** Immune to fear, charm, sleep and poison. Instability.

great unclean one.name: Great Unclean One
great unclean one.desc: *Ku'gath Plaguefather.* Its parts crawl back together and it stands up again.
great unclean one.stat: AC 15, HP 56, ATK 3 plague flail +9 (2d6 + rot), MV near, S +5, D -2, C +6, I +2, W +3, Ch +0, AL C, LV 11
traits: **Rot.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or lose 1d4 maximum HP per day until cured.
**Regeneration.** Regains 1d6 HP at the start of each of its turns.
**Reassembles.** Reduced to 0 HP, it crawls back together and rises with half its HP at
the end of the following round — unless the killing blow was fire.
**Daemon.** Immune to fear, charm, sleep and poison. Instability.

bloodthirster.name: Bloodthirster
bloodthirster.desc: *Skarbrand.* Four swings of an axe that takes shields with it.
bloodthirster.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 55, ATK 4 great axe +9 (2d8), MV double near (fly), S +6, D +3, C +5, I +1, W +2, Ch +3, AL C, LV 11
traits: **Shield-Breaker.** On a critical hit, the target's shield is destroyed outright. No check.
**Unstoppable.** Immune to fear, charm, sleep and poison. Never checks morale at all —
not even through Instability.

bloodletter.name: Bloodletter
bloodletter.desc: The hellblade does not care what it hits first.
bloodletter.stat: AC 13, HP 25, ATK 2 hellblade +5 (1d8+2), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Hellblade.** On a critical hit, the damage is dealt twice over.
**Daemon.** Immune to fear, charm, sleep and poison. Instability.

daemonette.name: Daemonette
daemonette.desc: The claws find the gap in the plate every time.
daemonette.stat: AC 13, HP 18, ATK 3 rending claw +4 (1d6), MV double near, S +1, D +4, C +1, I +1, W +0, Ch +4, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Rending Claws.** Armour gives no AC bonus against them. Shields still do.
**Beguiling.** On first meeting, each character makes a DC 12 WIS check or loses its
first action of the encounter.
**Daemon.** Immune to fear, charm, sleep and poison. Instability.

chao fury.name: Chaos Fury
chao fury.desc: Winged, screeching, and on you before anything else moves.
chao fury.stat: AC 14, HP 15, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d6), MV double near (fly), S +1, D +3, C +1, I -2, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 3
traits: **On the Wing.** On the first round of combat, furies act first and can be reached only
by ranged weapons and spells.
**Daemon.** Immune to fear, charm, sleep and poison. Instability.

nurgling.name: Nurgling
nurgling.desc: Three to a handful, and none of them worth a blow until you notice your boots are gone.
nurgling.stat: AC 12, HP 5, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4), MV near, S -2, D +2, C +2, I -2, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 1
traits: **Pilfer.** Instead of attacking: DC 12 DEX or one item of gear is taken and ruined —
boots, rations, a waterskin, a rope, in that order.
**Daemon.** Immune to fear, charm, sleep and poison. Instability.

pink horror.name: Pink Horror
pink horror.desc: Kill one and there are two, and they are both laughing.
pink horror.stat: AC 13, HP 20, ATK 2 warpflame (near) +4 (1d6), MV near, S +0, D +2, C +2, I +2, W +0, Ch +1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Splits.** When a pink horror is reduced to 0 HP it is immediately replaced by two Blue
Horrors: AC 12, HP 6, ATK 1 warpflame (near) +2 (1d4), LV 2. Blue Horrors do not split.
**Daemon.** Immune to fear, charm, sleep and poison. Instability.

plaguebearer.name: Plaguebearer
plaguebearer.desc: It counts as it cuts, and the count is of you.
plaguebearer.stat: AC 14 (natural), HP 20, ATK 2 plague blade +4 (1d8 + rot), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +4, I +0, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Rot.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or lose 1d4 HP at the end of the encounter, and again each
day until cured.
**Daemon.** Immune to fear, charm, sleep and poison. Instability.

young crag bear.name: Young Crag Bear
young crag bear.desc: There is no gentle way to be hit by one.
young crag bear.stat: AC 13, HP 17, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +3, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 3

tremor worm.name: Tremor Worm
tremor worm.stat: AC 14, HP 18, ATK 1 bite +4 (1d8), MV near (burrow), S +3, D +0, C +3, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Surfacing.** As they come up, every character makes a DC 12 DEX check or is knocked
down and must spend its next turn standing. They attack a character still on the ground with advantage.

bound cadaver.name: Bound Cadaver
bound cadaver.desc: Bound where they fell, and the binding keeps the clerics out too.
bound cadaver.stat: AC 11, HP 9, ATK 1 slam +2 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D -2, C +2, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Bindings.** On first meeting, each cleric makes a DC 12 WIS check. On a failure, that
cleric's turn undead and holy damage do nothing to bound cadavers this encounter.
**Dry.** Fire damage is rolled with advantage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

torpor wisp.name: Torpor Wisp
torpor wisp.desc: Small drifting sacs of red resin. One spit and you are upright and useless.
torpor wisp.stat: AC 13, HP 5, ATK 1 resin spit (near) +2 or 1 bite +2 (1d4), MV near (fly), S -2, D +3, C +0, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Red Resin.** Each wisp opens with a spit. DC 12 CON or the target is paralysed for 1d4
rounds and is hit automatically by any attack. A cleric's blessing, or any healing spell,
frees one victim early. After the first round the wisps fight normally.

warp void.name: Warp Void
warp void.desc: Small tears in the world, where the Wastes have worn through.
warp void.stat: AC 14, HP 10, ATK 1 touch +3 (1d6 + warp), MV near (fly), S +0, D +2, C +0, I -3, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Not Quite There.** Only magical weapons and spells harm a warp void. Immune to sleep
and charm.
**Warp.** On a hit, roll 1d6: on a 1 the target's armour is warped with it — a permanent
−1 AC until the armour is reforged or replaced.
**Always Fights.**

creeping sludge.name: Creeping Sludge
creeping sludge.desc: It goes round the armour, and then it goes through it.
creeping sludge.stat: AC 11, HP 16, ATK 2 touch +4 (1d6 + corrode), MV near (climb), S +1, D -1, C +3, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Through the Armour.** Armour gives no AC bonus against creeping sludge.
**Corrode.** On a critical hit, one piece of the target's armour is destroyed.
**Immune to Lightning.** Mindless: immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison. Always
fights to the death.

ursun chosen.name: Ursun'S Chosen
ursun chosen.desc: Bear-cloaked axemen of the bear-god. Once one has hold of you it does not let go.
ursun chosen.stat: AC 15, HP 32, ATK 2 axe +6 (1d10), MV near, S +4, D +1, C +4, I +0, W +2, Ch +1, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Smother.** A character struck by one takes two further attacks from that warrior at the
start of the following round as it closes.
**The Last One.** When all but one are down, the survivor goes berserk: three attacks per
round at +8, and it never checks morale.

the wandering dead.name: The Wandering Dead
the wandering dead.desc: You smell them a long time before you see them.
the wandering dead.stat: AC 12, HP 20, ATK 1 claw +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D -1, C +3, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Stench.** Before combat, every character makes a DC 12 CON check or has disadvantage on attacks and spellcasting for 1d4 rounds.
**Never Surprise.** The wandering dead can never surprise anyone.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

winged lancer.name: Winged Lancer
winged lancer.desc: The wings on the back are for noise. The lance is not.
winged lancer.stat: AC 17 (chainmail + shield), HP 18, ATK 1 lance (close/near) +4 (1d10) or 1 sabre +4 (1d8), MV double near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +1, AL L, LV 4
traits: **The Lance.** It attacks with advantage on the first round, and for the whole fight against a character on foot without a shield.

ice guard.name: Ice Guard
ice guard.desc: The cold does nothing to them and they know the ground.
ice guard.stat: AC 17 (chainmail + shield), HP 16, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +3 (1d6) or 1 bow (far) +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL L, LV 3
traits: **Ice-Blooded.** Immune to natural cold, and takes half damage from cold spells.
**Knows the Ground.** No penalty for ice or snow, and advantage on checks to track across
it.

splinter wolf.name: Splinter Wolf
splinter wolf.desc: Two heads, two bites, and neither lets go.
splinter wolf.stat: AC 13, HP 22, ATK 2 bite +4 (1d6 + grip), MV double near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I -1, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Grip.** On a hit, DC 12 STR or the head keeps hold: 1d6 automatic damage at the start
of each wolf turn, and disadvantage on attacks while any head grips, until a DC 12 STR check breaks
free or that head is killed.
**Howl.** If the pack passes a morale check, one howls and 1d4 dread wolves answer within
1d4 rounds.

war bear of the boyar.name: War Bear Of The Boyar
war bear of the boyar.desc: Harnessed, armoured, and worse for it.
war bear of the boyar.stat: AC 15 (chainmail barding), HP 27, ATK 2 claw +5 (1d10), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +4, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 5

the frozen horror.name: The Frozen Horror
the frozen horror.desc: A hunched giant of black ice. The cold off it does the work; the fists are extra.
the frozen horror.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 36, ATK 2 icy pummel +7 (1d10 + chill), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +4, I +0, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Chill.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or have disadvantage on attacks next turn.
**Cold Aura.** At the start of each round, every character in melee with it makes a DC 12
CON check or takes 1d6 cold damage. Heavy furs grant advantage; ice-blooded creatures are
immune.

boyar.name: Boyar
boyar.desc: He and his druzhina move before anyone else, always.
boyar.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 30, ATK 2 sabre +6 (1d10+1), MV double near, S +4, D +2, C +3, I +1, W +2, Ch +2, AL L, LV 6
traits: **First Always.** The boyar and any Ice Guard with him act before the party on the first
round of combat, without a roll.
**His Druzhina.** Rides with 1d6 Ice Guard.
**Ice-Blooded.** Immune to natural cold.

ice witch.name: Ice Witch
ice witch.desc: *The Tzarina.* She will not be touched while anything of hers still stands.
ice witch.stat: AC 13, HP 25, ATK 1 frozen eye (near) +5 (1d8) or 1 knife +3 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +2, I +2, W +4, Ch +2, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Behind the Dead.** An ice witch cannot be harmed by a melee attack while any of her
bound dead still stands. Spells and ranged attacks reach her normally.
**Her Bound Dead.** Roll 1d6: 1–3 she is attended by 1d6 Bound Bones, 4–5 by 1d6 Bound
Cadavers, 6 by 1d3 Bound Husks (AC 13, HP 20, ATK 2 slam +5 (1d8), LV 4).
**Frozen Eye.** A witch not in melee strikes with her eye instead, always against the
character with the most current HP.
**Frozen Eye, Taken.** Her eye can be prised out after: 50 gp to any wizard.

ursun avatar.name: Ursun'S Avatar
ursun avatar.desc: The bear-god's own, and it is not a metaphor.
ursun avatar.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 38, ATK 2 claw +7 (1d10 + jaw lock), MV double near, S +5, D +1, C +4, I +0, W +3, Ch +1, AL N, LV 7
traits: **Jaw Lock.** On a hit, DC 12 STR or the target forfeits its next turn.
**Out of the Snow.** 2-in-6 chance of surprise.
**Cubs.** 2-in-6 chance it is accompanied by 1d6 cubs (AC 13, HP 14, ATK 1 claw +3
(1d6), LV 2). If so it fights to the death.

blizzard daemon.name: Blizzard Daemon
blizzard daemon.desc: A winged thing of storm and ice, and the lightning arrives before it does.
blizzard daemon.stat: AC 16, HP 45, ATK 4 ice claw +8 (1d10+1), MV double near (fly), S +4, D +4, C +4, I +2, W +3, Ch +2, AL C, LV 9
traits: **Opening Storm.** Before anyone closes, every character makes a DC 15 DEX check or is
struck by lightning for 2d6.
**Gilded.** Gold or gilded weapons attack it with advantage.
**Impervious.** Immune to sleep and lightning, and so is everything that comes with it.

giant octopu.name: Giant Octopus
giant octopu.desc: Everything within reach is wrapped up before anyone has swung.
giant octopu.stat: AC 13, HP 23, ATK 2 tentacle (near) +4 (1d8 + grab), MV near (swim), S +3, D +3, C +1, I -2, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Grab.** DC 15 STR or immobilized. The tentacle hits automatically each round. DC 15 STR on its turn to break free.

cold one hatchling.name: Cold One Hatchling
cold one hatchling.desc: Stupid as stones, and their reek numbs the arm that holds the sword.
cold one hatchling.stat: AC 14 (natural), HP 11, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I -4, W -1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Reek.** Every character in melee with a hatchling attacks at disadvantage.
**Stupid.** At the start of each round, 1-in-6 chance the hatchlings turn on each other
instead of the party.

chained slave.name: Chained Slave
chained slave.desc: Driven ahead of the raid to soak up the first volley.
chained slave.stat: AC 10, HP 6, ATK 1 fist +1 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +0, W -1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Driven.** Checks morale at disadvantage, and cannot flee while chained.
**Spare Them.** If the party kills no chained slaves, the raiders behind them lose their
morale bonus for the encounter.

ship rat.name: Ship Rat
ship rat.desc: What came ashore with the slaves, and there are more of them every time.
ship rat.stat: AC 12, HP 5, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4 + infection), MV near (climb), S -1, D +2, C +1, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Infection.** A wounded character has a 1-in-6 chance of losing a further 1d4 HP.
**They Multiply.** Keep a tally. Each time the party meets ship rats again, add 2 to the
number appearing for every previous encounter.

bilge snake.name: Bilge Snake
bilge snake.desc: Thin, fast and venomous, in the shallows and the bilges.
bilge snake.stat: AC 13, HP 10, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d4 + poison), MV near (swim), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6.

harpy of karond kar.name: Harpy Of Karond Kar
harpy of karond kar.desc: The shrieking spoils everything that needs concentration.
harpy of karond kar.stat: AC 13, HP 9, ATK 1 claw +3 (1d6), MV near (fly), S +1, D +3, C +1, I -2, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Shrieking.** While any harpy lives, all spellcasting checks and ranged attacks within
near are at disadvantage.

black guard of naggarond.name: Black Guard Of Naggarond
black guard of naggarond.desc: The Witch King's household halberdiers, whose armour turns a lucky blow into a plain one.
black guard of naggarond.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 30, ATK 2 halberd (close/near) +6 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +3, I +1, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Tower Armour.** Melee attacks cannot score critical hits against the Black Guard. A
natural 20 hits but deals ordinary damage.
**Under the Captain.** Never checks morale at all while their tower-captain lives.

witch elf.name: Witch Elf
witch elf.desc: They fight by torchlight and they hate it.
witch elf.stat: AC 14, HP 25, ATK 2 sacrificial knife +5 (1d6+1), MV double near, S +2, D +4, C +2, I +1, W +0, Ch +2, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Frenzied.** Attacks against a character struck by a witch elf have advantage until the end of its next turn.
**Hates the Light.** With two or more lit lanterns held in hand, witch elves attack at
disadvantage.
**Immune to sleep.**

darkshard.name: Darkshard
darkshard.desc: Crossbows first, blades second, and no pause between.
darkshard.stat: AC 16 (chainmail), HP 16, ATK 1 repeater crossbow (far) +4 (1d6) or 1 blade +4 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +3, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Volley.** Each darkshard fires once before melee is joined.

black ark corsair.name: Black Ark Corsair
black ark corsair.desc: A volley of bolts, and then the sea-dragon cloaks come over the rail.
black ark corsair.stat: AC 16 (leather + shield), HP 14, ATK 1 hand crossbow (near) +4 (1d6) or 1 sabre +4 (1d8), MV near, S +1, D +3, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Opening Volley.** Every corsair fires once before closing. If that volley kills a
character, the whole boarding party attacks with advantage for the rest of the fight.

dreadspear.name: Dreadspear
dreadspear.desc: Household troops. They do not break and they do not sleep.
dreadspear.stat: AC 17 (chainmail + shield), HP 22, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +3, I +1, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Household.** Immune to sleep, charm and fear. Checks morale with advantage.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.desc: The draich takes a head or an arm. It is built for nothing else.
executioner.stat: AC 15 (chainmail), HP 24, ATK 2 draich +5 (1d10+2), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 5
traits: **The Draich.** On a critical hit, the damage is dealt twice over.
**Low Guard.** They attack halflings and dwarves with disadvantage — the stroke is pitched for
a taller neck.

black manticore.name: Black Manticore
black manticore.desc: Both blows land on the same person, and the tail is the one to watch.
black manticore.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 32, ATK 2 attacks +6, MV double near (fly), S +4, D +2, C +3, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **One Target.** Both attacks are always made against the same character. Roll 1d6 for
them: **1–2** claws, 1d8 each; **3–4** a bite, 2d6; **5–6** the tail sting, 1d6 and a DC
15 CON check or go to 0 HP.
**The Tail.** A character may attack the tail instead of the beast: AC 16, 8 HP. Damage
to the tail does not come off the manticore, and destroying it ends the sting.

cold one.name: Cold One
cold one.desc: Too stupid to fear anything, and too stupid to follow you out.
cold one.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 27, ATK 2 bite +5 (1d10+1), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +4, I -4, W -1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Too Stupid to Fear.** Never checks morale. Immune to fear and charm.
**Too Stupid to Follow.** It will not leave the room it is in.

war hydra.name: War Hydra
war hydra.desc: Cut the heads off and the rest follows.
war hydra.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 36, ATK 5 bite +7 (1d8), MV near, S +4, D +1, C +4, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Heads.** The hydra loses one attack for every 9 HP of damage it has taken.
**Regrowth.** If it ends a round having taken no fire damage, it regains 1d6 HP.

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.desc: Tentacles the length of a mast, kept at the ark's moorings. It never wanders inland.
kraken.atk: 4 tentacle (near) +9 (2d12) or 1 storm or 1d4 lightning bolt
kraken.stat: AC 18, HP 80, ATK 4 tentacle (near) +9 (2d12) or 1 storm or 1d4 lightning bolt, MV double near (swim), S +6, D +3, C +4, I +4, W +3, Ch +4, AL C, LV 17
traits: **Impervious.** Electricity immune.
**Crush.** Tentacle attacks deal double damage against objects.
**Lightning Bolt.** A straight line, 5 feet wide, extending far from the kraken. DC 15 DEX or 6d6 damage.
**Storm.** The sea becomes violently turbulent in a 1-mile radius for 2d4 rounds. Seaborne vessels have a 1-in-6 chance of capsizing each round.
**Always Fights.**

hag queen.name: Hag Queen
hag queen.desc: *Crone Hellebron.* The whip takes the weapon and the look takes the nerve.
hag queen.stat: AC 14, HP 34, ATK 3 whip (close/near) +7 (1d8), MV double near, S +2, D +4, C +3, I +2, W +3, Ch +3, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Her Regard.** At the start of combat, every male character makes a DC 15 WIS check or has disadvantage on attacks against her for the fight. Clerics and monks roll with advantage.
**Disarm.** On a critical hit, the target's weapon is torn away until the fight ends.
**Her Coven.** Leads 1d6+1 Witch Elves.
**Immune to sleep.**

dreadlord.name: Dreadlord
dreadlord.desc: *Malus Darkblade.* Nothing ordinary leaves a mark on the dragon-scale.
dreadlord.stat: AC 18 (dragon scale + shield), HP 30, ATK 2 warpsword +6 (1d10+1), MV near, S +3, D +3, C +3, I +2, W +1, Ch +2, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Dragon Scale.** Harmed only by magical weapons, masterwork weapons, or spells.
**Hoard.** Carries one masterwork weapon of the GM's choosing.

shade assassin.name: Shade Assassin
shade assassin.desc: *Shadowblade.* He takes the spellcasters first, then the wounded.
shade assassin.stat: AC 16 (leather), HP 38, ATK 1 poisoned blade +7 (2d8), MV double near (climb), S +2, D +5, C +2, I +3, W +3, Ch +1, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Almost Always Unseen.** Surprises the party on a 1–5 on 1d6.
**Priorities.** He attacks one character per round, choosing spellcasters first, then the
most wounded.
**Melts Away.** May withdraw from melee without provoking, and hides as a free action
wherever there is shadow.

supreme sorceress.name: Supreme Sorceress
supreme sorceress.desc: *Morathi · Sinestra.* Seeing her is the first thing that happens to you.
supreme sorceress.stat: AC 13, HP 36, ATK 2 staff +5 (1d6) or 1 spell +9, MV near, S +0, D +2, C +2, I +5, W +3, Ch +5, AL C, LV 8
traits: **First Sight.** Every character seeing her for the first time makes a DC 15 WIS check or
gains a lasting madness. Female characters roll this check at disadvantage.
**Word of Pain (INT Spell).** DC 15. One creature within far takes 3d6 and attacks at
disadvantage for 1d4 rounds.
**Black Horror (INT Spell).** DC 15. All creatures within near take 2d8; a DC 15 CON
check halves it.
**Hoard.** Triple any gold found.

the watery dead.name: The Watery Dead
the watery dead.desc: You smell them before you see them, every time.
the watery dead.stat: AC 12, HP 16, ATK 1 claw +4 (1d6), MV near (swim), S +2, D +0, C +2, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Stench.** Before combat, every character makes a DC 12 CON check or has disadvantage on attacks and spellcasting for 1d4 rounds.
**Never Surprise.** They stink too much to surprise anyone.
**Immune to fire.** Undead: immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

spine star.name: Spine Star
spine star.desc: They lie buried in the sand of the shallows, and the spines go through a boot.
spine star.stat: AC 13, HP 17, ATK 1 spine +4 (1d6), MV near (swim), S +1, D +0, C +3, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Buried.** Every attack against a spine star is at disadvantage while it stays in the
sand. 3-in-6 chance of surprise.
**Not Found by Fire.** Fire spells cannot target them.
**Blood in the Water.** Each time a spine star draws blood, roll 1d6: on a 5–6, 1d3 of
the Watery Dead arrive next round.
**Clinging Spines.** A character they have wounded withdraws at disadvantage.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 the bed is spotted in time — a DC 12 WIS check finds the spines under the sand · 5–6 the first character into the shallows treads on one.

jellyfish.name: Jellyfish
jellyfish.desc: They do not decide anything, which is the trouble.
jellyfish.stat: AC 11, HP 1, ATK 1 sting +1 (1 + toxin), MV close (swim), S -4, D +1, C +0, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 9 CON or paralyzed 1d4 rounds.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear. Always fights to the death.

razorfish.name: Razorfish
razorfish.desc: They boil around you from every side at once.
razorfish.stat: AC 12, HP 3, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4), MV near (swim), S -2, D +2, C +0, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 0
traits: **From Every Side.** Even in a narrow channel every fish can reach a target in the water.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 the shoal passes under the boat · 3–4 they boil around anyone already in the water · 5–6 they take whoever is nearest the surface.

scourge wing.name: Scourge Wing
scourge wing.desc: Hard to shoot, hard to swat, and the poison accumulates.
scourge wing.stat: AC 13, HP 6, ATK 1 sting +2 (1d4 + weaken), MV near (fly), S -2, D +4, C +0, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Elusive.** Ranged attacks are at disadvantage; bludgeoning weapons attack at
disadvantage. Fire damage is rolled with advantage.

vorpal crab.name: Vorpal Crab
vorpal crab.desc: It does not always wound you. Sometimes it just takes the sword.
vorpal crab.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 16, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d6), MV near (swim), S +2, D +1, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Shear.** When a vorpal crab hits, roll 1d6: on a 1 it shears the target's weapon
instead of wounding it; on a 2 it takes a point off the target's armour bonus. With
neither available to ruin, it deals its damage normally.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it backs into the surf · 4–5 it holds its ground and shears at anything reaching past it · 6 it comes forward.

white lion of chrace.name: White Lion Of Chrace
white lion of chrace.desc: Great pale cats that hunt the mountains above the shore.
white lion of chrace.stat: AC 14, HP 26, ATK 2 claw +5 (1d8), MV double near (climb), S +3, D +3, C +3, I -1, W +2, Ch -1, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Pounce.** On the first round of combat, attacks with advantage.
**Mountain-Bred.** Advantage on checks to climb, track and leap.

ljslfar swordmaster.name: Ljósálfar Swordmaster
ljslfar swordmaster.desc: Graceful, dangerous, and not remotely reliable.
ljslfar swordmaster.stat: AC 16 (elven plate), HP 24, ATK 2 greatsword +5 (1d12), MV near, S +2, D +3, C +2, I +2, W +1, Ch +2, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Blademaster.** Rolls initiative and damage with advantage.

**Reactions (d6).** **1** one of them lays a curse and they depart; **2** they withdraw if outnumbered; **3–4** they fight to the death; **5–6** they offer to heal 1d3 wounds per character, for a price.

phoenix guard.name: Phoenix Guard
phoenix guard.desc: They do not speak. No bribe, no quest, no parley is possible.
phoenix guard.stat: AC 18 (elven plate + shield), HP 30, ATK 2 halberd (close/near) +6 (1d10+1), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +3, I +1, W +4, Ch +0, AL L, LV 6
traits: **Silent.** Cannot be bribed, bargained with, questioned or deceived.
**Sworn.** Never checks morale. Immune to fear and charm.

sun dragon.name: Sun Dragon
sun dragon.desc: The lightning finds the heaviest armour in the room.
sun dragon.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 50, ATK 2 claw +9 (2d8), MV double near (fly), S +5, D +3, C +4, I +3, W +3, Ch +3, AL N, LV 10
traits: **Lightning.** At the start of each of its turns, 2-in-6 chance it looses lightning
instead of striking: every character in metal armour takes 2d8 automatically, and every
other character makes a DC 15 DEX check or takes 2d8.
**Otherwise.** On any other turn it claws two random characters.

star dragon.name: Star Dragon
star dragon.desc: Kill it and something of it stays with you.
star dragon.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 46, ATK 2 bite +8 (2d10) and 1 tail +8 (2d6), MV double near (fly), S +5, D +3, C +5, I +4, W +4, Ch +4, AL L, LV 9
traits: **Courteous.** A party that withdraws is allowed to go, without a parting attack.
**Its Blessing.** Every character who survives killing a star dragon carries one Luck
Token, over and above their usual limit, until the end of the adventure.
**Hoard.** A dragon's hoard, and worth the adventure.

prince of ulthuan.name: Prince Of Ulthuan
prince of ulthuan.desc: *Tyrion.* The best blade on the island, and he knows exactly how good that is.
prince of ulthuan.stat: AC 18 (elven plate + shield), HP 39, ATK 3 sunfang +7 (1d10+2), MV double near, S +4, D +4, C +3, I +2, W +2, Ch +4, AL L, LV 8
traits: **Peerless.** Rolls initiative with advantage and cannot be surprised.
**Sunfang.** On a critical hit, the target also takes 2d6 fire damage.

sea drake.name: Sea Drake
sea drake.desc: It fights as happily in the water as out of it.
sea drake.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 31, ATK 2 bite +6 (1d10+1), MV double near (fly, swim), S +4, D +2, C +4, I +1, W +2, Ch +0, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Immune to lightning.**
**At Home in the Water.** No penalty of any kind for fighting submerged, and characters
fighting it in water attack at disadvantage unless they can swim freely.

moon dragon.name: Moon Dragon
moon dragon.desc: It does not attack anyone who is not already caught in the illusion.
moon dragon.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 44, ATK 1 bite +8 (2d10), MV double near (fly), S +4, D +3, C +4, I +4, W +4, Ch +3, AL N, LV 9
traits: **Veil of Moonlight.** Before anyone acts, every character makes a DC 15 WIS check or is
caught: it may neither attack nor cast that turn. Elves roll this with advantage.

archmage.name: Archmage
archmage.desc: *Teclis.* Spells die in the air in front of him.
archmage.stat: AC 12, HP 44, ATK 2 spell +7, MV near, S -1, D +2, C -1, I +4, W +2, Ch +1, AL L, LV 10
traits: **Death Bolt (INT Spell).** DC 15. One target of LV 9 or less within near makes a DC 15 CON check or goes to 0 HP.
**Enervate (INT Spell).** DC 14. Focus. One target within near is stupefied for the duration.
**Fireblast (INT Spell).** DC 14. 4d6 damage to all within a near-sized cube within far.
**Float (INT Spell).** DC 14. Self. Fly double near for 5 rounds.
**Mithralskin (INT Spell).** DC 14. Self. AC becomes 18 for 5 rounds.
**Void Step (INT Spell).** DC 15. Self and up to 4 willing targets teleport up to 100 miles.
**Nullify.** Every spell cast at the archmage fails entirely on a 1–2 on 1d6.
**Turn the Word.** Once per encounter, he reflects one spell cast at him back on its
caster in full. No check.

boneworm.name: Boneworm
boneworm.desc: Pale things that crunch the bone to get at the marrow.
boneworm.stat: AC 13, HP 10, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6), MV near (burrow), S +1, D +1, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Marrow.** No character killed by boneworms can be raised or resurrected.
**Not Undead.** Holy water does them no damage at all, but the touch of it forces an
immediate morale check.
**Always Fight.** Boneworms never check morale and never withdraw.

fungu leech.name: Fungus Leech
fungu leech.desc: Bite, poison, and they come off with salt.
fungu leech.stat: AC 12, HP 7, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4 + poison), MV near (climb), S -1, D +1, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d4.
**Salt.** A bag of salt — 2 gp in any town — thrown at them kills two outright. Each
character may throw one bag per round.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they stay in the wet and nobody need go near them · 4–5 they take whoever wades · 6 they come overland after the party.

glow maggot.name: Glow Maggot
glow maggot.desc: Worth more as a lamp than as an enemy.
glow maggot.stat: AC 10, HP 3, ATK 1 bite +0 (1), MV close, S -3, D -2, C +0, I -4, W -2, Ch -4, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Living Lantern.** While any glow maggot is alive and carried, the party needs no other
light source. A slain maggot keeps burning for the next three rooms.
**Edible.** One may be eaten in place of a ration: DC 12 CON or lose 1d4 HP.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they go on glowing and take no notice of anyone · 5–6 one is trodden on, and the rest writhe and bite what is nearest.

mycognat.name: Myco-Gnat
mycognat.stat: AC 13, HP 3, ATK 1 bite +1 (1), MV near (fly), S -3, D +3, C +0, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Cloud.** While any myco-gnat is airborne, all spellcasting checks and ranged attacks
within near are at disadvantage.
**One Fireball.** Any area fire effect destroys the entire cloud at once.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 the cloud drifts off down the tunnel · 4–6 it stays with the party until fire or a draught moves it.

spore mite.name: Spore Mite
spore mite.desc: Small, and what they leave in your lungs lasts the fight.
spore mite.stat: AC 12, HP 4, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4 + spores), MV near, S -2, D +2, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Spores.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or cough for 1d4 rounds: disadvantage on attacks.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they stay in the fungus · 4–5 they puff once as the party passes and settle again · 6 the whole bed goes up.

ravenou rat.name: Ravenous Rat
ravenou rat.desc: They go for what you are holding before they go for you.
ravenou rat.stat: AC 12, HP 10, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4), MV near (climb), S +0, D +2, C +1, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Infestation.** Before anything else happens, every character makes a DC 12 DEX check or
drops everything held — weapon, shield and lantern — and forfeits its next action
retrieving it. Dwarves and barbarians roll with advantage.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they take the rations and go · 3–4 they follow the party for the smell of food without attacking · 5–6 they come for what is held.

stormvermin.name: Stormvermin
stormvermin.desc: The black-armoured clan elite, and the only skaven who hold a line.
stormvermin.stat: AC 17 (chainmail + shield), HP 26, ATK 2 halberd (close/near) +5 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +3, I +1, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Elite.** Checks morale with advantage.
**Keen Nose.** Advantage on checks to detect hidden and nearby foes.

globadier.name: Globadier
globadier.desc: The glass breaks first and the green comes out of it.
globadier.stat: AC 14 (leather), HP 20, ATK 1 poison wind globe (near) +4 or 1 blade +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +3, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Poison Wind Globe.** Thrown before melee. Every character within near makes a DC 12 CON
check or takes 2d6; the two characters at the front of the marching order roll this check
at disadvantage.

gutter runner.name: Gutter Runner
gutter runner.desc: They are already in the room and they always go first.
gutter runner.stat: AC 15 (leather), HP 14, ATK 2 poisoned dagger (close/near) +4 (1d6), MV near (climb), S +1, D +4, C +1, I +1, W +2, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Always First.** Gutter runners act before the party every round, even when met as
wandering monsters.
**Infiltrator.** Advantage on all climb, sneak and hide checks.
**Cut and Run.** Once half the gutter runners are dead, the rest flee automatically.

plague monk.name: Plague Monk
plague monk.desc: The blades are not cleaned, and that is deliberate.
plague monk.stat: AC 13, HP 16, ATK 2 infected blade +4 (1d6 + rot), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Rot.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or lose 1d4 HP at the end of the encounter, and again each
day until cured.
**Keen Nose.** Advantage on checks to detect hidden and nearby foes.
**Censer Bearers.** A variant: the same profile at LV 4, which never flees and whose rot
is DC 12.

clanrat.name: Clanrat
clanrat.desc: A crossbow volley, then flails that go round the shield.
clanrat.stat: AC 15 (leather + shield), HP 16, ATK 1 crossbow (far) +4 (1d6) or 1 flail +4 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Volley.** Each clanrat fires once before melee is joined.
**Flails.** Shields give no AC bonus against them.
**Keen Nose.** Advantage on checks to detect hidden and nearby foes.
**Mob.** Attacks with advantage in melee while beside an ally.

jezzail team.name: Jezzail Team
jezzail team.desc: They fire first every round and they never close.
jezzail team.stat: AC 14 (leather + pavise), HP 18, ATK 1 jezzail (far) +4 (1d12), MV near, S +1, D +3, C +2, I +1, W +2, Ch -2, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Long Shot.** A jezzail team acts first every round and will not enter melee. It
withdraws rather than be closed with.

plague furnace.name: Plague Furnace
plague furnace.desc: A wheeled altar with a bell, and the rot comes off it in sheets.
plague furnace.stat: AC 15, HP 40, ATK 2 censer sweep +6 (1d10 + rot), MV near, S +4, D -1, C +4, I -1, W +2, Ch -2, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Horde.** Each of its two attacks must target a different creature within close.
**Rot.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or lose 1d6 HP at the start of each of the character's turns
until the furnace is destroyed. Nothing stops it short of killing the thing, escaping
beyond far, or a teleport.
**Never checks morale.** Always fights to the death.

doomwheel.name: Doomwheel
doomwheel.desc: It is coming apart, and it knows roughly when.
doomwheel.stat: AC 14, HP 26, ATK 2 powered blade +5 (1d10), MV double near, S +3, D +2, C +3, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Powered Blades.** Shields give no AC bonus against it.
**Coming Apart.** At the end of each of its turns, roll 1d4. If the roll is less than the
number of that turn, the doomwheel explodes: every character within near makes a DC 15
DEX check or takes 4d6, and the machine is destroyed.
**Machine.** Immune to morale, fear, charm, sleep, poison and mind-affecting spells.
**Scrap.** 1d6 pieces of warp-scrap worth 20 gp each.

hell pit abomination.name: Hell Pit Abomination
hell pit abomination.desc: Sewn together out of whatever Clan Moulder had to hand.
hell pit abomination.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 37, ATK 2 fist +7 (1d12), MV near, S +5, D +0, C +5, I -3, W -1, Ch -4, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Sewn Together.** Bludgeoning weapons deal no damage at all. Immune to every spell
except fire-based spells.
**Crushing Fists.** On a critical hit, the damage is dealt twice over.
**Checks morale with advantage.**

brood horror.name: Brood Horror
brood horror.desc: A two-headed rat-thing out of the Hell Pit, big as an ox. The acid takes your gear first.
brood horror.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 40, ATK 2 bite +7 (1d12) or 2 acid spit (near) +8, MV near, S +5, D +1, C +4, I -2, W +1, Ch -3, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Acid Spit.** On a hit, the character takes 2d6 and loses one piece of gear to the acid,
in this order: shield, armour, main weapon. A round spent readying a replacement restores
the character to the fight. Masterwork and magical gear is only knocked away, and is
recovered when the brood horror is dead.
**Immune to acid and to lightning.**

skaven warlord.name: Skaven Warlord
skaven warlord.desc: *Queek Headtaker.* The warren holds while he does, and not one round longer.
skaven warlord.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 35, ATK 3 halberd (close/near) +7 (1d10+1), MV near, S +4, D +2, C +3, I +1, W +2, Ch +1, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Warlord.** Every skaven in the room checks morale with advantage while he lives, and at
disadvantage on the round he falls.
**Keen Nose.** Advantage on checks to detect hidden and nearby foes.

rat ogre.name: Rat Ogre
rat ogre.desc: Vat-grown, unstable, and not always sure whose side it is on.
rat ogre.stat: AC 13, HP 31, ATK 3 rending claw +6 (1d10+1), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +4, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Run Amok.** At the start of each of its turns, roll 1d6: on a 1 it attacks the nearest
creature instead, friend or foe.
**Berserk.** If it fails a morale check it goes berserk rather than fleeing: +1 attack
per round, and it attacks the closest target, friend or foe.

warlock engineer.name: Warlock Engineer
warlock engineer.desc: *Ikit Claw.* The machine is as likely to go off in his hands.
warlock engineer.stat: AC 13, HP 28, ATK 2 warp blade +5 (1d8) or 1 warplock pistol (far) +6 (1d10), MV near, S +1, D +3, C +2, I +4, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Warpstone Blast.** Once per encounter: every character within near makes a DC 15 DEX
check or takes 3d6.
**Backfire.** On a natural 1 on any of his attacks, he takes 1d6 from his own machinery.

plague priest.name: Plague Priest
plague priest.desc: He leads the mob and he carries what the mob carries.
plague priest.stat: AC 14, HP 24, ATK 2 censer +5 (1d8 + rot), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +3, I +1, W +3, Ch +0, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Rot.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or lose 1d4 HP at the end of the encounter and each day
after until cured.
**His Mob.** Leads 1d6+2 Plague Monks, which never check morale while he lives.

skaven assassin.name: Skaven Assassin
skaven assassin.desc: *Deathmaster Snikch.* He leaves at half, and comes back whole.
skaven assassin.stat: AC 16 (leather), HP 28, ATK 2 weeping blade +6 (1d8 + poison), MV double near (climb), S +2, D +5, C +2, I +2, W +3, Ch +0, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Always First.** Always surprises and always acts first, even as a wandering monster.
**Poison.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or take an extra 1d6.
**Withdraws.** At half HP he vanishes, and returns at full HP at the party's next
encounter, striking first.

grey seer.name: Grey Seer
grey seer.desc: *Grey Seer Thanquol.* The white fur is what the magic costs.
grey seer.stat: AC 13, HP 32, ATK 1 staff +5 (1d6) or 1 spell +7, MV near, S -1, D +2, C +2, I +4, W +3, Ch +1, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Call the Clan.** At the start of each of his turns, 2-in-6 chance that 1d4 Clanrats
arrive.
**Warp Lightning (INT Spell).** DC 15. Green lightning strikes everything in a line out
to far: 3d6 damage, half on a DC 15 DEX check.
**Mutating Beam (INT Spell).** DC 15. One creature within far takes 2d6 and makes a DC 15
CON check or has disadvantage on all rolls for 1d4 rounds.

cave squig lesser.name: Cave Squig, Lesser
cave squig lesser.stat: AC 13, HP 11, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I -4, W -1, Ch -4, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Bounding.** Moves double near and cannot be opportunity-attacked.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they bounce away; 3 they bounce straight past the party and onward; 4–6 they fight.

giant centipede.name: Giant Centipede
giant centipede.desc: Fast, low, and poisonous out of all proportion.
giant centipede.stat: AC 11, HP 4, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4 + poison), MV near (climb), S -3, D +1, C +0, I -4, W -3, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Poison.** DC 12 CON or paralyzed 1d4 rounds.

giant rat.name: Giant Rat
giant rat.desc: Numerous, filthy, and edible if you are the right sort.
giant rat.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4 + disease), MV near, S -2, D +1, C +1, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Disease.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or 1d4 CON damage, and no healing while ill. Repeat the check once a day; it ends on a success. Death at 0 CON.
**Rations.** Goblins, orcs, ogres and trolls count each slain rat as one ration.

bat.name: Bat
bat.desc: Enough of them to ruin a spell and nothing more.
bat.stat: AC 13, HP 3, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4), MV near (fly), S -3, D +3, C +0, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Shrieking.** While bats are in the air, spellcasting checks within near are at
disadvantage.

snotling.name: Snotling
snotling.desc: The smallest goblinoid, barely smart enough to take simple directions.
snotling.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 4, ATK 1 sticks and stones +2 (1d4), MV near, S -1, D +2, C +0, I -3, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 1
traits: **Stupid.** Snotlings never take morale tests, but tend to do the worst possible thing at
the worst possible time: at the start of each round, 1-in-6 chance they do something
catastrophic and useless.
**Dwarf-Bait.** Dwarves attack snotlings with advantage.

giant spider.name: Giant Spider
giant spider.desc: Hairy, dog-sized hunters that drop out of the webs. The bite keeps working after the fight.
giant spider.stat: AC 13, HP 13, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d4 + poison), MV near (climb), S +2, D +3, C +0, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Poison.** DC 12 CON or paralyzed 1d4 hours.
**Webs.** The party cannot withdraw from the encounter until the webs are burned — any
fire spell, or three rounds of torch work.

morlock.name: Morlock
morlock.desc: Pale, silent, and they will not come near a lantern.
morlock.stat: AC 13, HP 18, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d6), MV near (climb), S +2, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Light-Shy.** Morlocks attack a character carrying a lit light source with disadvantage.
**Trade.** They know the tunnels, and will sell what they know for 15 gp or five rations.

cockatrice.name: Cockatrice
cockatrice.desc: The beak is survivable. The other thing is not.
cockatrice.stat: AC 11, HP 14, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4 + petrify), MV near (fly), S -2, D +1, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Petrify.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or petrified.

gargoyle.name: Gargoyle
gargoyle.desc: Stone until it is not, and it was watching the whole time.
gargoyle.stat: AC 16, HP 20, ATK 2 claw +3 (1d6), MV near (fly), S +3, D +1, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Impervious.** Only damaged by magical sources.
**Statue.** 4-in-6 chance of surprise when encountered perched among ordinary stonework.

troglodyte.name: Troglodyte
troglodyte.desc: You cannot fight in that smell and they know it.
troglodyte.stat: AC 14 (natural), HP 26, ATK 2 stone axe +5 (1d8), MV near (climb), S +3, D +1, C +4, I -2, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Stench.** Before combat, every character makes a DC 12 CON check or retches: no attacks
for 1d3 rounds. Alchemists, plague doctors and anyone with a sealed mask are immune, and
a *protection* spell cast immediately before combat shields one character.
**Fire-Shy.** Any area fire effect forces an immediate morale check.

chao cube.name: Chaos Cube
chao cube.desc: One attack against everyone, every round, and lightning is the way to end it.
chao cube.stat: AC 15, HP 30, ATK 3 facet +6 (1d8), MV near (fly), S +3, D +1, C +3, I -2, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Every Hand.** Each attack must target a different creature within close.
**Grounded by Lightning.** Lightning and all electrical damage is rolled with advantage
and deals an extra 2d6.
**Impervious.** Immune to sleep, charm, fear and morale.

doppelganger.name: Doppelganger
