doppelganger.desc: It has already met one of you.
doppelganger.stat: AC 12, HP 20, ATK 1 dagger (close/near) +2 (1d4), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +2, I +1, W +0, Ch +4, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Change Shape.** In place of attacks, transforms into any similarly sized humanoid.
**Telepathy.** Secretly hears the surface thoughts of all humanoids within near.

giant spider great.name: Giant Spider, Great
giant spider great.desc: The old one, at the centre of the web.
giant spider great.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 30, ATK 2 bite +6 (1d10 + poison), MV near (climb), S +3, D +3, C +3, I -2, W +2, Ch -3, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or take an extra 2d6.
**Webs.** The party cannot withdraw until the webs are burned.

giant scorpion.name: Giant Scorpion
giant scorpion.desc: Two claws, a sting, and it serves a Stygian tomb as readily as a dungeon.
giant scorpion.stat: AC 14, HP 13, ATK 1 claw +2 (1d6 + grab) and 1 sting +2 (1d4 + poison), MV near (climb), S +2, D +2, C +0, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Grab.** DC 12 STR or the target is held. DC 12 STR on its turn to break free.
**Poison.** DC 12 CON or go to 0 HP.

rust monster.name: Rust Monster
rust monster.desc: *Iron Eater.* It does you no harm at all, which is not the same as leaving you alone.
rust monster.stat: AC 13, HP 19, ATK 2 claw +3 (1d6), MV near (climb), S +2, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Corrosive.** Metal that touches the rust monster is destroyed on a d6 roll of 1–3.

catoblepa.name: Catoblepas
catoblepa.desc: It does not want to look at you either.
catoblepa.stat: AC 14 (natural), HP 26, ATK 2 gore +5 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D -1, C +4, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Gaze.** At the start of the encounter, every character within near makes a DC 12 CON
check or takes 2d6 and attacks at disadvantage for 1d4 rounds.

young red dragon.name: Young Red Dragon
young red dragon.desc: It opens with the breath, and it is never met wandering.
young red dragon.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 46, ATK 2 bite +8 (2d10) and 1 claw +8 (2d6), MV double near (fly), S +5, D +2, C +5, I +3, W +3, Ch +3, AL C, LV 9
traits: **Opening Breath.** On its first turn it breathes without fail: a cone out to near, 5d6
fire, half on a DC 15 DEX check.
**Thereafter.** Breathes again every 1d4 rounds.
**Never Wandering.** This dragon is placed, not stumbled into.

wyvern.name: Wyvern
wyvern.desc: A big target in the air and a fast one on the ground.
wyvern.stat: AC 15, HP 37, ATK 2 rend +6 (1d8) and 1 stinger +6 (1d6 + poison), MV double near (fly), S +4, D +2, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 8
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or take an extra 2d10.
**Out of the Dark.** 4-in-6 chance of surprise.
**Venom Sac.** Its sting yields a vial worth 3d6 × 20 gp.

cavern werebear.name: Cavern Werebear
cavern werebear.desc: Silver is the only thing it takes seriously.
cavern werebear.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 31, ATK 2 claw +6 (1d10), MV double near, S +4, D +1, C +4, I +0, W +2, Ch -1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Silver.** Silvered weapons attack with advantage and deal +1d6.
**Regeneration.** Regains 1d6 HP at the end of every third round.
**Not Contagious.** Its bite passes on nothing.

fire bear.name: Fire Bear
fire bear.desc: Six-legged, and it breathes again every time you use fire on it.
fire bear.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 31, ATK 2 claw +6 (1d10), MV double near, S +4, D +1, C +4, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Fire Breath.** It opens the fight by breathing: every character within near makes a DC
14 DEX check or takes 2d8 fire, half on a success. It breathes again at the end of any
round in which a character used a fire effect against it.
**Never checks morale.**

medusa.name: Medusa
medusa.desc: Look at her before the ranged attacks start, or do not look at all.
medusa.stat: AC 14, HP 38, ATK 1 snake bite +6 (1d6 + poison), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I +2, W +3, Ch +4, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Godborn.** Hostile spells targeting the medusa are DC 15 to cast.
**Petrify.** Any creature, the medusa included, that looks directly at her makes a DC 15 CON check or is petrified.
**Poison.** DC 15 CON or go to 0 HP.

dragon.name: Dragon
dragon.desc: The one the dungeon was dug around.
dragon.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 40, ATK 2 bite +7 (2d8) and 1 tail +7 (2d6), MV double near (fly), S +5, D +2, C +4, I +3, W +3, Ch +2, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Breath.** Once every 1d4 rounds: a cone out to near, 4d6 of the dragon's element, half
on a DC 15 DEX check.
**Hoard.** A dragon's hoard.

coachman.name: Coachman
coachman.desc: Altdorf to Middenheim in ten days, wolves and weather permitting.
coachman.stat: AC 12 (leather), HP 10, ATK 1 blunderbuss (near) +2 (1d8) or 1 whip (close/near) +2 (1d4), MV near, S +1, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Blunderbuss.** The shot hits every creature in a close-wide spread at near: one attack roll against all of them. It takes two rounds to reload.
**Whip Up.** On the box he drives the coach at double near, and anyone in its path makes a DC 12 DEX check or takes 2d6.
**Carries.** The waybill, the mail, 2d6 gp. The strongbox under the seat holds 1d6 × 10 gp.

tollkeeper.name: Toll-Keeper
tollkeeper.desc: The road is the Emperor's. The gate across it is his.
tollkeeper.stat: AC 12 (leather), HP 5, ATK 1 crossbow (far) +2 (1d6) or 1 cudgel +1 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL L, LV 1
traits: **The Tariff.** 1 sp a leg, double for wheels, triple for dwarfs. A DC 12 CHA check halves it. Riding through is a minor crime, and the next toll has been told.
**Sees Who Passes.** He remembers everyone who came through this week, and sells the list for 1 gp.
**Carries.** The strongbox key, 3d6 sp in tolls.

halfling pieman.name: Halfling Pieman
halfling pieman.desc: From the Moot, by way of every kitchen door in the province.
halfling pieman.stat: AC 12, HP 3, ATK 1 thrown pie (near) +2 (1) or 1 carving knife +2 (1d4), MV near, S -1, D +2, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +1, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Kitchen Gossip.** He sells to every servant in town, and knows what each house had for dinner and who came to eat it. The price is a pie, at 2 cp.
**Small and Quick.** Attacks against him by anything larger than a man have disadvantage.
**Carries.** 2d6 pies of uncertain meat, 2d6 cp.

stirland peasant.name: Stirland Peasant
stirland peasant.desc: Mud to the knee, a turnip cart, and a rowan twig sewn into his hat.
stirland peasant.stat: AC 10, HP 4, ATK 1 pitchfork +1 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL L, LV 0
traits: **The Sign Against Evil.** He takes any elf, wizard, or stranger with a mark on them for a witch, and says so loudly. The crowd's reaction to the party is one step worse while he is talking.
**Seen It Before.** He knows which barrow walks and which wood nobody cuts. A drink, and a DC 9 CHA check.
**Carries.** Turnips, a rowan charm, 1d6 cp.

burgher.name: Burgher
burgher.desc: A guild badge, a full purse and a seat on some committee.
burgher.stat: AC 10, HP 3, ATK 1 walking stick +0 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +1, W +0, Ch +0, AL L, LV 0
traits: **Guildsman.** Harming him is a major crime. His guild posts a reward of 4d6 gp by nightfall.
**Calls the Watch.** He shouts before he runs. 1d4 State Troopers arrive in 1d4 rounds.
**Carries.** A guild badge, a ring of keys, 2d6 sp.

ratcatcher.name: Rat-Catcher
ratcatcher.desc: He has been telling the council about the big ones for years.
ratcatcher.stat: AC 11, HP 4, ATK 1 dog bite +1 (1d4) or 1 sling (near) +1 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Small but Vicious Dog.** The dog does his fighting for him. It dies at the first hit that deals 3 or more damage, and then he never checks morale.
**Knows the Sewers.** He can lead the party under any street in town, and knows which tunnels were not dug by men.
**Immune to the Stink.** Advantage on CON checks against disease.
**Carries.** A pole of dead rats worth 1 cp a tail, traps, 2d6 cp.

agitator.name: Agitator
agitator.desc: Down with the Elector Counts, the toll, and the price of bread, in that order.
agitator.stat: AC 10, HP 5, ATK 1 cudgel +1 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +1, W +0, Ch +3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Rouse the Rabble.** After three rounds of uninterrupted speaking, 2d6 Burghers and Stirland Peasants within earshot turn on whoever he points at. They disperse when he falls or the Watch arrives.
**Wanted.** There is 10 gp on him in this town, and friends who will remember who collected it.
**Carries.** A bundle of pamphlets, a printer's address, 1d6 sp.

charcoalburner.name: Charcoal-Burner
charcoalburner.desc: Lives in the forest by choice, which the town finds hard to forgive.
charcoalburner.stat: AC 10, HP 6, ATK 1 wood-axe +1 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Knows the Drakwald.** He knows where the herdstone stands, which paths the Beastmen use and when. With him as a guide the party is never surprised in the forest.
**Left Alone.** The Beastmen do not trouble him. He will not say why.
**Carries.** A cart of charcoal worth 2 gp, 1d6 sp.

mutant in hiding.name: Mutant In Hiding
mutant in hiding.desc: It began as a rash, the winter the green moon came close.
mutant in hiding.stat: AC 11, HP 9, ATK 1 knife +2 (1d4) or 1 mutation +2 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL N, LV 2
traits: **The Mark (d6).** 1 a tentacle for an arm, which grabs: a DC 12 STR check to break free · 2 scales, AC 14 · 3 a second mouth, which bites as its mutation attack and talks in its sleep · 4 eyes on stalks, and it cannot be surprised · 5 cloven hooves, MV double near · 6 acid blood: whoever wounds it in melee takes 1d4.
**Nothing to Lose.** Exposed, it never checks morale. Kept secret, it will do almost anything asked.
**Carries.** Gloves, a deep hood, 2d6 sp, and a letter from a cult that has noticed.

priest of sigmar.name: Priest Of Sigmar
priest of sigmar.desc: The Empire was founded with a hammer, and he sees no reason to change tools.
priest of sigmar.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 15, ATK 1 warhammer +3 (1d10), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +3, Ch +1, AL L, LV 3
traits: **Hammer of Sigmar.** Against undead, daemons, mutants and greenskins his warhammer deals an extra 1d6.
**Litany.** Allies who can hear him check morale with advantage, and those within near are immune to fear.
**Denounce.** If he names a character a heretic in public, no one in town will sell to, shelter or speak for them until a higher priest says otherwise.
**Carries.** A book of the *Deus Sigmar*, a twin-tailed comet in silver worth 10 gp, 2d6 sp.

dowager countess.name: Dowager Countess
dowager countess.desc: She has buried two husbands and an elector, and remembers what each owed her.
dowager countess.stat: AC 10, HP 8, ATK 1 cane +0 (1d4), MV near, S -1, D +0, C +0, I +2, W +2, Ch +3, AL L, LV 2
traits: **A Word at Court.** She can have a warrant written or torn up by morning. Her favour is worth a pardon for one minor crime.
**Escort.** She is never without her troopers, and they never check morale while she watches.
**An Errand.** She wants a letter recovered or a nephew found, and pays 1d6 × 10 gp.
**Carries.** Jewels worth 2d6 × 10 gp, a seal ring.

strigany fortuneteller.name: Strigany Fortune-Teller
strigany fortuneteller.desc: Her people came out of the east, and are blamed for everything that followed them.
strigany fortuneteller.stat: AC 10, HP 5, ATK 1 knife +1 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +1, W +2, Ch +2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Reads the Cards.** For 1 gp she turns three cards. Once per character, ever, the reading is true: the GM answers one question about what lies ahead.
**Evil Eye.** Once per day. One creature within near makes a DC 12 WIS check or has disadvantage on its next three checks.
**The Old Masters.** Her caravan still pays a tithe to something in Sylvania. She knows which castles are occupied.
**Carries.** A worn deck, a silver earring worth 3 gp, 2d6 sp.

altdorf urchin.name: Altdorf Urchin
altdorf urchin.desc: Knows every bridge, and who sleeps under it.
altdorf urchin.stat: AC 12, HP 3, ATK 1 thrown stone (near) +2 (1), MV near (climb), S -1, D +2, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Through the Fog.** For 1 cp he leads the party anywhere in the city by a way the Watch does not use.
**Saw the Rat-Men.** He has seen things come out of the drains. No adult has ever believed him.
**Never Fights.** He runs, and cannot be caught in streets he knows.
**Carries.** Somebody's handkerchief, 1d4 cp.

drummer boy.name: Drummer Boy
drummer boy.desc: The regiment's luck, and the only one the sergeant does not shout at.
drummer boy.stat: AC 11, HP 3, ATK 1 drumstick +0 (1), MV near, S -1, D +1, C +0, I +0, W +0, Ch +1, AL L, LV 0
traits: **Beat to Arms.** If he reaches his drum, 1d4 State Troopers arrive in 1d4 rounds.
**The Regiment's Luck.** Soldiers who see him harmed never check morale for the rest of the fight.
**Carries.** A drum in the elector's colours, 1d6 cp.

foundling of shallya.name: Foundlings Of Shallya
foundling of shallya.desc: A dozen orphans in grey, walked out twice a week for the air.
foundling of shallya.stat: AC 11, HP 3, ATK none, MV near, S -2, D +1, C +0, I +0, W +0, Ch +1, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Under the Dove.** Nobody in the Old World will stand by while they are harmed. Anyone who does it is attacked by every adult in sight.
**They Stare.** They have seen the party, and will describe every scar and weapon to whoever asks kindly.
**Carries.** Nothing. The sister with them has 1d6 cp for bread.

sister of shallya.name: Sister Of Shallya
sister of shallya.desc: The white dove's order turns nobody away, and carries nothing sharper than a needle.
sister of shallya.stat: AC 10, HP 9, ATK none, MV near, S +0, D +0, C +1, I +1, W +3, Ch +2, AL L, LV 2
traits: **Mercy.** Twice per day she heals 1d6 HP with a touch, and once per day ends a disease or a poison.
**Never Fights.** She will not strike, and she tends the party's enemies as readily as the party.
**The One Exception.** She will not heal a servant of the Plague God, and knows one on sight.
**Carries.** Bandages, a dove pendant, no money at all.

burgher wife.name: Burgher'S Wife
burgher wife.desc: She keeps the shop's books, whatever the guild roll says.
burgher wife.stat: AC 10, HP 3, ATK 1 basket +0 (1), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +1, W +1, Ch +1, AL L, LV 0
traits: **Knows the Street.** She knows who is in debt, who has a new lodger and whose cellar light burns all night. A DC 12 CHA check, or a real grievance against a neighbour.
**Good Family.** Harming her is a major crime.
**Carries.** The shop keys, 2d6 sp.

camp follower.name: Camp Follower
camp follower.desc: Laundress, cook, nurse and wife to the Fourth Company, more or less.
camp follower.stat: AC 10, HP 4, ATK 1 knife +0 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Knows the Regiment.** She can say where it is marching, how many are sick, and when it was last paid.
**Strips the Field.** She will sell 1d4 pieces of gear off the dead at half price, no questions either way.
**Carries.** A needle case, a soldier's ring, 2d6 cp.

charmseller.name: Charm-Seller
charmseller.desc: Blessed at the shrine of your choice, she says, and names six.
charmseller.stat: AC 10, HP 3, ATK 1 stick +0 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +1, W +0, Ch +2, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Charms.** 5 sp each. Roll a d6 when one is first tested: on a 6 it is real, and gives advantage on one check against a spell, a curse or a mutation before it crumbles.
**Knows Who Buys.** She can name everyone in town afraid enough to buy a charm against witchcraft this month, and what frightened them.
**Carries.** 2d6 charms, 2d6 sp.

sutler woman.name: Sutler Woman
sutler woman.desc: Follows the army, and sells it what the quartermaster forgot.
sutler woman.stat: AC 11 (leather), HP 6, ATK 1 cudgel +1 (1d4), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Stock.** Rations, lamp oil, powder, boots and Bretonnian brandy at twice the town price, anywhere.
**Owed by Everyone.** Half the regiment is in her book. 1d4 State Troopers will step in for her rather than see the book burned.
**Carries.** A mule, goods worth 6d6 gp, the book.

guild assassin.name: Guild Assassin
guild assassin.desc: The contract is lawful in three provinces if the paperwork is in order.
guild assassin.stat: AC 15 (leather), HP 20, ATK 2 poisoned blade +4 (1d6 + poison) or 1 garrotte +4 (1d6), MV near (climb), S +1, D +4, C +1, I +2, W +2, Ch +0, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or take an extra 1d6.
**The Mark.** He attacks only the name on the contract, unless someone stands in the way.
**The Contract.** It can be bought out for twice its fee, 2d6 × 20 gp, paid to the guild. Then he leaves.
**Out of the Dark.** 3-in-6 chance of surprise.
**Carries.** A sealed contract, a phial of manbane worth 30 gp.

tilean poisoner.name: Tilean Poisoner
tilean poisoner.desc: In Tilea it is a profession, with masters and apprentices.
tilean poisoner.stat: AC 12, HP 14, ATK 1 stiletto +3 (1d4 + poison), MV near, S +0, D +2, C +0, I +3, W +1, Ch +2, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or take an extra 2d6.
**In the Cup.** A character who eats or drinks in the same house makes a DC 15 WIS check to notice, or a DC 15 CON check an hour later or drops to 0 HP.
**The Antidote.** There is always one phial, and it is always for sale.
**Carries.** Three doses, one antidote, perfumes worth 20 gp.

racketeer.name: Racketeer
racketeer.desc: Insurance, he calls it, against fire and broken windows.
racketeer.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 10, ATK 1 cosh +2 (1d4) or 1 knife +2 (1d4), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I +1, W +1, Ch +1, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Protection.** Every shop on the street pays him. Nobody on it saw anything.
**Send the Lads.** If he is crossed and lives, 1d6 Protagonists find the party within a day.
**Carries.** A ledger of who pays, 4d6 sp.

wrecker.name: Wrecker
wrecker.desc: The village has lived off the rocks for two hundred years.
wrecker.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 boat-hook +1 (1d6), MV near (swim), S +1, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 1
traits: **False Light.** A pilot steering by his lantern makes a DC 15 WIS check or puts the ship on the rocks.
**No Survivors.** The law gives the wreck to the finder only if nobody lives. He knows the law.
**Carries.** Salvage worth 2d6 gp, a dark lantern.

protagonist.name: Protagonist
protagonist.desc: He insults your mother, you swing, and four witnesses say you started it.
protagonist.stat: AC 12 (leather), HP 6, ATK 1 cudgel +2 (1d4), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Paid to Provoke.** He was hired to start this. A DC 12 WIS check sees it. Whoever strikes the first blow is the one the Watch arrests.
**Stay Down.** He fights to knock out, and stops when his man is on the floor.
**Carries.** The fee, 2d6 sp, and the name of who paid it for double.

guild pickpocket.name: Guild Pickpocket
guild pickpocket.desc: Licensed by the Thieves' Guild, which is the only licence he holds.
guild pickpocket.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 5, ATK 1 knife +2 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +2, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Lift.** A character he brushes past makes a DC 12 WIS check or loses a purse or one small item.
**Guild Member.** Robbing or killing him is the guild's business by morning, and Ranald's by reputation.
**Carries.** 1d4 purses of 1d6 sp each, a guild token.

body snatcher.name: Body Snatcher
body snatcher.desc: The university pays four crowns a corpse and does not ask. Others pay more.
body snatcher.stat: AC 10, HP 5, ATK 1 spade +1 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Fresh Graves.** He knows every burial this month and which graves are already empty.
**Two Buyers.** The second one pays in old silver and wants them whole. He will name the house for 5 gp, or to save his neck.
**Carries.** A spade, a sack, 1d6 sp, and 1d2 bodies on the cart.

reik smuggler.name: Reik Smuggler
reik smuggler.desc: The river has forty tolls between Nuln and the sea. He pays none.
reik smuggler.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 cutlass +1 (1d6), MV near (swim), S +1, D +1, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **The Cargo (d6).** 1–3 Bretonnian brandy · 4 untaxed powder · 5 books the Sigmarites burn · 6 a lead box he was told not to open, which holds warpstone.
**No Lights.** 3-in-6 chance of surprise on the water at night.
**Carries.** A share of the cargo worth 3d6 gp.

fence.name: Fence
fence.desc: Everything in the window has a history, and he has forgotten all of them.
fence.stat: AC 10, HP 4, ATK 1 dagger +1 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +2, W +2, Ch +1, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Buys Anything.** A third of its worth, in coin, tonight. Half, for something a witch hunter would burn.
**Knows the Piece.** He can say what an odd treasure is, where it was stolen from and who is looking for it.
**Carries.** 4d6 gp, a jeweller's glass, a bell-pull that brings 1d2 Protagonists.

unlicensed wizard.name: Unlicensed Wizard
unlicensed wizard.desc: The Colleges of Magic burn their own mistakes. He is one they missed.
unlicensed wizard.stat: AC 11, HP 13, ATK 1 dagger +1 (1d4) or 1 spell +3, MV near, S -1, D +1, C +0, I +3, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Petty Magic.** He casts *magic missile*, *sleep* and *light* with a DC 12 spellcasting check.

**Tzeentch's Curse.** When he rolls a natural 1 on a spellcasting check, the winds answer: every creature within near, himself included, makes a DC 12 CON check or takes 1d6, and a witch hunter hears of it.
**Hunted.** He will pay 3d6 gp, or teach what he knows, to be got out of town.
**Carries.** A grimoire with the College seal cut off, 2d6 gp.

robber knight.name: Robber Knight
robber knight.desc: The title is good. The estate was mortgaged in his grandfather's time.
robber knight.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 25, ATK 2 longsword +4 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +2, I +0, W +0, Ch +1, AL C, LV 5
traits: **His Toll.** A tenth of everything carried, or a fight. Merchants pay; the count has not yet sent anyone.
**Ransom.** He takes prisoners rather than kill, and asks 1d6 × 20 gp for each.
**The Tower.** Three days' ride off the road, and worth storming: 2d6 × 50 gp in plunder, and whoever is in the cellar.
**Carries.** A warhorse worth 150 gp, a signet, 4d6 gp.

gentleman of the road.name: Gentleman Of The Road
gentleman of the road.desc: Your money or your life, with an apology to the ladies.
gentleman of the road.stat: AC 14 (leather), HP 14, ATK 2 pistol (near) +3 (1d8) or 1 sabre +3 (1d6), MV double near, S +1, D +3, C +0, I +1, W +1, Ch +3, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Brace of Pistols.** Two shots before he must reload, both fired from the saddle.
**Stand and Deliver.** He takes purses, not lives, and leaves a traveller enough for the inn. Draw on him and that ends.
**Known Face.** There is 50 gp on him in three towns, and a ballad in all of them.
**Carries.** A mask, a fast horse worth 80 gp, 4d6 gp.

tilean crossbowman.name: Tilean Crossbowman
tilean crossbowman.desc: A professional. He would like that understood before the price is discussed.
tilean crossbowman.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 10, ATK 1 crossbow (far) +3 (1d6) or 1 short sword +2 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Pavise.** Behind his planted shield he has AC 17 against ranged attacks.
**The Contract.** He changes sides for double pay, once, and tells everyone afterwards.
**Carries.** 20 bolts, a pavise painted with a city's arms, 2d6 gp.

charlatan.name: Charlatan
charlatan.desc: Doktor Festus's Genuine Elixir, as taken by the Emperor's own physician.
charlatan.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 sword-cane +1 (1d6), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +0, I +2, W +0, Ch +3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **The Elixir.** 1 gp a bottle. Roll a d6 when drunk: 1 sick for a day, disadvantage on CON checks · 2–5 nothing · 6 heals 1d6 HP, to his own surprise.
**Fast Talk.** A character he speaks to for a round makes a DC 12 WIS check or believes him until the next dawn.
**A Head Start.** His horses are always harnessed. He leaves at the first sign of trouble at double near.
**Carries.** 2d6 bottles, forged letters patent, 3d6 gp.

runaway trooper.name: Runaway Trooper
runaway trooper.desc: He stood at the ford until the things came across it.
runaway trooper.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 6, ATK 1 halberd (close/near) +1 (1d10), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL N, LV 1
traits: **The Rope.** The provosts hang deserters. He fights to the death rather than be taken, and surrenders at once to anyone else.
**What He Saw.** He can say what broke the regiment, how many of it there were, and which way it went.
**Carries.** Half a uniform, a halberd with the regiment's mark filed off, 1d6 sp.

outlaw of the drakwald.name: Outlaw Of The Drakwald
outlaw of the drakwald.desc: The forest takes anyone the law does not want.
outlaw of the drakwald.stat: AC 12 (leather), HP 5, ATK 1 bow (far) +2 (1d6) or 1 hatchet +1 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +1, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Ambush.** In woodland, 3-in-6 chance of surprise.
**Worse Neighbours.** The Beastmen hunt the same roads. For a share of food he says where they were last night.
**Carries.** A hood, 12 arrows, 2d6 sp.

student of the university.name: Student Of The University
student of the university.desc: Law, this year. It was theology until the duel.
student of the university.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 rapier +1 (1d6) or 1 tankard +1 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +0, I +2, W -1, Ch +1, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Town and Gown.** Only the university may try him. The Watch will not arrest him, and arrests whoever hurt him.
**Reads It.** Sober, he can read Classical, and knows which professor would pay for a strange book.
**Carries.** A duelling scar, a pawn ticket, 1d6 sp.

dockside pit fighter.name: Dockside Pit Fighter
dockside pit fighter.desc: A notched ear, a knuckleduster, and thirty wins in the pits under the Bögenhafen docks.
dockside pit fighter.stat: AC 12, HP 11, ATK 2 knuckleduster +2 (1d4), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Dirty.** On a natural 18 or higher the target also has disadvantage on its next attack.
**Takes a Wager.** He fights anyone bare-handed for 2d6 gp a side, and loses on purpose for twice that.
**Carries.** A knuckleduster, 2d6 sp, a promoter looking for him.

estalian diestro.name: Estalian Diestro
estalian diestro.desc: He fights by geometry, and explains it while he does.
estalian diestro.stat: AC 14 (leather), HP 14, ATK 2 rapier +3 (1d6), MV near, S +0, D +3, C +1, I +2, W +1, Ch +2, AL N, LV 3
traits: **The Circle.** The first melee attack against him each round has disadvantage.
**Point of Honour.** He fights one opponent at a time and to first blood, and expects the same. Break that and he fights to kill.
**Carries.** A rapier worth 30 gp, a treatise, 2d6 gp.

ogre doorman.name: Ogre Doorman
ogre doorman.desc: Ogres hire out to anyone who feeds them. The landlord feeds him well.
ogre doorman.stat: AC 11 (leather), HP 22, ATK 2 fist +4 (1d8), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +3, I -2, W +0, Ch -1, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Out You Go.** Instead of an attack: the target makes a DC 15 STR check or is thrown a near distance through the door, and lands prone for 1d6.
**Always Hungry.** A whole roast pig, about 2 gp, buys his goodwill for the night.
**Carries.** A gut-plate, a bone to pick, 2d6 sp.

troll slayer.name: Troll Slayer
troll slayer.desc: A dwarf who has sworn to die fighting, and keeps not managing it.
troll slayer.stat: AC 11, HP 22, ATK 2 great axe +4 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +3, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL L, LV 4
traits: **Seeks His Doom.** Never checks morale, never surrenders, and always attacks the largest enemy present.
**Shame.** Ask what he did and he fights the one who asked, with fists, to knockout.
**Will Follow.** Tell him where a troll, giant or daemon lairs and he comes along for nothing.
**Carries.** An axe worth 20 gp, gold rings in his beard worth 2d6 gp, ale.

captain of the count army.name: Captain Of The Count'S Army
captain of the count army.desc: He bought the commission, and has been earning it ever since.
captain of the count army.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 25, ATK 2 longsword +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +2, AL L, LV 5
traits: **Hold the Line.** Soldiers within near of him check morale with advantage.
**Billets.** He can quarter eighty men on a village with a word, or march them past it for 4d6 gp.
**Carries.** A commission with the elector's seal, 4d6 gp.

regimental sergeant.name: Regimental Sergeant
regimental sergeant.desc: Thirty years in the same regiment, under nine captains, and he ran it for all of them.
regimental sergeant.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 20, ATK 2 halberd (close/near) +3 (1d10), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I +0, W +2, Ch +1, AL L, LV 4
traits: **Knows a Deserter.** Advantage on WIS checks to see through a lie about who someone is or where they have been.
**Bawl.** Soldiers within near who hear him never check morale.
**Carries.** The muster roll, a pace-stick, 2d6 gp.

handgunner.name: Handgunner
handgunner.desc: The gun misfires one day in six and he loves it anyway.
handgunner.stat: AC 12 (leather), HP 10, ATK 1 handgun (far) +2 (1d10) or 1 dagger +2 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL L, LV 2
traits: **Slow Match.** The handgun takes a full round to reload, and misfires on a natural 1: no shot, and a round to clear it.
**Thunder.** Animals and anyone who has never heard a gun check morale at the first shot.
**Carries.** Powder for ten shots, a forked rest, 2d6 sp.

roadwarden.name: Roadwarden
roadwarden.desc: The law between towns: one man, one horse, forty miles of road.
roadwarden.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 10, ATK 1 longsword +2 (1d8) or 1 pistol (near) +2 (1d8), MV double near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL L, LV 2
traits: **Knows the Road.** He can say who passed today, where the bridge is out, and which inn is not what it seems.
**Hangs Them Himself.** He may lawfully try and hang a highway robber where he finds him, and is not always careful which traveller that is.
**Carries.** A warrant, a coil of rope, 2d6 sp.

militiaman.name: Militiaman
militiaman.desc: Drills on the green one Sunday in four, and complains about it.
militiaman.stat: AC 12 (leather), HP 5, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +1 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +1, C +0, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL L, LV 1
traits: **Defending Home.** In sight of his own town wall he ignores morale until half HP. Out of sight of it, he checks at the first wound.
**Carries.** A militia badge, 1d6 sp.

state trooper.name: State Trooper
state trooper.desc: A halberd, a slashed doublet in the province's colours, and four months' pay owing.
state trooper.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 10, ATK 1 halberd (close/near) +2 (1d10) or 1 sword +2 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL L, LV 2
traits: **Unpaid.** A purse of 2d6 gp buys his silence, his halberd or his company for a week.
**His Regiment.** If he is not back from furlough on the day, a sergeant comes asking.
**Carries.** A furlough pass, 1d6 sp.

raw recruit.name: Raw Recruit
raw recruit.desc: A ploughboy in a coat cut for a bigger man.
raw recruit.stat: AC 11 (leather), HP 4, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +1 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +0, W -1, Ch +0, AL L, LV 0
traits: **Green.** Checks morale at the first wound to anyone on his side.
**Wants Out.** He will tell the party anything about the regiment for a kind word, and desert for a plausible plan.
**Carries.** The shilling, 1d6 cp.

outrider.name: Outrider
outrider.desc: The colonel's messenger and the regiment's eyes, and well aware of how he looks doing it.
outrider.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 14, ATK 1 pistol (near) +3 (1d8) or 1 sabre +3 (1d6), MV double near, S +1, D +2, C +0, I +1, W +0, Ch +2, AL L, LV 3
traits: **Brace of Pistols.** Two shots before he must reload, and he fires both from the saddle before closing.
**A Good Family.** Harming him is a major crime. He will take a foolish wager.
**Carries.** Sealed dispatches, a horse worth 60 gp, 3d6 gp.

artillery engineer.name: Artillery Engineer
artillery engineer.desc: A graduate of the gunnery school, with nine fingers and a notebook.
artillery engineer.stat: AC 11, HP 9, ATK 1 pistol (near) +2 (1d8) or 1 hammer +2 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +0, I +3, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Blasting Charge.** Once per fight he lights and throws a charge: every creature within close of the target point makes a DC 15 DEX check or takes 2d6, half on a success.
**Reads a Wall.** He can say where any fortification is weakest, and how long it would stand.
**Carries.** One spare charge, instruments worth 20 gp, 2d6 gp.

kislevite lancer.name: Kislevite Lancer
kislevite lancer.desc: Wings of eagle feathers on his back, and a horse he thinks more of than his colonel.
kislevite lancer.stat: AC 16 (chainmail + shield), HP 15, ATK 1 lance (close/near) +3 (1d10) or 1 sabre +3 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Charge.** On a turn in which he moves at least near before attacking, a lance hit deals double damage.
**From the North.** He knows what is coming down out of the wastes this year, and how far south it has got.
**Carries.** A letter for the Emperor's court, a flask of kvas, 2d6 gp.

knight of the order.name: Knight Of The Order
knight of the order.desc: Full plate, a lance, a squire two miles behind, and vows he takes seriously.
knight of the order.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 25, ATK 2 longsword +4 (1d8) or 1 lance (close/near) +4 (1d12), MV double near, S +3, D +0, C +2, I +0, W +2, Ch +1, AL L, LV 5
traits: **Vow.** Never checks morale against the undead or the servants of Chaos.
**Honour.** He accepts a fair challenge to single combat, and a yielded foe is safe with him.
**Carries.** A warhorse worth 150 gp, the order's badge, 3d6 gp.

captain of the fleet.name: Captain Of The Fleet
captain of the fleet.desc: A greatship, three hundred men, and orders from an elector who has never seen the sea.
captain of the fleet.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 24, ATK 2 sabre +4 (1d6) or 1 pistol (near) +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +1, I +2, W +1, Ch +2, AL L, LV 5
traits: **Press Warrant.** He may lawfully take any able seaman, and anyone who looks like one, aboard for the voyage.
**Hates Pirates.** He pays 10 gp a head, and a great deal more for a captain alive.
**Carries.** The warrant, a spyglass worth 50 gp, 4d6 gp.

master gunner.name: Master Gunner
master gunner.desc: He can lay a cannon by ear, which is as well.
master gunner.stat: AC 11 (leather), HP 14, ATK 1 linstock +3 (1d6) or 1 pistol (near) +3 (1d8), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +2, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Deaf.** He cannot be surprised by sight, and hears nothing said behind him.
**Powder.** He knows who in this port sells it, who buys more than they should, and where it is stored.
**Carries.** A linstock, a powder measure, 2d6 gp.

bosun.name: Bosun
bosun.desc: The crew fear the captain's displeasure and the bosun's arm, in that order on paper.
bosun.stat: AC 11, HP 15, ATK 1 rope's end +3 (1d4) or 1 cutlass +3 (1d6), MV near (climb), S +2, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch +1, AL N, LV 3
traits: **All Hands.** His pipe brings 1d6 Deckhands within 1d4 rounds.
**Start Them.** Sailors within near of him check morale with advantage.
**Carries.** A silver pipe worth 5 gp, 2d6 sp.

stevedore.name: Stevedore
stevedore.desc: One of the dockers' brotherhood, and nothing moves on this quay without it.
stevedore.stat: AC 10, HP 4, ATK 1 hook +1 (1d4), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +1, I -1, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Saw It Come Ashore.** He knows which ship carried what and which warehouse it went to. A DC 9 CHA check or 1d6 sp.
**Carries.** A cargo hook, 2d6 cp.

deckhand.name: Deckhand
deckhand.desc: At home anywhere above the deck and nowhere on land.
deckhand.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 knife +1 (1d4), MV near (climb), S +1, D +1, C +0, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Aloft.** Climbs rigging, walls and cranes at full speed.
**Looking for a Berth.** Paid off and nearly broke, he signs on with anyone for 2 sp a day.
**Carries.** A knife, a tattoo of a sea-god, 1d6 sp.

river bargeman.name: River Bargeman
river bargeman.desc: The river is the Empire's only good road, and he has poled the length of it.
river bargeman.stat: AC 10, HP 6, ATK 1 quant pole +1 (1d6), MV near (swim), S +1, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **The River.** He knows every lock, toll, inn and wrecker's light between the mountains and the sea.
**Passage.** He carries the party downstream for 5 sp a head, and asks no questions that would spoil the fee.
**Carries.** A pole, a jug, 2d6 sp.

ship marine.name: Ship'S Marine
ship marine.desc: A soldier who has learned to be sick quietly.
ship marine.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 10, ATK 1 cutlass +2 (1d6) or 1 handgun (far) +2 (1d10), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL L, LV 2
traits: **Sea Legs.** No penalty for fighting on a moving deck or a gangplank.
**Bribable.** 1d6 sp and a DC 12 CHA check, and he did not see them.
**Carries.** The watch list, a cudgel, 1d6 sp.

merchant master.name: Merchant Master
merchant master.desc: He owns a third of the ship and all of the worry.
merchant master.stat: AC 11, HP 9, ATK 1 cutlass +2 (1d6), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +0, I +2, W +1, Ch +1, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Passage.** He will carry the party anywhere on his route for 1 gp a head, or free if they stand guard.
**Short of Hands.** He needs a deck guard, a debt collected or a rival's cargo delayed, and pays 2d6 gp.
**Carries.** A bill of lading, 3d6 gp.

ship carpenter.name: Ship'S Carpenter
ship carpenter.desc: Shapes a hull by eye, and can hear a rotten plank.
ship carpenter.stat: AC 10, HP 5, ATK 1 adze +1 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +0, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Sound or Rotten.** He can tell at a glance whether a ship will reach the next port, and what was done to make it look as if it would.
**Carries.** An adze, a caulking iron, 2d6 sp.

norse harpooner.name: Norse Harpooner
norse harpooner.desc: He has put an iron into things much bigger than you.
norse harpooner.stat: AC 12 (leather), HP 11, ATK 1 harpoon (close/near) +2 (1d8) or 1 hand axe +2 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Line.** A harpoon hit holds: the target cannot move further from him until it spends an action on a DC 12 STR check, or the line is cut.
**Bored.** He will fight anyone for sport, and sail anywhere for a share.
**Carries.** Whale-ivory worth 2d6 gp.

river pilot.name: River Pilot
river pilot.desc: The river moves every spring. He is paid to know where it went.
river pilot.stat: AC 10, HP 9, ATK 1 boat-hook +2 (1d6), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +1, W +2, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **The Passage.** With him aboard, the bars and the estuary are safe. Without him, a DC 15 WIS check or the ship strikes.
**His Price.** 2d6 gp, doubled if he does not like the look of the cargo.
**Carries.** A sounding-pole, a small skiff.

crocodile of the styx.name: Crocodile Of The Styx
crocodile of the styx.desc: The jaws lock and the rest of the fight happens around it.
crocodile of the styx.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 17, ATK 1 bite +4 (1d8 + lock), MV near (swim), S +3, D +0, C +3, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **From the Water.** 4-in-6 chance of surprise where there is water to hide in.
**Jaw Lock.** A character wounded by a crocodile has disadvantage on attacks and checks until that crocodile is killed.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it watches from the water and does not come out · 4–5 it takes the first thing to enter the water · 6 it comes up the bank.

jackal.name: Jackal
jackal.desc: Bold while there are many, and not for long after.
jackal.stat: AC 12, HP 10, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d6), MV double near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Pack Courage.** Jackals attack with advantage until their number is halved, and check
morale at disadvantage thereafter.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they call to each other and keep their distance · 4–5 they take the rearmost or the wounded and no one else · 6 the pack rushes together.

leech of the fen.name: Leech Of The Fens
leech of the fen.desc: One of them on you is the same as all of them.
leech of the fen.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 attach +2 (1), MV near (swim), S -2, D +0, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Drain.** A character with one or more leeches attached loses 1d4 HP at the start of
each leech turn — once, not once per leech — until every leech in the encounter is
destroyed.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 nobody goes into the water, and they find nobody · 5–6 they attach to whoever wades.

rat of the midden.name: Rat Of The Midden
rat of the midden.desc: What a camp leaves behind, and what lives on it.
rat of the midden.stat: AC 12, HP 4, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4 + infection), MV near (climb), S +0, D +2, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Infection.** A wounded character has a 1-in-6 chance of losing a further 1d4 HP.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they scatter from the firelight · 5–6 they come for the stores and bite whatever defends them.

carrion vulture.name: Carrion Vulture
carrion vulture.desc: They are not hunting. They are waiting, and they have noticed you are bleeding.
carrion vulture.stat: AC 12, HP 5, ATK 1 beak +1 (1d4), MV near (fly), S +0, D +2, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Carrion Only.** Vultures attack only characters who have lost HP, and ignore anyone at
full HP entirely. If nobody is wounded they have no legal target and do not attack at all,
whatever the reaction roll says. The moment any character takes a point of damage from any
source, every vulture present may attack that character; heal them to full and they are
ignored again.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they circle and do not attack at all, following the party for a day · 5–6 they come down and settle within near, attacking the moment any character is wounded.

poisonou serpent.name: Poisonous Serpent
poisonou serpent.desc: Small, quick and entirely out of proportion.
poisonou serpent.stat: AC 13, HP 10, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d4 + poison), MV near (climb, swim), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6. Halflings roll this with advantage.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it goes into the grass · 4–5 it coils and strikes only what comes within close · 6 it strikes first.

blood bat.name: Blood Bat
blood bat.desc: It is the bleeding that kills, not the bite.
blood bat.stat: AC 13, HP 9, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d4 + bleed), MV double near (fly), S -1, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Bleed.** A character wounded by a blood bat loses 1d4 HP at the start of each of its
turns until every blood bat in the encounter is destroyed.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 the roost does not stir · 4–5 they take one sleeper or straggler and leave · 6 the whole roost comes down.

wolf of the border.name: Wolf Of The Border
wolf of the border.desc: They fear fire and nothing else.
wolf of the border.stat: AC 12, HP 11, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +2, C +1, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Fear of Fire.** The pack checks morale whenever a fire effect kills two or more of
them, and again at disadvantage if that brings them below half strength.
**Pack.** Attacks with advantage while the wolves outnumber the party.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they pace the party at a distance until nightfall · 4–5 they test the flanks and fall back from any fire · 6 the pack closes.

sabretooth.name: Sabre-Tooth
sabretooth.desc: It is on you before the first round is properly under way.
sabretooth.stat: AC 14, HP 21, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d8+1), MV double near, S +4, D +3, C +3, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Pounce.** It attacks with advantage on the first round of melee.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it stalks the party and does not close · 4–5 it takes one straggler and drags it off · 6 it pounces at once.

marsh crocodile.name: Marsh Crocodile
marsh crocodile.desc: Blows that are not magical tend to skid off.
marsh crocodile.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 20, ATK 1 bite +4 (1d10) and 1 tail +4 (1d6), MV near (swim), S +3, D +0, C +4, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Thick Hide.** Any non-magical attack that would hit has a 3-in-6 chance of glancing off
and dealing no damage.
**Bite and Roll.** On a critical bite, the target also makes a DC 12 STR check or loses
its next action.
**Skins.** Each sells for 2d6 gp.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it is already fed and sinks out of sight · 3–4 it follows the boat without attacking · 5–6 it takes the nearest body in the water.

water snake.name: Water Snake
water snake.desc: The skins are worth more than the fight.
water snake.stat: AC 13, HP 14, ATK 1 bite +4 (1d6 + poison), MV near (swim), S +1, D +3, C +2, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6.
**Skins.** Each sells for 1d6 gp.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it swims off · 4–5 it defends the stretch of water it is in and no more · 6 it strikes.

hyena of the waste.name: Hyena Of The Waste
hyena of the waste.desc: They can tell which of you is already hurt.
hyena of the waste.stat: AC 13, HP 16, ATK 1 bite +4 (1d8), MV double near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Frenzy.** Attacks a wounded character with advantage.

**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they laugh, circle, and keep their distance, counting · 4–5 they take the wounded and nobody else — against a party at full health they follow and pace the camp for 1d6 days instead, and attack the moment anyone is hurt, on watch or on the road · 6 the pack commits at once, wounded or not.

jungle raptor lizard.name: Jungle Raptor Lizard
jungle raptor lizard.desc: There is no running from these.
jungle raptor lizard.stat: AC 14, HP 18, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +4, C +2, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 4
traits: **No Escape.** The party cannot flee this encounter except by flight, teleportation or
other magical transport.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 the flock is feeding elsewhere · 3–4 they circle and cut off the retreat before closing · 5–6 they come at once.

lion of the veldt.name: Lion Of The Veldt
lion of the veldt.desc: The pride holds until it does not, and the last one always runs.
lion of the veldt.stat: AC 14, HP 22, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d8), MV double near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I -2, W +2, Ch -1, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Pride.** Attacks with advantage while two or more lions are still standing.
**The Last One.** The final surviving lion always flees.

**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 the pride is fed and watches the party pass · 3–4 it takes the baggage animals and lets the party go, or tests the party once and withdraws if there are none · 5–6 the pride charges.

thunder lizard.name: Thunder Lizard
thunder lizard.desc: Four attacks a turn, and it does not break. The hardest thing in Part Two.
thunder lizard.atk: 1 bite +7 (2d8) and 2 stomp +7 (1d10) and 1 tail strike
thunder lizard.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 41, ATK 1 bite +7 (2d8) and 2 stomp +7 (1d10) and 1 tail strike, MV near, S +6, D +0, C +5, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 8
traits: **Tail Strike.** Its fourth attack each round. Up to three characters within near each
make a DC 15 DEX check or take 1d10 and are knocked down, losing their next attack.
**Magic Resistance.** Every spell cast at it requires a DC 15 check of the caster's
spellcasting stat, or it is wasted.
**Never checks morale.** Always fights to the death.
**Fangs.** 4d6 of them, worth 5 gp each.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it is drinking and does not register the party as food · 3–4 it drives them away from the water and does not pursue past near · 5–6 it attacks.

chaotic hill giant.name: Chaotic Hill Giant
chaotic hill giant.desc: Every blow goes round the shield and sends you backwards.
chaotic hill giant.stat: AC 15, HP 36, ATK 2 club +7 (2d8), MV double near, S +5, D +0, C +4, I -2, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Round the Shield.** Shields give no AC bonus against it.
**Knockback.** A character struck is knocked back to near and loses its next action.
**Rivalry.** If the party includes a giant of any kind, the two always challenge each
other and ignore everyone else until one falls.

giant constrictor snake.name: Giant Constrictor Snake
giant constrictor snake.desc: It takes one person and nobody else.
giant constrictor snake.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 31, ATK 1 constrict +6 (1d10 + coils), MV near (climb, swim), S +5, D +1, C +4, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Coils.** It attacks one character and only that character. On a hit, DC 15 STR or the
victim is in the coils: 1d10 automatic damage at the start of each snake turn until the
snake dies or a DC 15 STR check frees them.
**Shared Agony.** Any fire or lightning spell cast at the snake deals half its damage to
the character in the coils as well.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it is digesting and will not move · 4–5 it takes one person and is satisfied · 6 it strikes immediately.

bird bear.name: Bird Bear
bird bear.desc: It hugs, and then you choose what it breaks.
bird bear.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 31, ATK 2 claw +6 (1d10), MV near, S +4, D +1, C +4, I -2, W +2, Ch -1, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Bear Hug.** On a hit, DC 15 STR or the character chooses: take a further 2d6, or have
its shield or armour broken.
**Feathers.** 1d6+1 come off it, worth 40 gp each.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it rears and screams, and gives the party one round to back away · 4–5 it drives them off its ground and does not pursue · 6 it charges.

sabertooth tiger.name: Sabertooth Tiger
sabertooth tiger.desc: Bring it down alone, and it is yours.
sabertooth tiger.stat: AC 15, HP 32, ATK 2 claw +6 (1d10), MV double near (climb), S +4, D +3, C +3, I -2, W +2, Ch -1, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Pounce.** On the first round of melee, attacks with advantage.
**Earned.** A barbarian who brings it down single-handed, with no help of any kind, may
ride it thereafter.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it has eaten, and watches · 3–4 it follows the party for a day before it chooses · 5–6 it attacks.

escaped war rhino.name: Escaped War Rhino
escaped war rhino.desc: Its armour is studded with broken arrow shafts and a headless rider still hangs from the saddle.
escaped war rhino.stat: AC 17 (barding), HP 37, ATK 2 gore +7 (1d12), MV double near, S +5, D +0, C +5, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 7
traits: **Impale.** When the rhino is wounded, the character who wounded it makes a DC 12 DEX
check or takes 2d8 as it turns.
**Never checks morale.**
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it is grazing and wanders off if nothing moves quickly · 3–4 it mock-charges once and stops · 5–6 it charges in earnest, and *Never checks morale* means it does not stop.

the black dragon.name: The Black Dragon
the black dragon.desc: The king's own, and no lucky blow lands on that armour.
the black dragon.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 24, ATK 2 longsword +5 (1d8+1), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +3, I +1, W +2, Ch +1, AL L, LV 5
traits: **King's Harness.** Melee attacks cannot score critical hits against a Black Dragon. A
natural 20 hits but deals ordinary damage.
**Escort.** 2-in-6 chance a palace automaton marches with them (see *Zamora*).

border ranger.name: Border Ranger
border ranger.desc: Bossonian woodsmen hired to watch the Pictish line, and paid late.
border ranger.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 16, ATK 1 longbow (far) +4 (1d8) or 1 hand axe +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +3, C +2, I +0, W +2, Ch +0, AL L, LV 3
traits: **Woodcraft.** In forest or hills they surprise the party on a 1–3 on 1d6, and are never surprised themselves.
**Marksmen.** Ranged attacks at far suffer no penalty.

crossbowman.name: Crossbowman
crossbowman.desc: The bolts are poisoned, which is not how the kingdoms like to be described.
crossbowman.stat: AC 15 (leather + shield), HP 16, ATK 1 crossbow (far) +4 (1d8 + poison) or 1 blade +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL L, LV 3
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or have disadvantage on attacks for 1d4 rounds. Barbarians
and halflings roll with advantage.

city watch.name: City Watch
city watch.desc: A hedge of pole arms in a street too narrow to go round.
city watch.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 16, ATK 1 halberd (close/near) +4 (1d10), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL L, LV 3
traits: **Reach.** Shields give no AC bonus against them.
**Formation.** While two or more watchmen are adjacent, a character that misses one in
melee is struck by a second for 1d6. This ends when the watch no longer outnumbers the
party.

levy spearman.name: Levy Spearman
levy spearman.desc: Taken off the fields last week and handed a spear this morning.
levy spearman.stat: AC 13 (leather + shield), HP 6, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +2 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL L, LV 1
traits: **Levy.** Checks morale at disadvantage once a quarter of them are down.

bossonian archer.name: Bossonian Archer
bossonian archer.desc: The marches breed nothing but bowmen.
bossonian archer.stat: AC 14 (leather), HP 16, ATK 1 longbow (far) +4 (1d8) or 1 shortsword +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +3, C +2, I +0, W +2, Ch +0, AL L, LV 3
traits: **Volley.** Every archer looses once before melee is joined, then draws hand weapons.
**Marksmen.** Ranged attacks at far suffer no penalty.

gunderman pikeman.name: Gunderman Pikeman
gunderman pikeman.desc: The pike does not care how good your armour is.
gunderman pikeman.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 18, ATK 1 pike (close/near) +4 (1d10+1), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL L, LV 4
traits: **Pike.** On a critical hit, the damage is dealt twice over.
**Steady.** Checks morale with advantage.

nemedian knight.name: Nemedian Knight
nemedian knight.desc: Plate, lance and a family name older than the kingdom.
nemedian knight.stat: AC 17 (plate + shield), HP 24, ATK 1 lance (charge) +5 (1d10) or 1 longsword +5 (1d8), MV near (mounted, double near), S +3, D +0, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +1, AL L, LV 5
traits: **Charge.** A knight who moves at least near on horseback before attacking deals double damage with the lance.
**Proud.** Checks morale with advantage, and never surrenders to commoners.

aquilonian manatarm.name: Aquilonian Man-At-Arms
aquilonian manatarm.desc: Professional, paid, and in proper harness.
aquilonian manatarm.stat: AC 16 (chainmail + shield), HP 18, ATK 1 longsword +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL L, LV 4
traits: **Drilled.** Checks morale with advantage.

mercenary company.name: Mercenary Company
mercenary company.desc: They will fight anyone, and did last season.
mercenary company.stat: AC 17 (chainmail + shield), HP 20, ATK 1 longsword +4 (1d8) or 1 crossbow (far) +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Contract.** Will take a better offer: a bribe of 100 gp a head turns them, and they
keep the new bargain as faithfully as the old.

satha the old one.name: Satha, The Old One
satha the old one.desc: The king of snakes, kept in a pit by a sorcerer who feeds it prisoners.
satha the old one.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 36, ATK 1 constrict +7 (1d12 + coils), MV near (climb), S +5, D +1, C +4, I +0, W +2, Ch -2, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Coils.** It attacks one character and only that character. On a hit, DC 15 STR or the
victim is held: 1d12 automatic damage at the start of each snake turn until the snake
dies or a DC 15 STR check frees them.
**Shared Agony.** Fire and lightning spells cast at Satha deal half their damage to the
held character as well.

manifestation of mitra.name: Manifestation Of Mitra
manifestation of mitra.desc: It attacks whoever in the party is furthest from its god, and it does not stop.
manifestation of mitra.stat: AC 16, HP 35, ATK 2 radiant strike +7 (1d10), MV double near (fly), S +3, D +3, C +3, I +2, W +4, Ch +3, AL L, LV 7
traits: **Implacable.** Cannot be reasoned with, bribed or fled from indoors.
**Judgement.** It attacks only the character of the alignment furthest from Lawful, and
only moves on when that character falls.
**Regeneration.** Regains 1d6 HP at the start of each of its turns until it is destroyed.
**Immune to sleep and charm.**
**Reward.** A scroll of blessing on its remains.

the possessed general.name: The Possessed General
the possessed general.desc: *Constantius.* Something else is wearing a commander.
the possessed general.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 39, ATK 3 longsword +7 (1d8+2), MV near, S +4, D +2, C +3, I +2, W +0, Ch +2, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Ridden.** Immune to fear, charm and sleep. A *dispel magic* or exorcism forces a DC 15
CHA check; on a failure the thing departs and the general collapses.
**Commander.** Any soldiers present never check morale while he stands.

captain of the guard.name: Captain Of The Guard
captain of the guard.desc: *Pallantides · Bombaata.* The horn goes up before the sword does.
captain of the guard.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 30, ATK 2 longsword +6 (1d8+2), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +3, I +1, W +2, Ch +2, AL L, LV 6
traits: **Warhorn.** Each time he attacks, 3-in-6 chance that 1d4 City Watch arrive. This happens
once per encounter only.

xaltotun of acheron.name: Xaltotun Of Acheron
xaltotun of acheron.desc: The resurrected sorcerer of a dead empire. Place him by hand; never roll him.
xaltotun of acheron.stat: AC 16, HP 48, ATK 4 withering touch +9 (1d10) or 1 spell +9, MV near, S +2, D +2, C +3, I +5, W +4, Ch +4, AL C, LV 10
traits: **His Presence.** Every character who meets him makes a DC 15 WIS check or gains a
lasting madness and has disadvantage on attacks until he has been wounded twice.

worm of the earth.name: Worm Of The Earth
worm of the earth.desc: The thing the Picts dug up and were afraid of. A people who went underground and stayed.
worm of the earth.stat: AC 14 (natural), HP 26, ATK 2 stone axe +5 (1d8), MV near (climb), S +3, D +1, C +4, I -1, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Stench.** Before combat, every character makes a DC 12 CON check or retches: no attacks
for 1d3 rounds. Anyone with a sealed mask is immune, and a *protection* spell cast
immediately before combat shields one character.
**Fire-Shy.** Any area fire effect forces an immediate morale check.
**Below Ground.** Roll this result only where the party has gone below ground.

pict hunter.name: Pict Hunter
pict hunter.desc: Stone axes and a long memory.
pict hunter.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 16, ATK 1 stone axe +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +2, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Fire-Shy.** The band checks morale the first time one of them is killed by a fire
effect. Once per encounter only.
**Trackers.** Advantage on checks to track and to move unseen in forest.

pict archer.name: Pict Archer
pict archer.desc: One volley out of the trees, then knives.
pict archer.stat: AC 14 (leather), HP 8, ATK 1 bow (far) +3 (1d6) or 1 knife +3 (1d4), MV near, S +1, D +3, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Volley.** Each archer looses once before contact, then fights with knives.

pict skirmisher.name: Pict Skirmisher
pict skirmisher.desc: Painted, quiet, and gone again before the answer comes.
pict skirmisher.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 10, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Woodcraft.** 3-in-6 chance of surprise in forest.

savage dog.name: Savage Dog
savage dog.desc: The camp looses them before the warriors close.
savage dog.stat: AC 13, HP 16, ATK 1 bite +4 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Bowl Over.** The first time a character is struck by savage dogs, DC 12 STR or it is
knocked down, takes an extra 1d6, and must spend its next turn rising.

pict warrior.name: Pict Warrior
pict warrior.desc: Blood frenzy: they can see which of you is already cut.
pict warrior.stat: AC 15 (leather + shield), HP 20, ATK 1 war axe +4 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Blood Frenzy.** Attacks a wounded character with advantage.

pict shaman.name: Pict Shaman
pict shaman.desc: *Zogar Sag.* The drums do not stop and more of them keep arriving.
pict shaman.stat: AC 13, HP 24, ATK 1 bone staff +4 (1d6) or 1 spell +6, MV near, S +1, D +2, C +2, I +1, W +4, Ch +1, AL C, LV 5
traits: **The Drums.** At the start of each of his turns, 2-in-6 chance that 1d3 Pict Hunters
arrive out of the trees.
**Curse of Jhebbal Sag (WIS Spell).** DC 12. One creature within far makes a DC 12 INT
check or has disadvantage on attacks until the shaman dies.

pict chieftain.name: Pict Chieftain
pict chieftain.desc: *Sagayetha.* Four strokes a round and a standing offer of single combat.
pict chieftain.stat: AC 15 (leather + shield), HP 30, ATK 4 war axe +6 (1d8+1), MV near, S +4, D +2, C +3, I +0, W +2, Ch +1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Challenge.** Often opens with an offer of single combat, and honours the result.
**Chief.** All Picts within far check morale with advantage while he lives.

the forest demon.name: The Forest Demon
the forest demon.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 31, ATK 4 constricting limb +6 (1d6), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +4, I -1, W +2, Ch -2, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Many Limbs.** Each attack must target a different creature within close.
**Rooted In.** A character struck makes a DC 15 STR check or cannot flee the encounter at
all until the demon is destroyed.
**Never checks morale.**

the swamp demon.name: The Swamp Demon
the swamp demon.desc: A reed-choked mass of limbs that rises out of the water. Blades sink in and stay.
the swamp demon.stat: AC 15, HP 32, ATK 4 slam +6 (1d6), MV near (swim), S +4, D +1, C +4, I -2, W +1, Ch -3, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Many Limbs.** Each attack must target a different creature within close.
**Swallowed Steel.** Any melee weapon whose attack roll is a natural 1 sticks fast in the
demon's body and cannot be recovered until it is destroyed.
**Out of the Reeds.** 2-in-6 chance of surprise.
**Impervious.** Immune to sleep, poison, fear and morale.

jackal man.name: Jackal Man
jackal man.desc: Dog-headed scavengers who fight bravely only in a crowd.
jackal man.stat: AC 15 (leather + shield), HP 16, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +4 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Scavengers.** Checks morale at disadvantage.
**Pack.** Attacks with advantage in melee while adjacent to another jackal man.

spearman of the village.name: Spearman Of The Villages
spearman of the village.desc: They know the jungle and you do not.
spearman of the village.stat: AC 15 (leather + shield), HP 16, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +4 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +2, Ch +0, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Home Ground.** Advantage on checks to track, hide and move through jungle, and 3-in-6
chance of surprise there.
**Trinkets.** 1d6 small goods worth 1 gp for the whole band.

child of gullah.name: Child Of Gullah
child of gullah.desc: Great apes of the gorilla-god, and they are frightened of exactly one thing.
child of gullah.stat: AC 14 (natural), HP 20, ATK 2 fist +4 (1d8), MV double near (climb), S +4, D +1, C +3, I -2, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Fears Sorcery.** Checks morale every time a spell or prayer is used against them, and
at disadvantage once half of them are down.
**Rending Grip.** A character struck by both fists in one round makes a DC 12 STR check
or is held, attacking at disadvantage until it breaks free.

kushite mercenary.name: Kushite Mercenary
kushite mercenary.desc: Tall spearmen who have sold their service west and come back richer.
kushite mercenary.stat: AC 15 (leather + shield), HP 24, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +5 (1d8) or 1 bow (far) +5 (1d6), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +3, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Contract.** 50 gp a head turns them, and they keep the bargain.

the winged one.name: The Winged One
the winged one.desc: The thing in the ruined city on the Zarkheba that killed a pirate queen.
the winged one.stat: AC 16, HP 35, ATK 4 talon +7 (1d8+1), MV double near (fly), S +4, D +4, C +3, I +1, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 7
traits: **On the Wing.** It attacks and withdraws out of reach: melee attacks against it are at
disadvantage unless the attacker can fly.
**Snatch.** On a critical hit, the target is carried to near height and dropped for an
extra 2d6.
**Never checks morale.**

kushite witchhunter.name: Kushite Witch-Hunter
kushite witchhunter.desc: *Afari · Ghayoor · Shafiah · Shubba.* He hunts sorcerers, not you.
kushite witchhunter.stat: AC 16 (leather + shield), HP 32, ATK 2 assegai (close/near) +6 (1d8+1), MV near, S +3, D +3, C +3, I +1, W +3, Ch +1, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Silencing Stroke.** A character he hits makes a DC 15 WIS check or may cast nothing on
its next turn.
**Checks morale with advantage.**

**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 he ignores the party entirely — unless it contains a wizard, a necromancer or a demonologist, in which case he fights to the death · 3–4 he questions them about sorcerers in the district and lets them go · 5–6 he takes them for a sorcerer's hirelings and attacks.

the gray manape.name: The Gray Man-Ape
the gray manape.desc: It fights champions and ignores the rest.
the gray manape.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 42, ATK 2 fist +7 (1d12), MV double near (climb), S +5, D +2, C +4, I -1, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 8
traits: **Fights Champions.** Both attacks every round go against whichever character has the
highest total attack bonus, magic items included. Ties go to the one with the most
current HP. It ignores everyone else entirely until that character falls.
**Checks morale with advantage.**

xotalanc hunter.name: Xotalanc Hunter
xotalanc hunter.desc: Light armour, a light weapon, and the party may pick both up afterwards.
xotalanc hunter.stat: AC 14 (leather), HP 16, ATK 1 shortsword +4 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +3, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Dark-Dwellers.** Cannot be surprised in darkness.
**Salvage.** Their gear is intact and usable.

xotalanc warrior.name: Xotalanc Warrior
xotalanc warrior.desc: They have lived in the dark all their lives.
xotalanc warrior.stat: AC 16 (leather + shield), HP 18, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +4 (1d6+1), MV near, S +2, D +3, C +2, I +1, W +2, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Never Blind.** Cannot be surprised in darkness, and suffers no penalty for fighting
without light.

flaming skeleton.name: Flaming Skeleton
flaming skeleton.desc: Burning bones, and destroying one costs you something.
flaming skeleton.stat: AC 14, HP 20, ATK 1 burning blade +4 (1d8 + fire), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +3, I -2, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Burning Bones.** When a flaming skeleton is destroyed, whoever destroyed it makes a DC
13 DEX check or takes 1d6 fire damage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison. Immune to fire.

tecuhlti swordman.name: Tecuhlti Swordman
tecuhlti swordman.desc: The other half of Xuchotl's war, and lanterns in hand still spoil their aim.
tecuhlti swordman.stat: AC 16 (leather + shield), HP 25, ATK 2 sword +5 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +3, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Press.** Attacks against a character struck by one have advantage until the end of its next turn.
**Hates the Light.** With two or more lit lanterns held in hand, Tecuhlti attack at
disadvantage.

tascela who drink youth.name: Tascela, Who Drinks Youth
tascela who drink youth.desc: She has been beautiful for a very long time, and it has been paid for.
tascela who drink youth.stat: AC 14, HP 34, ATK 2 dagger +6 (1d6 + drain), MV near, S +1, D +4, C +2, I +3, W +3, Ch +5, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Drinks Youth.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or lose a level: 1d6 maximum HP until a *remove curse* or a cleric's blessing lifts it. She regains 2d6 HP
each time.
**Hard to Kill.** Harmed only by magical weapons, spells, holy water (1d6 a vial), or a
critical hit from any weapon.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

olmec prince of tecuhlti.name: Olmec, Prince Of Tecuhlti
olmec prince of tecuhlti.desc: Wound him and he is quite likely to answer there and then.
olmec prince of tecuhlti.stat: AC 15 (leather + shield), HP 31, ATK 2 broadsword +6 (1d10+1), MV near, S +4, D +2, C +4, I +1, W +1, Ch +2, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Answers Back.** Each time he is wounded, 2-in-6 chance he immediately attacks whoever
hurt him, out of turn.
**Prince.** Tecuhlti within far check morale with advantage while he lives.

tolkemec the mad wizard.name: Tolkemec, The Mad Wizard
tolkemec the mad wizard.desc: Half a century alone in the catacombs with a wand.
tolkemec the mad wizard.stat: AC 14, HP 32, ATK 2 wand blast (far) +7 (1d10) or 1 spell +7, MV near, S +0, D +2, C +2, I +4, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 7
traits: **The Sight of Him.** At the start of combat every character makes a DC 15 WIS check or
gains a lasting madness.
**Warded.** Spells cast at him are nullified entirely on a 1–2 on 1d6.
**The Wand.** His blast ignores cover and shields.

the crawler.name: The Crawler
the crawler.desc: A pale wall-climbing spider the size of a pony. The web is to keep you, not kill you.
the crawler.stat: AC 15, HP 30, ATK 1 bite +6 (1d10) and 1 web spray (near), MV near (climb), S +3, D +3, C +3, I -2, W +1, Ch -3, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Web Spray.** Its second attack each round. One character within near makes a DC 15 DEX
check or cannot leave the encounter until the crawler is destroyed.
**Immune to entangling effects.**

the dragon of xuchotl.name: The Dragon Of Xuchotl
the dragon of xuchotl.desc: A reptile, not a wyrm — and it dies of poisoned fruit rather than steel.
the dragon of xuchotl.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 40, ATK 2 bite +7 (2d8), MV double near, S +5, D +1, C +4, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 8
traits: **Crushing Bite.** On a critical hit, the damage is dealt twice over.
**Poisoned Fruit.** It can be killed outright by poisoned food left in its path. If the
party has any poison at all, let them try it and skip the fight.
**Eggs.** 2-in-6 chance of 1d3 eggs worth 100 gp each.

foo dog.name: Foo Dog
foo dog.desc: The lions come down off the steps.
foo dog.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 21, ATK 1 bite +4 (1d8), MV double near, S +3, D +1, C +3, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL L, LV 4
traits: **Stone.** Bludgeoning weapons attack with advantage.
**Construct.** Immune to sleep, poison, charm, fear, morale and anything that affects
only the living.
**Set to Guard.** They do not pursue beyond the gate or stair they keep.

warrior monk.name: Warrior Monk
warrior monk.desc: Shaved heads, bare hands, and no interest in surrender.
warrior monk.stat: AC 14 (unarmoured), HP 18, ATK 2 strike +4 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +3, C +2, I +0, W +2, Ch +0, AL L, LV 4
traits: **Deflect.** Once per round, a monk turns a missile that would hit it into a miss.
**Calm.** Immune to fear and charm.

khitan crossbowman.name: Khitan Crossbowman
khitan crossbowman.desc: Repeating crossbows, and they do not need to aim well.
khitan crossbowman.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 14, ATK 2 repeating crossbow (far) +3 (1d6) or 1 blade +2 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL L, LV 3
traits: **Hail Of Bolts.** While three or more crossbowmen shoot at the same target, those attacks have advantage.

khitan guard.name: Khitan Guard
khitan guard.desc: There are always more of them than there are of you.
khitan guard.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 16, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +4 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL L, LV 3
traits: **More Coming.** At the end of each round, 2-in-6 chance that 1d4 more guards arrive, to
a maximum of twice the number first rolled.

khitan acolyte.name: Khitan Acolyte
khitan acolyte.desc: They chant while they die, which is unsettling and does not stop.
khitan acolyte.stat: AC 12, HP 9, ATK 1 staff +3 (1d6), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +1, I +1, W +3, Ch +0, AL L, LV 2
traits: **Never checks morale.**
**The Chant.** While three or more acolytes still chant, every other Khitan in the encounter attacks with advantage.

javelin thrower.name: Javelin Thrower
javelin thrower.desc: The javelins are drugged, and one of you will miss the fight entirely.
javelin thrower.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 16, ATK 1 javelin (near) +4 (1d6 + drug) or 1 blade +3 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL L, LV 3
traits: **Drugged Javelins.** Each thrower makes one throw at a random character before melee.
On a hit, DC 15 CON or sleep until the end of the encounter. Barbarians and large
characters roll with advantage.

khitan lancer.name: Khitan Lancer
khitan lancer.desc: Lacquered armour on a steppe pony that never tires.
khitan lancer.stat: AC 15 (chainmail), HP 20, ATK 1 lance (charge) +4 (1d8) or 1 sabre +4 (1d6), MV double near (mounted), S +2, D +1, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL L, LV 4
traits: **Charge.** A lancer who moves at least near before attacking deals double damage with the lance.

khitan officer.name: Khitan Officer
khitan officer.desc: Silk over steel, and a whistle for the guards.
khitan officer.stat: AC 16 (chainmail + shield), HP 26, ATK 2 sword +5 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +2, AL L, LV 5
traits: **Whistle.** Once per fight, 1d6 Khitan guards arrive at the end of the round.
**Command.** Khitan soldiers within near check morale with advantage while the officer stands.

honor guard.name: Honor Guard
honor guard.desc: The household's best, and a crossbow is not beneath them.
honor guard.stat: AC 17 (chainmail + shield), HP 26, ATK 2 dao +5 (1d8+1) or 1 crossbow (far) +5 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +3, I +1, W +2, Ch +1, AL L, LV 5
traits: **Crossbows.** 1-in-6 chance the detachment carries them. If so it acts first
automatically on the first round.
**Disciplined.** Checks morale with advantage. Immune to fear.

shuang mian the twofaced.name: Shuang Mian, The Two-Faced
shuang mian the twofaced.desc: Until he turns around, he is a sorcerer. Afterwards he is a swordsman.
shuang mian the twofaced.stat: AC 14, HP 35, ATK 2 jian +6 (1d8) or 1 spell +8, MV near, S +2, D +3, C +3, I +4, W +2, Ch +2, AL C, LV 7
traits: **The First Face.** While above half HP he fights as a sorcerer. At the start of combat
every character makes a DC 15 WIS check or has disadvantage on attacks while he lives, and spells
cast at him are nullified on a 1 on 1d6.
**The Second Face.** The round his HP first drops below half, he turns around. From then
he makes three attacks per round at +8 (1d8+2), checks morale with advantage, and casts
nothing at all — the wards end with the sorcery.
**Hand of the East (INT Spell).** DC 15. One creature within far takes 3d6.

the great temple lion.name: The Great Temple Lion
the great temple lion.desc: It has been on that step a long time and has not been relieved.
the great temple lion.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 46, ATK 2 bite +8 (2d8) and 1 claw +8 (1d10), MV double near, S +5, D +1, C +5, I -2, W +2, Ch -3, AL L, LV 9
traits: **Stone.** Immune to sleep, poison, charm and all fire-based spells.
**Shield-Breaker.** On a critical hit, a non-magical shield is destroyed.
**Construct.** Never checks morale.

bronze scarab swarm.name: Bronze Scarab Swarm
bronze scarab swarm.desc: The tomb's immune system. It eats metal, not meat — and it can end an expedition without taking a single hit point.
bronze scarab swarm.stat: AC 13, HP 17, ATK 2 devour +6, MV near (climb, fly), S +0, D +3, C +3, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Eats Metal.** Its attacks deal no damage to creatures. Each attack must target a
different character within close, and on a hit the swarm consumes metal from that
character, choosing in this order: a metal weapon or shield, then armour, then 1d6 × 10
coins. A suit of plate takes two hits to consume; a magical metal item takes four.
**Disperses.** When the last metal in the party is gone, the swarm disperses and departs.
**Clockwork.** Immune to sleep, poison, disease, fear and morale. Spells that destroy
undead or constructs deal double damage.
**Scrap.** Destroyed, it leaves 50 gp in gears, which a capable artificer can work into a
one-shot key that opens any lock.

carrion worm.name: Carrion Worm
carrion worm.desc: Pale burrowing grubs the length of an arm, still larval and not always hungry yet.
carrion worm.stat: AC 12, HP 11, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d4 + paralysis), MV near (burrow), S +0, D +1, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Paralysis.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or be paralysed for one round. Attacks against a
paralysed character hit automatically.

**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they ignore the party — and keep ignoring them on any later passage through that room · 3–4 they take whatever is already dead and do not pursue · 5–6 they come for the living.

large black scorpion.name: Large Black Scorpion
large black scorpion.desc: The poison is ordinary. There are simply a great many of them.
large black scorpion.stat: AC 14 (natural), HP 11, ATK 1 sting +3 (1d4 + poison), MV near (climb), S +1, D +1, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they go under the stones · 4–5 they hold the ground they are on and sting what steps on it · 6 they come across it.

temple bat.name: Temple Bat
temple bat.desc: They fly in circles and nobody can aim.
temple bat.stat: AC 13, HP 5, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4), MV double near (fly), S -2, D +3, C +0, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Nobody Can Aim.** While the swarm is above half its starting number, characters attack with disadvantage and the swarm attacks with advantage. Beastmasters and druids are unaffected.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 the roost circles once and settles · 4–6 they fill the chamber, and nobody can aim.

septic snake.name: Septic Snake
septic snake.desc: The wound keeps giving long after the snake has gone.
septic snake.stat: AC 13, HP 10, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d4 + sepsis), MV near (swim), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Sepsis.** At the end of each snake turn, every character the snakes have wounded makes
a DC 12 CON check or loses a further 1d4 HP.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it is into the rubble before anyone sees it · 4–5 it strikes once at whoever disturbed it and withdraws · 6 it strikes and stays.

mutant fly.name: Mutant Fly
mutant fly.desc: Bloated green things the size of housecats, and blood draws them.
mutant fly.stat: AC 13, HP 10, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d4 + infection), MV near (fly), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Drawn to Blood.** If any character is already wounded when the flies are met, they
always attack.

tomb asp.name: Tomb Asp
tomb asp.desc: Kept in the burial jars on purpose, and fed by the priests.
tomb asp.stat: AC 13, HP 4, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d4 + poison), MV near, S -2, D +3, C +0, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6.
**In The Jars.** Found coiled in urns, chests and sarcophagi; the first character to reach in is bitten with advantage.

bone guardian.name: Bone Guardian
bone guardian.desc: Armoured when buried, and still wearing it.
bone guardian.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 16, ATK 1 blade +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I -3, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Still Armoured.** Bludgeoning weapons gain no advantage against them.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

giant scorpion templebred.name: Giant Scorpion, Temple-Bred
giant scorpion templebred.desc: The temple breeds them in the dark under the floor.
giant scorpion templebred.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 16, ATK 1 sting +4 (1d6 + poison), MV near (climb), S +2, D +1, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
