traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 2d6.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it holds the doorway it was set to hold · 3–4 it advances only on what advances on it · 5–6 it attacks.

stygian assassin.name: Stygian Assassin
stygian assassin.desc: Poisoned daggers, out of a doorway you had already passed.
stygian assassin.stat: AC 15 (leather), HP 20, ATK 2 poisoned dagger (close/near) +4 (1d6 + poison), MV near, S +1, D +4, C +2, I +1, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or take an extra 1d6.
**Out of the Dark.** 3-in-6 chance of surprise.

snakeman in human seeming.name: Snakeman In Human Seeming
snakeman in human seeming.desc: Wearing the faces of the city guard, and wearing them well.
snakeman in human seeming.stat: AC 17 (chainmail + shield), HP 20, ATK 1 halberd (close/near) +4 (1d10), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +3, I +2, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 4
traits: **The Seeming.** Fight them as City Watch for the first round. At the start of the second
round the illusion drops: they fight as Slithering Snakemen from then on, and every
character makes a DC 12 WIS check or loses its next attack.

cultist of set.name: Cultist Of Set
cultist of set.desc: They have been down there a long time, and they are glad of company.
cultist of set.stat: AC 16 (chainmail + shield), HP 14, ATK 1 khopesh +4 (1d8) or 1 spell +4, MV near, S +1, D +1, C +2, I +1, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Devoted.** Checks morale with advantage.
**Leader.** 2-in-6 chance of a cult leader: AC 15, HP 24, ATK 2 khopesh +6 (1d8), LV 5.

the eternal guard.name: The Eternal Guard
the eternal guard.stat: AC 13, HP 20, ATK 1 two-handed blade +4 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +3, I -2, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Great Blades.** On a critical hit, the damage is dealt twice over.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

slithering snakeman.name: Slithering Snakeman
slithering snakeman.desc: Serpent-folk of the old empire, still keeping the rites.
slithering snakeman.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 20, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +4 (1d8) and 1 bite +4 (1d4 + poison), MV near (climb, swim), S +2, D +3, C +3, I +2, W +2, Ch -1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Poison.** On a bite hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6.
**The Reeds.** Where there is standing water, 4-in-6 chance of surprise.
**Escort.** A band of fewer than three is accompanied by a Constrictor of the Temple.
A band of more than six drags 1d6 captives.

lesser mummy.name: Lesser Mummy
lesser mummy.desc: The tomb's servants, wrapped and buried with their master.
lesser mummy.stat: AC 14 (natural), HP 21, ATK 1 rotting fist +4 (1d8 + rot), MV near, S +3, D -1, C +3, I -2, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Rot.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or lose 1d4 maximum HP per day until cured.
**Packed Linen.** Fire and torches are rolled with advantage; a flask of oil deals an
extra 2d6. Arrows and bolts attack at disadvantage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

screaming ghoul.name: Screaming Ghoul
screaming ghoul.desc: The sound is the first attack and it does not stop.
screaming ghoul.stat: AC 14, HP 20, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +3, I -1, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 4
traits: **The Scream.** On the first round, every character makes a DC 15 WIS check or gains a
lasting madness. Clerics and necromancers roll with advantage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

voodoo zombie.name: Voodoo Zombie
voodoo zombie.desc: Put one down and it has a fair chance of getting up again.
voodoo zombie.stat: AC 10, HP 12, ATK 1 slam +3 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D -2, C +2, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Rises.** When a voodoo zombie is killed, roll 1d6 at the start of the next round: on a
1 it stands again with half its HP. It may rise any number of times.
**Soft.** Arrows, bolts and javelins attack at disadvantage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

zombie wolf.name: Zombie Wolf
zombie wolf.desc: They cannot surprise anyone — they have stopped being quiet.
zombie wolf.stat: AC 12, HP 14, ATK 1 bite +4 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Never Surprise.** The party always acts first against zombie wolves, even as wandering
monsters.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

risen dead.name: Risen Dead
risen dead.desc: The ordinary dead of the river towns, standing up again.
risen dead.stat: AC 11, HP 16, ATK 1 claw +4 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D -1, C +3, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Holy Water.** A flask destroys one outright.
**Soft and Slow.** Bludgeoning weapons attack with advantage; arrows at disadvantage.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

fen ghoul.name: Fen Ghoul
fen ghoul.desc: The paralysis is what they are for.
fen ghoul.stat: AC 13, HP 20, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d6 + paralysis), MV near (swim), S +2, D +2, C +2, I -2, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Paralysis.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or be paralysed for 1d3 rounds. Attacks against a
paralysed character hit automatically. Elves are immune.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

swamp hydra.name: Swamp Hydra
swamp hydra.desc: It grows back faster than you can cut, until magic stops it.
swamp hydra.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 37, ATK 5 bite +7 (1d8), MV near (swim), S +4, D +1, C +5, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 7
traits: **Heads.** It loses one attack for every 9 HP of damage currently on it.
**Regrowth.** Regains 2d6 HP at the start of each of its turns. Damage dealt by spells is
never regained.
**Always Fights.**

the scorpion broodmother.name: The Scorpion Broodmother
the scorpion broodmother.desc: Two pincers and a sting, and the pincers come off as weapons.
the scorpion broodmother.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 32, ATK 2 pincer +6 (1d8) and 1 sting +6 (1d6 + paralysis), MV near (climb), S +4, D +1, C +4, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Paralysis.** On a sting hit, DC 15 CON or be paralysed for 1d6 rounds.
**Harvest.** Her pincers and stinger make two non-metallic light weapons (1d6).

vampiric mist.name: Vampiric Mist
vampiric mist.desc: Lanterns are the thing it does not like.
vampiric mist.stat: AC 14, HP 23, ATK 2 drain +5 (1d8 + drain), MV near (fly), S +0, D +4, C +0, I +1, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Mist.** Only lantern-light, holy water, magic, and silvered or gilded weapons deal more
than 1 damage per round to it.
**Drain.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or lose a level.
**Surprise.** 3-in-6 chance, reduced by 1 for each lantern held after the first.
**Sated.** Once it has drained two levels, it flees.

constrictor of the temple.name: Constrictor Of The Temple
constrictor of the temple.desc: It takes one person and keeps them.
constrictor of the temple.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 28, ATK 1 constrict +5 (1d10 + coils), MV near (climb, swim), S +4, D +1, C +3, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Coils.** It attacks one character and only that character. On a hit, DC 15 STR or the
victim is held, taking 1d10 automatically at the start of each snake turn until the snake
dies or a DC 15 STR check frees them.
**Shared Agony.** Fire and lightning cast at the snake deal half their damage to the held
character too.

the son of set.name: The Son Of Set
the son of set.desc: A serpent thick as a man and long as a boat. Once it has you it does nothing else.
the son of set.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 31, ATK 1 crush +6 (1d10), MV near (swim), S +5, D +0, C +4, I -2, W +1, Ch -3, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Crush.** On a critical hit, the target is seized. From the following round the Son of
Set makes no other attack and deals 2d8 automatically to that character each round, until
it is killed or a DC 15 STR check prises them loose.
**Always Fights.**

the scourge of set.name: The Scourge Of Set
the scourge of set.desc: A knot of serpent-arms around one mouth. Every wound you give it buys another arm.
the scourge of set.stat: AC 15, HP 31, ATK 2 lash +6 (1d8), MV near, S +4, D +2, C +4, I +0, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Feeds on Wounds.** For every 6 HP of damage the Scourge has taken, it gains one
additional attack, to a maximum of six attacks.
**Always Fights.**

thulsa doom.name: Thulsa Doom
thulsa doom.desc: *The Snake That Speaks.* His true form is the Avatar's.
thulsa doom.stat: AC 16, HP 46, ATK 4 strike +8 (1d10+1) or 1 constrict +9, MV double near, S +5, D +3, C +5, I +4, W +4, Ch +6, AL C, LV 9
traits: **The Voice.** Before combat, every character makes a DC 15 CHA check or may not attack
him at all this encounter. Clerics, paladins and barbarians roll with advantage.
**Coils.** As the Snake Avatar.
**Shared Agony.** As the Snake Avatar.
**Old Hatreds.** Attacks paladins and dwarves with advantage.
**Immune to sleep and charm.**

akivasha who never died.name: Akivasha, Who Never Died
akivasha who never died.desc: Every hero she kills makes her stronger and puts her back together.
akivasha who never died.stat: AC 14, HP 35, ATK 2 kiss +7 (1d10 + drain), MV near, S +2, D +3, C +3, I +3, W +3, Ch +5, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Mesmerising.** Before the fight, every character makes a DC 15 WIS check or is
mesmerised for 1d3 rounds — unable to attack or defend, and hit automatically — until a
cleric's blessing frees them. Clerics and paladins roll with advantage.
**Magic Resistance.** Every spell cast in her chamber requires a DC 15 check of the
caster's spellcasting stat or it fizzles.
**Feeds.** Each character she kills heals her to full HP and raises her attack bonus and
damage by 1 for the rest of the fight.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

stygian high priest.name: Stygian High Priest
stygian high priest.desc: *Natohk the Veiled.* The veil is not for your benefit.
stygian high priest.stat: AC 13, HP 34, ATK 3 staff +6 (1d8) or 1 spell +8, MV near, S +1, D +2, C +3, I +4, W +4, Ch +3, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Dark Gift.** Roll 1d6: 1–3 none; 4 **evil eye** — every character within far makes a DC 14 WIS check or he attacks them with advantage until he falls; 5 **energy drain** — on a hit, DC 15 CON or
lose a level; 6 **hellfire blast** — once per encounter, all within near take 3d6 fire,
half on a DC 15 DEX check.
**Serpent's Coil (INT Spell).** DC 15. One creature within far is grappled by conjured
coils: 2d6 per round and no actions until a DC 15 STR check frees it.

serpent folk sorcerer.name: Serpent Folk Sorcerer
serpent folk sorcerer.desc: Its attacks find the gap in anything.
serpent folk sorcerer.stat: AC 14, HP 30, ATK 3 claw +6 (1d8) or 1 spell +7, MV near (climb), S +2, D +3, C +3, I +4, W +3, Ch +1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Finds the Gap.** Armour and shields give no AC bonus against its attacks.
**The First Touch.** Its first successful attack of the encounter also inflicts a lasting
madness.
**Rebound.** Spells cast at it rebound on the caster on a 1–2 on 1d6.

mummy of khemi.name: Mummy Of Khemi
mummy of khemi.desc: Wrapped in oiled linen in the vaults of Khemi. Its dead get up as more of it.
mummy of khemi.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 36, ATK 2 rotting fist +7 (1d10 + rot), MV near, S +4, D -1, C +4, I +1, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Rot.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or lose 1d4 maximum HP per day until cured.
**They Join.** A character slain by it rises as a Lesser Mummy at the end of the
following round.
**Packed Linen.** Fire and torches are rolled with advantage; a flask of oil deals an
extra 2d6.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

thothamon.name: Thoth-Amon
thothamon.desc: Master of the Black Ring, flanked by his serpent-folk.
thothamon.stat: AC 14, HP 39, ATK 3 serpent staff +7 (1d10) or 1 spell +9, MV near, S +2, D +2, C +3, I +5, W +4, Ch +4, AL C, LV 8
traits: **His Escort.** Enters with 1d3+1 Slithering Snakemen.
**Rebound.** Spells cast at him rebound on the caster on a 1–2 on 1d6.

**The Serpent Ring.** Roll 1d6: 1–3 none; 4 **evil eye** — all within far make a DC 15 WIS check or he attacks them with advantage until he is slain; 5 **energy drain** — on a hit, DC 15 CON or lose a
level, all restored by a single blessing; 6 **hellfire blast** — at the start of combat
all within near take 4d6 fire, half on a DC 15 DEX check.

ghoul ogre.name: Ghoul Ogre
ghoul ogre.desc: Every blow lands on three people at once.
ghoul ogre.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 41, ATK 2 sweeping claw +7 (1d10 + paralysis), MV near, S +5, D +0, C +5, I -2, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Sweeping Claw.** Each attack strikes three characters within close. Roll once to hit,
and compare that roll against each of their ACs separately.
**Paralysis.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or be paralysed for 1d4 rounds. Elves roll with
advantage and can be paralysed only once per fight.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

snake avatar of ssikli.name: Snake Avatar Of Ssiklis
snake avatar of ssikli.desc: *The Father of Serpents.* The coils are the whole fight.
snake avatar of ssikli.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 46, ATK 4 bite +8 (1d10) or 1 constrict +9, MV double near (climb, swim), S +6, D +2, C +5, I +2, W +3, Ch +2, AL C, LV 9
traits: **Coils.** On a critical hit, or in place of its bites, the avatar seizes one character:
DC 15 STR or held, taking 2d8 automatically each round until it dies or a DC 15 STR check
frees them.
**Shared Agony.** Any spell that damages the avatar deals half its damage to the held
character as well.
**Old Hatreds.** Attacks paladins and dwarves with advantage.
**Immune to sleep and charm.**

snakewoman of the clutch.name: Snakewoman Of The Clutch
snakewoman of the clutch.desc: She is tending eggs, and she is not armed.
snakewoman of the clutch.stat: AC 12 (natural), HP 9, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4 + poison), MV near (climb), S +0, D +2, C +2, I +2, W +2, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6.
**Will Not Start It.** She fights only if attacked, and flees at half HP if she can.

vanir primitive.name: Vanir Primitive
vanir primitive.desc: The crew of a longship on its way out, with nothing yet to show for it.
vanir primitive.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 16, ATK 1 axe +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Hungry for It.** Attacks with advantage on the first round of combat.
**Nothing Yet.** They carry almost no loot.

vanir zombie.name: Vanir Zombie
vanir zombie.desc: Buried with the two-handed weapons they died holding.
vanir zombie.stat: AC 12, HP 20, ATK 1 two-handed axe +4 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D -1, C +3, I -3, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Great Axes.** On a critical hit, the damage is dealt twice over.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

vanir berserker.name: Vanir Berserker
vanir berserker.desc: No shield, no armour, and no intention of stopping.
vanir berserker.stat: AC 11, HP 31, ATK 2 greataxe +6 (1d10+1), MV near, S +4, D +1, C +4, I -1, W -1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Berserk.** Immune to fear. Checks morale with advantage, and never flees once below
half HP.

monstrou crow.name: Monstrous Crow
monstrou crow.desc: They curse you first, and then they know where to peck.
monstrou crow.stat: AC 13, HP 15, ATK 1 beak +4 (1d6), MV double near (fly), S +0, D +3, C +1, I +2, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 3
traits: **The Curse.** On first meeting, every character makes a DC 15 WIS check or is cursed: the first attack or check they make in each fight is at disadvantage, until lifted.
**They Know.** The crows attack cursed characters before any others, and attack them with
advantage.
**Riddling.** They speak. On a riddling reaction they pose one riddle, and depart if it
is answered.

vanir warrior.name: Vanir Warrior
vanir warrior.desc: The same crew on the way home — fewer, and richer.
vanir warrior.stat: AC 16 (chainmail + shield), HP 20, ATK 1 axe +4 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +2, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Laden.** Carries the season's plunder.

barrow wight vanir.name: Barrow Wight, Vanir
barrow wight vanir.desc: Half-there, and they never leave the grave they keep.
barrow wight vanir.stat: AC 13, HP 24, ATK 2 ancient blade +5 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Half-There.** Characters attack at disadvantage unless their weapon is magical.
**Grave-Bound.** They guard one barrow and will not leave it. A party that withdraws is
not pursued.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

atali the frostgiant daughter.name: Atali, The Frost-Giant'S Daughter
atali the frostgiant daughter.desc: She does not fight. She does not have to.
atali the frostgiant daughter.stat: AC 13, HP —, ATK none, MV double near, S +0, D +5, C +2, I +3, W +4, Ch +6, AL C, LV 6
traits: **She Does Not Fight.** Atali cannot be caught, bribed, harmed or killed, and carries
nothing. She has no HP: she simply withdraws when she chooses.
**Across the Snow.** On the turn she appears, every male character makes a DC 15 WIS
check or spends its next turn following her out across the snow, out of the fight.
Clerics, monks and paladins roll with advantage; barbarians roll at disadvantage.
**Her Brothers.** At the end of her second turn, two Frost Giants arrive and she
withdraws.

frost giant.name: Frost Giant
frost giant.desc: *Nijgor or Seski.* Roll each brother separately.
frost giant.stat: AC 14 (chainmail), HP 44, ATK 3 greataxe +8 (2d10), MV double near, S +5, D +1, C +4, I +2, W +3, Ch +2, AL C, LV 9
traits: **Frostblood.** Cold immune.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 he poses a riddle; 2 he offers a temptation; 3 he will take 100 gp; 4–6 he attacks.

frostbite ape.name: Frostbite Ape
frostbite ape.desc: Standing near it is the dangerous part.
frostbite ape.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 38, ATK 2 icy pummel +7 (1d10 + chill), MV double near (climb), S +4, D +1, C +4, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Chill.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or have disadvantage on attacks next turn.
**Cold Aura.** At the start of each round, every character in melee makes a DC 12 CON
check or takes 1d6 cold damage. Heavy furs grant advantage; ice-blooded creatures are
immune.

the drowned crew.name: The Drowned Crew
the drowned crew.desc: Still at their stations, and still wet.
the drowned crew.stat: AC 14, HP 24, ATK 1 cutlass +5 (1d8), MV near (swim), S +3, D +1, C +3, I -2, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Never checks morale.** Unless a cleric's blessing is spoken over them, after which
they check morale normally and can be broken.
**Their Captain.** 2-in-6 chance the Captain of the Drowned is with them.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

zingaran freebooter.name: Zingaran Freebooter
zingaran freebooter.desc: More of them than you expected, and better dressed.
zingaran freebooter.stat: AC 16 (leather + shield), HP 18, ATK 1 rapier +4 (1d8) or 1 crossbow (far) +4 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +3, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +1, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Duellists.** On a critical hit, attacks against the target also have advantage until the end of its next turn.

deep one.name: Deep One
deep one.desc: Fish-eyed and patient, and they do not come up where the sun is.
deep one.stat: AC 13, HP 10, ATK 2 spear (close/near) +2 (1d6), MV near (swim), S +2, D +1, C +1, I -2, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Sunblind.** Blinded in bright light.

pressganged crew.name: Press-Ganged Crew
pressganged crew.desc: Taken off a quay last month and not yet reconciled to it.
pressganged crew.stat: AC 12 (leather), HP 8, ATK 1 cutlass +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Unwilling.** Checks morale at disadvantage, and surrenders readily.
**Near Water.** 4-in-6 chance of surprise where there is water.

black corsair.name: Black Corsair
black corsair.desc: Three of them carry bows and resent being shot at first.
black corsair.stat: AC 15 (leather + shield), HP 20, ATK 1 cutlass +4 (1d8) or 1 bow (far) +4 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Bows Ready.** Three of any band carry bows. If the party attacks before a reaction is
rolled, those three shoot first.

sharkman.name: Sharkman
sharkman.desc: They swim with the Barachan crews and take the swimmers.
sharkman.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 22, ATK 1 bite +4 (1d10), MV double near (swim), S +3, D +2, C +3, I -1, W +1, Ch -2, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Blood in the Water.** Attacks a wounded character with advantage.
**At Home.** Characters fighting a sharkman in water attack at disadvantage.

barachan pirate.name: Barachan Pirate
barachan pirate.desc: Professional, and they have done this to better ships than yours.
barachan pirate.stat: AC 15 (leather + shield), HP 24, ATK 2 cutlass +5 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +3, I +1, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Boarders.** On the first round of a boarding action, attacks with advantage.

ballista crew and reaver.name: Ballista Crew And Reaver
ballista crew and reaver.desc: One volley, then they spend a turn drawing steel.
ballista crew and reaver.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 26, ATK 1 ballista (far) +5 (2d8) or 1 sword +5 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +3, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 5
traits: **One Volley.** They shoot once before melee. They then spend their first melee round
drawing weapons and make no attack that round.

the kraken of the coast.name: The Kraken Of The Coast
the kraken of the coast.desc: Coast and open water only. It does not come inland.
the kraken of the coast.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 41, ATK 4 tentacle (near) +7 (1d10), MV double near (swim), S +6, D +2, C +5, I +1, W +2, Ch -2, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Many Arms.** Each attack must target a different creature within near.
**Drag Under.** On a critical hit, the target is pulled into the water: it begins
drowning unless freed by a DC 15 STR check.

the black one.name: The Black One
the black one.desc: Enormous, deliberate, and magic dies in front of it.
the black one.stat: AC 16, HP 36, ATK 2 club +7 (1d12+2), MV near, S +5, D +0, C +4, I -1, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Sweep.** On a critical hit, one additional character of its choice within close takes
**Magic Resistance.** Every spell or prayer cast within near — scrolls and magic items
included — requires a DC 15 check of the caster's spellcasting stat, or it is wasted.

giant crab.name: Giant Crab
giant crab.desc: A wagon-sized shell on legs, and two pincers that close.
giant crab.stat: AC 15, HP 24, ATK 2 pincer +4 (1d8 + crush), MV near (swim), S +3, D +0, C +2, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Crush.** DC 15 STR or the target takes 1d8 damage.
**Harvest.** A slain crab yields one non-metallic shield and two non-metallic edged
weapons (1d6).

corsair captain.name: Corsair Captain
corsair captain.desc: *Bêlit, Queen of the Black Coast.* The ship is listening.
corsair captain.stat: AC 17 (leather + shield), HP 26, ATK 2 scimitar +5 (1d8+1), MV double near, S +2, D +4, C +3, I +2, W +2, Ch +4, AL C, LV 5
traits: **Calls Aid.** On her first turn she calls to the ship. Roll 1d6: on 5–6, six more Black
Corsairs board within 1d3 rounds.
**Captain.** Every corsair within far checks morale with advantage while she lives.

zaporavo of the wastrel.name: Zaporavo Of The Wastrel
zaporavo of the wastrel.desc: He fights one at a time and will not be flanked.
zaporavo of the wastrel.stat: AC 18 (chainmail + shield), HP 30, ATK 2 cutlass +6 (1d10), MV near, S +3, D +3, C +3, I +1, W +1, Ch +2, AL C, LV 6
traits: **The Duel.** Zaporavo chooses one character and only that character may attack him. The
rest must wait, or break the duel with a spell or a ranged attack — in which case the
crew closes on whoever broke it, dealing 2d6 to them at once.

captain of the drowned.name: Captain Of The Drowned
captain of the drowned.desc: The cutlass is cursed and no living hand may use it.
captain of the drowned.stat: AC 16, HP 36, ATK 1 cursed cutlass +7 (2d8), MV near (swim), S +4, D +2, C +4, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Cursed Cutlass.** Cannot be wielded by any living character. A character who tries
takes 2d6 and drops it.
**His Crew.** Sometimes alone, sometimes at the head of the Drowned Crew.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

philtre wraith.name: Philtre Wraith
philtre wraith.desc: Humans and half-humans ruined by alchemical compounds.
philtre wraith.stat: AC 14, HP 20, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +3, I -2, W -2, Ch -4, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Ruined.** Immune to charm, fear, sleep and poison. Never checks morale.

zamorian fence.name: Zamorian Fence
zamorian fence.desc: Buys anything, asks nothing, and remembers every face.
zamorian fence.stat: AC 12 (leather), HP 12, ATK 1 dagger +3 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +2, C +1, I +2, W +2, Ch +2, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Bodyguards.** Never alone: 1d4 hoodlums stand within near.
**Knows Things.** Bought off for 20 gp, or a stolen item worth more, they will name who has what in the city.

tavern brawler.name: Tavern Brawler
tavern brawler.desc: Nobody here meant for it to go this far.
tavern brawler.stat: AC 12, HP 11, ATK 1 stool or fist +3 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **The Dogs.** Accompanied by 1d3 mongrels: AC 12, HP 7, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d4), LV 2. If no
dog lands a hit in a round, the pack is confused and loses all attacks the following
round.
**Barking.** 2-in-6 chance the noise draws 1d3 more dogs before the fight ends.

lost drunkard.name: Lost Drunkard
lost drunkard.desc: Subdue them rather than kill them and they sober up with something to say.
lost drunkard.stat: AC 10, HP 7, ATK 1 fist +1 (1d4), MV near, S +1, D -1, C +1, I -1, W -1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Barely Upright.** Checks morale at disadvantage. Attacks at disadvantage.
**Sobered.** A party that subdues rather than kills them learns something useful about
the district.
**Loot.** A lantern, and a few coins.

dockside rabble.name: Dockside Rabble
dockside rabble.desc: More of them than the alley should hold.
dockside rabble.stat: AC 11, HP 6, ATK 1 knife +2 (1d4), MV near, S +1, D +1, C +1, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 1
traits: **Near Water.** 4-in-6 chance of surprise in any area with water.
**Rabble.** Checks morale at disadvantage.

stiltwalking footpad.name: Stilt-Walking Footpad
stiltwalking footpad.desc: They know these streets from above.
stiltwalking footpad.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 11, ATK 1 long cudgel (close/near) +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Above You.** 2-in-6 chance of surprise, and they attack at reach.
**Their Boss.** A band of eight or fewer is led by a guild bravo: AC 14, HP 24, ATK 2
blade +5 (1d6), LV 4.

gangster.name: Gangster
gangster.desc: Knives, and a sense of proportion about money.
gangster.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 14, ATK 1 knife +4 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Bribe.** 30 gp each, some or all.

temple guard of bel.name: Temple Guard Of Bel
temple guard of bel.desc: The god of thieves keeps guards like anyone else, and these ones are paid in loot.
temple guard of bel.stat: AC 14 (leather + shield), HP 15, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +3 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Holy Ground.** Inside the temple of Bel they check morale with advantage.
**Bribe.** 30 gp each, paid at the altar.

hoodlum.name: Hoodlum
hoodlum.desc: Sticks, and an eye for who is already hurt.
hoodlum.stat: AC 12 (leather), HP 16, ATK 1 stick +4 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Pick on the Wounded.** They attack a character already wounded when they are met with advantage.
**Bribe.** 25 gp each — and the party may buy off some and fight the rest.

thief of zamora.name: Thief Of Zamora
thief of zamora.desc: A guild crew out in force, which is unusual and means something.
thief of zamora.stat: AC 15 (leather), HP 20, ATK 1 shortsword +4 (1d6) or 1 sling (near) +4 (1d4), MV near (climb), S +1, D +4, C +2, I +2, W +2, Ch +1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Guild Work.** Advantage on climb, sneak and hide checks.
**Backstab.** Deals an extra 1d6 against a target that has not yet acted this encounter.

baalpteor the strangler.name: Baal-Pteor, The Strangler
baalpteor the strangler.desc: No weapon, no treasure, and he takes one of you at a time because he is proud of it.
baalpteor the strangler.stat: AC 15, HP 32, ATK 1 strangling grip +8, MV near, S +5, D +3, C +4, I +2, W +2, Ch +1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **The Grip.** On a hit, DC 15 STR or the character is caught by the throat: it loses 2d6
HP at the start of each of his turns and may neither attack nor flee. He holds only one
character at a time. Another character may spend an entire turn, taking no other action,
to break the hold.
**Bare-Handed.** He carries nothing and no treasure comes off him.

master thief.name: Master Thief
master thief.desc: *Shevatas · Taurus of Nemedia.* Over walls and across roofs, and nobody hides from him.
master thief.stat: AC 16 (leather), HP 25, ATK 2 blade +5 (1d6+1), MV near (climb), S +1, D +5, C +2, I +3, W +2, Ch +2, AL C, LV 5
traits: **In the Dark.** In darkness or dim light his attacks deal +1d6, and no character can
hide from him — his darkvision negates stealth.
**Over the Wall.** Advantage on all climb, sneak and hide checks; may withdraw from melee
without provoking.

sorcerer of the tower.name: Sorcerer Of The Tower
sorcerer of the tower.desc: *Skuthus · Yara.* Whatever is in the tower, he put it there.
sorcerer of the tower.stat: AC 13, HP 34, ATK 2 staff +6 (1d8) or 1 spell +8, MV near, S +1, D +2, C +3, I +4, W +3, Ch +2, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Warded.** Spells cast at him are nullified on a 1 on 1d6.
**Wither (INT Spell).** DC 15. One creature within far takes 3d6 and makes a DC 15 CON
check or attacks at disadvantage for 1d4 rounds.
**Summon the Watcher (INT Spell).** DC 15. A Palace Automaton or the Zamorian Spider,
whichever the tower keeps, arrives within 1d3 rounds.

the elephantheaded guardian.name: The Elephant-Headed Guardian
the elephantheaded guardian.desc: *Yag-kosha, in the tower of the elephant.* It is not always hostile.
the elephantheaded guardian.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 40, ATK 1 great mace +7 (2d8), MV near, S +5, D +0, C +4, I +5, W +5, Ch +3, AL N, LV 8
traits: **Thick Hide.** Roll 1d6 for each hit: a melee attack bounces off on a 1–2, an arrow or
sling bullet on a 1–3, and a bounce deals nothing at all. Spells never bounce.
**The Mace.** Can be taken and used two-handed, but deals only 1d8 in a character's hands.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it offers food and rest; 2 it ignores the party; 3 it asks for something; 4–6 it attacks. Reaching for the jewel always makes it attack.

sphinx.name: Sphinx
sphinx.desc: Answer it first. It has seen how this ends either way.
sphinx.stat: AC 16, HP 42, ATK 3 claw +7 (1d10) or 2 spell +5, MV double near (fly), S +4, D +1, C +2, I +4, W +4, Ch +3, AL L, LV 9
traits: **Roar.** In place of attacks, all creatures within far that can hear make a DC 18 CHA check or are paralyzed 1d4 rounds.
**Gate (WIS Spell).** DC 14. Opens a portal at a point within near to another location on any plane. Lasts 1d6 rounds or until dismissed.
**Omens (WIS Spell).** DC 12. Self. Advantage on all actions for 1d4 rounds.
**Riddle (WIS Spell).** DC 12. One target within far makes a DC 15 INT check or is stupefied 1d4 rounds.
**Time Bend (WIS Spell).** DC 14. One target within near is frozen in time for 1d4 rounds.
**Unmake (WIS Spell).** DC 13. One target within far takes 3d8 damage.
**The Riddle.** It always poses a riddle first. Wizards and rogues may assist the answer.

the zamorian spider.name: The Zamorian Spider
the zamorian spider.desc: The webs are the cage; the bite is incidental.
the zamorian spider.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 30, ATK 2 bite +6 (1d8 + poison), MV near (climb), S +3, D +3, C +3, I -2, W +2, Ch -3, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 2d6.
**Webs.** The party cannot flee the encounter until the webs are burned.

lamia.name: Lamia
lamia.desc: You may have been fighting a double the whole time.
lamia.stat: AC 13, HP 30, ATK 2 claw +6 (1d8 + drain), MV near, S +2, D +3, C +3, I +3, W +3, Ch +5, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Drain.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or lose a level until a cleric's blessing restores it.
**The Double.** The first time she drops to 0 HP, the party has been fighting an illusory
double: the real lamia steps out within near with 15 HP.
**Immune to sleep.**
**Her Terms.** She will send the party on an errand — always to kill a rival of hers —
or take jewels worth 100 gp and more, or fight until one character dies and leave with
the body.

vermin walker.name: Vermin Walker
vermin walker.desc: Hundreds of crawling things moving as one body, and cutting it only makes more.
vermin walker.stat: AC 14, HP 32, ATK 1 slam +6 (1d10), MV near (climb), S +3, D +2, C +3, I -3, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Splits.** Each time the vermin walker is wounded, roll 1d6: on a 1–4 it splits in two.
Each half has half the HP remaining, rounded down, and the same attack. A half with 4 HP
or less does not split again.

palace automaton.name: Palace Automaton
palace automaton.desc: It sweeps the room on a schedule.
palace automaton.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 31, ATK 2 bladed arm +6 (1d10), MV near, S +4, D +0, C +4, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Sweep.** On its first turn, and every fourth turn thereafter, it sweeps instead of
attacking: three random characters make a DC 15 DEX check or take 2d6, and on a natural 1
that character's shield is destroyed.
**Construct.** Immune to all spells, poison and mind control. Never checks morale, always
fights to the death.
**Armoured.** Slashing weapons and arrows attack at disadvantage.

thak the manape.name: Thak, The Man-Ape
thak the manape.desc: A servant that learned to open doors.
thak the manape.stat: AC 15 (natural), HP 38, ATK 2 fist +7 (1d10+1), MV double near (climb), S +5, D +2, C +4, I +0, W +2, Ch -2, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Crushing Grip.** On a critical hit the character is held: it may not attack on its next
turn and is hit automatically until a DC 15 STR check frees it.
**Cannot Be Bribed.** Immune to fear and charm.
**Opens Doors.** No closed door will keep it out.

awakening horror.name: Awakening Horror
awakening horror.desc: A half-made thing still deciding its shape. Worse every round; it forgets those who leave.
awakening horror.stat: AC 15, HP 32, ATK 2 limb +6 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +1, C +4, I -2, W +0, Ch -3, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Awakening.** At the end of each round after the first, its attack bonus and damage rise
by 1, cumulative.
**Forgets.** A party that flees resets the horror entirely, and it never pursues.
**Half-Formed.** Slashing weapons attack at disadvantage.
**Never checks morale.**

doom pyre.name: Doom Pyre
doom pyre.desc: A drifting column of flame with hands in it. Touch it and you keep burning.
doom pyre.stat: AC 15, HP 28, ATK 2 burning hand +6 (1d8 + fire), MV near (fly), S +2, D +3, C +3, I +0, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Catches.** On a hit, DC 15 DEX or the character is alight: 1d6 fire at the start of
each of its turns until it succeeds on a DC 15 DEX check, or until water or smothering
puts it out.
**Immune to fire and sleep. Never checks morale.**

drinker of null.name: Drinker Of Null
drinker of null.desc: A hole in the air with arms. It is not there until it is, and then it is close.
drinker of null.stat: AC 16, HP 30, ATK 2 void touch +6 (1d10), MV double near (fly), S +2, D +4, C +3, I +2, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 6
traits: **Out of Nothing.** 3-in-6 chance of surprise.
**Immune to sleep and charm.**

chime bearer.name: Chime Bearer
chime bearer.desc: Iron bells are sewn into their skins. They can never surprise anyone.
chime bearer.stat: AC 16, HP 38, ATK 2 iron blade +7 (1d10+1), MV near, S +4, D +2, C +4, I +1, W +1, Ch -1, AL C, LV 7
traits: **Never Surprise.** The party always hears them coming.
**Toll.** When a chime bearer is killed, every character within near makes a DC 15 WIS
check or is stunned for one round.
**Immune to sleep and charm.**

thog the devourer.name: Thog, The Devourer
thog the devourer.desc: The thing in the pool under Xuthal. Its parts crawl back together.
thog the devourer.stat: AC 16, HP 56, ATK 4 pseudopod +9 (2d6), MV near (climb), S +6, D +2, C +6, I +0, W +1, Ch -3, AL C, LV 11
traits: **Regeneration.** Regains 1d6 HP at the start of each of its turns.
**Crawls Back Together.** Reduced to 0 HP, Thog reassembles and rises at the end of the
following round with half its HP — unless the killing blow was fire.
**Never checks morale.**

demon of the earth.name: Demon Of The Earth
demon of the earth.desc: A horned digger that comes up through the floor, claws first and bearing one bad gift.
demon of the earth.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 46, ATK 3 claw +8 (1d12), MV near (burrow), S +6, D +1, C +5, I +2, W +2, Ch +1, AL C, LV 9
traits: **Dark Gift.** Roll 1d6: 1–2 **evil eye** — every character within far makes a DC 15 WIS check or it attacks them with advantage until it falls; 3–4 **energy drain** — on a hit, DC 15 CON or lose a
level; 5–6 **hellfire blast** — once per encounter, all within near take 4d6 fire, half
on a DC 15 DEX check.
**Immune to fear and charm.**

thaug.name: Thaug
thaug.desc: The witch's thing in the temple at Khauran. Each tentacle is a wound it has not yet taken.
thaug.stat: AC 16, HP 41, ATK 6 tentacle +7 (1d8), MV near, S +5, D +1, C +5, I -2, W +1, Ch -3, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Tentacles.** Thaug loses one attack for every 8 HP of damage currently on it.
**Immune to sleep and poison. Never checks morale.**

wicker man.name: Wicker Man
wicker man.desc: It keeps one of you in its burning ribcage.
wicker man.stat: AC 15, HP 36, ATK 2 burning limb +7 (1d12 + fire), MV near, S +5, D +0, C +4, I -1, W +0, Ch -2, AL C, LV 7
traits: **The Ribcage.** When combat begins, one random character makes a DC 15 DEX check or is
caught inside the burning ribcage: 2d6 fire at the start of each wicker man turn, no
actions but a DC 15 STR check to climb out.
**Immune to fire. Never checks morale.**

bone golem.name: Bone Golem
bone golem.desc: Built out of a great many people.
bone golem.stat: AC 16 (natural), HP 40, ATK 3 bone claw +7 (1d10), MV near, S +5, D +1, C +4, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL C, LV 8
traits: **Brittle Frame.** Bludgeoning weapons deal +1d10. A vial of holy water deals 2d6
automatically, no attack roll needed.
**Construct.** Immune to morale, fear, charm, sleep and poison.

time feeder.name: Time Feeder
time feeder.desc: An eyeless drifting shape. It deals no damage, only marks, and they come due together.
time feeder.stat: AC 16, HP 46, ATK 3 mark +9, MV near (fly), S +2, D +4, C +4, I +4, W +4, Ch +2, AL C, LV 9
traits: **Death Mark.** Its attacks deal no damage. On a hit, the character takes a death mark.
**The Reckoning.** Each time the Time Feeder is wounded, every death mark comes due at
once: each marked character takes 2d8 per mark it carries, and the marks are cleared.
**Immune to lightning and sleep. Never checks morale.** Always fights to the death.
**Hoard.** 1d3 soul cubes — black glass, each a stolen lifetime; 50 gp apiece to a sorcerer.

the outer dark demon.name: The Outer Dark Demon
the outer dark demon.desc: A clawed undead thing out of the dark between stars. Only holy magic touches it.
the outer dark demon.stat: AC 16, HP 49, ATK 4 claw +9 (1d10+1), MV near (fly), S +4, D +3, C +4, I +3, W +3, Ch +2, AL C, LV 10
traits: **Spell-Proof.** Immune to every spell except those that destroy undead, which always
deal 3d6 to it regardless of any check.
**Regeneration.** Regains 1d6 HP at the start of each of its turns.
**Undead.** Immune to morale, fear, sleep and poison.

khosatral khel.name: Khosatral Khel
khosatral khel.desc: The iron demon. Past half, only a blessed blade bites deep.
khosatral khel.stat: AC 19 (iron body), HP 50, ATK 3 iron fist +9 (1d12+2), MV near, S +6, D +2, C +5, I +3, W +3, Ch +3, AL C, LV 10
traits: **Iron Body.** Immune to every non-magical weapon. Magic weapons, spells and holy water
work normally.
**Past Half.** Once reduced to half HP, he takes half damage from everything except a
blessed blade — such as the old knife in the Yuetshi shrine.
**Never checks morale.**

aquilonian noble.name: Aquilonian Noble
aquilonian noble.desc: His line goes back to the first kings, as he mentions.
aquilonian noble.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 14, ATK 2 broadsword +3 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +1, I +1, W +0, Ch +2, AL L, LV 3
traits: **Rank.** Harming him is death. His word is taken over that of any ten commoners.
**Plots.** He is in a conspiracy for the throne, or against one, and needs men nobody will miss. 1d6 × 10 gp, half in advance.
**Pride.** Called a coward in public, he fights alone.
**Carries.** A signet, a silk purse of 4d6 gp, a letter he should have burned.

kothian slaver.name: Kothian Slaver
kothian slaver.desc: He buys after a war and sells before the next.
kothian slaver.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 10, ATK 1 whip (close/near) +2 (1d4) or 1 scimitar +2 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I +1, W +0, Ch +0, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Whip.** On a hit he may entangle instead of wound: the target cannot move away until it spends an action on a DC 12 STR check.
**Always Buying.** A prisoner the party sells him fetches 2d6 gp. A character taken alive in this country ends on his chain.
**The Coffle.** Unchained, his slaves turn on him before they run.
**Carries.** Keys, a branding iron, 4d6 gp.

street astrologer.name: Street Astrologer
street astrologer.desc: He reads the stars for coppers, and they tell him the same as they tell the king's man.
street astrologer.stat: AC 10, HP 5, ATK 1 staff +1 (1d4), MV near, S -1, D +0, C +0, I +2, W +3, Ch +1, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Casts a Chart.** For 1 gp, a true reading once per character, ever: the GM names one danger waiting in the place the party is going.
**An Ill Star.** Once per day. He names a doom on one creature within near: a DC 12 WIS check, or disadvantage on its next three checks.
**Carries.** A brass star-tablet worth 5 gp, 2d6 sp.

serf of the barony.name: Serf Of The Barony
serf of the barony.desc: Sold with the land, twice in his lifetime.
serf of the barony.stat: AC 10, HP 4, ATK 1 bill-hook +1 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Hates the Baron.** He will show a hidden way into the keep, or hide the party in the byre, for nothing.
**Fears the Baron More.** Questioned by a man in mail, he tells everything at once.
**Carries.** A bill-hook, a crust.

household slave.name: Household Slave
household slave.desc: Brythunian, Kushite or Zamorian; the collar is the same.
household slave.stat: AC 10, HP 3, ATK 1 fists +0 (1), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Sees Everything.** Nobody lowers their voice for a slave. For 1 sp, or a promise, he tells what was said in his master's house.
**Property.** Harming him is a debt to the owner, 3d6 gp. Freeing him is theft.
**Will Run.** Given a real chance he takes it, and remembers who gave it.
**Carries.** A bronze token with the master's mark.

hyborian townsman.name: Hyborian Townsman
hyborian townsman.desc: Tawny-haired, grey-eyed, and sure that everything east of Koth is sorcery.
hyborian townsman.stat: AC 10, HP 3, ATK 1 cudgel +0 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL L, LV 0
traits: **Run or Beg.** Flees at the first wound, and surrenders if he cannot flee.
**Fears the Outlander.** He takes any Stygian, Pict or sorcerer for an enemy, and fetches the City Watch: they arrive in 1d4 rounds.
**Carries.** 2d6 cp.

waterseller.name: Water-Seller
waterseller.desc: He has walked this quarter with a wet goatskin for thirty years.
waterseller.stat: AC 10, HP 4, ATK 1 brass cup +0 (1), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +2, Ch +1, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Every Rumour.** He knows which house hired guards, which caravan came in short, and who was carried out of the temple at dawn. A copper and a DC 9 CHA check.
**Never Fights.** He drops the skin and runs.
**Carries.** A goatskin of water, 2d6 cp.

shemite pedlar.name: Shemite Pedlar
shemite pedlar.desc: Blue-black beard, hooked nose, and a price that begins at three times the worth.
shemite pedlar.stat: AC 11, HP 3, ATK 1 curved knife +1 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +0, I +2, W +1, Ch +1, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Haggle.** He buys at half and sells at double. A DC 12 CHA check brings either to a fair price; a failed one adds a tenth.
**Carries Letters.** He has walked from Asgalun to Shadizar, and carries messages between people who must not be seen to write.
**Carries.** Cloth and trinkets worth 3d6 gp, 2d6 sp, a letter.

nemedian scholar.name: Nemedian Scholar
nemedian scholar.desc: He is writing a chronicle, and has reached the part nobody wants written.
nemedian scholar.stat: AC 10, HP 4, ATK 1 penknife +0 (1d4), MV near, S -1, D +0, C +0, I +3, W +2, Ch +0, AL L, LV 1
traits: **Reads the Old Tongues.** He reads Acheronian, old Stygian and the glyphs of Valusia, and can say what a ruin was and who was buried in it.
**Skeptic.** He does not believe in sorcery. The first time he sees it he makes a morale check with disadvantage.
**Pays for Proof.** 2d6 gp for any inscription, rubbing or relic from a place older than the Hyborians.
**Carries.** A scroll case, ink, 2d6 gp.

eunuch chamberlain.name: Eunuch Chamberlain
eunuch chamberlain.desc: He has served three kings in one palace, and buried two.
eunuch chamberlain.stat: AC 10, HP 8, ATK 1 jewelled dagger +0 (1d4 + poison), MV near, S -1, D +0, C +0, I +3, W +2, Ch +2, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6.
**The Palace Door.** He can bring the party before the king, or have them forgotten in the pits, with a word.
**Buys Secrets.** He pays 2d6 gp for anything about a rival, and sells it on within the day.
**Carries.** Palace keys, perfume, rings worth 3d6 gp.

priest of mitra.name: Priest Of Mitra
priest of mitra.desc: Mitra asks for no blood and no gold image, which the East finds suspicious.
priest of mitra.stat: AC 10, HP 14, ATK 1 staff +2 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +1, I +2, W +3, Ch +2, AL L, LV 3
traits: **Sign of Mitra.** Demons, the undead and things of the Outer Dark cannot come within close of him while he stands and speaks. He can hold it for as long as he does nothing else.
**Knows the Old Evil.** He can name a sorcerer's school from its work, and knows how the thing was beaten last time.
**Sanctuary.** His temple shelters anyone hunted by sorcery, and nobody hunted by the king.
**Carries.** A plain staff, a phial of blessed oil, no money.

hill witch.name: Hill Witch
hill witch.desc: She was old when the last king was crowned, and told him how he would die.
hill witch.stat: AC 11, HP 14, ATK 1 staff +1 (1d4) or 1 wolf bite +3 (1d6), MV near, S -1, D +1, C +1, I +2, W +4, Ch +1, AL N, LV 3
traits: **The Wolf.** A great grey wolf attacks on her turn. It leaves when she falls.
**Sees.** She burns herbs and looks: once per visit she answers one question about a living enemy, truly.
**Not for Sale.** She takes no gold. She helps those the black priests are hunting, and nobody else.
**Charm Against Sorcery.** She may give one character a root-bundle: advantage on the next check against a spell.
**Carries.** Herbs, a staff, a hearth with a secret way out.

veiled lady.name: Veiled Lady
veiled lady.desc: The veil is expensive and the sandals are wrong for the street.
veiled lady.stat: AC 10, HP 4, ATK 1 dagger +0 (1d4), MV near, S -1, D +0, C +0, I +1, W +1, Ch +2, AL L, LV 1
traits: **An Errand in the Dark.** She is going to a sorcerer, a lover or a moneylender, and pays 3d6 gp for an escort that asks nothing.
**Her House.** If she comes to harm, her kin hunt whoever was with her. If she comes home safe, a door in the noble quarter is open to the party.
**Carries.** A ring worth 30 gp, a note in a cipher.

brythunian captive.name: Brythunian Captive
brythunian captive.desc: Taken in a border raid and sold three times since.
brythunian captive.stat: AC 10, HP 3, ATK 1 fists +0 (1), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +1, AL N, LV 0
traits: **A Ransom.** Her father is a lord of some small hall in the north. Brought home, she is worth 2d6 × 10 gp and a welcome.
**Not Meek.** Given a blade she uses it, on the slaver first: ATK 1 knife +1 (1d4).
**Carries.** Nothing.

palace page.name: Palace Page
palace page.desc: Somebody's younger son, sent to court to be useful or forgotten.
palace page.stat: AC 11, HP 3, ATK none, MV near, S -2, D +1, C +0, I +1, W +0, Ch +1, AL L, LV 0
traits: **The Message.** The tablet is sealed and addressed to someone who matters. Its contents are worth 3d6 gp to that person's rival.
**Knows the Passages.** He can say which palace doors are guarded, and which stair the queen's physician uses.
**Carries.** A sealed tablet, livery worth 2 gp.

alley children.name: Alley Children
alley children.desc: Eight or nine of them, and they work the street like a wolf pack.
alley children.stat: AC 12, HP 3, ATK 1 thrown stone (near) +0 (1), MV near (climb), S -2, D +2, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Many Hands.** While they crowd round, one character makes a DC 12 WIS check or loses a purse or one small item.
**Gone.** They scatter into holes no adult fits. They never fight.
**Eyes of the Maul.** The thieves' quarter pays them to watch. For 1 sp they watch for the party instead, for a day.
**Carries.** What they took.

market wife.name: Market Wife
market wife.desc: She has sold figs from this pitch since before the old king died.
market wife.stat: AC 10, HP 3, ATK 1 basket +0 (1), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +1, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Raises the Bazaar.** Her shout turns every head in the market: 2d6 Hyborian Townsmen crowd in, and nothing here goes unseen for the rest of the day.
**Knows Who Buys.** She knows which house is feeding twenty more mouths than last week.
**Carries.** Figs, a brass scale, 2d6 cp.

dancing girl.name: Dancing Girl
dancing girl.desc: From Zamboula, she says. The accent is from two streets away.
dancing girl.stat: AC 12, HP 3, ATK 1 hairpin +2 (1d4), MV near, S -1, D +2, C +0, I +0, W +0, Ch +2, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Heard at the Tables.** Mercenaries talk when they drink. She knows who is hiring, who was paid, and which captain is planning to change sides.
**Slips Away.** Advantage on any check to get out of a grip, a room or a bargain.
**Carries.** Ankle bells, a hairpin, 2d6 sp sewn into a hem.

goatherd girl.name: Goatherd Girl
goatherd girl.desc: She has walked down from the hills twice a year since she was six.
goatherd girl.stat: AC 11, HP 4, ATK 1 sling (near) +1 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Knows the Hills.** She knows the bandits' pass, the cave nobody shelters in, and the standing stone her grandmother would not walk past.
**The Flock.** Twenty goats. Stampeded down a street, they block it for 1d4 rounds.
**Carries.** A sling, cheese, 1d6 cp.

zamorian courtesan.name: Zamorian Courtesan
zamorian courtesan.desc: Dark-eyed, soft-voiced, and better informed than the king's spymaster.
zamorian courtesan.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 dagger +1 (1d4), MV near, S -1, D +1, C +0, I +2, W +1, Ch +3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Knows Their Secrets.** She can name one true weakness of any powerful man in the city: a debt, a fear, a hidden door. The price is 3d6 gp, or a favour of the same weight.
**Drugged Wine.** A character who drinks with her makes a DC 12 CON check or sleeps for 1d6 hours, and wakes without a purse.
**Carries.** Jewels worth 4d6 gp, a small phial.

priestess of ishtar.name: Priestess Of Ishtar
priestess of ishtar.desc: The temple is older than the city and richer than its king.
priestess of ishtar.stat: AC 10, HP 9, ATK 1 ritual knife +1 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +1, W +3, Ch +3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Ishtar's Favour.** Once per day she heals 1d6 HP, or lifts a curse, for an offering of 10 gp.
**Sacrilege.** Harming her within sight of the temple brings 2d4 temple guards (as City Watch) and the hatred of the whole city.
**Hears Confession.** Half the city's wives tell her what the other half are doing.
**Carries.** An ivory image, gold ornaments worth 5d6 gp.

swordwoman.name: Sword-Woman
swordwoman.desc: She sailed with the Red Brotherhood, and left when a captain forgot she was not for sale.
swordwoman.stat: AC 14 (leather), HP 14, ATK 2 straight sword +3 (1d8) or 1 poniard +3 (1d4), MV near (climb), S +1, D +3, C +1, I +1, W +0, Ch +2, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Quick as a Panther.** She cannot be surprised, and acts first in the first round.
**Lays Hands on Her.** A character who grabs or insults her is attacked at once, with advantage on her first blow.
**Looking for a Ship.** She joins any venture with plunder in it for an equal share, and leaves if cheated.
**Carries.** A sword, sea-boots, 2d6 gp, a price on her head in Zingara.

hired bravo.name: Hired Bravo
hired bravo.desc: A cloak over one arm and a long blade in the other.
hired bravo.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 10, ATK 1 rapier +3 (1d6) or 1 thrown dagger (near) +3 (1d4), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch +1, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Cloak.** Once per fight he throws it over a weapon: that attacker has disadvantage until it spends an action to clear it.
**Bought by the Night.** He names his employer for twice the fee, and does not come back for the job.
**Carries.** A fee of 2d6 gp, a description of the party.

zingaran smuggler.name: Zingaran Smuggler
zingaran smuggler.desc: Wine out, silk in, and the customs galley paid to be elsewhere.
zingaran smuggler.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 cutlass +1 (1d6), MV near (swim), S +1, D +1, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **The Cargo (d6).** 1–3 Kyros wine · 4 Khitan silk · 5 a passenger who paid not to be seen · 6 a sealed jar from Stygia that hums.
**Knows the Coast.** He can land the party on any shore from Kordava to the Black Coast, unseen, for 2 gp a head.
**Carries.** A share of the cargo worth 3d6 gp.

lotusseller.name: Lotus-Seller
lotusseller.desc: Yellow lotus for dreams, black lotus for those who do not mean to wake.
lotusseller.stat: AC 10, HP 5, ATK 1 dagger +1 (1d4) or 1 lotus dust (close), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +2, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 1
traits: **Black Lotus Dust.** Once per fight he blows a palmful: every creature within close makes a DC 15 CON check or sleeps for 1d6 rounds.
**The Sleepers.** One of the men on his couches is somebody important. He knows which.
**Stock.** Yellow lotus at 5 gp a dose, black lotus at 50 gp: a drinker sleeps a day and dreams true, or fails a DC 15 CON check and does not wake.
**Carries.** 1d4 doses of yellow, one of black, 3d6 gp.

kidnapper of the maul.name: Kidnapper Of The Maul
kidnapper of the maul.desc: He sells to the slavers, the galleys, and the temples that want them young.
kidnapper of the maul.stat: AC 11, HP 6, ATK 1 cudgel +2 (1d4), MV near, S +2, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch -1, AL C, LV 1
traits: **Sack and Carry.** A target at 0 HP, or grabbed on a DC 12 STR check, is bagged and gone the next round unless someone stops him.
**The Buyer.** For his life he names who ordered it, and where the others were taken.
**Carries.** A sack, a cord, 2d6 sp.

cutpurse of the maul.name: Cutpurse Of The Maul
cutpurse of the maul.desc: Born in the thieves' quarter, and never been arrested out of it.
cutpurse of the maul.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 5, ATK 1 dagger +2 (1d4), MV near (climb), S +0, D +2, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 1
traits: **Lift.** A character he brushes past makes a DC 12 WIS check or loses a purse or one small item.
**Home Ground.** Inside the Maul the guard does not follow, and 1d4 more of him come to a whistle.
**Carries.** 1d4 purses of 1d6 sp each.

tombrobber.name: Tomb-Robber
tombrobber.desc: He went into a Stygian tomb with five men and has not slept well since.
tombrobber.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 pick +1 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +1, C +0, I +1, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **The Thing in Linen.** Worth 1d6 × 20 gp to a collector. Roll a d6: on a 1 it is cursed, and something has followed it north.
**Knows the Way In.** He can draw the tomb: the false door, the pit, the third chamber he did not enter.
**Carries.** A pick, a lamp, the thing.

fence of the bazaar.name: Fence Of The Bazaar
fence of the bazaar.desc: Everything stolen in this city passes his stall within three days.
fence of the bazaar.stat: AC 10, HP 4, ATK 1 dagger +1 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +2, W +2, Ch +1, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Buys Anything.** A third of its worth tonight; half for temple gold, which he melts before dawn.
**Knows the Piece.** He can say whose jewel it was and which guild has marked that house as its own.
**Carries.** 4d6 gp, a touchstone, a boy who runs for the guild.

roofrunner.name: Roof-Runner
roofrunner.desc: He has never used a door he did not have to.
roofrunner.stat: AC 14 (leather), HP 9, ATK 1 short sword +2 (1d6), MV near (climb), S +0, D +3, C +0, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Wall and Wire.** Climbs any wall at full speed, and crosses a rope as if it were a street.
**Backstab.** Deals an extra 1d6 against a target that has not yet acted this encounter.
**The Tower.** He has been halfway up a sorcerer's tower and came back. He will sell the route for 4d6 gp, or go again as a partner.
**Carries.** A silk rope, a grapnel, 2d6 gp.

court poisoner.name: Court Poisoner
court poisoner.desc: Kings die of fevers. He is very good with fevers.
court poisoner.stat: AC 11, HP 13, ATK 1 needle ring +3 (1 + poison), MV near, S -1, D +1, C +0, I +3, W +2, Ch +2, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or take an extra 2d6.
**Purple Lotus.** Once per fight, in place of his poison: a DC 15 CON check or the target is paralysed for 1d4 rounds, awake and aware.
**The Slow Dose.** He can kill over a month with no mark. He knows who in the palace is already dying.
**Carries.** Three doses, one antidote, a physician's seal.

agent of the red priest.name: Agent Of The Red Priest
agent of the red priest.desc: The king rules the city. The Red Priest rules the king.
agent of the red priest.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 14, ATK 2 short sword +3 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I +2, W +2, Ch +1, AL C, LV 3
traits: **The Priest's Hand.** No guard stops him and no magistrate hears a charge against him.
**The List.** Names on it disappear. A name can be taken off for a service, never for gold.
**Informers.** He hears where the party slept last night within a day of asking.
**Carries.** A seal no one questions, a list, 3d6 gp.

kozak hetman.name: Kozak Hetman
kozak hetman.desc: Escaped slave, broken soldier, outlaw; the steppe made him a chief.
kozak hetman.stat: AC 15 (chainmail), HP 25, ATK 2 sabre +4 (1d6) or 1 horse-bow (far) +4 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +2, AL C, LV 5
traits: **The Free Brotherhood.** Kozaks who can see him never check morale.
**Loot to Sell.** Turanian plunder worth 2d6 × 20 gp, at a third of its price to anyone who asks nothing.
**Takes Recruits.** Any hard-handed outcast may ride with him. Leaving is another matter.
**Carries.** A fast horse worth 80 gp, a gilded sabre worth 50 gp, 5d6 gp.

slavecatcher.name: Slave-Catcher
slavecatcher.desc: He is paid by the head, and paid more if it is still attached.
slavecatcher.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 14, ATK 1 whip (close/near) +3 (1d4) or 1 broadsword +3 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +2, Ch +0, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Hounds.** Two mastiffs attack on his turn: +3 (1d6) each. Each is out of the fight after 6 damage.
**Tracker.** He follows a day-old trail without a check.
**The Description.** It is vague. One of the party fits it well enough to be worth 20 gp.
**Carries.** Manacles, a writ, 3d6 gp.

hyrkanian horsethief.name: Hyrkanian Horse-Thief
hyrkanian horsethief.desc: On the steppe it is how a young man proves he is worth a wife.
hyrkanian horsethief.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 9, ATK 1 horse-bow (far) +3 (1d6) or 1 sabre +2 (1d6), MV double near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Parthian Shot.** He may shoot at full effect while riding away.
**Takes the Horses.** At night, a DC 15 WIS check by the watch or the party's mounts are gone by dawn.
**Sells Cheap.** Good horses at half price, 30 gp, and a day's start on whoever owned them.
**Carries.** 1d6 horses, a bow, 2d6 sp.

zuagir raider.name: Zuagir Raider
zuagir raider.desc: The desert tribes take a toll on every caravan between Shem and Turan.
zuagir raider.stat: AC 12 (leather), HP 6, ATK 1 scimitar +1 (1d6) or 1 short bow (far) +2 (1d4), MV double near, S +1, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Ride By.** Mounted, he moves, attacks and moves again, and provokes nothing.
**Law of the Tent.** Whoever shares his salt is safe for three days, and he will kill his own kin to keep that.
**Carries.** A lean horse worth 30 gp, a water-skin, 2d6 sp.

hill bandit.name: Hill Bandit
hill bandit.desc: A herdsman in a bad year, which is most years.
hill bandit.stat: AC 12 (leather), HP 5, ATK 1 short bow (far) +2 (1d4) or 1 hand axe +1 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +1, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL C, LV 1
traits: **The High Ground.** From above, 3-in-6 chance of surprise, and ranged attacks against them have disadvantage.
**Takes the Mules.** They want the goods, not a fight: a third of what the party carries buys the pass.
**Carries.** 2d6 sp, a goatskin cloak.

runaway slave.name: Runaway Slave
runaway slave.desc: Three days off a Kothian estate, travelling by night.
runaway slave.stat: AC 10, HP 4, ATK 1 club +0 (1d4), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Nothing to Go Back To.** Cornered, they fight until half are down. Offered food, they talk.
**The Estate.** They know its walls, its guard and where the master keeps his strongbox.
**A Price.** 5 gp a head from any slave-catcher, and they know it.
**Carries.** A filed collar, a stolen loaf.

drunken mercenary.name: Drunken Mercenary
drunken mercenary.desc: A Free Companion with a season's pay and no captain.
drunken mercenary.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 6, ATK 1 broadsword +1 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +1, I +0, W -1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Sloppy.** Disadvantage on attack rolls while drunk, which is until morning.
**Liquid Courage.** Never checks morale tonight.
**For Hire Tomorrow.** Bought a drink instead of fought, he signs on for 3 sp a day.
**Carries.** What is left of 3d6 sp.

dicer.name: Dicer
dicer.desc: He loses the first three throws. Everybody does, with him.
dicer.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 knife +1 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +0, I +2, W +1, Ch +2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Loaded.** A character who plays makes a DC 15 WIS check to spot the dice. Otherwise they lose 2d6 gp before they stop.
**Called Out.** Accused, he overturns the table, and 1d3 Drunken Mercenaries who lost to him earlier take the party's side.
**Carries.** Two sets of dice, 4d6 sp.

pitwrestler.name: Pit-Wrestler
pitwrestler.desc: He has broken eleven men in the pits of Shadizar, by his owner's count.
pitwrestler.stat: AC 12, HP 11, ATK 2 fist +2 (1d4), MV near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Hold.** If both fists hit one target it is grabbed: it cannot move, and takes 1d6 at the start of each of his turns until it wins a DC 12 STR check.
**The Wager.** His owner takes any bet up to 20 gp against all comers, bare-handed.
**Wants His Freedom.** 60 gp buys him, and he does not forget it.
**Carries.** Nothing. The owner has 4d6 gp.

robber baron.name: Robber Baron
robber baron.desc: His castle sits on the only road, which is why it was built.
robber baron.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 20, ATK 2 broadsword +3 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I +1, W +0, Ch +1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **His Road.** A fifth of everything, or a cell and a ransom of 1d6 × 20 gp a head.
**Men at the Gate.** Within sight of his keep, 2d6 more Hill Bandits arrive in 1d4 rounds.
**Hires Swords.** He is at feud with a neighbour, and pays 1d6 × 10 gp for a night raid.
**Carries.** A warhorse worth 150 gp, a gold chain worth 40 gp, 4d6 gp.

cimmerian wanderer.name: Cimmerian Wanderer
cimmerian wanderer.desc: A barbarian from the grey hills, gigantic in his mirth and his melancholy.
cimmerian wanderer.stat: AC 14 (leather), HP 22, ATK 2 broadsword +4 (1d8), MV near (climb), S +3, D +3, C +3, I +1, W +1, Ch +1, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Wolf's Senses.** He cannot be surprised, and sees in the dark as far as near.
**Hates Sorcery.** He attacks spellcasters and unnatural things first, and never checks morale against them.
**Rough Honour.** He does not strike first at a man who has shared his wine, and never forgives a cheat.
**Thief, Reaver, Slayer.** He joins any venture with gold or a good fight in it, for an equal share.
**Carries.** A broadsword, a horned helmet, 2d6 gp, and a jewel he has not told anyone about.

guardsman of the black dragon.name: Guardsman Of The Black Dragons
guardsman of the black dragon.desc: The king's own household troop: black mail, and a loyalty that has outlasted two kings.
guardsman of the black dragon.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 25, ATK 2 broadsword +4 (1d8), MV near, S +3, D +0, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +1, AL L, LV 5
traits: **The King's Errand.** He carries the royal signet. Hindering him is treason in Aquilonia; elsewhere it is an incident.
**To the Death.** Never checks morale while on the king's business.
**Carries.** The signet, sealed orders, 3d6 gp.

mercenary captain.name: Mercenary Captain
mercenary captain.desc: He has sold the same company to both sides of one war, in the right order.
mercenary captain.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 20, ATK 2 broadsword +3 (1d8), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I +1, W +1, Ch +2, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Hiring.** He signs any fighter for 1 gp a week and a share, and knows which king is paying.
**Paid to Stay.** His men check morale with advantage while they are owed money.
**Carries.** A contract with two seals on it, 4d6 gp.

zingaran swordsman.name: Zingaran Swordsman
zingaran swordsman.desc: The best blade-school in the west, and manners to match until the blade is out.
zingaran swordsman.stat: AC 14 (leather), HP 14, ATK 2 rapier +3 (1d8), MV near, S +0, D +3, C +0, I +1, W +0, Ch +2, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Riposte.** Once a round, when a melee attack misses him, he may make one attack against that attacker.
**Touchy.** Any slight is a challenge, and he will accept a challenge from anyone.
**Carries.** A good blade worth 20 gp, a scented glove, 2d6 gp.

bossonian bowman.name: Bossonian Bowman
bossonian bowman.desc: From the marches between the kingdoms and the Picts, where every man shoots before he walks.
bossonian bowman.stat: AC 12 (leather), HP 9, ATK 1 longbow (far) +2 (1d8) or 1 shortsword +2 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +1, C +0, I +0, W +1, Ch +0, AL L, LV 2
traits: **Marksman.** No penalty for shooting into a melee.
**Stands.** He does not check morale while he has arrows and a clear field.
**Carries.** A yew bow, twenty arrows, 2d6 sp.

spearman of the levy.name: Spearman Of The Levy
spearman of the levy.desc: Forty days' service owed, and he is counting them.
spearman of the levy.stat: AC 13 (leather + shield), HP 5, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +1 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL L, LV 1
traits: **Counting the Days.** After his forty days he goes home, whoever is besieging what.
**Carries.** His lord's badge, 1d6 sp.

free companion.name: Free Companion
free companion.desc: No king, no country, and a mail shirt taken off a man who had both.
free companion.stat: AC 15 (chainmail + shield), HP 10, ATK 1 broadsword +2 (1d8), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Paid to Stay.** Checks morale with advantage while he is owed money, and with disadvantage once he is paid.
**For Hire.** 5 sp a day, a week in advance, and loot.
**Carries.** Coins of four kingdoms worth 2d6 sp.

raw levy.name: Raw Levy
raw levy.desc: Taken from the plough on a Tuesday.
raw levy.stat: AC 10, HP 4, ATK 1 bill-hook +1 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I -1, W +0, Ch -1, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Green.** Checks morale at the first wound to anyone on his side.
**Wants to Go Home.** He will show the party the way round the army for a loaf, and go with them.
**Carries.** A bill-hook, 1d6 cp.

shemite archer.name: Shemite Archer
shemite archer.desc: The meadow cities hire out the finest bowmen south of the marches, by the hundred.
shemite archer.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 10, ATK 1 bow (far) +2 (1d6) or 1 scimitar +2 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Volley.** Two or more shooting at the same target attack with advantage.
**Blood Price.** Kill one and his kin are owed; his company will collect.
**Carries.** A horn bow, a blue-black curled beard, 2d6 sp.

turanian horsebowman.name: Turanian Horse-Bowman
turanian horsebowman.desc: Silk under the mail, and a horse that turns on a coin.
turanian horsebowman.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 9, ATK 1 bow (far) +2 (1d6) or 1 tulwar +2 (1d8), MV double near, S +0, D +2, C +0, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Parting Shot.** He may shoot and then move away without being attacked for leaving.
**Scout.** He is counting wells and garrisons for an empire to the east, and will count the party too.
**Carries.** A map nobody else can read, 2d6 gp.

kozak.name: Kozak
kozak.desc: An escaped slave, a deserter and a horse-thief, free on the steppe and nowhere else.
kozak.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 15, ATK 1 sabre +3 (1d8) or 1 bow (far) +3 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL C, LV 3
traits: **Reckless.** He checks morale only at half HP.
**Brotherhood.** Share his wine and he is a friend for a season. Refuse it and he is not.
**Carries.** A stolen horse, a skin of wine, 1d6 gp.

poitanian knight.name: Poitanian Knight
poitanian knight.desc: The southern chivalry: scarlet and gold, and a loyalty to their count before any king.
poitanian knight.stat: AC 17 (plate mail + shield), HP 20, ATK 2 broadsword +3 (1d8) or 1 lance (close/near) +3 (1d12), MV double near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I +0, W +1, Ch +2, AL L, LV 4
traits: **Charge.** On a turn in which he moves at least near before attacking, a lance hit deals double damage.
**Honour.** He accepts a fair challenge, and a yielded foe is safe with him.
**Carries.** A warhorse worth 150 gp, a lady's favour, 3d6 gp.

argossean seacaptain.name: Argossean Sea-Captain
argossean seacaptain.desc: Argos lives by trade and keeps its captains honest by paying them more than piracy would.
argossean seacaptain.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 24, ATK 2 cutlass +4 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +1, I +2, W +1, Ch +2, AL L, LV 5
traits: **Ships at His Word.** He can put a galley and its crew anywhere on the coast within 1d4 days.
**Hates Pirates.** He pays 10 gp a head, and a great deal more for a captain alive.
**Carries.** A royal commission, 4d6 gp.

barachan mate.name: Barachan Mate
barachan mate.desc: The isles elect their captains and their mates, and un-elect them the same way.
barachan mate.stat: AC 13 (leather), HP 19, ATK 2 cutlass +3 (1d6), MV near, S +2, D +2, C +1, I +0, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 4
traits: **Goods to Sell.** He has a cargo with no papers, at half its worth, and a short temper about questions.
**The Crew.** A shout brings 1d6 Barachan Pirates within 1d4 rounds.
**Carries.** Mixed loot worth 4d6 gp.

steersman.name: Steersman
steersman.desc: The one man aboard who is paid to be right.
steersman.stat: AC 11, HP 14, ATK 1 knife +3 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +1, C +0, I +1, W +3, Ch +0, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Reads the Sky.** He can say what the sea will do tomorrow, and is right on 1–5 on 1d6.
**Knows the Coast.** Every harbour, shoal and pirate cove from Zingara to the black coast, and what each will cost.
**Carries.** A sounding-lead, 2d6 gp.

wharf porter.name: Wharf Porter
wharf porter.desc: Paid by the bale, and missing nothing.
wharf porter.stat: AC 10, HP 4, ATK 1 hook +1 (1d4), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +1, I -1, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Saw It Come Ashore.** He knows which ship carried what and which warehouse it went to. A DC 9 CHA check or 1d6 sp.
**Carries.** A cargo hook, 2d6 cp.

argossean sailor.name: Argossean Sailor
argossean sailor.desc: Born in sight of the sea and never more than a mile from it since.
argossean sailor.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 knife +1 (1d4), MV near (climb, swim), S +1, D +1, C +0, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Aloft.** Climbs rigging, walls and cranes at full speed.
**Looking for a Berth.** Signs on with anyone for 2 sp a day and a share.
**Carries.** A knife, a charm against drowning, 1d6 sp.

galley rower.name: Galley Rower
galley rower.desc: Some pull for pay and some in chains, and tonight nobody is asking which.
galley rower.stat: AC 10, HP 7, ATK 1 fists +1 (1d4), MV near, S +2, D +0, C +2, I -1, W +0, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **A Bench Together.** Never one alone in a fight: every Galley Rower within near joins in.
**Wants Off.** On 1–2 on 1d6 he is a slave slipped ashore, and will do a great deal for whoever strikes the ring off his ankle.
**Carries.** Calluses, 1d6 cp.

seaguard.name: Sea-Guard
seaguard.desc: The port's own soldiers: they search holds, take the harbour dues, and are paid from both.
seaguard.stat: AC 13 (chainmail), HP 10, ATK 1 cutlass +2 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL L, LV 2
traits: **Search.** He may lawfully open any hold, chest or sack on the quay.
**Bribable.** 1d6 sp and a DC 12 CHA check, and the hold was empty.
**Carries.** The harbour seal, 1d6 sp.

merchant of messantia.name: Merchant Of Messantia
merchant of messantia.desc: He trades with the Barachans in the morning and dines with the men who hang them at night.
merchant of messantia.stat: AC 10, HP 9, ATK 1 knife +2 (1d4), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +2, W +1, Ch +1, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Passage.** He carries the party anywhere on his route for 1 gp a head, or free if they stand guard.
**Short of Hands.** He needs a guard, a debt collected or a partner watched, and pays 2d6 gp.
**Carries.** A sealed contract, 3d6 gp.

shipwright.name: Shipwright
shipwright.desc: Shapes a hull by eye, and can hear a rotten plank.
shipwright.stat: AC 10, HP 5, ATK 1 adze +1 (1d6), MV near, S +1, D +0, C +0, I +1, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Sound or Rotten.** He can tell at a glance whether a ship will reach the next port, and what was done to make it look as if it would.
**Carries.** An adze, a caulking iron, 2d6 sp.

corsair ashore.name: Corsair Ashore
corsair ashore.desc: One of the black corsairs, alone, in a port that would hang him if it knew.
corsair ashore.stat: AC 13 (shield), HP 10, ATK 1 spear (close/near) +2 (1d6) or 1 javelin (far) +2 (1d4), MV near (swim), S +1, D +1, C +1, I +0, W +0, Ch +0, AL C, LV 2
traits: **Passing.** He is a deckhand until somebody looks twice: a DC 12 WIS check to place him.
**Knows Where They Lie Up.** For his life, or for 3d6 gp, he names the river mouth where the war-canoes are hidden.
**Carries.** An ivory arm-ring worth 2d6 gp.

pilot of the reef.name: Pilot Of The Reefs
pilot of the reef.desc: Forty years on the same two miles of water.
pilot of the reef.stat: AC 10, HP 9, ATK 1 boat-hook +2 (1d6), MV near, S +0, D +0, C +0, I +1, W +2, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **The Passage.** With him aboard, the channel is safe. Without him, a DC 15 WIS check or the ship strikes.
**His Price.** 2d6 gp, doubled if he does not like the look of the cargo.
**Carries.** A boat-hook, a small skiff.

steppe lion.name: Steppe Lion
steppe lion.desc: The old pride male, scarred and alone, and the reason the lionesses moved on.
steppe lion.stat: AC 13, HP 30, ATK 2 claw +5 (1d10), MV double near, S +5, D +2, C +3, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Roar.** The first time it roars, each character within near makes DC 12 WIS or cannot move toward it on their next turn.
**Drag Away.** A character reduced to 0 HP is dragged off on its next turn rather than struck again.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it watches from the grass and lets the party pass · 3–4 it follows for a day · 5–6 it hunts.
**Harvest.** Maned pelt, 4d6 gp. Three slots. Claws and teeth, 1d6 gp, no slot.

cheetah.name: Cheetah
cheetah.desc: It has already decided which of you is slowest.
cheetah.stat: AC 13, HP 14, ATK 1 rend +3 (1d8), MV double near, S +3, D +4, C +1, I -2, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Sprint.** On the first round it acts before initiative and moves twice.
**Takes The Straggler.** It attacks the character with the fewest HP remaining, and withdraws the round after it draws blood.
**Will Not Press.** Checks morale after any round in which it takes damage.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it watches from the grass and does not close · 4–5 it takes the straggler and runs · 6 it hunts in earnest.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 2d6 gp, the finest on the steppe. One slot.

auroch.name: Aurochs
auroch.desc: Cattle in the way that a wolf is a dog.
auroch.stat: AC 11, HP 18, ATK 1 gore +3 (1d8), MV double near, S +4, D +0, C +3, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Herd Defence.** While two or more aurochs stand, each has advantage on attacks against anything within close of a calf.
**Trample.** A character knocked flat by a gore takes a further 1d8 at the start of the aurochs' next turn.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 the herd moves off · 4–5 the bull puts itself between the party and the calves · 6 it charges.
**Harvest.** Hide, 2d6 gp, two slots. Meat, 2d6 rations.

locust swarm.name: Locust Swarm
locust swarm.desc: It is not hunting you. You are simply in the way of the grass.
locust swarm.stat: AC 12, HP 10, ATK 2 bite +2 (1d4), MV double near (fly), S -3, D +2, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **One Body.** The swarm is a single creature. Its two attacks must fall on different targets within close.
**Stripped Bare.** Whenever it reaches the party, even passing over, each character loses 1d4 rations unless they are sealed or buried.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 it passes over in a quarter hour, eating everything green · 5–6 it settles on the party.
**Harvest.** None, though the locusts themselves are food: 1d4 poor rations.

horsehead hawk.name: Horsehead Hawk
horsehead hawk.desc: Too big for the shape of it, and it stoops at the eyes.
horsehead hawk.stat: AC 13, HP 9, ATK 1 talon +2 (1d6), MV double near (fly), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Stoop.** On its first attack each combat it has advantage and strikes before initiative.
**At The Eyes.** A character wounded by a hawk makes DC 12 DEX or has disadvantage on ranged attacks for 1d4 rounds.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they keep to their height · 3–4 they drive the party off a nest · 5–6 they stoop.
**Harvest.** Pinion feathers, 1d6 gp the set, prized for arrows. No slot.

hyena.name: Hyena
hyena.desc: The laughing is not a threat. It is a headcount.
hyena.stat: AC 12, HP 10, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Bone Crusher.** On a natural 19 or 20 the bite does an extra 1d6.

**Count First.** Hyenas will not engage a party that is standing together and unwounded, whatever the reaction roll says. They wait for the party to spread out or for someone to drop, and attack in the first round after either happens.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they follow and call to each other · 4–5 they take the rearmost character · 6 they attack together.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 1d4 gp. One slot per two.

biting fly cloud.name: Biting Fly Cloud
biting fly cloud.desc: The oxen go mad first. Then everyone else.
biting fly cloud.stat: AC 11, HP 6, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4), MV double near (fly), S -3, D +2, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **No Rest.** A party that camps in the cloud gains no benefit from the night's rest unless it makes smoke.
