**Maddened Beasts.** Any animal the party leads must make DC 9 WIS or bolt, scattering its load.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it drifts off · 3–6 it stays with the party until wind or smoke moves it.
**Harvest.** None.

wild dog.name: Wild Dog
wild dog.stat: AC 12, HP 6, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4), MV double near, S +1, D +2, C +1, I -2, W +1, Ch -1, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Pack.** Attacks with advantage while the dogs outnumber the party.
**Still Half Tame.** A character who spends a ration and succeeds at DC 12 CHA turns the whole pack aside. On a 1 on 1d6 one of them follows the party as a dog.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they beg · 3–4 they shadow the party · 5–6 they attack.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 1 gp. One slot per four.

antelope herd.name: Antelope Herd
antelope herd.desc: Food, if you are quick, and a wall of bone if you are not.
antelope herd.stat: AC 12, HP 5, ATK 1 kick +1 (1d4), MV double near, S +1, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Not A Fight.** The herd flees. It attacks only what is between it and open ground.
**Stampede.** If the party blocks the herd's line, every character in the way makes DC 12 DEX or takes 2d6 and is knocked flat.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they run · 5 they run through the party · 6 something else is hunting them — roll on this table again.
**Harvest.** Hide, 1d6 gp, one slot. Meat, 2d4 rations per beast taken.

prairie rat.name: Prairie Rat
prairie rat.desc: The burrows go down further than a horse's leg.
prairie rat.stat: AC 11, HP 1, ATK 1 bite +1 (1), MV near (burrow), S -1, D +2, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Broken Ground.** The first character to cross a warren at speed makes DC 9 DEX or falls, losing their action.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they vanish down the holes · 5–6 they swarm what is already on the ground.
**Harvest.** None worth the hour.

grass adder.name: Grass Adder
grass adder.desc: The grass moves against the wind, and that is all the warning there is.
grass adder.stat: AC 12, HP 5, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4 + venom), MV near (climb), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 9 CON or take an extra 1d4. Halflings roll this with advantage.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it is gone before anyone draws · 4–5 it holds its ground and strikes only if stepped over · 6 it strikes.
**Harvest.** Venom, 1d4 gp per adder, or coats one weapon for its next hit. No slot.

steppe hare.name: Steppe Hare
steppe hare.desc: Two hundred of them, and every one of them already running.
steppe hare.stat: AC 12, HP 1, ATK 1 kick +1 (1), MV double near, S -1, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +2, Ch -3, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Not A Fight.** Hares never attack. They are rations, and catching one is a DC 12 DEX check, not combat.
**What They Are Running From.** On a 1 in 6, something is already driving them. Roll on this table again.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–6 they flee. The question is only what you catch.
**Harvest.** Meat, one ration per hare.

steppe pony.name: Steppe Pony
steppe pony.desc: Shaggy, bad-tempered, and worth forty gold in any town.
steppe pony.stat: AC 11, HP 6, ATK 1 hoof +1 (1d4), MV double near, S +2, D +1, C +2, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Not A Fight.** Ponies flee. They kick only when cornered or roped.
**Catchable.** A character who spends an hour and succeeds at DC 12 WIS or CHA takes one as a mount. Each further pony is a new check at disadvantage.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–5 the band scatters · 6 the lead mare stands over a foal and kicks.
**Harvest.** Alive, 40 gp in a settlement. Dead, 1d6 gp of hide and meat.

giant dung beetle.name: Giant Dung Beetle
giant dung beetle.desc: Something very large passed this way, and these followed it.
giant dung beetle.stat: AC 13, HP 10, ATK 1 horn +1 (1d4 + knock), MV near, S +1, D -1, C +1, I -3, W -1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Knock.** On a hit, DC 9 STR or pushed a close distance and knocked down.
**Sign.** Their presence means a herd of something far larger is within a day's travel. Roll this terrain's table again and read only the result.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–5 they go on rolling · 6 they defend the ball.
**Harvest.** Carapace plate, 1d6 gp, makes a shield's facing. One slot.

ostrich.name: Ostrich
ostrich.desc: A bird the height of a man, with a kick that folds a shield.
ostrich.stat: AC 12, HP 10, ATK 1 kick +2 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +2, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Folding Kick.** On a hit against a character carrying a shield, they make DC 12 STR or the shield is bent out of use until repaired in a settlement.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 it outruns everything · 5 it guards a clutch of eggs · 6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Plumes, 1d6 gp. Eggs, 1d3 found, two rations each.

wild boar.name: Wild Boar
wild boar.desc: It does not stop when it is hurt. That is the whole problem.
wild boar.stat: AC 13, HP 16, ATK 1 tusk +3 (1d8), MV double near, S +3, D +1, C +3, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Will Not Stop.** Never checks morale. At 0 HP it goes on acting for one more round.
**Charge.** If it moves a full double near before attacking, the tusk does 2d6 instead.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it crashes away through the grass · 3–4 it stands and screams · 5–6 it charges.
**Harvest.** Tusks, 1d6 gp. Meat, 2d4 good rations.

lesser ant lion.name: Lesser Ant Lion
lesser ant lion.desc: A cone of loose sand in the grass, and the grass around it is dead.
lesser ant lion.stat: AC 14, HP 15, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d8 + drag), MV near (burrow), S +3, D +0, C +2, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Pit.** The first character within close of the cone makes DC 12 DEX or slides in and is attacked with advantage.
**Drag.** A character bitten is held. Escaping is DC 12 STR and costs an action.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** Always fights. It cannot leave the pit.
**Harvest.** Mandibles, 2d6 gp as a knife pair. One slot.

lioness.name: Lioness
lioness.desc: The male is asleep somewhere. These are the ones that work.
lioness.stat: AC 13, HP 20, ATK 2 claw +3 (1d6), MV double near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Hunt Together.** All lionesses in the encounter attack the same target where they can, and have advantage while two or more are within close of it.
**Drag Away.** A lioness that reduces a character to 0 HP spends its next turn dragging them off instead of attacking.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they let the party pass · 3–4 they follow at a hundred paces for a day · 5–6 they hunt.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 2d6 gp. Two slots. Claws and teeth, a further 1d6 gp, no slot.

terror bird.name: Terror Bird
terror bird.desc: There is a reason nothing else uses this valley.
terror bird.stat: AC 13, HP 25, ATK 2 beak +4 (1d8), MV double near, S +4, D +2, C +2, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Hooked Beak.** A character hit twice in one round makes DC 12 STR or is lifted and dropped for a further 1d8.
**Runs Down.** It can move double near and still make both attacks.
**No Fear Of Men.** Never checks morale while a character is below half HP.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it is already feeding and ignores the party · 2–3 it screams and displays · 4–6 it runs the party down.
**Harvest.** Beak and leg bone, 3d6 gp to a collector. Two slots. Meat, 2d6 rations.

forest tiger.name: Forest Tiger
forest tiger.desc: Striped like the shadows under the canopy, and the villages will not say its name.
forest tiger.stat: AC 13, HP 30, ATK 2 claw +5 (1d10), MV double near (swim), S +5, D +3, C +3, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Ambush.** Its first attack is made with advantage and before initiative.
**Man-Eater.** It attacks the smallest character in the party, every time.
**Solitary.** Checks morale at disadvantage once below half HP.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it is seen once, across a river, and not again · 3–4 it follows the camp for two nights · 5–6 it takes someone at the edge of the firelight.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 4d6 gp. Two slots. Claws, 1d6 gp.

leopard.name: Leopard
leopard.desc: It is in the tree you just walked under.
leopard.stat: AC 13, HP 20, ATK 2 claw +3 (1d6), MV double near (climb), S +3, D +4, C +1, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 4
traits: **From Above.** Its first attack is made with advantage and before initiative.
**Takes And Climbs.** A leopard that reduces a character to 0 HP drags them up a tree on its next turn instead of attacking. Recovering the body is its own problem.
**Solitary.** Checks morale at disadvantage once below half HP — it has no pack to lose face with.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it lets the party pass beneath it · 3–4 it follows along the branches for a mile · 5–6 it drops.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 3d6 gp — the best coat in the forest. One slot.

black bear.name: Black Bear
black bear.desc: It wants the food, not the fight, but it will take the fight.
black bear.stat: AC 13, HP 21, ATK 2 claw +3 (1d6), MV near (climb), S +3, D +1, C +3, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Bluff Charge.** Its first aggressive act is a charge that stops short. Any character who holds their ground makes DC 12 WIS; on a success the bear breaks off entirely.
**After The Rations.** If the party drops food and withdraws, the bear takes it and does not pursue.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it goes up a tree · 3–4 it bluffs · 5 it takes the food · 6 it fights.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 2d6 gp, two slots. Fat, 1d6 gp and renders to four flasks of lamp oil, one slot.

army ant.name: Army Ants
army ant.desc: A column two feet wide and half a mile long, and it does not go around.
army ant.stat: AC 12, HP 17, ATK 2 bite +3 (1d6), MV double near (climb), S -2, D +2, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **One Body.** The column is a single creature. Its attacks must fall on different targets within close.
**Reinforced.** At the end of each round, if the column still stands, it regains 1d6 HP as more ants arrive.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear. It cannot be driven off, only outrun or burned.
**Reactions (d6).** Always advances. It will not stop for anything but fire or deep water.
**Harvest.** None.

carnivorou nettle.name: Carnivorous Nettle
carnivorou nettle.desc: A thicket that leans toward warmth.
carnivorou nettle.stat: AC 12, HP 11, ATK 1 lash +2 (1d6 + sting), MV none, S +1, D +0, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d4 as the welts open.
**Rooted.** It cannot move or pursue. It can be walked around by anyone who sees it.
**Fire.** Takes double damage from fire. Crushing weapons do half.
**Reactions (d6).** Always attacks anything within close. It has no choice in the matter.
**Harvest.** Fibre, 1d4 gp, and the sting-oil is worth 1d6 more to a herbalist. One slot.

giant wasp.name: Giant Wasp
giant wasp.desc: The nest is the size of a cart and it is directly above the trail.
giant wasp.stat: AC 13, HP 9, ATK 1 sting +3 (1d6 + venom), MV near (fly), S +1, D +3, C +0, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 9 CON or go to 0 HP.
**The Nest.** Any area attack, or any loud failure, brings 1d6 more within two rounds.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they are working and ignore a party that moves quietly · 5–6 the nest turns out.
**Harvest.** Venom, 2d6 gp if the sacs are drawn without breaking — DC 12 DEX. No slot.

grey wolf.name: Grey Wolf
grey wolf.desc: They fear fire and very little else.
grey wolf.stat: AC 12, HP 11, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +2, C +1, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Pack.** Attacks with advantage while the wolves outnumber the party.
**Fear Of Fire.** The pack checks morale whenever a fire effect kills one of them, and again at disadvantage if that brings them below half strength.
**Cut Out The Weakest.** Wolves attack whichever character has the fewest HP remaining.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they watch from the treeline and follow · 3 they melt away · 4–6 they hunt.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 1d6 gp. One slot per two.

fruit bat.name: Fruit Bat
fruit bat.desc: Thousands of them, and they all leave at once.
fruit bat.stat: AC 12, HP 1, ATK 1 bite +1 (1), MV double near (fly), S -2, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Not A Fight.** The colony does not attack. It panics, and the panic is the problem.
**Blind Rush.** When disturbed, every character makes DC 9 DEX or loses their light source and their footing.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–5 they flood out and are gone · 6 something came in behind them — roll on this table again.
**Harvest.** Guano, 1d6 gp to an alchemist, and it is worse to carry than that sounds. Two slots.

blood midge.name: Blood Midge
blood midge.desc: Too small to kill and too many to escape.
blood midge.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4), MV double near (fly), S -3, D +3, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Everywhere.** The cloud is one creature. A character who sleeps unsheltered in it loses 1d4 HP and gains no benefit from the rest.
**Smoke.** Any fire with green wood on it drives them off entirely.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they thin out by dusk · 3–6 they follow the party through the hex.
**Harvest.** None.

poison frog.name: Poison Frog
poison frog.desc: Brilliantly coloured, entirely harmless, and lethal to handle.
poison frog.stat: AC 12, HP 1, ATK 1 touch +2 (poison), MV near (climb), S -3, D +2, C +0, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Poison.** DC 15 CON or go to 0 HP with a death timer of 1, and you cannot be magically healed while it runs. Survive it and every disease afflicting you ends.
**Not A Fight.** Frogs do not attack. They are a hazard, and a resource.
**Skin Poison.** Any character who handles one bare-handed makes DC 12 CON or takes 1d6 and has disadvantage on their next check.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–6 they sit there. Everything that happens next is the party's own doing.
**Harvest.** Toxin, 2d6 gp, or coats one weapon for its next three hits — DC 12 DEX to draw it safely, 1d6 damage on a failure. No slot.

rot grub.name: Rot Grub
rot grub.desc: They are in the deadfall, and they go in through the boot.
rot grub.stat: AC 11, HP 4, ATK 1 burrow +1 (1), MV close, S -3, D +0, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **In The Flesh.** A character hit loses 1 HP at the start of each of their turns. Cutting the grub out is an action and 1d4 damage. Fire applied at once destroys it with 1d6 damage to the host.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** Always attacks whatever disturbs the wood.
**Harvest.** None.

red deer.name: Red Deer
red deer.desc: Meat on legs, and the legs are faster than yours.
red deer.stat: AC 12, HP 6, ATK 1 kick +1 (1d4), MV double near, S +1, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Not A Fight.** Deer flee. A stag in rut is the exception and will stand.
**In Rut.** On a 1 on 1d6 the stag charges instead: +2 to hit for 1d8 and it does not check morale.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 the herd is gone · 5 they hold still and are catchable · 6 the stag stands its ground.
**Harvest.** Hide, 1d6 gp, one slot. Meat, 2d4 rations per beast. Antlers, 1d4 gp more.

howler troop.name: Howler Troop
howler troop.desc: The noise arrives a quarter of an hour before they do.
howler troop.stat: AC 12, HP 9, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4), MV near (climb), S +1, D +3, C +1, I -1, W +1, Ch -1, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Thrown Filth.** Before closing, each howler makes one ranged attack at near: no damage, but on a hit the target has disadvantage on their next attack.
**Noise.** While the troop is active, the party cannot surprise anything in this hex and cannot rest.
**Clever Thieves.** On a 1 on 1d6 per round, one howler takes an unsecured item and climbs out of reach.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they scream and throw and nothing else · 4–5 they steal and run · 6 they mob the party.
**Harvest.** Nothing anyone wants.

forest spider.name: Forest Spider
forest spider.desc: The web is between two trunks, and it is strong enough to hold a deer.
forest spider.stat: AC 13, HP 11, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d6 + venom), MV near (climb), S +1, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Web.** The first character to walk into it makes DC 12 STR or is held, attacked with advantage until free.
**Drops.** Attacks from above and is not seen until it has struck.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** Always fights while anything is in the web.
**Harvest.** Silk, 1d6 gp the skein, and makes 50 feet of rope. One slot.

tree viper.name: Tree Viper
tree viper.desc: Green on green, at the height of your throat.
tree viper.stat: AC 13, HP 8, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4 + venom), MV near (climb), S -1, D +4, C +1, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6. Halflings roll this with advantage.
**At Head Height.** Attacks with advantage against any character who has not stated they are watching the branches.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 it does not move and is never noticed · 5–6 it strikes the first to pass.
**Harvest.** Venom, 1d6 gp, or coats one weapon for its next hit. No slot.

giant eagle.name: Giant Eagle
giant eagle.desc: Wingspan of a cart, and it is interested in the pack animals.
giant eagle.stat: AC 13, HP 15, ATK 1 talon +3 (1d8), MV double near (fly), S +3, D +3, C +1, I +0, W +2, Ch +0, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Stoop.** On its first attack each combat it has advantage and acts before initiative.
**Takes The Mule.** It will carry off a pack animal or a halfling rather than fight: DC 12 STR to hold on, and it climbs out of reach in one round.
**Proud.** Will not attack a party that has made no move toward its nest, unless it is hungry — a 1 on 1d6.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it keeps its height and watches · 4 it takes an animal · 5–6 it defends a nest.
**Harvest.** Pinions, 2d6 gp the set. One slot. Taking an egg is 3d6 gp and makes an enemy for life.

tusked boar.name: Tusked Boar
tusked boar.desc: Older, heavier, and entirely without the sense to run.
tusked boar.stat: AC 13, HP 21, ATK 2 tusk +3 (1d8), MV double near, S +4, D +1, C +3, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Will Not Stop.** Never checks morale. At 0 HP it acts for one more round.
**Charge.** If it moves a full double near before attacking, its first tusk does 2d8.
**Thick Hide.** Takes half damage from arrows and bolts.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it withdraws · 2–3 it stands and screams · 4–6 it charges.
**Harvest.** Tusks, 2d6 gp, one slot. Meat, 2d6 rations.

giant chameleon.name: Giant Chameleon
giant chameleon.desc: The branch it is on is the wrong colour, and then it is not a branch.
giant chameleon.stat: AC 13, HP 19, ATK 2 bite +3 (1d6) or 1 tongue (near) +3 (1d4), MV near (climb), S +2, D +2, C +2, I -3, W +2, Ch -4, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Unseen.** Cannot be noticed without a DC 15 WIS check. It has advantage on its first attack against anyone who failed.
**Tongue.** On a hit with the tongue, the target makes DC 12 STR or is dragged within close and attacked with advantage next round.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it stays still and is never found · 3–6 it takes the nearest character.
**Harvest.** Hide, 2d6 gp, and a cloak made from it gives advantage on one hiding attempt before it fades. One slot.

giant constrictor.name: Giant Constrictor
giant constrictor.desc: Thirty feet of it, and the first you know is the weight.
giant constrictor.stat: AC 14, HP 27, ATK 1 bite +4 (1d8 + coil), MV near (climb, swim), S +4, D +1, C +3, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Coil.** On a hit, DC 15 STR or be grappled. A grappled character takes 1d8 automatically at the start of each of the snake's turns and cannot act except to escape, DC 15 STR.
**One At A Time.** It can hold only one character. While it holds one it does not attack others.
**Slow To Rouse.** On a 1 on 1d6 it has fed recently and will not attack at all.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it is torpid and ignores everything · 2–3 it withdraws into the water · 4–6 it takes the nearest character.
**Harvest.** Skin, 3d6 gp, two slots. Rendered fat, 1d6 gp more.

silverback gorilla.name: Silverback Gorilla
silverback gorilla.desc: He has decided the party is a rival troop, and he is not wrong.
silverback gorilla.stat: AC 13, HP 32, ATK 2 fist +5 (1d8) or 1 thrown branch (near) +5 (1d6), MV near (climb), S +5, D +1, C +3, I +0, W +2, Ch +0, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Display First.** It opens with a round of screaming and ground-beating. Every character makes DC 12 WIS or loses their first action to it.
**Sunder.** On a natural 20, a shield or a weapon in the target's hand is broken.
**Protects The Troop.** If 1d6 lesser apes are present it never checks morale. Alone, it breaks off at half HP.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it displays and the troop withdraws · 3–4 it drives the party out of the hex without closing · 5–6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 2d6 gp, two slots. Nothing else, and most people would rather not.

hippogriff.name: Hippogriff
hippogriff.desc: Eagle before, horse behind, and the horses know it at once.
hippogriff.stat: AC 13, HP 20, ATK 1 claw +3 (1d6) and 1 bite +3 (1d8), MV double near (fly), S +3, D +2, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -1, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Dive.** If it flies at least near before attacking, its attacks that turn have advantage.
**Raised From The Egg.** A hippogriff hatched in captivity can be trained as a flying mount.
**Nest.** On a 1–2 on 1d6 there is a nest within a mile holding 1d2 eggs, each worth 150 gp alive.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it circles and leaves · 4–5 it stoops on a pack animal · 6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Flight feathers, 2d6 gp. One slot.

griffon.name: Griffon
griffon.desc: It hunts horses. You have horses.
griffon.stat: AC 12, HP 19, ATK 2 rend +4 (1d10), MV double near (fly), S +4, D +2, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -1, AL N, LV 4
traits: **After The Horses.** It attacks mounts and pack animals before characters, every time, and will carry one off rather than press a fight.
**Nest.** On a 1–2 on 1d6 there is a nest within a mile holding 1d3 eggs, each worth 200 gp alive and a mortal enemy thereafter.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it takes an animal and leaves · 3–4 it circles and does not close · 5–6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Pinions, 3d6 gp the set, one slot. Beak and claws, 2d6 gp.

moor stag.name: Moor Stag
moor stag.desc: Fourteen points, and in autumn it has nothing to lose.
moor stag.stat: AC 12, HP 17, ATK 1 antler +3 (1d8), MV double near, S +3, D +2, C +2, I -3, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 3
traits: **In Rut.** In autumn it never checks morale and charges on sight. At any other season it flees.
**Charge.** If it moves a full double near before attacking, the antlers do 2d6 and the target makes DC 12 STR or is knocked flat.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it stands, screams, and goes · 4 it drives the party off its hinds · 5–6 it charges.
**Harvest.** Hide, 2d6 gp, one slot. Meat, 2d4 rations. The head is worth 3d6 gp to a hall that wants one.

giant badger.name: Giant Badger
giant badger.desc: It has decided the sett is worth dying over and it may be right.
giant badger.stat: AC 13, HP 13, ATK 2 claw +2 (1d6), MV near (burrow), S +2, D +0, C +3, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Will Not Yield.** Never checks morale within near of its sett.
**Digs Out.** It can burrow a full move and attack in the same round, and it will come up behind the party.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it goes to ground · 3–4 it warns and holds the entrance · 5–6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 1d6 gp. One slot. The bristles alone are 1d4 gp to a brushmaker.

giant shrew.name: Giant Shrew
giant shrew.desc: Half a yard of appetite with a heartbeat you can hear.
giant shrew.stat: AC 12, HP 8, ATK 2 bite +2 (1d4), MV double near (burrow), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Frantic.** It acts before initiative on every round. It must eat three times its weight a day and has no patience at all.
**Starving.** Never checks morale while anything edible is within near.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it is gone down a hole · 3–6 it attacks, because it always attacks.
**Harvest.** Nothing.

heather wasp.name: Heather Wasp
heather wasp.desc: The nest is in the ground and the first man over it does not know.
heather wasp.stat: AC 13, HP 10, ATK 1 sting +2 (1d4 + venom), MV double near (fly), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Underfoot Nest.** The character who disturbed it is attacked by all of them in the first round.
**Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d4 and have disadvantage on attacks for 1d4 rounds.
**Ambush.** They always strike first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** Always attacks once the nest is trodden on.
**Harvest.** Comb, 1d6 gp and 1d4 rations. One slot.

buzzard.name: Buzzard
buzzard.desc: Four of them on a dead ewe, and they do not move aside for you.
buzzard.stat: AC 12, HP 6, ATK 1 beak +1 (1d4), MV near (fly), S +0, D +2, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Carrion Only.** Buzzards attack only characters who have lost HP. With nobody wounded they have no legal target and do not attack, whatever the reaction roll says.
**The Dead Ewe.** Whatever killed it is within a mile. On a 1–2 on 1d6, roll on this table again.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they lift off and settle again fifty paces on · 5–6 they defend the carcass.
**Harvest.** Feathers, 1 gp per bird. One slot per six.

wild goat.name: Wild Goat
wild goat.desc: On a ledge no wider than a hand, looking down at you.
wild goat.stat: AC 12, HP 6, ATK 1 butt +1 (1d4), MV double near (climb), S +1, D +2, C +2, I -3, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Not A Fight.** Goats flee upward. The billy will stand on a ledge and will not be moved.
**Rockfall.** A goat driven up a scree slope starts a slide: every character below makes DC 12 DEX or takes 1d6.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they go up and out of reach · 5 they start a slide · 6 the billy blocks the only path.
**Harvest.** Hide, 1d4 gp. Meat, 1d6 rations each. Horns, 1d4 gp more.

hill rat.name: Hill Rat
hill rat.desc: They are in the cairn, and the cairn is the only shelter for an hour.
hill rat.stat: AC 11, HP 1, ATK 1 bite +1 (1 + infection), MV near (climb), S -1, D +2, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Infection.** A wounded character has a 1-in-6 chance of losing a further 1d4 HP.
**In The Shelter.** They are always in the one dry place. A party that wants the cairn must clear them.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they scatter into the stones · 4–6 they defend the nest.
**Harvest.** None.

crag bat.name: Crag Bat
crag bat.desc: They come out of the cliff face at dusk, all at once, from everywhere.
crag bat.stat: AC 12, HP 1, ATK 1 bite +1 (1), MV double near (fly), S -2, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Blind Rush.** When the colony leaves, each character makes DC 9 DEX or loses their footing on the slope for 1d4 damage.
**Dusk Only.** Encountered at dusk or dawn. At any other hour they are asleep in the rock and this result is no encounter at all.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–5 they stream past and are gone · 6 they mob the nearest light.
**Harvest.** Guano, 1d4 gp. Two slots, and nobody will share a camp with you.

moor adder.name: Moor Adder
moor adder.desc: They bask on the stones, which are also where you want to put your hands.
moor adder.stat: AC 12, HP 5, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4 + venom), MV near (climb), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 9 CON or take an extra 1d4. Halflings roll this with advantage.
**On The Stones.** Any character climbing a scree slope or a wall without checking first is bitten with advantage.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they pour off the rock · 5–6 the trodden-on one strikes.
**Harvest.** Venom, 1d4 gp each, or coats one weapon for its next hit. No slot.

giant tick.name: Giant Tick
giant tick.desc: The size of a fist, and it has already been on the sheep.
giant tick.stat: AC 12, HP 5, ATK 1 attach +1 (1), MV close (swim), S -2, D +0, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Attach.** A character with ticks on them loses 1d4 HP at the start of each tick turn — once, not once per tick — until every tick is destroyed.
**Fever.** A character who was attached makes DC 9 CON at the next dawn or loses 1d4 maximum HP until a week's rest.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** Always attaches to whatever walks through the bracken.
**Harvest.** None.

moor hound.name: Moor Hound
moor hound.desc: Somebody's hunting pack, abandoned or outlived.
moor hound.stat: AC 12, HP 11, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +2, C +2, I -2, W +1, Ch -1, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Pack.** Attacks with advantage while the hounds outnumber the party.
**Trained Once.** A character who succeeds at DC 12 CHA while speaking a hunting command turns the pack aside for the day.
**Runs Down.** They do not break off. A fleeing party is caught — hounds move double near and the party does not.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they come to the command · 3 they circle and bay · 4–6 they hunt.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 1d4 gp. One slot per three. A collar on the lead hound bears a house's mark: 1d6 gp, or a clue.

bombardier beetle.name: Bombardier Beetle
bombardier beetle.desc: It turns its back on you, which is the dangerous end.
bombardier beetle.stat: AC 14, HP 12, ATK 1 spray (close) +2 (1d6), MV near (burrow), S +1, D +0, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Boiling Spray.** The spray ignores armour entirely — it is heat, not force. A character hit makes DC 12 CON or is blinded for 1d4 rounds.
**Armoured.** Takes half damage from piercing weapons.
**Limited.** Each beetle can spray three times, then it is only a thing that bites for 1d4.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they trundle away · 5–6 they turn and spray.
**Harvest.** Gland, 2d6 gp, and it can be thrown once as a flask doing 1d6 — DC 12 DEX to draw it intact. One slot.

blood hawk.name: Blood Hawk
blood hawk.desc: Smaller than it sounds and far worse than it looks.
blood hawk.stat: AC 13, HP 9, ATK 1 talon +2 (1d6), MV double near (fly), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Flock.** Attacks with advantage while the hawks outnumber the party.
**At The Eyes.** A character wounded makes DC 12 DEX or has disadvantage on ranged attacks for 1d4 rounds.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they wheel away · 3–4 they drive the party off a nesting crag · 5–6 the flock stoops.
**Harvest.** Pinions, 1d4 gp the set. No slot.

giant raven.name: Giant Raven
giant raven.desc: Clever enough to be a problem and large enough to be a threat.
giant raven.stat: AC 12, HP 10, ATK 1 beak +2 (1d6), MV double near (fly), S +0, D +3, C +1, I +1, W +2, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Thief.** Each round, on a 1–2 on 1d6, one raven takes an unsecured item — a torch, a potion, a loose coin pouch — and flies off with it.
**Mimic.** They repeat words they have heard. On a 1 on 1d6 the party hears a phrase in a human voice from somewhere in the hex, and it is not a trap, only a bird.
**Watches.** While ravens live, the party cannot surprise anything in this hex.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they follow and call · 4–5 they steal · 6 they mob.
**Harvest.** Nothing. One can be kept, and is worth 2d6 gp to the right buyer.

lynx.name: Lynx
lynx.desc: Tufted ears above the heather, forty paces off, already gone.
lynx.stat: AC 13, HP 13, ATK 2 claw +3 (1d4), MV double near (climb), S +2, D +4, C +1, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Will Not Engage.** The lynx attacks only a character who is alone, asleep, or already below half HP. Otherwise it withdraws every time.
**From Cover.** Its one attack each combat comes with advantage and before initiative, then it is gone.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 it watches and is not seen again · 5 it takes the watchman at night · 6 it fights.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 2d6 gp, the best on the moor. One slot.

crag bear.name: Crag Bear
crag bear.desc: It is the colour of the rock and it is between you and the pass.
crag bear.stat: AC 13, HP 26, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d8), MV near (climb), S +4, D +1, C +3, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Bowls Over.** A character its claws reduce below half HP is also knocked flat.
**Holds The Pass.** It does not pursue beyond its own ground, but it does not give that ground up either.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it withdraws uphill · 2–4 it stands across the path and roars · 5–6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 3d6 gp, three slots. Fat, 1d6 gp and six flasks of oil, one slot. Claws, 1d6 gp.

cave lion.name: Cave Lion
cave lion.desc: Bigger than the ones in the south, and it has never seen a spear.
cave lion.stat: AC 13, HP 30, ATK 2 claw +5 (1d10), MV double near, S +5, D +2, C +3, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 6
traits: **No Fear Of Men.** Never checks morale. It has no reason to have learned.
**Drag Away.** A character reduced to 0 HP is dragged off on its next turn rather than struck again.
**Hunts The Noise.** If the party has made a fire or a fight in this hex, it arrives within the hour whatever else was rolled.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it is feeding and will not be disturbed · 2–3 it follows the party for a day · 4–6 it hunts.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 4d6 gp, three slots. Skull, 2d6 gp, two slots, and it marks the carrier as someone who killed one.

snow leopard.name: Snow Leopard
snow leopard.desc: Grey on grey rock, with a tail as long as itself.
snow leopard.stat: AC 14, HP 24, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d8), MV double near (climb), S +3, D +5, C +2, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Leap.** It crosses gaps and cliff faces up to double near in one bound.
**From Above.** Its first attack each combat has advantage and comes before initiative.
**Solitary.** Checks morale at disadvantage once below half HP.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it is a shape on a ridge at dusk and nothing more · 4–5 it takes a goat or a mule and is gone · 6 it hunts.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 5d6 gp, the finest fur in the mountains. One slot.

cave bear.name: Cave Bear
cave bear.desc: It is using the cave you intended to use.
cave bear.stat: AC 13, HP 27, ATK 2 claw +4 (1d10), MV near (climb), S +4, D +0, C +4, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Fills The Entrance.** In a cave mouth or passage only one character can engage it at a time.
**Will Not Leave.** Never checks morale within its own den.
**Crush.** A character reduced below half HP by a claw is knocked flat and attacked with advantage next round.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it is asleep and may be left alone · 2–3 it roars and holds the entrance · 4–6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 3d6 gp, three slots. Fat, 1d6 gp and six flasks of oil. Claws, 2d6 gp.

snow ape.name: Snow Ape
snow ape.desc: White, eight feet, and it throws the rocks underhand.
snow ape.stat: AC 13, HP 19, ATK 2 fist +4 (1d6) or 1 rock (far) +4 (2d6), MV near (climb), S +3, D +1, C +1, I -2, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Thick Fur.** Cold immune.
**Thrown Rock.** It prefers range. It will spend three rounds throwing before it ever closes.
**White On White.** Cannot be seen at distance in snow without a DC 15 WIS check.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it withdraws uphill · 3–4 it throws until the party leaves the hex · 5–6 it closes.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 3d6 gp, three slots, and worth double in any southern city.

great condor.name: Great Condor
great condor.desc: The shadow crosses the whole party at once.
great condor.stat: AC 11, HP 16, ATK 2 beak +3 (1d8 + grab), MV double near (fly), S +2, D +1, C +3, I -2, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Grab.** On a hit, steal one random piece of the target's carried gear.
**Carrion First.** It will take a corpse or a downed animal in preference to any fight, and leave with it.
**Stoop.** Its first attack each combat has advantage and comes before initiative.
**Drops.** It can carry a halfling or a pack animal to a height of near and release it: 2d6 falling damage.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it takes the dead and goes · 4 it circles for a day · 5–6 it stoops.
**Harvest.** Pinions, 2d6 gp the set, one slot, and a quill from one is worth 1d6 to a scribe.

crag spider.name: Crag Spider
crag spider.desc: The crevice is webbed shut and the web is grey with rock dust.
crag spider.stat: AC 13, HP 14, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6 + venom), MV near (climb), S +1, D +3, C +2, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6 and have disadvantage on DEX checks for an hour.
**Web Across The Gap.** The first character to cross makes DC 12 STR or is held fast over a drop, and is attacked with advantage. Escaping the web is DC 12 STR and costs an action.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** Always fights while anything is in the web.
**Harvest.** Silk, 2d6 gp and 100 feet of rope stronger than hemp. One slot.

yak.name: Yak
yak.desc: Shaggy, patient, and worth sixty gold to anyone who has to cross a pass.
yak.stat: AC 11, HP 14, ATK 1 gore +2 (1d6), MV double near (climb), S +3, D +0, C +3, I -3, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Not A Fight.** Yaks flee or stand. They gore only when roped or cornered.
**Catchable.** An hour's work and DC 12 WIS or CHA takes one as a pack animal carrying ten slots. Each further yak is a new check at disadvantage.
**Herd Defence.** While a calf is within close, every yak attacks with advantage.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 the herd moves off up the slope · 5 one can be taken · 6 the bull stands over a calf.
**Harvest.** Alive, 60 gp. Dead, hide for 2d6 gp, two slots, and 2d6 rations.

stone adder.name: Stone Adder
stone adder.desc: Grey on grey, coiled in the one patch of sun on the ledge.
stone adder.stat: AC 13, HP 8, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4 + venom), MV near (climb), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6. Halflings roll this with advantage.
**On The Ledge.** A character bitten while on a narrow path makes DC 12 DEX or falls for 2d6.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it withdraws into the rock · 4–6 it strikes.
**Harvest.** Venom, 1d6 gp, or coats one weapon for its next hit. No slot.

rock baboon.name: Rock Baboon
rock baboon.desc: Forty of them on the cliff above the trail, and they have thrown things before.
rock baboon.stat: AC 12, HP 11, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d6) or 1 thrown rock (near) +2 (1d4), MV double near (climb), S +2, D +2, C +2, I -1, W +1, Ch -1, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Rock Barrage.** Before closing, the whole troop throws. Every character takes one ranged attack at near.
**Troop.** Attacks with advantage while the baboons outnumber the party.
**The Big Male.** One baboon has 16 HP and attacks at +3. While it lives the troop never checks morale.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they scream and show teeth only · 3–4 they throw and withdraw · 5–6 the troop comes down.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 1d4 gp. One slot per three.

cliff swift.name: Cliff Swift
cliff swift.desc: Thousands, nesting in a face that goes up for a thousand feet.
cliff swift.stat: AC 12, HP 1, ATK 1 beak +1 (1), MV double near (fly), S -3, D +2, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Not A Fight.** Swifts never attack unless a nest is taken.
**The Nests.** The nests are edible and valuable, and they are forty feet up a vertical face. Reaching them is DC 15 DEX; failure is a 2d6 fall.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–6 they wheel and scream. They fight only for the nests.
**Harvest.** Nests, 2d6 gp the basket to any eastern kitchen, and 1d4 rations. One slot.

cave bat.name: Cave Bat
cave bat.desc: The cave mouth is the only shelter, and the floor of it is moving.
cave bat.stat: AC 12, HP 1, ATK 1 bite +1 (1), MV double near (fly), S -2, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Blind Rush.** When disturbed, each character makes DC 9 DEX or drops their light source.
**Fills The Passage.** While the colony is in the air, nobody in the cave can make a ranged attack or read anything aloud.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–5 they pour out and are gone for the night · 6 they mob the nearest light.
**Harvest.** Guano, 1d4 gp. Two slots.

rock mite.name: Rock Mite
rock mite.desc: The scree moves, and it is not the scree.
rock mite.stat: AC 11, HP 4, ATK 1 bite +1 (1), MV near (climb), S -3, D +2, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **In The Boots.** A character who walks through a colony loses 1d4 HP at the start of each of their turns until they stop and spend an action clearing them out.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** Always swarms whatever stands on the colony.
**Harvest.** None.

marmot.name: Marmot
marmot.desc: They whistle, and then every living thing for a mile knows where you are.
marmot.stat: AC 11, HP 1, ATK 1 bite +1 (1), MV near (burrow), S -1, D +2, C +2, I -3, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Not A Fight.** Marmots do not attack. They whistle and go down the hole; catching one first is a DC 12 DEX check.
**The Whistle.** While marmots are active in the hex, the party cannot surprise anything and anything hunting them finds them a turn sooner.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–6 they whistle and vanish. That is the whole encounter and the whole problem.
**Harvest.** Meat, one ration per marmot. Pelt, 1 gp. One slot per four.

mountain goat.name: Mountain Goat
mountain goat.desc: It is standing on nothing at all and looking faintly amused.
mountain goat.stat: AC 12, HP 6, ATK 1 butt +1 (1d4), MV double near (climb), S +2, D +3, C +2, I -3, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Not A Fight.** They go up. The billy holds a ledge and will not move for anyone.
**Shows The Way.** A party that watches where the goats go gains advantage on its next check to cross this terrain.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they are two hundred feet up before anyone speaks · 5 they start a slide, DC 12 DEX or 1d6 · 6 the billy blocks the path.
**Harvest.** Hide, 1d4 gp. Meat, 1d6 rations. Horn, 1d4 gp.

scree beetle.name: Scree Beetle
scree beetle.desc: Flat, black, and exactly the shape of a loose stone.
scree beetle.stat: AC 14, HP 11, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d6), MV near (climb), S +1, D +0, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Underfoot.** A character who puts weight on one makes DC 12 DEX or takes the bite with advantage and goes down on the slope.
**Armoured.** Takes half damage from piercing weapons.
**Ambush.** They always strike first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they clamp down and are stones again · 4–6 they bite.
**Harvest.** Carapace, 1d4 gp. One slot per three.

mountain vulture.name: Mountain Vulture
mountain vulture.desc: It has a nine-foot span and it is in no hurry at all.
mountain vulture.stat: AC 12, HP 10, ATK 1 beak +2 (1d6), MV double near (fly), S +1, D +2, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Carrion Only.** Attacks only characters at or below half HP, and ignores everyone else. With no such character present it has no legal target and does not attack, whatever the reaction roll says.
**Bone Dropper.** It carries bones aloft and drops them on the rocks to crack them. A character beneath one makes DC 12 DEX or takes 1d6 from above.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they circle for a day and do nothing · 5–6 they come down on the wounded.
**Harvest.** Flight feathers, 1d6 gp the set. One slot.

thunder beetle.name: Thunder Beetle
thunder beetle.desc: It strikes its shell to warn the others, and the mountain answers.
thunder beetle.stat: AC 14, HP 16, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6), MV near (burrow, climb), S +2, D +0, C +3, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Drum.** Its first act in any encounter is to drum. Every character within near makes DC 12 CON or is deafened for 1d4 rounds — no spoken casting, no hearing a warning.
**Rockfall.** The drumming brings down the slope. On a 1–2 on 1d6, every character makes DC 12 DEX or takes 2d6.
**Armoured.** Takes half damage from piercing weapons.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they drum and dig in · 3–6 they drum and then fight.
**Harvest.** Shell plate, 1d6 gp, and a drum worth 2d6 to the right buyer. One slot.

mountain lion.name: Mountain Lion
mountain lion.desc: Tawny, silent, and it has been following since the pass.
mountain lion.stat: AC 13, HP 22, ATK 2 claw +3 (1d8), MV double near (climb), S +3, D +4, C +2, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 4
traits: **From Above.** Its first attack each combat has advantage and comes before initiative.
**Takes The Rearmost.** It attacks whoever is last in the marching order, every time.
**Solitary.** Checks morale at disadvantage once below half HP.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it follows for a day and is never seen · 4–5 it takes the rearmost and withdraws · 6 it hunts.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 3d6 gp. Two slots. Claws, 1d6 gp.

lesser roc.name: Lesser Roc
lesser roc.desc: Its shadow is the size of a field and it has seen the mules.
lesser roc.stat: AC 14, HP 36, ATK 2 talon +6 (2d6) or 1 beak +6 (2d8), MV double near (fly), S +5, D +2, C +4, I -2, W +2, Ch -1, AL N, LV 7
traits: **Carries Off.** Instead of attacking, it seizes one character or animal of any size: DC 15 STR to break free. On its next turn it is at a height of far, and anything released falls for 4d6.
**Out Of Reach.** It fights from the air. Only ranged attacks and reach weapons can touch it except on the round it strikes.
**Nest.** On a 1–2 on 1d6 there is an eyrie within the hex: 1d3 eggs at 500 gp each, and nothing in the world will make the roc forget it.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it takes a pack animal and is gone · 3 it passes overhead and ignores the party · 4–6 it hunts.
**Harvest.** One pinion, 4d6 gp, two slots — a single feather is the length of a spear. Talon, 3d6 gp.

king monitor.name: King Monitor
king monitor.desc: The caravans call it a dragon. It is not, but it is big enough to settle the argument.
king monitor.stat: AC 15, HP 30, ATK 1 bite +5 (2d6 + rot), MV double near (swim), S +5, D +1, C +4, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Rot.** A character bitten makes DC 15 CON at the next dawn or loses 1d6 maximum HP until the wound is cleaned by a healer or a week's rest.
**Tail.** On a natural 20 the tail sweeps instead: every character within close makes DC 12 DEX or is knocked flat.
**Follows The Wounded.** A character it has bitten is tracked for days, and it attacks again when they sleep.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it is basking and will not move · 3–4 it bites once and waits · 5–6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Hide, 3d6 gp. Two slots. Meat, 3d6 rations.

giant rhagodessa.name: Giant Rhagodessa
giant rhagodessa.desc: A yard of legs and a mouth that is mostly suction.
giant rhagodessa.stat: AC 13, HP 21, ATK 2 bite +3 (1d6 + latch), MV double near (climb), S +3, D +3, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Latch.** On a hit, the suckered forelegs hold. The target is attacked with advantage thereafter and escape is DC 15 STR as an action.
**Runs Flat Out.** It moves double near and attacks in the same round and cannot be outrun on open sand.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it is already feeding · 2–6 it runs the party down.
**Harvest.** Nothing anyone will buy.

desert lion.name: Desert Lion
desert lion.desc: Maneless, pale, and it works the waterholes.
desert lion.stat: AC 13, HP 22, ATK 2 claw +3 (1d8), MV double near, S +4, D +2, C +3, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Owns The Water.** It is always found at the only water in the hex, which is the one place the party has to go.
**Hunt Together.** All lions attack the same target where they can, with advantage while two or more are within close of it.
**At Dusk.** Encountered at dusk or by night. By day it is in shade and this is no encounter.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it gives the water up and withdraws · 3–4 it holds the water and will not attack if the party backs off · 5–6 it hunts.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 2d6 gp, two slots. Claws and teeth, 1d6 gp.

monitor lizard.name: Monitor Lizard
monitor lizard.desc: Twelve feet of indifference with a bite that goes bad.
monitor lizard.stat: AC 14, HP 18, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d8 + rot), MV double near (climb, swim), S +3, D +1, C +3, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Rot.** A character bitten makes DC 12 CON at the next dawn or loses 1d4 maximum HP until the wound is cleaned by a healer or a week's rest.
**Tail.** On a natural 20 the tail sweeps instead: every character within close makes DC 12 DEX or is knocked flat.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it walks away at its own pace · 3–4 it stands its ground and hisses · 5–6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Hide, 2d6 gp, two slots — it makes good armour. Meat, 2d4 rations.

desert hyena.name: Desert Hyena
desert hyena.desc: It has been following the party since the second waterhole.
desert hyena.stat: AC 12, HP 15, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6), MV double near, S +2, D +1, C +3, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Bone Crusher.** On a natural 19 or 20 the bite does an extra 1d8.
**Patient.** It will not engage a party at full strength. It follows for 1d6 days and attacks on the first night a character is below half HP.
**Takes The Dead.** It would rather have a corpse or a carcass than a fight.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it follows and waits · 4 it takes the stores in the night · 5–6 it attacks the watch.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 1d6 gp. One slot per two.

sand mole.name: Sand Mole
sand mole.desc: Four feet of it, blind, and it comes up under the camp.
sand mole.stat: AC 12, HP 12, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d6), MV double near (burrow), S +2, D +0, C +2, I -4, W +2, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **From Below.** It burrows a full move and attacks in the same round, always against a character who is standing still.
**Blind.** Cannot be fooled by light or illusion, and attacks unerringly at close. Immune to any effect that needs sight.
**Takes The Stores.** On a 1–3 on 1d6 it takes a pack rather than a person and is gone with it.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it takes a pack and burrows away · 4–6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 1d6 gp — the fur is remarkable. One slot.

camel spider.name: Camel Spider
camel spider.desc: Not a spider, not venomous, and worse than both of those facts suggest.
camel spider.stat: AC 13, HP 11, ATK 2 bite +2 (1d4), MV double near (burrow), S +1, D +4, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Runs At Shade.** It moves toward shade, which means toward whoever is standing still. It acts before initiative every round.
**Shears.** Its bite ignores leather armour entirely, taking the armour bonus out of the target's AC for that attack.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it crosses the camp and keeps going · 3–6 it goes for the nearest shadow and bites what is casting it.
**Harvest.** None.

dust mite.name: Dust Mite
dust mite.desc: The dust devil has a texture, and the texture bites.
dust mite.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4), MV double near (fly), S -4, D +3, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **In The Eyes.** Each round, every character makes DC 9 CON or has disadvantage on all attacks that round.
**Scoured.** Any open waterskin loses half its contents to grit before it can be closed.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 the wind takes them on · 4–6 they stay with the party for the hour.
**Harvest.** None.

sand flea.name: Sand Flea
sand flea.desc: In the bedroll, in the boots, and in the bread.
sand flea.stat: AC 11, HP 4, ATK 1 bite +1 (1), MV near, S -4, D +2, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **No Rest.** A party that camps on an infested ground gains no benefit from the night unless the bedding is burned and replaced.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** Always infests. There is no fight to have.
**Harvest.** None.

scorpion swarm.name: Scorpion Swarm
scorpion swarm.desc: Hundreds, all small, and the stones are all the wrong shape to stand on.
scorpion swarm.stat: AC 12, HP 6, ATK 1 sting +1 (1 + venom), MV near (climb), S -3, D +2, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Poison.** A character stung loses 1d4 HP at the start of each of their turns until every scorpion within close is dead or they leave the ground entirely.
**Underfoot.** No character may take a move action through the swarm without being stung.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** Always stings whatever is on the ground.
**Harvest.** None, though a sealed jar of them is worth 1d6 gp to a poisoner. One slot.

jackal of the waste.name: Jackal Of The Waste
jackal of the waste.desc: Thinner than the ones in the grass, and bolder for it.
jackal of the waste.stat: AC 12, HP 9, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d6), MV double near, S +1, D +2, C +2, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Pack Courage.** Attacks with advantage until their number is halved, then checks morale at disadvantage.
**Follows Water.** They are always within a mile of water. Tracking them back finds it.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they lead the party to water without meaning to · 3–4 they scatter · 5–6 they take the straggler.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 1d4 gp. One slot per three.

horned viper.name: Horned Viper
horned viper.desc: It buries itself and leaves the horns up, which look like two small stones.
horned viper.stat: AC 13, HP 8, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4 + venom), MV near (burrow), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 2d6. Halflings roll this with advantage.
**Buried.** Cannot be seen without a DC 15 WIS check. Its first attack has advantage against anyone who failed.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it stays buried and is never found · 4–6 it strikes the leg that passes.
**Harvest.** Venom, 2d6 gp, or coats one weapon for its next hit. No slot.

wild camel.name: Wild Camel
wild camel.desc: Ill-tempered, long-suffering, and the difference between crossing and not.
wild camel.stat: AC 10, HP 13, ATK 1 hoof +3 (1d6) or 1 spit (near) +0 (1d4), MV double near, S +3, D +0, C +4, I -2, W +1, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Not A Fight.** Camels flee or spit. They kick only when roped badly.
**Catchable.** An hour and DC 12 WIS or CHA takes one, carrying ten slots and needing water only every fourth day. Each further camel is a new check at disadvantage.
**Finds The Water.** A party following the herd at dusk finds water with no check at all.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 the herd moves off · 4 it can be taken · 5 it spits in somebody's face · 6 the bull kicks.
**Harvest.** Alive, 80 gp in any desert settlement. Dead, hide for 2d6 gp, two slots, and 2d6 rations.

spitting cobra.name: Spitting Cobra
spitting cobra.desc: It does not need to reach you and it is not aiming at your body.
spitting cobra.stat: AC 13, HP 14, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6 + venom) or 1 spit (near) +3, MV near (climb, swim), S +0, D +4, C +2, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Spit.** On a hit with the spit, the target makes DC 12 CON or is blinded for 1d6 rounds. It deals no damage.
**Poison.** On a bite hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 2d6.
**Hood.** It displays for one round before striking, and a party that withdraws in that round is not pursued.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it hoods and gives ground · 4–5 it spits and withdraws · 6 it strikes.
**Harvest.** Venom, 2d6 gp, or coats one weapon for its next hit. No slot. Skin, 1d6 gp.

giant ant lion.name: Giant Ant Lion
giant ant lion.desc: The whole slope is the trap and you are already on it.
giant ant lion.stat: AC 15, HP 21, ATK 2 bite +4 (1d10 + drag), MV near (burrow), S +4, D +0, C +3, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 4
traits: **The Slope.** Every character on the sand slope makes DC 15 DEX at the start of the fight or slides to the bottom, within close of the jaws and attacked with advantage.
**Drag.** A character bitten is held. Escape is DC 15 STR and costs an action. A character held at the start of the ant lion's turn is pulled under and begins to suffocate.
**Armoured.** Takes half damage from piercing weapons.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** Always fights. It cannot leave the pit, and the pit is thirty feet across.
**Harvest.** Mandibles, 3d6 gp as a pair of shortswords that need no smith. Two slots.

gaping worm.name: Gaping Worm
gaping worm.desc: The sand funnels downward in a circle thirty feet across, and something in the middle is open.
gaping worm.stat: AC 14, HP 31, ATK 2 bite +5 (2d8 + swallow), MV double near (burrow), S +5, D -1, C +4, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Swallow.** A character reduced to 0 HP by the bite is swallowed. They take 1d6 each round inside and can be cut out from within — 15 damage to the gut wall — or recovered if the worm is killed within 1d6 rounds.
**Tremor Sense.** It cannot see. It strikes wherever the ground is struck hardest, which is wherever someone is running.
**Stand Still.** A character who takes no move action cannot be targeted by it at all.
**Reactions (d6).** Always attacks anything that moves across its ground. It cannot leave.
**Harvest.** Hide plates, 3d6 gp, three slots. Whatever is in the gut: roll one treasure.

desert behemoth.name: Desert Behemoth
desert behemoth.desc: A grey hill that was not there yesterday, with a trunk and a temper.
desert behemoth.stat: AC 14, HP 41, ATK 3 stomp +6 (2d10) or 1 tusk +6 (3d6), MV double near, S +6, D -1, C +5, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 8
traits: **Trample.** Any character knocked flat takes 2d10 at the start of the behemoth's next turn automatically.
**Unstoppable.** Never checks morale. Immune to fear and to any effect that would move it against its will.
**Would Rather Not.** It is not a predator. It attacks only what stands in its path or threatens a calf, and a party that simply gets out of the way is never attacked at all.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 the herd passes and the party had better not be in the way · 4 it blocks the only road and will not move · 5–6 it charges.
**Harvest.** Ivory, 4d6 gp per tusk and two slots each — the reason anyone hunts these and the reason nobody carries anything else home. Hide, 2d6 gp, three slots.

giant salamander.name: Giant Salamander
giant salamander.desc: Black and yellow, the length of a boat, and it has lived in this pool since the old kings.
giant salamander.stat: AC 14, HP 34, ATK 1 bite +5 (2d6), MV near (swim), S +4, D +0, C +4, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Poison.** A character who touches its skin, or hits it with a natural weapon, makes DC 12 CON or takes 1d6.
**Regrows.** It regains 1d6 HP at the start of each of its turns while in water.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it sinks and does not return · 3–4 it watches the boat from the bottom · 5–6 it takes the nearest wader.
**Harvest.** Skin, 2d6 gp. Two slots. Meat, 3d6 rations.

giant caecilia.name: Giant Caecilia
giant caecilia.desc: A blind worm the thickness of a barrel, and it comes up through the bottom of the pool.
giant caecilia.stat: AC 13, HP 31, ATK 2 bite +5 (2d8 + swallow), MV double near (burrow), S +5, D +0, C +4, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Swallow.** A character reduced to 0 HP is swallowed whole and takes 1d6 each round within. They can cut out from inside with 15 damage, or be recovered if it dies within 1d6 rounds.
**Blind.** Immune to anything requiring sight. It hunts by vibration and cannot be hidden from by any means but standing still.
**From Below.** It burrows and swims a full move and attacks in the same round, always from beneath.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it passes beneath and does not surface · 2–6 it takes the heaviest character.
**Harvest.** Hide, 2d6 gp, three slots. Whatever is in the gut: roll one treasure.

snapping turtle.name: Snapping Turtle
snapping turtle.desc: Six feet of shell and a beak that takes a hand off at the wrist.
snapping turtle.stat: AC 16, HP 22, ATK 1 bite +4 (2d6 + shear), MV near (swim), S +4, D -2, C +4, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Shell.** While it has withdrawn into the shell it cannot attack and takes half damage from everything, and it will do this whenever it drops below half HP.
**Shear.** On a natural 20 the target loses whatever was in the hand that was bitten — a weapon, a torch, a hand.
**Slow.** It cannot pursue. It can be walked away from by anyone not in the water.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it withdraws into the shell and waits them out · 4–6 it bites whatever comes within close.
**Harvest.** Shell, 3d6 gp and three slots, and it makes a shield that counts as a pavise. Meat, 2d6 rations.

draco lizard.name: Draco Lizard
draco lizard.desc: It does not fly so much as fall sideways with intent.
draco lizard.stat: AC 13, HP 16, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6), MV double near (climb), S +2, D +3, C +2, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Glides.** It launches from a tree and crosses a full double near downward, attacking with advantage at the end of the glide.
**Back Up The Tree.** After any round in which it takes damage it climbs out of melee reach, and glides again the round after.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they glide away over the water · 4–6 they drop onto the party one at a time.
**Harvest.** Hide, 1d6 gp — the membranes are prized. One slot.

water buffalo.name: Water Buffalo
water buffalo.desc: Standing chest-deep and entirely unbothered until it is bothered.
water buffalo.stat: AC 11, HP 17, ATK 1 gore +3 (1d8), MV double near (swim), S +4, D +0, C +3, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Not A Fight.** Buffalo do not hunt. They charge what comes between them and the calves, and they do not stop.
**Charge.** If it moves a full double near first, the gore does 2d6 and the target makes DC 12 STR or is knocked into the water.
**Herd Defence.** While two or more stand, each has advantage against anything within close of a calf.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 the herd moves deeper · 4–5 the bull puts itself between the party and the calves · 6 it charges.
**Harvest.** Hide, 2d6 gp, two slots. Meat, 2d6 rations. Horns, 1d6 gp.

giant toad.name: Giant Toad
giant toad.desc: It is the size of a dog and the tongue reaches further than that.
giant toad.stat: AC 12, HP 13, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d6) or 1 tongue (near) +2, MV near (swim), S +2, D +1, C +2, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Tongue.** On a hit with the tongue, the target makes DC 12 STR or is dragged within close and attacked with advantage next round.
**Swallows Whole.** A halfling or gnome reduced to 0 HP is swallowed and takes 1d4 a round until cut out.
**Still As A Stone.** Cannot be noticed without a DC 12 WIS check.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it sits and is never noticed · 4–6 it takes the nearest small target.
**Harvest.** Skin glands, 1d6 gp to a herbalist. No slot. Legs, 1d4 surprisingly good rations.

fen spider.name: Fen Spider
fen spider.desc: It runs on the water, which nothing that size should be able to do.
fen spider.stat: AC 13, HP 11, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d6 + venom), MV double near (swim, climb), S +1, D +4, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Walks On Water.** It moves across open water at full speed and attacks anything swimming with advantage.
**Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d4 and be unable to swim for 1d4 rounds.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it skates away · 4–6 it takes whoever is deepest in the water.
**Harvest.** Silk, 1d6 gp, and 50 feet of rope that does not rot. One slot.

marsh hound.name: Marsh Hound
marsh hound.desc: Lean, wet, and it knows which ground holds a man.
marsh hound.stat: AC 12, HP 11, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d6), MV double near (swim), S +2, D +2, C +2, I -2, W +2, Ch -1, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Pack.** Attacks with advantage while the hounds outnumber the party.
**Knows The Ground.** The hounds cross the bog at full speed. The party does not. They always choose where the fight happens.
**Drives Into The Mire.** A character who takes damage from a hound makes DC 12 STR or is driven a step into the soft ground and must spend their next action getting out.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they bay and shadow the party · 3 they go · 4–6 they drive the party into the water and fight there.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 1d4 gp. One slot per three.

giant leech.name: Giant Leech
giant leech.desc: One of them on you is the same as all of them.
giant leech.stat: AC 9, HP 10, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4 + attach), MV near (swim), S +1, D -1, C +1, I -3, W -1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Attach.** On a hit it attaches; its bite hits automatically next round. DC 12 STR on the target's turn to tear it off.
**Unnoticed.** A character wading does not feel the first one. They are discovered at the end of the wade, already attached.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** Always attaches to whatever enters the water.
**Harvest.** None, though a healer will buy a live jar for 1d6 gp. One slot.

bog fly.name: Bog Fly
bog fly.desc: They lay eggs in anything warm and they are not fussy about which part.
bog fly.stat: AC 11, HP 4, ATK 1 bite +1 (1), MV double near (fly), S -4, D +2, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Flyblown.** An open wound left untreated for a day becomes infected: DC 12 CON or lose 1d4 maximum HP until cleaned.
**Spoiled Stores.** Any uncovered rations are ruined. The party loses 1d6 rations.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they move on with the wind · 3–6 they stay on the party all day.
**Harvest.** None.

mosquito cloud.name: Mosquito Cloud
mosquito cloud.desc: The sound arrives first and it does not stop for three days.
mosquito cloud.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4), MV double near (fly), S -4, D +3, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **No Rest.** A party camping in the open gains no benefit from the night unless it makes smoke or sleeps under netting.
**Fever.** Each character who slept in it makes DC 9 CON at dawn or loses 1d4 maximum HP until a week's rest or a healer.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** Always present. Smoke moves it; nothing else does.
**Harvest.** None.

stirge.name: Stirge
stirge.desc: A pint of blood at a time, and it does not come back for a second.
stirge.stat: AC 13, HP 8, ATK 1 proboscis +2 (1d4 + drain), MV double near (fly), S -1, D +3, C +1, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Drain.** On a hit it attaches. It drains 1d4 automatically at the start of each of its turns, and detaches and flies off once it has taken 8 HP in total.
**Attached.** A stirge on a character can be struck, but on a miss by 5 or more the attacker hits the host instead.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 the flock passes over · 3–6 they come down, one per character.
**Harvest.** None.

water adder.name: Water Adder
water adder.desc: It swims with its head out, which is the only warning.
water adder.stat: AC 12, HP 10, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4 + venom), MV near (swim), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6. Halflings roll this with advantage.
**In The Water.** Attacks only characters who are wading or swimming, with advantage against anyone carrying more than half their slots.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they swim away · 4–6 they strike whatever is in the water.
**Harvest.** Venom, 1d6 gp. Skin, 1d4 gp. No slot.

marsh ga flare.name: Marsh Gas Flare
marsh ga flare.desc: A blue light over the water, and the air around it will burn.
marsh ga flare.stat: AC 12, HP 10, ATK 1 flare +2 (1d6), MV near (fly), S -4, D +2, C +0, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Not Alive.** It is gas and marsh light, not a creature. Immune to all mind-affecting effects, to poison, and to morale. It cannot be reasoned with or frightened.
**Ignition.** Any open flame within near of it causes it to detonate: every character within close makes DC 12 DEX or takes 2d6.
**Leads Astray.** A party that follows the lights loses half a day and arrives nowhere.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 it drifts ahead of the party, inviting them to follow · 5–6 it drifts into the party's torches.
**Harvest.** None.

giant frog.name: Giant Frog
giant frog.desc: Man-sized, warty, and the tongue arrives before the rest of it.
giant frog.stat: AC 12, HP 10, ATK 1 tongue and 1 bite +2 (1d6), MV near (swim), S +2, D +2, C +1, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Tongue.** One creature within near makes a DC 12 DEX check or is pulled to close range.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it is gone into the water · 4–6 it leaps on the nearest character.
**Harvest.** Legs, 1d6 gp or 1d6 rations.

green sludge.name: Green Sludge
green sludge.desc: A mat of it across the pool, and it is the same colour as the pool.
green sludge.stat: AC 12, HP 15, ATK 1 engulf +3 (1d6 + corrode), MV close (swim), S +2, D -2, C +3, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Corrode.** On a hit, a piece of the target's leather or cloth is ruined, or a wooden shaft is eaten through. Metal is unharmed.
**Not Alive.** Immune to morale, fear, poison, and all mind-affecting effects.
**Clings.** A character hit is engulfed and takes the damage automatically each round until they or an ally spend an action scraping it off.
**Reactions (d6).** Always engulfs whatever enters the water. It does not pursue onto land.
**Harvest.** A sealed flask, 2d6 gp to an alchemist. One slot, and DC 12 DEX to fill it without a loss.

swamp crocodile.name: Swamp Crocodile
swamp crocodile.desc: The jaws lock and the rest of the fight happens around it.
swamp crocodile.stat: AC 15, HP 22, ATK 2 bite +4 (1d8 + lock), MV double near (swim), S +4, D +0, C +3, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 4
traits: **From The Water.** 4-in-6 chance of surprise wherever there is water to hide in.
**Jaw Lock.** A character bitten is held, takes the bite damage automatically each round, and cannot act except to escape: DC 15 STR.
**Death Roll.** A held character at the start of the crocodile's turn is pulled under and begins to drown.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it submerges and waits for a better moment · 3–6 it takes whoever is nearest the water.
**Harvest.** Hide, 2d6 gp, two slots — the best armour leather in the fen. Teeth, 1d6 gp.

hangman tree.name: Hangman Tree
hangman tree.desc: There is one dead tree in a mile of living ones, and the dead one moves.
hangman tree.stat: AC 14, HP 27, ATK 2 vine +4 (1d8 + strangle), MV none, S +4, D +0, C +3, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Strangle.** On a hit, DC 15 STR or be hauled up and held. A held character takes 1d8 automatically each round, cannot speak or cast, and escaping is DC 15 STR.
**Rooted.** It cannot move or pursue, and anyone who identifies it can simply go around.
**Looks Dead.** Cannot be told from a dead tree without a DC 15 WIS check.
**Fire.** Takes double damage from fire.
**Reactions (d6).** Always attacks anything that passes within close. It has waited a long time.
**Harvest.** Nothing from the tree, but the roots hold what is left of the last several travellers: roll one treasure.

fen constrictor.name: Fen Constrictor
fen constrictor.desc: Twenty-five feet of it and the water is the colour of its back.
fen constrictor.stat: AC 12, HP 33, ATK 2 bite +6 (1d10 + swallow), MV near (climb, swim), S +4, D +2, C +2, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 7
traits: **Swallow.** On a hit, DC 12 STR or be swallowed: total darkness and 1d8 a round inside. It regurgitates everything it holds if dealt 15 or more damage in one round.
**Coil.** On a hit, DC 15 STR or be grappled, taking 1d8 automatically each round and unable to act but to escape, DC 15 STR.
**One At A Time.** It holds only one character, and ignores the others while it does.
**Drowns.** A grappled character is pulled under on the snake's second turn and begins to drown.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it has fed and ignores everything · 2–3 it submerges and goes · 4–6 it takes whoever is in the water.
**Harvest.** Skin, 3d6 gp, two slots. Fat, 1d6 gp, renders to eight flasks of oil.

the fen serpent.name: The Fen Serpent
the fen serpent.desc: The locals have a name for it and they will not say it after dark.
the fen serpent.stat: AC 15, HP 36, ATK 3 bite +6 (2d8 + venom), MV double near (swim), S +5, D +2, C +4, I -2, W +2, Ch -3, AL N, LV 7
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 15 CON or take an extra 3d6 and lose 1d4 maximum HP until a week's rest.
**Many Heads.** Its three bites may be divided among any targets within close. Each time it takes 12 or more damage in one round it loses one bite for the rest of the fight.
**Owns The Water.** Within its own fen it never checks morale and regains 1d6 HP at the start of each of its turns while any part of it is submerged.
**Driven Off.** It will withdraw if its HP drops below 10, and it will come back the following night.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it is sleeping off a meal · 2 it surfaces, is seen, and submerges · 3–6 it hunts.
**Harvest.** Skin, 4d6 gp and three slots. Venom from a head, 3d6 gp — DC 15 DEX to draw, 3d6 damage on a failure.

giant pike.name: Giant Pike
giant pike.desc: It took the ducks first. This year it has started on the dogs.
giant pike.stat: AC 13, HP 28, ATK 1 bite +5 (2d6), MV double near (swim), S +4, D +3, C +2, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Strike From The Reeds.** Its first attack is made with advantage and before initiative.
**Pulls Under.** A character it hits while in the water makes DC 12 STR or is dragged under and cannot breathe until they break free.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it ignores the party · 3–4 it takes the bait and the line · 5–6 it attacks whoever is in the water.
**Harvest.** Meat, 3d6 rations. Jaw, 1d6 gp.

hippopotamu.name: Hippopotamus
hippopotamu.desc: It is a herbivore, which is the single most misleading fact about it.
hippopotamu.stat: AC 12, HP 24, ATK 2 bite +4 (1d10), MV near (swim), S +4, D +0, C +2, I -3, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Stumpy.** Advantage on STR checks to grab or drag other creatures.
**Capsizes.** Its first action against a boat is to come up underneath it. Every character aboard makes DC 15 DEX or goes into the water with half their slots.
**Will Not Be Reasoned With.** Never checks morale. It is not hunting and it will not stop.
**Owns The River.** It attacks anything that enters its stretch of water, and pursues to the bank but no further.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it yawns, which is a warning, and the party may still leave · 2–3 it drives the party off the water · 4–6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Hide, 2d6 gp and three slots. Teeth, 2d6 gp. Meat, 3d6 rations.

giant catfish.name: Giant Catfish
giant catfish.desc: Twelve feet along the bottom, and its mouth is the width of a man.
giant catfish.stat: AC 14, HP 23, ATK 2 bite +3 (1d8 + swallow), MV double near (swim), S +4, D +0, C +3, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Swallow.** A character reduced to 0 HP is swallowed and takes 1d4 a round. They can be cut out from inside with 12 damage, or recovered if the fish is killed within 1d6 rounds.
**From The Bottom.** 4-in-6 chance of surprise in any water deeper than a man.
**Takes The Boat.** On a 1–2 on 1d6 it strikes the boat instead: DC 15 STR at the tiller or the boat swamps.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it stays on the bottom · 3–4 it strikes the boat and goes · 5–6 it takes a swimmer.
**Harvest.** Oil, 2d6 gp, one slot. Meat, 2d6 rations. Whatever is in the gut: roll one treasure.

piranha shoal.name: Piranha Shoal
piranha shoal.desc: One is nothing. The river is not holding one.
piranha shoal.stat: AC 12, HP 17, ATK 3 bite +3 (1d6), MV double near (swim), S -2, D +3, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **One Body.** The shoal is a single creature. Its attacks must fall on different targets in the water.
**Blood In The Water.** Against any character already below half HP it attacks with advantage and deals an extra 1d6.
**Cannot Leave The Water.** On dry land it is no threat whatever.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 the shoal is downstream and misses the party · 3–6 it finds them mid-crossing.
**Harvest.** Meat, 1d6 rations. Jaws, 1d4 gp as a saw.

giant bass.name: Giant Bass
giant bass.desc: It takes a duck off the surface without breaking stride.
giant bass.stat: AC 13, HP 16, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d8), MV double near (swim), S +3, D +2, C +2, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Takes The Surface.** It strikes anything on the water — a swimmer's hand, a trailing rope, a halfling in a coracle — with advantage.
**Fights The Line.** A character who hooks one is pulled: DC 12 STR each round or be dragged into the water.
**Worth Catching.** It is the best eating in the river and every village knows it.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it is gone with a swirl · 4–5 it takes what is trailing in the water · 6 it attacks a swimmer.
**Harvest.** Meat, 2d6 rations. A settlement pays 1d6 gp for one brought in whole.

giant otter.name: Giant Otter
giant otter.desc: Playful, six feet long, and extremely territorial about fish.
giant otter.stat: AC 13, HP 11, ATK 2 bite +2 (1d6), MV double near (swim), S +2, D +3, C +2, I -1, W +2, Ch +0, AL N, LV 2
traits: **In The Water.** It attacks with advantage against anything swimming and withdraws underwater after every attack, surfacing elsewhere.
**Takes The Catch.** If the party is carrying fish or has been fishing, the otters steal it and leave. 1d6 rations gone.
**Curious.** On a 1–2 on 1d6 they follow the party along the bank for a day, which makes fishing impossible and ambush unlikely.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they follow and watch · 3–4 they take the catch and go · 5–6 they defend a stretch of bank.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 2d6 gp — one of the finest furs there is. One slot.

reed viper.name: Reed Viper
reed viper.desc: It is the same colour and width as the reeds, and the reeds are where you put your hands.
reed viper.stat: AC 13, HP 8, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4 + venom), MV near (climb, swim), S +0, D +4, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6. Halflings roll this with advantage.
**In The Reeds.** Attacks with advantage against any character pushing through reeds or hauling a boat.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 it is gone into the water · 5–6 it strikes.
**Harvest.** Venom, 1d6 gp. No slot.

giant water beetle.name: Giant Water Beetle
giant water beetle.desc: It comes up from the bottom like a thrown shield.
giant water beetle.stat: AC 14, HP 12, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d6 + grip), MV double near (swim), S +2, D +1, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Grip.** On a hit it holds the target under. They cannot act but to escape, DC 12 STR, and begin to drown on the second round.
**Armoured.** Takes half damage from piercing weapons.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it goes to the bottom · 3–6 it takes whoever is swimming.
**Harvest.** Carapace, 1d6 gp. One slot.

water strider.name: Water Strider
water strider.desc: A yard across the legs, and it stands on the river as if the river were a floor.
water strider.stat: AC 12, HP 6, ATK 1 stab +1 (1d4), MV double near (swim), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Walks On Water.** It crosses open water at full speed and attacks anything swimming with advantage.
**Light.** It can be killed by almost anything, but it must be hit first, and it is never where it was.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they skate away upriver · 5–6 they go for whatever is in the water.
**Harvest.** None.

river rat.name: River Rat
river rat.desc: The bank is undermined for fifty yards and every yard of it is occupied.
river rat.stat: AC 11, HP 1, ATK 1 bite +1 (1 + infection), MV double near (swim), S -1, D +2, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Infection.** A wounded character has a 1-in-6 chance of losing a further 1d4 HP.
**Undermined Bank.** The first character to walk the bank at speed makes DC 9 DEX or goes into the water with their pack.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they go into the water · 4–6 they swarm the bank.
**Harvest.** None.

caddi swarm.name: Caddis Swarm
caddi swarm.desc: They hatch all at once, in millions, and they go into the lungs.
