caddi swarm.stat: AC 11, HP 4, ATK 1 swarm +1 (1), MV double near (fly), S -4, D +2, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Chokes.** Each round in the swarm, every character makes DC 9 CON or loses their action coughing.
**Blinds The Water.** No ranged attack can be made across the river while the hatch is up.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 the hatch passes within the hour · 4–6 it lasts the day.
**Harvest.** None, though the fish are mad for them: advantage on any fishing attempt during a hatch.

water termite.name: Water Termite
water termite.desc: They are in the hull, or in the raft, or in the bridge you were about to use.
water termite.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 bite +1 (1), MV near (swim), S -3, D +0, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Eats Wood.** Any boat, raft or wooden bridge in the hex has been hollowed out. A DC 12 WIS check spots it; otherwise it fails under the second person to cross.
**No Interest In Meat.** They attack only a character who is in the water and holding wood.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–5 they ignore the party entirely and eat the boat · 6 they swarm whatever is holding an oar.
**Harvest.** None.

lamprey knot.name: Lamprey Knot
lamprey knot.desc: A dozen of them in a ball, and the ball comes apart when it reaches you.
lamprey knot.stat: AC 12, HP 9, ATK 1 attach +2 (1d4 + drain), MV double near (swim), S +0, D +2, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Drain.** A character with lampreys attached loses 1d4 HP at the start of each lamprey turn — once, not once per lamprey — until all are destroyed.
**Hard To Remove.** Pulling one off is an action and deals 1d4 to the host.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** Always attaches to whatever enters the water.
**Harvest.** Smoked, 1d4 gp and 1d6 rations, and they are considered a delicacy by people who have no alternative.

swan flock.name: Swan Flock
swan flock.desc: Everyone knows what a swan is. Nobody remembers until it is too late.
swan flock.stat: AC 12, HP 10, ATK 1 buffet +2 (1d6), MV double near (fly, swim), S +2, D +2, C +2, I -2, W +1, Ch -1, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Breaks Bones.** On a natural 20, the target makes DC 12 CON or has disadvantage on all attacks until they rest — something in the arm is cracked.
**Only For The Nest.** They attack only a party that comes within near of the nest, and they are always nesting.
**Will Not Be Driven.** They never check morale while an egg remains.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they hiss and pace the party along the bank · 4 they block the only landing · 5–6 they attack.
**Harvest.** Down, 1d6 gp. Eggs, 1d4 found, one ration each.

giant beaver.name: Giant Beaver
giant beaver.desc: It has dammed the river, which is either a bridge or a flood waiting to happen.
giant beaver.stat: AC 13, HP 15, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d8 + fell), MV double near (swim), S +3, D +0, C +3, I -1, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Fell.** Its bite takes through a spear shaft, a bow, or a mast. On a natural 20 a wooden item the target carries is cut in two.
**The Dam.** There is a dam. It can be crossed as a bridge, or broken for a flood that carries everything in the hex downstream — every character makes DC 15 STR or is swept a mile.
**Defends The Lodge.** Never checks morale within near of the dam.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they slap the water and dive · 4–5 they drive the party off the dam · 6 they attack.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 2d6 gp, one slot. Castor glands, 2d6 gp to any apothecary.

electric eel.name: Electric Eel
electric eel.desc: The water goes white and everyone in it falls down.
electric eel.stat: AC 12, HP 14, ATK 1 shock +3 (2d6), MV double near (swim), S +0, D +2, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Discharge.** Instead of attacking one target, it may shock every creature in the water within close: 2d6, DC 12 CON for half, and on a failure the target cannot act next round.
**Three Times.** It can discharge three times, then it must rest an hour and is only a thing that bites for 1d4.
**Metal.** A character in metal armour rolls the save at disadvantage.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it moves off · 3–6 it discharges into the ford.
**Harvest.** Organ, 2d6 gp to an alchemist and it holds one more discharge as a thrown weapon. One slot.

river crocodile.name: River Crocodile
river crocodile.desc: Smaller than the fen kind, in larger numbers, at the one ford.
river crocodile.stat: AC 15, HP 20, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d8 + lock), MV double near (swim), S +3, D +0, C +3, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 4
traits: **From The Water.** 4-in-6 chance of surprise at any crossing.
**Jaw Lock.** A character bitten is held, takes the damage automatically each round, and escapes on DC 15 STR.
**At The Ford.** They are always at the crossing. Going around costs the party half a day; going through costs what it costs.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they submerge and let the party cross · 3–6 they take whoever enters the water first.
**Harvest.** Hide, 2d6 gp, two slots. Teeth, 1d4 gp.

giant gar.name: Giant Gar
giant gar.desc: An armoured log with a beak full of needles.
giant gar.stat: AC 15, HP 26, ATK 2 bite +4 (1d10), MV double near (swim), S +4, D +1, C +3, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 5
traits: **Armoured Scales.** Takes half damage from piercing and slashing weapons. Crushing weapons do full.
**Breaks The Line.** It attacks the character who is fishing, swimming, or holding a rope into the water, before any other.
**Holds Its Ground.** Never checks morale in its own pool.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it ignores the party · 2–3 it circles the boat · 4–6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Scales, 2d6 gp, and they make a suit of scale armour. Two slots. Meat, 2d6 rations.

giant sturgeon.name: Giant Sturgeon
giant sturgeon.desc: Twenty feet of fish older than the kingdom it swims through.
giant sturgeon.stat: AC 14, HP 31, ATK 2 ram +5 (2d8), MV double near (swim), S +5, D +0, C +4, I -3, W +2, Ch -3, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Rams.** It does not bite — it has no teeth worth the name. It rams, and a character hit makes DC 15 STR or is knocked from the boat or the bank into the water.
**Bony Plates.** Takes half damage from arrows and bolts.
**Not A Predator.** It attacks only what is in its way or what has hooked it, and a party that cuts the line is never troubled again.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it passes under the boat and is a wonder, not an encounter · 4 it rams once and goes · 5–6 it will not be shaken off.
**Harvest.** Roe, 5d6 gp, one slot, the single most valuable thing anyone takes out of a river. Meat, 3d6 rations.

the river bull.name: The River Bull
the river bull.desc: The old hippo bull, white with scars, with a mile of river and no rivals left in it.
the river bull.stat: AC 14, HP 37, ATK 2 bite +6 (3d6), MV double near (swim), S +6, D -1, C +5, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 7
traits: **Capsizes.** Its first action against a boat is to come up beneath it. Everyone aboard makes DC 15 DEX or is in the water with half their slots gone.
**No Morale.** Never checks morale, cannot be frightened, and will not break off while anything is still in its water.
**Pursues To The Bank.** It follows onto land for a full near, which is further than anyone expects.
**Scarred.** Takes half damage from the first attack made against it each round — the hide is an inch thick and layered with old wounds.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it allows one boat through · 2 it yawns and the party may yet leave · 3–6 it attacks, and goes on attacking.
**Harvest.** Hide, 3d6 gp and four slots. Teeth, 3d6 gp, one slot. Meat, 3d6 rations. The village downstream will pay 200 gp for proof it is dead.

great white shark.name: Great White Shark
great white shark.desc: Twenty feet, and it does not circle first.
great white shark.stat: AC 14, HP 40, ATK 1 bite +6 (2d8), MV double near (swim), S +5, D +2, C +4, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 8
traits: **Blood In The Water.** Against a character below half HP it attacks with advantage.
**Rams Boats.** It can strike a small boat instead of attacking: everyone aboard makes DC 12 DEX or goes into the water.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it passes under the hull · 3–4 it follows the ship for a day · 5–6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Jaws, 4d6 gp. Two slots. Meat, 4d6 rations.

killer whale.name: Killer Whale
killer whale.desc: Thirty feet, in a pod, and it is cleverer than anyone aboard.
killer whale.stat: AC 12, HP 39, ATK 2 bite +5 (1d10), MV double near (swim), S +4, D +0, C +3, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 8
traits: **Hunts In A Pod.** Each whale attacks the same target where it can, and has advantage while two or more are within close of it.
**Washes Them Off.** Instead of attacking, a whale may drive a wave over a boat or a floe: every character makes DC 15 DEX or is in the water.
**Decides.** On a 1–2 on 1d6 at the start of any round, the pod simply loses interest and leaves, whatever the fight looked like.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 the pod inspects the boat and goes · 4 it takes a seal instead and the party watches · 5–6 it hunts the party.
**Harvest.** Blubber, 3d6 gp and twenty flasks of oil, four slots. Teeth, 2d6 gp, one slot.

giant squid.name: Giant Squid
giant squid.desc: The arms come over both rails at once and the lamps go out.
giant squid.stat: AC 13, HP 30, ATK 2 tentacle +5 (2d6 + grapple) or 1 beak +5 (2d8), MV double near (swim), S +5, D +3, C +3, I -2, W +2, Ch -3, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Grapple.** On a tentacle hit, DC 15 STR or be held and pulled over the side on its next turn. A held character cannot act but to escape.
**Takes The Mast.** Instead of attacking it may seize the rigging: the boat heels and everyone aboard makes DC 15 DEX or falls into the water.
**From Below.** It is never seen before it strikes. Automatic surprise in deep water at night.
**Dies Hard.** A severed tentacle goes on gripping. A held character must still escape after the squid is dead.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it passes beneath · 2–6 it comes aboard.
**Harvest.** Meat, 3d6 rations. Ink, 3d6 gp. Beak, 2d6 gp, and proof of the thing.

barracuda.name: Barracuda
barracuda.desc: It goes for anything bright, which includes rings, buckles and blades.
barracuda.stat: AC 13, HP 15, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d10), MV double near (swim), S +2, D +4, C +1, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Goes For The Shine.** It attacks the character carrying the most metal, with advantage. A character who drops or sheathes everything bright is ignored entirely.
**One Strike.** It strikes once at speed, then withdraws to a distance and considers. It attacks every other round.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it holds its distance and watches · 4–6 it strikes.
**Harvest.** Meat, 2d4 rations, though the flesh is risky: DC 12 CON or lose 1d4 HP.

moray eel.name: Moray Eel
moray eel.desc: There is a hole in the reef, and the hole has teeth in the back of it.
moray eel.stat: AC 13, HP 17, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d8 + hold), MV double near (swim), S +3, D +2, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Hold.** Its teeth angle backward. A character bitten cannot pull free: escape is DC 15 STR, and failing it deals a further 1d4.
**In The Hole.** It fights from cover. Attacks against it are at disadvantage while it remains in the reef, and it will not leave.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it withdraws into the rock · 4–6 it takes the hand that came near it.
**Harvest.** Meat, 2d4 rations. Skin, 1d6 gp.

barbed star.name: Barbed Star
barbed star.desc: They come up the hull, or the anchor rope, or the leg.
barbed star.stat: AC 13, HP 11, ATK 1 rasp +2 (1d6 + grip), MV close (swim), S +1, D -1, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Grip.** On a hit it attaches. It deals its damage automatically each round and must be prised off: an action and DC 12 STR.
**Climbs Anything.** It comes aboard. A boat left unattended for a night has 1d4 of them in it.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** Always attaches to whatever it touches.
**Harvest.** Dried, 1d6 gp to an alchemist. One slot per three.

seal.name: Seal
seal.desc: Playful, enormously fast underwater, and shaped like bait.
seal.stat: AC 12, HP 6, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4), MV double near (swim), S +1, D +2, C +3, I -2, W +2, Ch +0, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Not A Fight.** Seals do not attack unless cornered on a rock or defending a pup.

**What Hunts Them.** Seals mean something that eats seals. On a 1–3 on 1d6, roll on this table again until one of the great hunters comes up — Giant Squid, Plesiosaur, Killer Whale, Megalodon or Sperm Whale.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 the colony pours into the water · 5 they are curious and follow the boat · 6 a bull holds the rock.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 1d6 gp. One slot. Blubber, 1d4 gp and six flasks of oil. Meat, 2d4 rations.

carnivorou fish.name: Carnivorous Fish
carnivorou fish.desc: Small, in thousands, and the water goes pink very quickly.
carnivorou fish.stat: AC 12, HP 6, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4), MV double near (swim), S -2, D +3, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Blood In The Water.** Against a character already below half HP they attack with advantage.
**Cannot Leave.** Harmless to anyone out of the water.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 the shoal moves off · 3–6 it finds whoever is swimming.
**Harvest.** Meat, 1d6 rations.

sea louse.name: Sea Louse
sea louse.desc: They strip a drowned man to bone in a day, and they do not insist he be drowned.
sea louse.stat: AC 11, HP 4, ATK 1 bite +1 (1), MV near (swim), S -4, D +1, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Strips.** A character in the water loses 1d4 HP at the start of each louse turn — once, not once per louse — until they leave the water entirely.
**Takes The Dead First.** If there is a corpse or a carcass in the water they go to it and ignore the living.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** Always swarms. Throw them something dead and they are no longer a problem.
**Harvest.** None.

jellyfish bloom.name: Jellyfish Bloom
jellyfish bloom.desc: A mile of them, and the water looks perfectly clear.
jellyfish bloom.stat: AC 12, HP 5, ATK 1 sting +1 (1d4 + sting), MV near (swim), S -3, D +0, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 9 CON or take an extra 1d4 and be unable to swim for 1d4 rounds — which in deep water is the entire problem.
**Unseen.** They cannot be noticed in the water without a DC 12 WIS check made before entering.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** Always stings whatever enters the bloom. It cannot do anything else.
**Harvest.** None.

gull flock.name: Gull Flock
gull flock.desc: Hundreds, and they have learned exactly what a sack of rations looks like.
gull flock.stat: AC 12, HP 5, ATK 1 beak +1 (1d4), MV double near (fly, swim), S -1, D +3, C +1, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Thieves.** Each round, on a 1–3 on 1d6, one gull takes an item of food or something small and shiny and is gone with it.
**Noise.** While the flock is overhead the party cannot surprise anything and is visible for miles.
**Marks The Fish.** A diving flock means a shoal, which means something larger beneath it. On a 1–2 on 1d6, roll on this table again.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they wheel off · 3–5 they steal · 6 they mob anyone holding food.
**Harvest.** Eggs from a cliff colony, 1d6 rations and a DC 12 DEX climb.

urchin bed.name: Urchin Bed
urchin bed.desc: The shallows are paved with them and the only way ashore is across.
urchin bed.stat: AC 14, HP 5, ATK 1 spine +1 (1d4 + venom), MV none, S -3, D -2, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Underfoot.** Any character who wades the bed takes one attack automatically. There is no avoiding it, only going around, which takes an hour.
**Poison.** On a hit, DC 9 CON or the foot swells: movement halved and disadvantage on DEX checks for a day.
**Cannot Act.** They do not move, pursue, or make choices. They are terrain with a damage value.
**Reactions (d6).** No reaction. They are where they are.
**Harvest.** Roe, 1d4 gp or 1d4 rations. The spines are worth 1d4 gp to a poisoner.

sea snake.name: Sea Snake
sea snake.desc: Banded, curious, and the bite does not hurt until it is far too late.
sea snake.stat: AC 13, HP 9, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4 + venom), MV double near (swim), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take 2d6 at the end of the next round, as the paralysis reaches the chest. A character who fails cannot swim at all until it passes.
**Painless.** The target does not know they have been bitten until the save is rolled.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they investigate and move on · 5–6 they bite what is in the water.
**Harvest.** Venom, 2d6 gp. Skin, 1d6 gp. No slot.

dolphin.name: Dolphin
dolphin.desc: They are not on anybody's side, but they are not on the shark's side either.
dolphin.stat: AC 13, HP 13, ATK 1 ram +2 (1d6), MV double near (swim), S +2, D +3, C +2, I +1, W +2, Ch +1, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Not A Fight.** Dolphins almost never attack. This result is usually good news.
**Drives Off Sharks.** If a pod is present, any shark, barracuda or megalodon in the hex checks morale immediately and at disadvantage.
**Pulls Them Out.** A drowning character within near of a pod is pushed to the surface and to the nearest boat or shore. No check.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they escort the boat for a day · 5 they drive off whatever else was coming · 6 a bull rams a boat that has harmed one.
**Harvest.** Possible and extremely ill-advised. Any crew that sees it done is at disadvantage on morale for the voyage.

reef shark.name: Reef Shark
reef shark.desc: Eight feet, and there is never only one.
reef shark.stat: AC 13, HP 16, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d8), MV double near (swim), S +3, D +2, C +2, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Blood In The Water.** Against a character below half HP it attacks with advantage and deals an extra 1d6.
**Circles First.** It spends one round circling. A party that leaves the water in that round is not attacked at all.
**Pack.** Attacks with advantage while the sharks outnumber the swimmers.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they pass through · 3–4 they circle and do not commit · 5–6 they take whoever is bleeding.
**Harvest.** Jaws, 1d6 gp. Liver oil, 1d6 gp. One slot. Meat, 2d4 rations.

manowar.name: Man-O'-War
manowar.desc: Not one animal. A colony pretending to be one, thirty feet of it trailing behind.
manowar.stat: AC 12, HP 15, ATK 2 tendril (near) +3 (1d6 + sting), MV near (swim), S +0, D +0, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Reach.** Its tendrils strike at near, which from a small boat means it never has to be close.
**Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 2d6 and be unable to act next round.
**Not One Creature.** Immune to all mind-affecting effects and to morale. Damage to the float does not harm the tendrils and the reverse.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 the current takes it past · 4–6 it drifts into the party and keeps stinging.
**Harvest.** Nothing, and handling the tendrils after death still stings.

plesiosaur.name: Plesiosaur
plesiosaur.desc: A neck like a mast with a head on the end of it, and it has been here longer than ships.
plesiosaur.stat: AC 13, HP 31, ATK 2 bite +5 (2d8), MV double near (swim), S +4, D +3, C +3, I -3, W +2, Ch -3, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Reach.** The neck lets it strike anything on deck from outside the reach of any weapon but a spear or a bow.
**Takes One And Dives.** A character reduced to 0 HP is taken under and is gone. Recovery means killing it inside 1d6 rounds.
**Surfaces Elsewhere.** It submerges after every second round and reappears on the other side of the boat, which resets who is in reach.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it surfaces, looks, and dives · 3 it follows the boat for a day · 4–6 it hunts.
**Harvest.** Hide, 3d6 gp, three slots. Meat, 3d6 rations. The skull is worth 3d6 gp to a collector and takes four slots.

megalodon.name: Megalodon
megalodon.desc: Fifty feet of shark. There is nothing else to say about it.
megalodon.stat: AC 14, HP 41, ATK 3 bite +7 (2d8), MV double near (swim), S +6, D +2, C +5, I -3, W +2, Ch -3, AL N, LV 8
traits: **Breaks The Hull.** Its first action against a boat is a strike to the keel: the boat takes on water and sinks in 1d6 rounds unless 15 damage worth of repair is done.
**Blood In The Water.** Against a character below half HP it attacks with advantage and deals an extra 2d6.
**No Morale.** Never checks morale. It has never encountered a reason to.
**Swallows.** A character reduced to 0 HP is swallowed whole and is not recoverable.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it passes under the boat, which is a thing the crew will talk about for years · 2–6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Jaws, 5d6 gp and four slots — the single most impressive thing anyone can nail above a door. Liver oil, 3d6 gp.

sperm whale.name: Sperm Whale
sperm whale.desc: Sixty feet, and it is not hunting you. It simply does not consider you.
sperm whale.stat: AC 14, HP 41, ATK 3 ram +6 (2d10) or 1 bite +6 (3d10), MV double near (swim), S +6, D +0, C +5, I +1, W +3, Ch +0, AL N, LV 8
traits: **Stoves The Boat.** It rams. A boat struck is destroyed outright and every character aboard is in the water with half their slots.
**Will Not Begin It.** It attacks only a boat that has struck it first, or one that has come between it and a calf. A party that does neither has no encounter here at all, only a very large animal.
**Dives.** After any round in which it takes 15 or more damage it dives and is gone for an hour, then returns.
**Sounding.** Its clicks can be felt through a hull. The party always knows it is there, and always knows it is coming.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 it sounds, passes, and is gone · 5 it surfaces beside the boat and does nothing · 6 it has been harpooned before, and it remembers.
**Harvest.** Spermaceti, 6d6 gp and five slots, worth more than most cargoes. Ambergris, on a 1–2 on 1d6, 10d6 gp and one slot. Blubber, 4d6 gp and thirty flasks of oil.

sabretooth cat.name: Sabre-Tooth Cat
sabretooth cat.desc: The fangs reach past its jaw, and it hunts mammoth.
sabretooth cat.stat: AC 13, HP 34, ATK 2 claw +5 (1d8) and 1 bite +5 (2d6), MV double near, S +5, D +2, C +3, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 7
traits: **Pin.** A character hit by both claws in one turn is pinned: DC 15 STR to escape, and the bite has advantage against them.
**Drag Away.** A character reduced to 0 HP is dragged off on its next turn rather than struck again.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it is feeding and will not be disturbed · 2–3 it follows the party for a day · 4–6 it hunts.
**Harvest.** Fangs, 3d6 gp the pair, no slot. Pelt, 2d6 gp, two slots.

woolly rhinocero.name: Woolly Rhinoceros
woolly rhinocero.desc: Head down, going at a run, and it does not steer.
woolly rhinocero.stat: AC 14, HP 33, ATK 2 gore +5 (2d8), MV double near, S +5, D -1, C +5, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Charge.** If it moves a full double near first, its first gore does 3d8 and the target makes DC 15 STR or is thrown a full near and knocked flat.
**Cannot Turn.** After a charge it must spend its next action turning. A party that scatters and lets it pass is not pursued that round.
**Thick Hide.** Takes half damage from arrows and bolts.
**Short Sighted.** It attacks whatever moved most recently, which can be used against it.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it ignores the party entirely · 3 it blocks the route and will not be moved · 4–6 it charges.
**Harvest.** Horn, 4d6 gp and two slots, and every alchemist in the world wants one. Hide, 2d6 gp, four slots.

walru.name: Walrus
walru.desc: Two tons of it on the ice between the party and the boat.
walru.stat: AC 12, HP 18, ATK 1 tusk +3 (1d8), MV double near (swim), S +4, D -1, C +4, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Owns The Ice.** The haul-out is the only solid ice for a mile and it is covered in them. Going around costs half a day.
**Hooks The Ice.** On a natural 20 it drives a tusk through the floe: every character on it makes DC 12 DEX or goes into the water.
**Slow On Land.** It cannot pursue on ice. In the water it is faster than any swimmer.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 the herd shuffles aside · 4 a bull blocks the route and bellows · 5–6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Ivory, 3d6 gp per tusk, one slot each. Blubber, 2d6 gp and fifteen flasks of oil, three slots. Meat, 3d6 rations.

ice worm.name: Ice Worm
ice worm.desc: Six feet of it, blue-white, and it moves through solid ice as if it were water.
ice worm.stat: AC 13, HP 16, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6 + cold), MV double near (burrow), S +2, D +1, C +3, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Cold.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6 and have disadvantage on the next attack as the hand goes dead.
**Through The Ice.** It attacks from directly beneath, through what the party is standing on. It cannot be seen coming and cannot be blocked.
**Hates Fire.** Takes double damage from fire and checks morale whenever a fire effect strikes it.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they move off through the ice · 3–6 they come up under the party.
**Harvest.** Chill glands, 2d6 gp, and one can be thrown as a flask for 2d6 cold damage. One slot.

arctic wolf.name: Arctic Wolf
arctic wolf.desc: White, heavier than the grey kind, and the pack does not break for anything.
arctic wolf.stat: AC 13, HP 17, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d8), MV double near, S +3, D +2, C +3, I -2, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Pack.** Attacks with advantage while the wolves outnumber the party.
**Does Not Break.** Never checks morale while three or more remain. They have nowhere else to eat.
**Waits For The Night.** They follow for 1d6 days and attack at the coldest hour of the watch, when the fire is lowest.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 they let the party pass · 2–3 they shadow the party and attack the night watch · 4–6 they hunt now.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 2d6 gp each. One slot per pelt, and worth double in any southern city.

snow adder.name: Snow Adder
snow adder.desc: Pale blue and the length of an arm, coiled in the lee of every rock.
snow adder.stat: AC 12, HP 11, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d4 + venom), MV near (burrow), S +0, D +3, C +2, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6 and have movement halved for an hour as the limb stiffens.
**In The Shelter.** They are always in the one place out of the wind, which is where the party wants to camp.
**Ambush.** They always strike first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they are too cold to do anything at all · 4–6 they strike.
**Harvest.** Venom, 1d6 gp. Skin, 1d4 gp. No slot.

ptarmigan flock.name: Ptarmigan Flock
ptarmigan flock.desc: White on white until they burst out from underfoot, all at once.
ptarmigan flock.stat: AC 12, HP 7, ATK 1 peck +1 (1), MV double near (fly), S -2, D +3, C +2, I -3, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Not A Fight.** Ptarmigan never attack. They explode out of the snow and are gone; taking one is a DC 12 DEX check.
**Gives Away The Watch.** Whatever is in the hex now knows exactly where the party is. The party cannot surprise anything for the next hour.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–6 they flush. Catching them is the only question.
**Harvest.** Meat, one ration per bird — the single most welcome thing on the ice.

carrion gull.name: Carrion Gull
carrion gull.desc: Grey, enormous, and they have followed the party for three days waiting.
carrion gull.stat: AC 12, HP 6, ATK 1 beak +1 (1d4), MV double near (fly), S +0, D +2, C +2, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Carrion Only.** They attack only characters at or below half HP. With no such character present they have no legal target and do not attack, whatever the reaction roll says.
**Takes The Cache.** Any food cached or sledged uncovered is found and taken: 1d6 rations.
**Follows.** Once they have found the party they stay with it until it leaves the terrain.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they circle and wait · 4–5 they rob the sledge · 6 they come down on the wounded.
**Harvest.** Eggs from a cliff, 1d6 rations. Down, 1d4 gp.

ice mite.name: Ice Mite
ice mite.desc: They live in the crust and they are the reason the crust gives way.
ice mite.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4), MV near (burrow), S -4, D +2, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Honeycombed.** The snow where they live will not hold weight. The first character across makes DC 12 DEX or breaks through to the waist and loses their turn.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** Always swarms whatever breaks through into the colony.
**Harvest.** None.

snow flea.name: Snow Flea
snow flea.desc: Black specks on the white, in their millions, and they get into the furs.
snow flea.stat: AC 11, HP 7, ATK 1 bite +1 (1), MV near, S -4, D +3, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **In The Furs.** A character who sleeps in infested furs gains no benefit from the rest and must spend an hour beating them out at dawn.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** Always infests. There is no fight.
**Harvest.** None.

lemming swarm.name: Lemming Swarm
lemming swarm.desc: Thousands of them, all going the same way, and not one of them will turn aside.
lemming swarm.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 bite +1 (1), MV double near (burrow), S -3, D +2, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Not A Fight.** They do not attack. They run over everything in their path, including the party's camp.
**Flattens The Camp.** Any camp in their line is wrecked. The party loses 1d6 rations and one item left on the ground, GM's choice.
**What Follows Them.** Everything that eats lemmings is a day behind. Roll on this table again.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–6 they pour past. Whatever is behind them is the encounter.
**Harvest.** Meat, 1d4 very poor rations.

reindeer.name: Reindeer
reindeer.desc: Food, hides, and the only reason anyone lives up here.
reindeer.stat: AC 12, HP 6, ATK 1 antler +1 (1d4), MV double near, S +2, D +2, C +3, I -3, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Not A Fight.** The herd flees. In autumn a bull will stand and charge.
**Catchable.** A day's work and DC 15 WIS or CHA takes one as a draught animal carrying eight slots.
**Follows The Herd.** A party travelling with the herd needs no food and no navigation check while it stays with them.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 the herd moves off · 5 one may be taken · 6 a bull in rut charges.
**Harvest.** Hide, 2d6 gp, one slot. Meat, 2d6 rations per beast. Antlers, 1d6 gp.

frost leech.name: Frost Leech
frost leech.desc: In the meltwater at the glacier's edge, and the cold means you feel nothing.
frost leech.stat: AC 11, HP 12, ATK 1 attach +2 (1), MV near (swim), S -2, D +0, C +3, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Drain.** A character with leeches attached loses 1d4 HP at the start of each leech turn — once, not once per leech — until all are destroyed.
**Numb.** A character does not notice they are attached until they stop moving. They are discovered at the next rest, having already drained once.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** Always attaches to whatever crosses the meltwater.
**Harvest.** None.

snow owl.name: Snow Owl
snow owl.desc: Four feet of wingspan and it makes no sound whatever.
snow owl.stat: AC 13, HP 11, ATK 2 talon +2 (1d4), MV double near (fly), S +1, D +4, C +2, I -2, W +3, Ch -2, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Silent.** It is never heard. Automatic surprise, and its first attack has advantage.
**At The Face.** On a natural 20 the target makes DC 12 CON or is blinded for 1d4 rounds.
**Takes The Small.** It attacks halflings, gnomes and familiars before anyone else, and will carry one off.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it watches from a rock and is not noticed at all · 4–5 it drives the party off a nest · 6 it strikes.
**Harvest.** Down, 2d6 gp — the warmest lining there is. One slot. Pinions, 1d6 gp.

crevasse spider.name: Crevasse Spider
crevasse spider.desc: The crevasse is bridged with web and snow has settled on the web.
crevasse spider.stat: AC 13, HP 15, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d6 + venom), MV near (climb), S +1, D +3, C +2, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **The Bridge.** What looks like a snow bridge is web. The first character onto it makes DC 15 DEX or falls through and is held, hanging over the drop and attacked with advantage.
**Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6 and be unable to climb for 1d4 rounds.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Reactions (d6).** Always attacks whatever is in the web.
**Harvest.** Silk, 2d6 gp and 100 feet of rope that does not freeze. One slot.

musk ox.name: Musk Ox
musk ox.desc: They form a ring with the calves inside and they wait for you to try.
musk ox.stat: AC 12, HP 19, ATK 1 gore +3 (1d8), MV double near, S +4, D +0, C +4, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 3
traits: **The Ring.** While three or more stand they form a circle. No character may attack a calf, and every ox attacks with advantage against anything within close.
**Charge.** If one moves a full double near first, the gore does 2d6 and the target makes DC 12 STR or is knocked flat.
**Will Not Flee.** Never checks morale while in the ring.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they form the ring and nothing else happens · 3–4 the ring holds the only pass · 5–6 the bull charges.
**Harvest.** Hide, 2d6 gp and three slots. Wool, 2d6 gp and one slot, finer than anything woven. Meat, 2d6 rations.

glacier toad.name: Glacier Toad
glacier toad.desc: Grey, the size of a shield, and the air around it hurts.
glacier toad.stat: AC 12, HP 19, ATK 1 bite +3 (2d4), MV near (swim), S +2, D +0, C +3, I -3, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Cold Aura.** Every creature within close at the start of its turn makes DC 9 CON or takes 1d4.
**Still As A Stone.** Cannot be noticed in the ice without a DC 15 WIS check.
**Slow.** It cannot pursue. Anything that walks away is not followed.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it sits and is never noticed · 4–6 it bites whatever comes within close.
**Harvest.** Glands, 2d6 gp to an alchemist and they hold the cold for a month. One slot.

dire wolverine.name: Dire Wolverine
dire wolverine.desc: Forty pounds of it, and it will take a kill off a bear.
dire wolverine.stat: AC 13, HP 22, ATK 2 claw +3 (1d6 + rend), MV double near (burrow), S +3, D +1, C +4, I -2, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Rend.** If both claws hit the same target in one round, that target takes an extra 2d6 and makes DC 12 CON or bleeds 1d4 at the start of each of their turns until they rest.
**No Morale, No Sense.** Never checks morale. It does not retreat, consider odds, or recognise that it is losing.
**Takes The Kill.** It attacks whoever is carrying meat or harvest, before anyone else, and will leave with it.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it takes the harvest and goes · 2–6 it attacks, and goes on attacking.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 3d6 gp — it does not frost, which makes it the only hood worth having. One slot.

polar bear.name: Polar Bear
polar bear.desc: It has been stalking the party for two miles and it did it from downwind.
polar bear.stat: AC 13, HP 34, ATK 2 claw +6 (2d6), MV near (climb), S +4, D +1, C +3, I -2, W +1, Ch -2, AL N, LV 7
traits: **Stalks.** Automatic surprise on open ice or snow. It has been following for 1d6 hours before it is ever seen.
**Hunts Men.** It is the one animal on the list that considers a person food on purpose. It does not bluff, display, or warn.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it is already feeding and may be avoided · 2 it takes a seal instead · 3–6 it hunts the party.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 4d6 gp and four slots. Fat, 2d6 gp and twelve flasks of oil. The liver is poisonous and has killed people who did not know that.

woolly mammoth.name: Woolly Mammoth
woolly mammoth.desc: A hill with tusks, and the herd behind it is twelve more hills.
woolly mammoth.stat: AC 14, HP 41, ATK 3 stomp +6 (2d10) or 1 tusk +6 (3d8), MV double near, S +6, D -1, C +5, I -1, W +3, Ch -1, AL N, LV 8
traits: **Trample.** A character knocked flat takes 2d10 automatically at the start of the mammoth's next turn.
**Unstoppable.** Never checks morale. Immune to fear and to anything that would move it against its will.
**Would Rather Not.** It is not a predator. It attacks what threatens a calf or blocks the herd, and a party that stands aside is never attacked at all.
**The Herd.** On a 1–3 on 1d6 there are 1d6 more within near. They do not join the fight unless a calf is harmed, at which point every one of them does.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 the herd passes and the party had better be elsewhere · 4 the matriarch drives the party out of the hex without closing · 5–6 it charges.

**Harvest.** Ivory, 5d6 gp per tusk and three slots each — the reason anyone comes north and the reason most of them stay. Hide, 3d6 gp, four slots. Wool, 2d6 gp. Meat, 4d6 rations, far more than anyone can carry off.

cave python.name: Cave Python
cave python.desc: White as a root and thick as a man, it has never seen light and does not need to.
cave python.stat: AC 14, HP 30, ATK 1 bite +4 (1d8 + coil), MV near (climb, swim), S +4, D +1, C +3, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 6
traits: **Coil.** On a hit, DC 15 STR or be grappled. A grappled character takes 1d8 automatically at the start of each of the snake's turns and cannot act except to escape, DC 15 STR.
**Blind.** Immune to anything requiring sight. It hunts by warmth.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it is torpid and ignores everything · 2–3 it withdraws into a crack · 4–6 it takes the nearest character.
**Harvest.** Skin, 3d6 gp. Two slots.

cave fisher.name: Cave Fisher
cave fisher.desc: A lobster the size of a dog, on the ceiling, fishing with a line.
cave fisher.stat: AC 14, HP 19, ATK 2 pincer +3 (1d8 + crush), MV near (climb), S +4, D +1, C +3, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Line.** Before combat it casts a filament at one character at near: DC 15 STR or be hauled up toward the ceiling, helpless, and attacked with advantage. The line can be cut — AC 14, 5 damage.
**Ambush.** It always strikes first and before any ranged attack.
**Crush.** On a pincer hit, DC 12 STR or be held and take the damage automatically each round.
**Will Not Come Down.** It fights from the ceiling and withdraws upward if reduced below half HP.
**Reactions (d6).** Always fishes. It has nothing else to do and no reason to stop.
**Harvest.** Filament, 2d6 gp and 100 feet of line that holds a man. One slot. Meat, 1d6 rations.

cave toad.name: Cave Toad
cave toad.desc: Grey, the size of a hound, and the tongue comes out of the dark.
cave toad.stat: AC 12, HP 16, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d8) or 1 tongue (near) +3, MV double near (climb, swim), S +2, D +1, C +3, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Tongue.** On a hit, DC 12 STR or be dragged within close and attacked with advantage next round.
**Swallows Whole.** A halfling or gnome reduced to 0 HP is swallowed and takes 1d4 a round until cut out.
**Still As A Stone.** Cannot be noticed without a DC 15 WIS check. Automatic surprise.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it sits and is never found · 4–6 it takes the smallest character.
**Harvest.** Glands, 1d6 gp. Legs, 1d4 rations.

giant gecko.name: Giant Gecko
giant gecko.desc: Four feet of it, upside down on the ceiling, watching the lamp.
giant gecko.stat: AC 13, HP 13, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d6), MV double near (climb), S +2, D +3, C +2, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Walks Anywhere.** Ceiling, wall or overhang at full speed. It attacks from above and withdraws out of reach afterward.
**Drops On The Light.** It attacks whoever is carrying the lantern, every time.
**Sheds Its Tail.** The first time it would be hit, the tail comes away instead and the attack misses. Once only.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it scuttles off across the ceiling · 4–6 it drops on the lamp-bearer.
**Harvest.** Hide, 1d6 gp — gloves made of it grip stone. One slot.

carrion beetle.name: Carrion Beetle
carrion beetle.desc: They have found something dead, and they are not fussy about how recently.
carrion beetle.stat: AC 14, HP 12, ATK 2 bite +2 (1d4), MV double near (climb), S +1, D +1, C +2, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Takes The Dead.** They go to a corpse or a carcass in preference to the living, and will leave with it. A party that drops a dead thing can walk past.
**Armoured.** Takes half damage from piercing weapons.
**Stink.** They cannot surprise anyone — the smell precedes them by a chamber — and nothing they are near can be smelled either.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 they take the dead and go · 4–6 they attack what is nearest.
**Harvest.** Carapace, 1d4 gp. One slot per three.

blind cave fish.name: Blind Cave Fish
blind cave fish.desc: A pool full of them, and they have no idea what a hand is.
blind cave fish.stat: AC 12, HP 1, ATK 1 bite +1 (1), MV double near (swim), S -2, D +2, C +1, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 0
traits: **Not A Fight.** They do not attack unless the pool is entered, and then only in curiosity.
**Blind.** They hunt by vibration. A character who enters the water and stays perfectly still is ignored entirely.
**Easy Taking.** They have no predators here and no caution: catching them needs no check at all.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–5 they investigate and disperse · 6 they nibble at whoever is in the water, for 1 HP a round.
**Harvest.** Meat, 1d6 rations. The water they live in is safe to drink.

cave cricket.name: Cave Cricket
cave cricket.desc: The size of a cat, and the whole passage leaps at once.
cave cricket.stat: AC 12, HP 5, ATK 1 bite +1 (1d4), MV double near (climb), S +0, D +3, C +1, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Leaps.** They cross a full double near in one bound and arrive from every direction at once.
**Startled.** They attack only in the round they are disturbed. After that they scatter into cracks and are gone.
**The Noise.** The clatter carries. Whatever is in the next three chambers now knows the party is here.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–4 they leap past and are gone · 5–6 they leap onto the party first.
**Harvest.** Meat, 1d4 rations, if anyone is hungry enough.

glow worm.name: Glow Worm
glow worm.desc: A ceiling of green stars, which is beautiful, and a floor of sticky threads, which is not.
glow worm.stat: AC 11, HP 4, ATK 1 thread +1 (1), MV close, S -3, D +0, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **Lures.** The light draws anything that flies. A party that rests beneath a colony is found by 2d6 of something else — roll on this table and read the result as what arrives.
**Threads.** A character who walks through the curtain makes DC 9 DEX or is stuck fast and must spend an action tearing free.
**Lights The Cave.** While a colony is overhead no torch is needed, and nothing in the cave can be surprised either.
**Reactions (d6).** No reaction. They hang there and let the cave come to them.
**Harvest.** A jar of them, 1d6 gp, and it lights a room for a week. One slot.

albino rat.name: Albino Rat
albino rat.desc: The same as any other rat, except they have never seen a light and do not fear it.
albino rat.stat: AC 11, HP 1, ATK 1 bite +1 (1 + infection), MV double near (climb, swim), S -1, D +2, C +2, I -3, W +1, Ch -3, AL N, LV 0
traits: **No Fear Of Fire.** They do not scatter from torches, and a party that relies on that will be surprised.
**Infection.** A wounded character has a 1-in-6 chance of losing a further 1d4 HP.
**Eats The Packs.** Any pack left on the ground for an hour loses 1d6 rations and one item of leather.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they flow past · 3–6 they swarm whatever is warm.
**Harvest.** None.

fungu gnat.name: Fungus Gnat
fungu gnat.desc: They live in the shelf fungus and they go for the eyes and the mouth.
fungu gnat.stat: AC 11, HP 5, ATK 1 swarm +1 (1), MV double near (fly), S -4, D +2, C +1, I -4, W +0, Ch -4, AL N, LV 1
traits: **In The Eyes.** Each round, every character within the cloud makes DC 9 CON or has disadvantage on all rolls that round.
**Spores.** A character who fails twice makes DC 12 CON or loses 1d4 maximum HP until a week's rest as the spores take.
**Mindless.** Immune to morale and fear.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they settle back onto the fungus · 3–6 they stay on the party for as long as it is in the chamber.
**Harvest.** The fungus itself, 1d4 rations and 1d4 gp to an apothecary. One slot.

cave spider.name: Cave Spider
cave spider.desc: The web is across the passage at the height of a face and there is no going round.
cave spider.stat: AC 13, HP 11, ATK 1 bite +2 (1d6 + venom), MV double near (climb), S +0, D +4, C +1, I -3, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Web.** The first character into it makes DC 12 STR or is held and attacked with advantage until free.
**From The Ceiling.** It drops. Automatic surprise in any chamber it has webbed.
**Poison.** On a hit, DC 12 CON or take an extra 1d6 and have disadvantage on DEX checks for an hour.
**Reactions (d6).** Always attacks whatever is in the web.
**Harvest.** Silk, 1d6 gp and 50 feet of rope. One slot.

giant cave shrew.name: Giant Cave Shrew
giant cave shrew.desc: Blind, frantic, and it must eat three times its weight before dawn.
giant cave shrew.stat: AC 12, HP 10, ATK 2 bite +2 (1d4), MV double near (burrow), S +1, D +3, C +2, I -3, W +2, Ch -4, AL N, LV 2
traits: **Frantic.** It acts before initiative every round.
**Blind.** Immune to light, darkness and illusion alike. It hunts by sound and cannot be hidden from except by standing still.
**Starving.** Never checks morale while anything edible is within near, which is always.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it is already eating something · 2–6 it attacks immediately.
**Harvest.** Nothing.

blind cave lizard.name: Blind Cave Lizard
blind cave lizard.desc: Pale, long-legged, and it runs down everything in this cave for a living.
blind cave lizard.stat: AC 13, HP 15, ATK 1 bite +3 (1d8), MV double near (climb), S +2, D +3, C +2, I -4, W +2, Ch -4, AL N, LV 3
traits: **Blind.** Immune to light, darkness and illusion. It hunts by sound alone.
**Runs Them Down.** It moves double near and attacks in the same round. Nobody in armour outruns it.
**Hunts The Noisy.** It attacks the character in the heaviest armour, or whoever last shouted.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 it keeps its distance · 3–6 it runs the party down.
**Harvest.** Hide, 1d6 gp, one slot. Meat, 1d6 rations.

albino ape.name: Albino Ape
albino ape.desc: White, hairless, and it has been down here long enough to have lost its eyes.
albino ape.stat: AC 13, HP 20, ATK 2 fist +3 (1d6) or 1 thrown stone (near) +3 (1d6), MV double near (climb), S +4, D +1, C +3, I -1, W +2, Ch -2, AL N, LV 4
traits: **Blind.** Immune to light, darkness and illusion. It hunts by echo and cannot be hidden from by any means but silence.
**Throws Stones.** It will stand off and throw for two rounds before closing, and it does not miss by much.
**Troop.** Attacks with advantage while the apes outnumber the party.
**Hates The Light.** Any bright light causes it to check morale immediately — not from fear of being seen, but from the heat.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–2 they withdraw up the chimney · 3–4 they throw until the party leaves · 5–6 they close.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 1d6 gp. Two slots. Nobody wants it, but it is warm.

great mole.name: Great Mole
great mole.desc: Twelve feet long, blind, and it does not know the party is there until it is among them.
great mole.stat: AC 14, HP 37, ATK 2 claw +6 (2d8), MV double near (burrow), S +5, D -1, C +5, I -3, W +2, Ch -4, AL N, LV 7
traits: **Comes Through The Wall.** It burrows a full move and attacks in the same round, from any surface including the floor and the ceiling. It cannot be positioned against.
**Collapse.** Every round it digs, the chamber degrades. On a 1–2 on 1d6 a section comes down: every character makes DC 15 DEX or takes 2d6 and is pinned until they or an ally spend an action.
**Blind.** Immune to anything requiring sight. It hunts by tremor, and a character who stays absolutely still cannot be targeted.
**Not Hunting.** It is digging. It attacks what is in the way, and once the party is behind it, it never turns back.
**Reactions (d6).** 1–3 it passes through the chamber and keeps going · 4–6 it clears the obstruction, which is the party.
**Harvest.** Pelt, 3d6 gp and three slots — a remarkable fur that has never seen daylight. Claws, 2d6 gp.

young purple worm.name: Young Purple Worm
young purple worm.desc: Thirty feet, which is the small one, and the tunnel it made is how you got in.
young purple worm.stat: AC 14, HP 41, ATK 3 bite +7 (2d10 + swallow) or 1 sting +7 (1d10 + venom), MV double near (burrow), S +6, D -2, C +5, I -4, W +1, Ch -4, AL N, LV 8
traits: **Swallow.** A character reduced to 0 HP by the bite is swallowed. They take 1d6 a round inside and can cut out with 20 damage to the gut wall, or be recovered if the worm dies within 1d6 rounds.
**Poison.** On a sting hit, DC 15 CON or take an extra 4d6.
**Blind.** It hunts entirely by tremor. A character who takes no action at all cannot be targeted by it.
**Fills The Tunnel.** In any passage, only one character can engage it, and nobody behind that character can attack at all.
**No Morale.** Never checks morale. It is not capable of the concept.
**Reactions (d6).** 1 it is sleeping off something large · 2 it passes through the wall and is gone · 3–6 it attacks.
**Harvest.** Poison sac, 4d6 gp — DC 15 DEX to draw, 4d6 damage on a failure. Hide plates, 3d6 gp, four slots. Whatever is in the gut: roll two treasures.
